examples.en: The late penalty caps at thirty percent, so submit anyway.
examples.zh: 「迟交扣分」上限是百分之三十，所以还是要交。

words.enDefinition: marks taken off for an error or broken rule

examples.en: Each formatting error in the file carries a small point deduction.
examples.zh: 文件里每个格式错误都会有少量「扣分」。

examples.en: There's an automatic two-point deduction for a missing cover page.
examples.zh: 少了封面页会自动「扣两分」。

words.enDefinition: optional work that adds points beyond the normal total

examples.en: This problem set includes an extra credit question worth five points.
examples.zh: 这份习题集里有一道值五分的「附加分」题。

examples.en: Extra credit lifted my grade from B minus to B.
examples.zh: 「附加分」让我的成绩从 B− 升到了 B。

words.enDefinition: some points awarded even when the final answer is wrong

examples.en: Even with the wrong answer, I earned partial credit for the setup.
examples.zh: 虽然答案错了，但列式正确，我拿到了「过程分」。

examples.en: Show every step; the graders give partial credit for correct methods.
examples.zh: 每一步都写出来，方法对就有「过程分」。

words.enDefinition: all the points available for an item

examples.en: Follow the required format exactly if you want full credit.
examples.zh: 想要拿「满分」，就要严格按要求的格式来。

examples.en: You only get full credit if every part of the question is answered.
examples.zh: 只有每小问都答到才能拿「满分」。

words.enDefinition: the official solutions used to check or grade work

examples.en: The TA posted the answer key after the problem set closed.
examples.zh: 习题集提交截止后，助教上传了「参考答案」。

examples.en: Check your work against the answer key before asking questions.
examples.zh: 提问之前，先对照「参考答案」检查一遍。

words.enDefinition: write out each step instead of only the final answer

examples.en: The instructions say to show your work on every single question.
examples.zh: 要求里说每道题都要「写出解题步骤」。

examples.en: If you show your work, you can still earn partial credit.
examples.zh: 只要「写出解题步骤」，即使答错也有分。

collocations: show your work for each problem

words.enDefinition: the calendar day an assignment must be submitted by

examples.en: The due date for the essay moved from Friday to Monday.
examples.zh: 作文的「截止日期」从周五推迟到了周一。

examples.en: Write every due date into your planner during the first week.
examples.zh: 第一周就把每个「截止日期」写进计划本。

words.enDefinition: must be handed in the very next day

examples.en: The essay is due tomorrow and I still need a conclusion.
examples.zh: 作文「明天截止」，我还差个结论。

examples.en: My lab report is due tomorrow, so tonight is crunch time.
examples.zh: 实验报告「明天截止」，今晚进入冲刺模式。

words.enDefinition: finish and submit before the deadline passes

examples.en: We worked all weekend to meet the deadline for the report.
examples.zh: 为了赶上报告的「截止时间」，我们干了一整个周末。

examples.en: She trimmed two sections to meet the deadline in time.
examples.zh: 为了「赶上截止时间」，她删掉了两个部分。

words.enDefinition: fail to submit before the deadline passes

examples.en: Miss a deadline in this class and you lose ten percent.
examples.zh: 这门课「错过截止时间」就扣百分之十。

examples.en: I missed a deadline once and now I start assignments three days early.
examples.zh: 我「错过」过一次截止时间，现在都提前三天动笔。

collocations: miss a deadline by an hour

words.enDefinition: extra time officially added to a deadline

examples.en: The storm got everyone a deadline extension until Thursday afternoon.
examples.zh: 暴风雨让全班获得「延期」，改到周四下午交。

examples.en: He got a deadline extension because the portal crashed Sunday night.
examples.zh: 因为周日晚上门户崩溃，他拿到了「延期」。

words.enDefinition: a formal ask for more time on an assignment

examples.en: My extension request was approved within an hour of sending it.
examples.zh: 我的「延期申请」发出去一小时内就批了。

examples.en: Attach evidence when you send an extension request by email.
examples.zh: 发「延期申请」邮件时要附上证明材料。

words.enDefinition: formally request more time for an assignment

examples.en: It's better to ask for an extension than to submit unfinished work.
examples.zh: 与其交没写完的作业，不如「申请延期」。

examples.en: Email early if you plan to ask for an extension.
examples.zh: 想「申请延期」的话，要尽早发邮件。

collocations: ask the professor for an extension
never hurts to ask for an extension

words.enDefinition: progressing at the planned pace with nothing late

examples.en: We're on schedule: the outline is done, draft due next week.
examples.zh: 我们「按计划推进」：提纲已完成，初稿下周交。

examples.en: The extra Sunday meeting kept the whole project on schedule.
examples.zh: 临时加开的周日会议让整个项目「按计划推进」。

words.enDefinition: a short window after the deadline with no penalty

examples.en: The portal has a generous ten-minute grace period after midnight.
examples.zh: 门户在午夜后有十分钟宽裕的「宽限期」。

examples.en: Use the grace period only for genuine emergencies, never laziness.
examples.zh: 「宽限期」只留给真正的紧急情况，别拿懒散当借口。

words.enDefinition: a sudden serious problem at home that disrupts study

examples.en: A family emergency pulled her home the week the paper was due.
examples.zh: 论文截止那一周，她因「家庭急事」回了家。

examples.en: Tell your professor early if a family emergency affects your submission.
examples.zh: 如果「家庭急事」影响交作业，要尽早告诉教授。

words.zhGloss: 同时应对多个截止日期
words.enDefinition: handle several deadlines competing for the same days
acceptedZhAnswers: 同时应对多个截止日期

examples.en: I'm juggling deadlines from five different courses all this month.
examples.zh: 这个月我要「同时应对」五门课的截止日期。

examples.en: A planner makes it easier to juggle deadlines without panic.
examples.zh: 有了计划本，「同时应对多个截止日期」就不会慌。

words.enDefinition: one of the students working on a team project

examples.en: One group member never answered any messages all week long.
examples.zh: 有个「组员」一整周都不回任何消息。

examples.en: Every group member writes their name next to their task.
examples.zh: 每个「组员」都在自己的任务旁边写上名字。

words.enDefinition: a fellow member of your project team

examples.en: My teammate covered the slides while I handled the data.
examples.zh: 「队友」负责幻灯片，我处理数据。

examples.en: A good teammate flags problems early instead of hiding them.
examples.zh: 好的「队友」会及早提出问题，而不是藏着掖着。

words.enDefinition: someone who cooperates well in a group

examples.en: Professors can tell who's a team player during group work.
examples.zh: 小组作业时，教授看得出来谁「有团队精神」。

examples.en: Be a team player: share notes and cover for absent members.
examples.zh: 要做「有团队精神的人」：分享笔记，替缺席的成员补位。

words.enDefinition: the member who organizes the team's work

examples.en: Our group leader set a Sunday deadline for individual drafts.
examples.zh: 「小组组长」把个人初稿的截止时间定在周日。

examples.en: The group leader emails the professor on behalf of the team.
examples.zh: 「组长」代表全组给教授发邮件。

words.enDefinition: start organizing and guide the others

examples.en: Nobody wanted to start, so I took the lead on planning.
examples.zh: 没人想开头，我「牵头」做规划。

examples.en: She took the lead on contacting the professor about the deadline.
examples.zh: 就截止日期的事，她「牵头」去联系教授。

collocations: take the lead on a project

words.enDefinition: decide who does which job in the group

examples.en: Assign roles early in the project so nobody stands around confused.
examples.zh: 项目一开始就「分配角色」，免得有人干站着。

examples.en: Our professor made us assign roles in the very first meeting.
examples.zh: 教授要求第一次开会就「分配角色」。

words.enDefinition: splitting the work into separate parts for members

examples.en: A clear division of labor kept our project on schedule.
examples.zh: 明确的「分工」让项目按期推进。

examples.en: Our division of labor fell apart when one member vanished.
examples.zh: 一位成员失联后，我们的「分工」全乱了。

collocations: agree on the division of labor

words.enDefinition: hand specific jobs out to team members

examples.en: Leaders who delegate tasks early avoid the final-week deadline crunch.
examples.zh: 尽早「分派任务」的组长能避开最后一周的赶工。

examples.en: The leader delegated tasks based on each member's individual strengths.
examples.zh: 组长按每个人的长处「分派任务」。

words.enDefinition: do most of the work while others contribute little

examples.en: She carried the whole team when two members went quiet.
examples.zh: 两位成员失联后，是她「扛起了全组」。

examples.en: I'm so tired of carrying the team through every deadline.
examples.zh: 每次都是我「扛起全组」赶截止日期，我太累了。

collocations: carry the team on group projects

words.enDefinition: handle the hardest, biggest part of the work

examples.en: Maya did the heavy lifting on the data analysis section.
examples.zh: 数据分析部分由 Maya「挑大梁」。

examples.en: You did the heavy lifting; let me handle the slides.
examples.zh: 你已经「挑了大梁」，幻灯片交给我。

collocations: do the heavy lifting on the report

words.enDefinition: work less hard than you should

examples.en: He slacked off for weeks and panicked the night before.
examples.zh: 他「偷懒」了几周，交稿前夜才慌。

examples.en: Don't slack off just because the deadline is far away.
examples.zh: 别因为截止日期还远就「摸鱼」。

collocations: slack off early in the term

words.enDefinition: a scheduled get-together to work on the project

examples.en: Our group meeting is Sundays at the library, third floor.
examples.zh: 我们的「小组会议」定在周日，图书馆三楼。

examples.en: Skip two group meetings and the team starts without you.
examples.zh: 缺席两次「小组会议」，大家就会甩开你推进。

words.enDefinition: two commitments that clash on the calendar

examples.en: A scheduling conflict with practice means we meet Thursday instead.
examples.zh: 因为训练的「时间冲突」，我们改到周四见面。

examples.en: Half the team has a scheduling conflict with evening meetings.
examples.zh: 一半成员晚上有「时间冲突」，没法开会。

collocations: sorry, I have a scheduling conflict

words.enDefinition: briefly meet or message to share progress

examples.en: Let's check in every Wednesday so that nobody falls behind.
examples.zh: 我们每周三「碰一次进度」，免得有人掉队。

examples.en: The professor asks groups to check in by email weekly.
examples.zh: 教授要求各小组每周邮件「同步进度」。

words.enDefinition: an online file everyone in the team can edit

examples.en: Put the outline in a shared document so everyone can comment.
examples.zh: 把提纲放进「共享文档」，大家都能评论。

examples.en: Our shared document clearly shows who edited which paragraph last.
examples.zh: 「共享文档」能清楚看出谁最后改了哪一段。

collocations: a shared document for the outline

words.enDefinition: a common drive folder holding the team's files

examples.en: Drop all your sources into the shared folder before Friday.
examples.zh: 周五前把所有资料放进「共享文件夹」。

examples.en: The shared folder holds our drafts, data sets, and slides.
examples.zh: 「共享文件夹」里放着我们的草稿、数据和幻灯片。

collocations: upload it to the shared folder

words.enDefinition: permission to make changes to a shared file

examples.en: Give every group member edit access before the first draft.
examples.zh: 初稿之前要给每个组员开「编辑权限」。

examples.en: I only had view rights, so I requested edit access.
examples.zh: 我只有查看权，所以申请了「编辑权限」。

words.enDefinition: members rating each other's contribution to a project

examples.en: Our peer evaluation scores adjust each person's final grade individually.
examples.zh: 「组内互评」的分数会单独调整每人的最终成绩。

examples.en: The peer evaluation form asks how fairly the work was divided.
examples.zh: 「互评表」会问分工是否公平。

words.enDefinition: one score the whole team receives for a project

examples.en: Everyone gets exactly the same group grade on this project.
examples.zh: 这个项目所有人拿完全相同的「小组共同成绩」。

examples.en: Your individual reflection can slightly adjust the group grade at the end.
examples.zh: 个人反思在最后会微调「小组共同成绩」。

words.enDefinition: the member who delivers part of a talk

examples.en: Each presenter gets exactly two minutes, and not a second more.
examples.zh: 每位「汇报人」限时正好两分钟，一秒都不能超。

examples.en: Practice the handovers so one presenter doesn't talk over another.
examples.zh: 排练好交接，免得「汇报人」互相抢话。

words.enDefinition: practice a presentation before delivering it

examples.en: Rehearse the whole talk twice with a timer before presentation day.
examples.zh: 展示日之前拿计时器把整场「排练」两遍。

examples.en: We rehearsed the handovers between speakers until they were smooth.
examples.zh: 我们反复「排练」演讲者之间的交接，直到流畅为止。

words.enDefinition: a checkpoint marking major progress on a project

examples.en: Finish the user survey by Friday; it's our first milestone.
examples.zh: 周五前完成用户问卷，这是我们的第一个「阶段节点」。

examples.en: The professor checks progress at each milestone of the project.
examples.zh: 教授会在项目的每个「阶段节点」来查进度。

words.enDefinition: the member who keeps everyone's parts moving together

examples.en: As coordinator, I track deadlines and progress for every section.
examples.zh: 作为「统筹人」，我跟踪各部分的截止日期和进度。

examples.en: Our coordinator merged everyone's slides into one single deck overnight.
examples.zh: 「统筹人」连夜把大家的幻灯片合成了一份。

words.enDefinition: work achieved by everyone contributing together

examples.en: Getting the report in on time took a real group effort.
examples.zh: 报告能按时交，靠的是大家的「共同努力」。

examples.en: The presentation was a group effort from outline to delivery.
examples.zh: 这次展示从提纲到上台都是「集体努力」的成果。

collocations: the result of a group effort

words.enDefinition: the written record of what a meeting decided

examples.en: Post the meeting notes in the shared folder tonight, please.
examples.zh: 麻烦今晚把「会议记录」传到共享文件夹。

examples.en: Our meeting notes list every task and the person responsible.
examples.zh: 「会议记录」上列了每项任务和负责人。

words.enDefinition: the specific tasks agreed at a meeting

examples.en: Every meeting should end with clear action items and owners.
examples.zh: 每次开会都应该定下明确的「待办事项」和负责人。

examples.en: I emailed the action items to everyone after Sunday's meeting.
examples.zh: 周日开完会，我把「待办事项」邮件发给了大家。

collocations: follow up on the action items

words.enDefinition: a set of questions students must solve for homework

examples.en: The problem set is due Friday, and question four is taking me forever.
examples.zh: 「习题集」周五截止，第四题花了我好长时间。

examples.en: Did you finish the problem set for linear algebra yet?
examples.zh: 你线性代数的「习题集」做完了吗？

words.enDefinition: an exercise for drilling a skill before graded work

examples.en: She warmed up with a few practice problems before starting the graded set.
examples.zh: 开始做计分作业前，她先练了几道「练习题」找感觉。

examples.en: I redo the practice problems until each solution method feels automatic.
examples.zh: 我会反复刷「练习题」，直到每种解法都熟练为止。

words.enDefinition: a short written reaction to readings due every week

examples.en: Our weekly response is due every Thursday night before midnight.
examples.zh: 我们的「每周短评」每周四午夜前要交。

examples.en: Keep each weekly response to about three hundred words maximum.
examples.zh: 每篇「每周短评」控制在三百词以内。

words.enDefinition: the question or instructions your essay must answer

examples.en: Read the essay prompt twice before you start outlining anything.
examples.zh: 动笔列提纲前，先把「作文题目」读两遍。

examples.en: I misread the essay prompt and had to rewrite my whole draft.
examples.zh: 我看错了「作文题目」，只好把整篇初稿重写。

words.enDefinition: a question you must answer in paragraph form

examples.en: Each essay question needs at least three clearly developed supporting points.
examples.zh: 每道「论述题」至少要有三个展开充分的论点。

examples.en: I misread the second essay question and answered the wrong chapter.
examples.zh: 第二道「论述题」我看错了，答错了章节。

words.enDefinition: homework that asks you to write an essay or report

examples.en: The writing assignment asks for two pages on climate policy.
examples.zh: 这份「写作作业」要求就气候政策写两页。

examples.en: She finished the writing assignment a full week before it was due.
examples.zh: 她在截止前整整一周就写完了「写作作业」。

words.enDefinition: chapters or articles you must read before class

examples.en: Finish the reading assignment before Tuesday's seminar or you'll be lost.
examples.zh: 周二研讨课之前要完成「阅读任务」，不然你会跟不上。

examples.en: The reading assignment for this week is two very long chapters.
examples.zh: 本周的「阅读任务」是特别长的两章。

words.enDefinition: homework you complete outside class and submit later

examples.en: The take-home assignment is open for two weeks, so pace yourself.
examples.zh: 这份「课后作业」有两周完成时间，注意安排节奏。

examples.en: I lost points on the take-home assignment for skipping part two.
examples.zh: 「课后作业」我漏做了第二部分，被扣了分。

words.enDefinition: a short paper analyzing your own thoughts or experience

examples.en: The reflection paper asks how the internship shaped your goals.
examples.zh: 这篇「反思报告」要写实习如何影响了你的职业目标。

examples.en: She wrote her reflection paper in first person, as the instructions allowed.
examples.zh: 按要求，她的「反思报告」用第一人称写。

words.enDefinition: a structured write-up of a science experiment

examples.en: My lab report needs graphs, so I'm exporting the data tonight.
examples.zh: 我的「实验报告」需要图表，今晚得把数据导出来。

examples.en: The lab report is due one week after the experiment ends.
examples.zh: 「实验报告」在实验结束后一周内交。

words.enDefinition: a long research paper written across the whole term

examples.en: Her term paper compares two economic models over twelve pages.
examples.zh: 她的「学期论文」用十二页比较了两种经济模型。

examples.en: Start your term paper early because finding sources takes time.
examples.zh: 「学期论文」要早点动笔，查资料很花时间。

words.enDefinition: the major end-of-term paper that counts heavily

examples.en: The final paper counts for forty percent of our grade.
examples.zh: 「期末论文」占我们成绩的百分之四十。

examples.en: I've narrowed my final paper down to two possible topics.
examples.zh: 我把「期末论文」的选题缩小到了两个方向。

words.enDefinition: a detailed analysis of one real example or company

examples.en: Our case study analyzes how the startup lost its early customers.
examples.zh: 我们的「案例分析」研究那家初创公司怎么流失了早期用户。

examples.en: Each group writes a case study on a company of their choice.
examples.zh: 每个小组要自选一家公司写「案例分析」。

words.enDefinition: the posted page detailing one assignment's requirements

examples.en: The assignment sheet lists the format, sources, and due date.
examples.zh: 「作业说明单」上列有格式、资料来源和截止日期。

examples.en: Lost the assignment sheet? Download it again from the course page.
examples.zh: 「作业说明单」丢了？去课程页面再下载一份。

words.enDefinition: your first forum post that classmates then reply to

examples.en: Your initial post is due Wednesday and replies by Friday.
examples.zh: 「首帖」周三截止，回复同学的帖子周五截止。

examples.en: Read the assigned article carefully before drafting your initial post.
examples.zh: 写「首帖」之前要仔细读指定文章。

words.enDefinition: the total amount of work you have to do

examples.en: My workload doubled when all three professors assigned essays at once.
examples.zh: 三位教授同时布置论文，我的「课业负担」翻倍了。

examples.en: A lighter workload this term lets me join a club.
examples.zh: 这学期「课业负担」轻一些，我可以参加社团了。

words.enDefinition: a period when many assignments land at once

examples.en: The workload crunch hit when four essays landed in one week.
examples.zh: 四篇作文挤在同一周，「任务高峰期」来了。

examples.en: During the workload crunch, even sleeping felt like a luxury.
examples.zh: 「任务高峰期」里，连睡觉都成了奢侈。

words.enDefinition: extremely busy with too much to do

examples.en: I'm swamped with three major assignments due the same day.
examples.zh: 三门大作业同一天交，我「忙得不可开交」。

examples.en: She was too swamped to help with the group project this week.
examples.zh: 她这周「忙得不可开交」，顾不上小组项目。

words.enDefinition: overloaded with so much work you can barely cope

examples.en: I'm totally snowed under with three problem sets this week.
examples.zh: 这周我被三份习题集「压得喘不过气」。

examples.en: He's been snowed under ever since the group project started.
examples.zh: 自从小组项目开始，他就一直「忙得团团转」。

words.enDefinition: the intense final period right before deadlines

examples.en: It's crunch time; the essay and the lab report are both due Friday.
examples.zh: 到「冲刺关头」了，作文和实验报告周五都要交。

examples.en: Everyone camps out in the library when crunch time starts.
examples.zh: 一到「冲刺关头」，大家都泡在图书馆。

words.enDefinition: feeling stressed because much is expected quickly

examples.en: I work best under pressure, but not with three essays at once.
examples.zh: 我「承受压力」时效率反而更高，但三篇作文一起也扛不住。

examples.en: She stays calm under pressure and usually finishes her work early.
examples.zh: 她「承受压力」时依然冷静，总能提前完成。

words.enDefinition: delay starting work you should be doing

examples.en: I procrastinated for a week and wrote the essay in one night.
examples.zh: 我「拖」了一周，最后一夜赶完作文。

examples.en: Stop procrastinating; even the outline alone will take two hours.
examples.zh: 别再「拖延」了，光提纲就要写两小时。

words.enDefinition: become so absorbed you forget how long you worked

examples.en: I lost track of time while rewriting and skipped dinner.
examples.zh: 我改稿改得「忘了时间」，晚饭都没吃。

examples.en: Set an alarm so you don't lose track of time on question one.
examples.zh: 定个闹钟，免得做第一题就「忘了时间」。

collocations: tend to lose track of time

words.enDefinition: keep working hard despite tiredness until finished

examples.en: I powered through the last forty pages of the reading.
examples.zh: 我「硬啃」完了阅读材料的最后四十页。

examples.en: Power through tonight; tomorrow you will only need to polish.
examples.zh: 今晚「咬牙冲完」，明天只需润色。

words.enDefinition: start working seriously after slacking off

examples.en: Time to buckle down; the draft is due this Monday.
examples.zh: 该「收心苦干」了，初稿这周一要交。

examples.en: Once the group finally picked a topic, everyone buckled down.
examples.zh: 小组终于定题之后，大家都「埋头苦干」起来。

words.enDefinition: a week packed with assignments and obligations

examples.en: With two essays and a quiz, this is a busy week.
examples.zh: 两篇作文加一个小测，真是「忙碌的一周」。

examples.en: Sunday planning keeps a busy week from spiraling out of control.
examples.zh: 周日做好规划，「忙碌的一周」才不会失控。

words.enDefinition: planning how to divide your hours across tasks

examples.en: Good time management means finishing everything before the panic starts.
examples.zh: 「时间管理」做得好，就能在慌乱来临前全部搞定。

examples.en: The first-year seminar teaches basic time management skills in week one.
examples.zh: 大一研讨课第一周就会教基本的「时间管理」技巧。

words.enDefinition: decide tasks early instead of reacting late

examples.en: Plan ahead and the big assignments stop feeling so scary.
examples.zh: 学会「提前规划」，大作业就没那么吓人了。

examples.en: Planning ahead kept the group project from collapsing in week ten.
examples.zh: 因为「提前规划」，小组项目没有在第十周崩盘。

words.enDefinition: decide which tasks matter most and do them first

examples.en: Prioritize the assignment that counts for thirty percent of the grade.
examples.zh: 「分清轻重缓急」，先做占三成成绩的那份作业。

examples.en: I prioritize my homework by due date and how much it's worth.
examples.zh: 我按截止日期和分值给作业「排优先级」。

words.enDefinition: a notebook or app where you schedule assignments

examples.en: Every Sunday I copy next week's deadlines into my planner.
examples.zh: 每周日我都把下周的截止日期抄进「计划本」。

examples.en: My planner shows the essay due the same day as the lab report.
examples.zh: 「计划本」显示作文和实验报告同一天截止。

words.enDefinition: reserve set hours on your schedule for one task

examples.en: Block out time tonight for the problem set, two full hours.
examples.zh: 今晚「留出整块时间」做习题集，整整两小时。

examples.en: I block out time each morning for the reading assignment.
examples.zh: 我每天早上都会「留出整块时间」做阅读任务。

words.enDefinition: reserve part of your day for a task

examples.en: Set aside time Sunday night to plan the whole week.
examples.zh: 周日晚「抽出时间」规划一周。

examples.en: Set aside time for revisions after you get peer feedback.
examples.zh: 拿到同伴反馈后，要「抽出时间」修改。

collocations: set aside an hour each day

words.enDefinition: keep control of tasks so nothing slips

examples.en: Check the syllabus weekly to stay on top of assignments.
examples.zh: 每周查课程大纲，才能「掌控住」作业进度。

examples.en: Staying on top of small tasks prevents deadline pileups later.
examples.zh: 小任务都「掌控住」，截止日期才不会堆成山。

collocations: hard to stay on top of everything

words.enDefinition: continuously know the state of something

examples.en: Keep track of which group member owes which section this week.
examples.zh: 这周要「随时掌握」每个组员负责哪一部分。

examples.en: I keep track of all my grades in a spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 我在电子表格里「跟进记录」各科成绩。

collocations: hard to keep track of everything

words.enDefinition: a list of items to verify before finishing

examples.en: Run through the whole submission checklist before you hit upload.
examples.zh: 点上传之前，把整份「核对清单」过一遍。

examples.en: My checklist includes format, word count, and the file name.
examples.zh: 我的「核对清单」包括格式、字数和文件名。

words.enDefinition: give yourself a treat after finishing work

examples.en: Reward yourself with milk tea after the essay is submitted.
examples.zh: 作文交完，用奶茶「奖励自己」。

examples.en: I reward myself with one episode per finished problem set.
examples.zh: 每做完一份习题集，我就「奖励自己」看一集剧。

collocations: a small way to reward yourself

words.enDefinition: a first imperfect version you will improve later

examples.en: Finish a rough draft tonight so tomorrow is only for editing.
examples.zh: 今晚先写完「初稿」，明天专心修改。

examples.en: My rough draft was messy, but it gave me something to fix.
examples.zh: 我的「初稿」很粗糙，但至少有东西可改。

words.enDefinition: the polished last version you submit

examples.en: The final draft is due Friday; the rough draft was due Monday.
examples.zh: 「定稿」周五交，初稿周一交。

examples.en: Read your final draft aloud to catch any awkward sentences.
examples.zh: 把「定稿」朗读一遍，找出别扭的句子。

words.enDefinition: comments classmates give on your draft before revision

examples.en: We exchange written peer feedback in class every other week.
examples.zh: 我们每隔一周在课上互换书面「同伴反馈」。

examples.en: The peer feedback pointed out that my argument needed examples.
examples.zh: 「同伴反馈」指出我的论证缺少例子。

words.enDefinition: write something again in order to improve it

examples.en: I had to rewrite the opening paragraph after the professor's comments.
examples.zh: 看了教授的批注，我只好「重写」开头段。

examples.en: Don't rewrite the whole essay; sometimes moving one paragraph fixes it.
examples.zh: 不必「重写」整篇作文，有时挪动一段就解决了。

words.enDefinition: quickly list ideas before you start writing

examples.en: Spend ten minutes brainstorming before you start outlining the essay.
examples.zh: 列作文提纲之前，先花十分钟「头脑风暴」。

examples.en: Our group brainstormed three possible angles for the project topic.
examples.zh: 我们小组就项目主题「头脑风暴」出了三个角度。

words.enDefinition: make final small improvements to a nearly finished draft

examples.en: Polish your conclusion last, once the argument is fully settled.
examples.zh: 论证完全定下来之后，最后再「润色」结论。

examples.en: She spent the entire last hour just polishing her wording.
examples.zh: 最后一小时她全都在「润色」用词。

words.enDefinition: all the assignments a course requires

examples.en: This course's coursework includes labs, essays, and a final report.
examples.zh: 这门课的「课程作业」包括实验、作文和期末报告。

examples.en: Coursework stacks up fast if you skip a single week.
examples.zh: 只要落下一周，「课程作业」就会堆成山。

words.enDefinition: work you created yourself, not copied

examples.en: The submission page makes you promise the file is original work.
examples.zh: 提交页面要求你承诺文件是「原创作品」。

examples.en: Recycled essays from other classes don't count as original work.
examples.zh: 从别的课回收来的论文不算「原创作品」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum time allowed for a task or talk

examples.en: The presentation has a strict ten-minute time limit this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期的展示有严格的十分钟「时间限制」。

examples.en: Practice under the time limit or you will run long.
examples.zh: 要在「时间限制」内练习，不然会超时。

collocations: the time limit is ten minutes

words.enDefinition: do problems or steps one by one until done

examples.en: Work through the problem set in order; each builds on the last.
examples.zh: 习题集要按顺序「逐题做完」，题目环环相扣。

examples.en: We worked through the sample questions together before starting ours.
examples.zh: 动笔之前，我们一起把例题「过了一遍」。

words.enDefinition: be unable to continue on a problem

examples.en: I got stuck on question six for almost an hour.
examples.zh: 第六题我「卡」了快一个小时。

examples.en: If you get stuck, post the question on the class forum.
examples.zh: 「卡住」了就把问题发到课程论坛。

words.enDefinition: request assistance when you cannot manage alone

examples.en: Ask for help early instead of struggling in silence for weeks.
examples.zh: 别闷头硬撑几周，早点「求助」。

examples.en: The TA encourages students to ask for help during lab hours.
examples.zh: 助教鼓励大家在实验课时间「提问求助」。

collocations: not afraid to ask for help

words.enDefinition: the last completed version of a file or paper

examples.en: Email me the final version tonight so I can review it.
examples.zh: 今晚把「最终版」发我，我好看一遍。

examples.en: Compare the final version with the rough draft to see your progress.
examples.zh: 把「最终版」和初稿对比，能看到你的进步。

collocations: the final version of the report

words.enDefinition: an explanation that removes confusion about a task

examples.en: I emailed the TA to ask for clarification on part two.
examples.zh: 第二部分我不懂，邮件向助教要了「澄清说明」。

examples.en: The professor posted a quick clarification about the word count.
examples.zh: 教授就字数问题补发了一份「澄清说明」。

words.enDefinition: unfinished work piling up from earlier days

examples.en: The long weekend cleared my backlog of problem sets completely.
examples.zh: 长周末我清完了「积压任务」，全是习题集。

examples.en: One lazy week creates a backlog that takes three to fix.
examples.zh: 松懈一周，「积压任务」要花三周才能还清。

words.enDefinition: a junior dean supporting college administration

examples.en: The assistant dean manages all of the college's scholarship budgets.
examples.zh: 「院长助理」管理学院的奖学金预算。

examples.en: Ask the assistant dean about any late graduation request forms.
examples.zh: 延迟毕业的申请要找「院长助理」。

words.enDefinition: a junior tenure-track rank below associate professor

examples.en: Professor Lee joined us as an assistant professor straight after her postdoc.
examples.zh: 李教授博士后出站后直接受聘为「助理教授」。

examples.en: Assistant professors often carry heavier teaching loads while seeking tenure.
examples.zh: 「助理教授」在争取终身教职时授课任务往往更重。

words.enDefinition: software and devices that help students read, write, and organize

examples.en: Assistive technology like screen readers is available in the library lab.
examples.zh: 图书馆机房提供屏幕阅读器等「辅助技术」。

examples.en: Ask disability services for free training on assistive technology software.
examples.zh: 可以向残障学生服务处申请「辅助技术」软件的免费培训。

words.enDefinition: a department chair's deputy for scheduling or advising

examples.en: The associate chair resolves schedule conflicts within the whole department.
examples.zh: 系内排课冲突由「副系主任」处理。

examples.en: Bring your course plan to the associate chair for approval.
examples.zh: 选课计划要拿给「副系主任」审批。

words.enDefinition: a dean's deputy handling a specific area

examples.en: The associate dean handles student conduct cases for our college.
examples.zh: 我们学院的「副院长」负责学生纪律事务。

examples.en: Send the appeal to the associate dean if the professor declines.
examples.zh: 教授不同意的话，就把申请发给「副院长」。

words.enDefinition: a two-year degree typically earned at a community college

examples.en: She earned an associate degree at a community college before transferring here.
examples.zh: 转来这里之前，她在社区学院拿了「副学士学位」。

examples.en: Many associate degree credits transfer toward a four-year bachelor's program.
examples.zh: 很多「副学士学位」的学分可以转入四年制本科项目。

collocations: an associate degree in liberal arts

words.enDefinition: a mid-level faculty rank, usually already tenured

examples.en: She was promoted to associate professor the year her book appeared.
examples.zh: 新书出版那年，她晋升为「副教授」。

examples.en: Ask an associate professor how the tenure process really works.
examples.zh: 不妨问问「副教授」，终身教职评审究竟怎么回事。

words.enDefinition: an online discussion where people post replies at different times

examples.en: Post in the asynchronous discussion by Wednesday and reply to two classmates by Friday.
examples.zh: 周三前在「异步讨论」发帖，周五前回复两位同学。

examples.en: Asynchronous discussion gives quieter students more time to think before they write.
examples.zh: 「异步讨论」让不太爱发言的同学有更多时间想好再写。

words.enDefinition: learning from recorded materials on your own schedule, not live

examples.en: Asynchronous learning means I can do all my coursework at midnight.
examples.zh: 「异步学习」意味着我可以半夜把功课都做完。

examples.en: The course is mostly asynchronous learning, with one live seminar a week.
examples.zh: 这门课以「异步学习」为主，每周只有一次直播研讨。

words.enDefinition: add a document or image to a message or submission box

examples.en: Attach a file instead of pasting the whole essay into the text box.
examples.zh: 别把整篇论文粘进文本框，要「添加附件」。

examples.en: She attached the wrong file and had to email the TA a corrected version.
examples.zh: 她「添加附件」时传错了文件，只好把正确版本发给助教。

collocations: attach a file to the submission

words.enDefinition: take part in a class from somewhere else over the internet

examples.en: You can attend remotely once a week if you sign up in advance.
examples.zh: 提前申请的话，每周可以有一次「远程上课」。

examples.en: She attended remotely from the health center and stayed for the whole seminar.
examples.zh: 她在医务室「远程上课」，完整听完了研讨课。

words.enDefinition: a quick poll that records who showed up for an online class

examples.en: Answer the attendance poll within the first five minutes or you're marked absent.
examples.zh: 前五分钟内要完成「签到投票」，否则算缺勤。

examples.en: She missed the attendance poll and had to email the professor proof she was there.
examples.zh: 她错过了「签到投票」，只好发邮件向教授证明自己来过。

words.enDefinition: a simple opening poll used just to check who is present

examples.en: Today's attendance question was which city we'd most like to visit.
examples.zh: 今天的「签到问题」是最想去的城市是哪座。

examples.en: The attendance question appears on screen during the first two minutes.
examples.zh: 「签到问题」会在开课头两分钟出现在屏幕上。

words.enDefinition: stop hearing someone because their sound suddenly failed

examples.en: Her audio cut out mid-sentence, so we lost the last example.
examples.zh: 她讲到一半「声音中断」，最后一个例题没听到。

examples.en: If your audio cuts out, rejoin the meeting instead of troubleshooting on camera.
examples.zh: 如果「声音中断」，直接重新入会，别当着全班排查。

words.enDefinition: any problem with sound during an online class or call

examples.en: If you have an audio issue, switch to your phone's dial-in number.
examples.zh: 遇到「音频故障」，就改用手机拨入号码。

examples.en: Half the class reported an audio issue with yesterday's guest lecture.
examples.zh: 昨天嘉宾课，一半同学都反映有「音频故障」。

collocations: an audio issue with the recording

words.enDefinition: a recorded reading of a book you stream or download

examples.en: The library app streams audiobooks free with your student login.
examples.zh: 用学生账号登录图书馆App就能免费听「有声书」。

examples.en: I finished the sociology reading as an audiobook on my commute.
examples.zh: 我通勤时用「有声书」听完了社会学阅读材料。

words.enDefinition: attend a course regularly without earning credit

examples.en: You can audit a course for free if the instructor agrees.
examples.zh: 只要任课老师同意，你就能免费「旁听」这门课。

examples.en: Some seniors audit a course they loved one last time before graduating.
examples.zh: 有些大四学生会毕业前再「旁听」一次自己喜欢的课。

words.enDefinition: a short performance given to be chosen for a group

examples.en: A cappella auditions are next Tuesday; prepare one verse and one chorus.
examples.zh: 阿卡贝拉「试演选拔」定在下周二，准备一段主歌和一段副歌。

examples.en: She was nervous before her audition, but the director smiled at her song choice.
examples.zh: 「试演选拔」前她非常紧张，不过导演对她选的歌很满意。

words.enDefinition: captions created by software without a human checking them

examples.en: The auto-generated captions turned 'derivative' into a completely different word.
examples.zh: 「自动生成字幕」把derivative识别成了完全另一个词。

examples.en: Auto-generated captions help when you rewatch a lecture at double speed.
examples.zh: 用双倍速重看回放时，「自动生成字幕」特别有用。

words.enDefinition: an online quiz scored instantly by the system, not a person

examples.en: The auto-graded quiz shows your score the second you submit.
examples.zh: 「自动判分测验」一提交就出分。

examples.en: Our weekly auto-graded quiz lets us check answers right away.
examples.zh: 每周的「自动判分测验」可以马上核对答案。

words.enDefinition: a setting that extends loans automatically before they fall due

examples.en: The library's auto-renewal feature extended the loan before the book was due last Friday.
examples.zh: 图书馆的「自动续借」功能在上周五的到期日之前就给这本书续借了。

examples.en: I turned on auto-renewal so the library system could extend my eligible loans automatically.
examples.zh: 我开启了「自动续借」，这样图书馆系统就能为符合条件的借阅自动延长期限。

words.enDefinition: a letter grade below a B, worth about 2.7 points

examples.en: That B minus in calculus dropped my semester GPA to 3.1.
examples.zh: 微积分那个「B减」把我的学期绩点拉到了3.1。

examples.en: My advisor said one B minus will not sink my graduate applications.
examples.zh: 导师说一个「B减」不至于毁掉我的研究生申请。

words.enDefinition: a letter grade above a B, usually worth 3.3 points

examples.en: A B plus in statistics still keeps my major GPA above 3.5.
examples.zh: 统计课拿「B加」仍能让我的专业课绩点保持在3.5以上。

examples.en: The syllabus says 87 to 89 counts as a B plus.
examples.zh: 课程大纲写着87到89分算作「B加」。

collocations: just short of a B plus

words.enDefinition: a first degree in humanities or social science subjects

examples.en: My brother will graduate with a bachelor of arts in history next spring.
examples.zh: 我哥哥明年春季将以历史学「文学学士」毕业。

examples.en: The diploma reads Bachelor of Arts, but everyone just calls it a BA.
examples.zh: 证书上印着「文学学士」，不过大家都简称 BA。

collocations: a bachelor of arts in history

words.enDefinition: a first degree in science or technical subjects

examples.en: She is completing a bachelor of science in computer science this semester.
examples.zh: 她这学期就要读完计算机科学的「理学学士」。

examples.en: A bachelor of science usually requires more lab courses than a BA.
examples.zh: 和文学学士相比，「理学学士」通常要求更多实验课。

collocations: a bachelor of science in nursing

words.enDefinition: an undergraduate university degree usually completed in four years

examples.en: After four years of hard work, she finally earned her bachelor's degree in economics.
examples.zh: 经过四年努力，她终于拿到了经济学「学士学位」。

examples.en: The graduation office confirmed my bachelor's degree will be conferred this May.
examples.zh: 毕业办公室确认我的「学士学位」将在今年五月正式授予。

words.enDefinition: an older edition of a magazine kept after newer ones arrive

examples.en: Ask at the desk for back issues older than one year.
examples.zh: 一年以上的「过刊」需要向柜台索取。

examples.en: I photocopied an ad from a 1998 back issue for my media class.
examples.zh: 我从1998年的一期「过刊」上复印了一则广告，用于媒介课作业。

words.enDefinition: extra sound like traffic or roommates that the mic picks up

examples.en: Stay muted when there's background noise so the lecture stays clear.
examples.zh: 有「背景噪音」就保持静音，别影响大家听课。

examples.en: My background noise is the dining hall, so I answer questions from a study room.
examples.zh: 我这边的「背景噪音」是食堂，所以提问时都去自习室。

words.enDefinition: second-choice course ready if your first fills

examples.en: Always list a backup course in case your first choice fills.
examples.zh: 一定要准备「备选课程」，以防首选的课满了。

examples.en: I picked a backup course in case the economics seminar filled before my registration time.
examples.zh: 我选了一门「备选课程」，以防经济学研讨课在我能选课前满员。

collocations: backup course in the same slot

words.enDefinition: a score much lower than you hoped for

examples.en: My first bad grade in college was a 58 on the chem midterm.
examples.zh: 我大学第一个「差成绩」是化学期中的58分。

examples.en: One bad grade early in the term still leaves time to recover.
examples.zh: 学期初的一个「差成绩」还留有补救的时间。

collocations: a bad grade on the midterm

words.enDefinition: a term whose grades fall well below your usual level

examples.en: One bad semester during Covid does not define your college GPA.
examples.zh: 疫情期间的一个「糟糕学期」并不能定义你的大学绩点。

examples.en: I explained my bad semester in the addendum about my family emergency.
examples.zh: 我在补充说明里解释了因家庭变故导致的那个「糟糕学期」。

words.enDefinition: selling homemade baked goods to raise money for a club

examples.en: The bake sale table outside the library sold out by two o'clock.
examples.zh: 图书馆外的「烘焙义卖」摊位两点前就卖光了。

examples.en: For the bake sale, we need thirty dozen cookies from volunteer bakers.
examples.zh: 这次「烘焙义卖」需要志愿者提供三十打饼干。

words.enDefinition: the internet capacity available for video calls and streaming

examples.en: Everyone streaming at once eats up the dorm's bandwidth around midnight.
examples.zh: 半夜大家一起看视频，宿舍楼的「带宽」根本不够用。

examples.en: Turn off your video to save bandwidth when the connection gets choppy.
examples.zh: 网络卡的时候关掉视频，省点「带宽」。

words.enDefinition: to pass a course with only the lowest acceptable score

examples.en: I barely passed statistics with a 61, so my GPA took a hit.
examples.zh: 我统计课61分「勉强及格」，绩点受了点影响。

examples.en: He barely passed the lab section but made up for it with an A on the final.
examples.zh: 他实验部分「勉强及格」，但靠期末的A补了回来。

words.enDefinition: a supervised toilet visit allowed during an exam

examples.en: Raise your hand for a bathroom break and an invigilator will escort you.
examples.zh: 想「上洗手间」就举手，监考员会带你去。

examples.en: No bathroom break is allowed in the first half hour of the exam.
examples.zh: 开考后的半小时内不允许「上洗手间」。

collocations: no bathroom break in the first hour

words.enDefinition: the normal distribution shape used to adjust grades

examples.en: The professor fits results to a bell curve so the average lands midrange.
examples.zh: 教授按「钟形曲线」调分，让平均分落在中间段。

examples.en: On a strict bell curve, your grade also depends on how classmates performed.
examples.zh: 在严格的「钟形曲线」下，你的成绩还要看同学们的表现。

collocations: fit results to a bell curve

words.enDefinition: a common polite email sign-off

examples.en: Close the email with Best regards, then your full name.
examples.zh: 邮件结尾用「Best regards」，再署上全名。

examples.en: Best regards works for most emails you send to professors.
examples.zh: 给教授的多数邮件用「Best regards」落款都可以。

collocations: Best regards followed by your name

words.enDefinition: study that mixes online activities with face-to-face teaching

examples.en: Blended learning suits me because I can rewatch everything online.
examples.zh: 「混合式学习」很适合我，线上内容可以反复看。

examples.en: The department is expanding blended learning to more introductory courses.
examples.zh: 系里正把「混合式学习」推广到更多基础课。

words.enDefinition: an event where students can donate blood on campus

examples.en: The pre-med society volunteers as escorts at each campus blood drive.
examples.zh: 每场校园「献血活动」，预医学社都会去做引导志愿者。

examples.en: Book a slot online if you want to donate at Tuesday's blood drive.
examples.zh: 想在周二的「献血活动」献血，可以网上预约时段。

words.enDefinition: a small booklet for handwritten US essay exams

examples.en: Buy two blue books at the campus store before the history final.
examples.zh: 历史期末考前，先在校内商店买两本「蓝皮答题册」。

examples.en: The professor let us outline our answers on the blue book cover.
examples.zh: 教授允许我们先在「蓝皮答题册」封面上列提纲。

words.enDefinition: the governing board that oversees a university

examples.en: The board of trustees voted to freeze tuition for next year.
examples.zh: 「校董会」投票决定明年冻结学费。

examples.en: Decisions about tuition never rest with professors but with the board of trustees.
examples.zh: 学费的决定权在「校董会」而不是教授手里。

collocations: voted by the board of trustees
member of the board of trustees

words.enDefinition: extra points awarded beyond the standard maximum score

examples.en: The bonus points on question twelve saved my statistics grade.
examples.zh: 第12题的「附加分」救了我的统计课成绩。

examples.en: Bonus points cannot push your total above the hundred-percent cap.
examples.zh: 「加分」不能让总分突破百分上限。

words.enDefinition: an extra question offering optional additional points

examples.en: There is a bonus question at the end worth five extra points.
examples.zh: 卷末有一道「附加题」，值五分附加分。

examples.en: Attempt the bonus question even if unsure, because it can only help your score.
examples.zh: 「附加题」没把握也要试一试，它只会拉高你的分数。

collocations: a bonus question at the end

words.enDefinition: a wheeled cart holding books waiting to be reshelved

examples.en: Leave finished books on the book cart instead of reshelving them yourself.
examples.zh: 看完的书放到「书车」上，不用自己放回书架。

examples.en: The student worker wheeled a loaded book cart toward the history section.
examples.zh: 学生助理推着装满书的「书车」走向历史区。

words.enDefinition: a themed table of books arranged to catch browsers' attention

examples.en: The book display near the entrance features Asian American authors this month.
examples.zh: 本月入口处的「图书展台」主题是亚裔美国作家。

examples.en: Staff build a book display for every heritage month and exam season.
examples.zh: 每个文化月和期末季，馆员都会布置一个「图书展台」。

words.enDefinition: an outdoor bin that accepts returns around the clock

examples.en: The drive-up book drop stays open even when the building is locked.
examples.zh: 即使馆内上锁，路边「还书箱」也全天可还书。

examples.en: Staff empty the book drop every morning before opening hours begin.
examples.zh: 馆员每天早上开馆前会清空「还书箱」。

words.enDefinition: the slot where you drop books after the desk closes

examples.en: Feed the books into the book return chute by the entrance after closing.
examples.zh: 闭馆后把书从入口旁的「还书口」塞进去就行。

examples.en: The book return chute jams when everyone dumps hardcovers in during finals.
examples.zh: 期末大家都往「还书口」里塞精装书，很容易卡住。

collocations: book return chute by the entrance

words.enDefinition: an overhead scanner that photographs pages without pressing the spine

examples.en: The overhead book scanner photographs pages without crushing the spine.
examples.zh: 这台顶置式「书籍扫描仪」拍照取页，不会压坏书脊。

examples.en: Scan your professor's old handbook with the book scanner instead of photocopying it.
examples.zh: 教授那本旧手册用「书籍扫描仪」扫，别拿去复印。

collocations: book scanner on the ground floor

words.enDefinition: the edge of a book that faces outward showing the label

examples.en: The call number is printed on the book spine, so tilt your head to read.
examples.zh: 「书脊」上印着索书号，得歪着头读。

examples.en: A cracked book spine usually means the volume was forced open too wide.
examples.zh: 「书脊」开裂通常说明这本书被人硬掰开过。

words.enDefinition: the maximum hours or rooms one group may reserve per day

examples.en: The booking limit is two hours per group per day in the science library.
examples.zh: 理学分馆的「预订上限」是每组每天两小时。

examples.en: We split the project across two pods to work around the booking limit.
examples.zh: 为了绕开「预订上限」，我们把项目拆到两个研讨舱进行。

words.enDefinition: a score right at the edge between two letter grades

examples.en: My 88.4 is a borderline grade, so I emailed the professor about rounding.
examples.zh: 我的88.4分是个「临界成绩」，所以写信问教授能否四舍五入。

examples.en: Borderline grades at the end of term usually go to students with strong participation.
examples.zh: 期末的「边缘成绩」通常判给课堂参与积极的学生。

collocations: a borderline grade between two letters

words.enDefinition: the maximum number of items you can have out at once

examples.en: The borrowing limit for undergraduates is fifteen books and three media items.
examples.zh: 本科生的「借阅上限」是十五本书加三件音像资料。

examples.en: You hit the borrowing limit, so return something before checking out the next novel.
examples.zh: 你已达「借阅上限」，想再借小说得先还掉一本。

words.enDefinition: the rights that let you borrow items from the library

examples.en: Borrowing privileges are suspended until you settle the outstanding fine at the desk.
examples.zh: 在柜台结清未付罚款之前，你的「借阅权限」会被暂停。

examples.en: Grad students get extended borrowing privileges compared with undergraduates at most universities.
examples.zh: 在多数大学，研究生的「借阅权限」比本科生更长。

words.enDefinition: to share half-formed ideas back and forth to improve them

examples.en: Before writing our responses, we bounce ideas off each other over cheap coffee.
examples.zh: 动笔写读书回应之前，我们先端着便宜咖啡「互相碰想法」。

examples.en: Brainstorming works best when you bounce ideas off each other without judging them too fast.
examples.zh: 「互相碰想法」又不过快评判时，头脑风暴效果最好。

collocations: bounce ideas off each other freely

words.enDefinition: a year of magazine issues sewn into one hardbound volume

examples.en: Older issues are bound journals shelved by title on level four.
examples.zh: 过刊会做成「合订本期刊」，按刊名排在四楼。

examples.en: Pull the bound journal from the shelf and scan the article at the copier.
examples.zh: 从架上取下「合订本期刊」，在复印机旁扫描那篇文章。

words.enDefinition: a meeting where people generate as many ideas as possible

examples.en: Our brainstorming session produced twenty ideas, and we narrowed them to three after lunch.
examples.zh: 一场「头脑风暴」下来攒了二十个点子，午饭后收敛到三个。

examples.en: Save judgment for later; a brainstorming session falls apart the moment someone starts nitpicking.
examples.zh: 评价留到后面；一旦有人开始挑剔，「头脑风暴」就进行不下去了。

collocations: a brainstorming session for the essay

words.enDefinition: a smaller subject-specific library located away from the main one

examples.en: The science branch library keeps lab manuals the main building doesn't stock.
examples.zh: 理学「分馆」藏有主馆没有的实验手册。

examples.en: Architecture students do most of their borrowing at the art branch library.
examples.zh: 建筑系学生主要在艺术「分馆」借书。

words.enDefinition: a summer program preparing incoming students before freshman year

examples.en: The bridge program starts three weeks before regular classes begin.
examples.zh: 「衔接项目」在正式开课前三周开始。

examples.en: Bridge program participants move in early and earn three credits.
examples.zh: 参加「衔接项目」的学生提前到校，还能修三个学分。

words.enDefinition: a link that no longer opens the page or file it should

examples.en: I emailed the TA after finding a broken link to the required reading.
examples.zh: 我发现必读材料用的是「失效链接」，于是给助教发了邮件。

examples.en: The professor fixed a broken link in module two just before the deadline.
examples.zh: 教授在截止前修复了模块二里的一个「失效链接」。

words.enDefinition: walk the shelves looking for useful titles rather than searching

examples.en: Take an hour to browse the stacks near your call number for better sources.
examples.zh: 花一小时「浏览书库」里索书号附近的书架，找找更好的资料。

examples.en: Browse the stacks on level three when the search engine gives you nothing.
examples.zh: 检索系统没结果时，就去三楼「浏览书库」。

collocations: browse the stacks for an hour

words.enDefinition: to fill the circles on a machine-read answer sheet

examples.en: Bubble in your answers completely, or the scanner will miss them.
examples.zh: 「涂答题卡」时要涂满涂黑，否则扫描仪会漏读。

examples.en: Remember to bubble in your student number before the timer starts.
examples.zh: 计时开始前，记得先「涂答题卡」填好学号。

words.enDefinition: a program matching new international students with local students

examples.en: The buddy program matched me with a senior who showed me around.
examples.zh: 「结对互助项目」给我匹配了一位带我熟悉校园的高年级学长。

examples.en: Sign up for the buddy program when you accept your offer.
examples.zh: 接受录取后，就可以报名「结对互助项目」。

collocations: sign up for the buddy program

words.enDefinition: a reduction in the money a club receives for the year

examples.en: The budget cut forced our club to cancel the interstate tournament trip.
examples.zh: 「预算削减」迫使社团取消了跨州锦标赛之行。

examples.en: Officers appealed the budget cut by showing attendance records from last year.
examples.zh: 干事们出示去年的出勤记录，对「预算削减」提出申诉。

words.enDefinition: to add to what a classmate said rather than starting over

examples.en: I'd like to build on Maria's point about stigma rather than start a new thread.
examples.zh: 我想「接着玛丽亚关于污名的观点」往下说，而不是另起话题。

examples.en: The best comments build on someone's point and push it one step further.
examples.zh: 最好的发言都是「顺着别人的观点」再推进一步。

words.enDefinition: the officer who collects tuition and fees

examples.en: The bursar's office emailed me about the unpaid lab fee.
examples.zh: 「财务主管」办公室来信提醒我补交实验费。

examples.en: Set up a payment plan through the bursar before the deadline.
examples.zh: 截止日前，在「财务主管」处办好分期付款。

collocations: a payment plan with the bursar

words.enDefinition: weekdays when offices are open, excluding weekends and holidays

examples.en: Allow five business days for the letter to arrive by mail.
examples.zh: 信件邮寄要留出五个「工作日」。

examples.en: The office answers requests within two business days, weekends excluded.
examples.zh: 办公室两个「工作日」内答复，周末不算。

words.enDefinition: to interrupt rudely without being invited into the talk

examples.en: Excuse me for butting in, but I think we are misreading the author's claim.
examples.zh: 原谅我「插嘴」，但我觉得我们误读了作者的观点。

examples.en: He kept butting in with jokes while the presenters were explaining their slides.
examples.zh: 展示的同学讲解幻灯片时，他不停「插嘴开玩笑」。

words.enDefinition: only at an arranged time, not walk-in

examples.en: Professor Kim sees students by appointment during the grading season.
examples.zh: 阅卷期间，金教授「需预约」才能见面。

examples.en: You can meet the associate dean by appointment on Friday afternoons.
examples.zh: 周五下午可「预约」会见副院长。

words.enDefinition: detailed club rules covering elections, dues, and member duties

examples.en: Our bylaws spell out exactly how vacancies on the board are filled.
examples.zh: 我们的「章程细则」明确规定了理事会职位空缺如何补选。

examples.en: The committee checked the bylaws carefully before scheduling the spring election.
examples.zh: 委员会在安排春季选举前仔细核对了「章程细则」。

words.enDefinition: a barely passing letter grade that pulls your GPA down

examples.en: The department requires a C minus or higher to move into the next course.
examples.zh: 系里要求「C减」或更高才能进入下一门课。

examples.en: That C minus in physics is the grade I need to retake.
examples.zh: 物理那个「C减」就是我要重修的成绩。

collocations: repeat the course after a C minus

words.enDefinition: a grade of C or higher required for some purpose

examples.en: You need a C or better in chem lab before taking the advanced course.
examples.zh: 先修要求化学实验拿到「C以上」才能选修高级课程。

examples.en: The scholarship renews only for students with a C or better in every class.
examples.zh: 奖学金只延续给每门课都拿到「C或更好」的学生。

collocations: a C or better in the prerequisite

words.enDefinition: a middling letter grade, usually worth 2.3 points

examples.en: A C plus in orgo is survivable if the rest of your grades are strong.
examples.zh: 如果其他成绩够强，有机化学拿个「C加」也还能接受。

examples.en: Graduate admissions committees rarely reject an application over a single C plus.
examples.zh: 研究生招生委员会很少会因为一个「C加」就拒掉申请。

collocations: a C plus on the midterm

words.enDefinition: an electronic request that adds a class event to your calendar

examples.en: The TA sent a calendar invite for Thursday's review session.
examples.zh: 助教给周四的复习课发了「日历邀请」。

examples.en: Accept the calendar invite so the class shows up on your schedule.
examples.zh: 记得接受「日历邀请」，课程才会出现在你的日程里。

collocations: a calendar invite for the session

words.enDefinition: the code on a book's spine showing its exact shelf position

examples.en: Write down the call number before you head into the stacks, or you'll wander.
examples.zh: 进书库前先抄下「索书号」，不然会瞎转半天。

examples.en: Books are arranged by call number, so read the labels from top to bottom.
examples.zh: 图书按「索书号」排列，看架标要从上往下读。

words.enDefinition: nervous or unwilling about appearing on camera

examples.en: I'm camera-shy, so I always sit out of the webcam's frame in my dorm.
examples.zh: 我有点「不愿出镜」，所以在宿舍总躲开摄像头拍到的范围。

examples.en: Even camera-shy students usually turn on their cameras for group presentations.
examples.zh: 就连「不愿出镜」的同学，小组展示时一般也会开摄像头。

words.enDefinition: stay settled in one library spot for many hours

examples.en: Engineering students camp out in the atrium the night before the mechanics final.
examples.zh: 力学期末考前夜，工科生们在中庭「安营扎寨」。

examples.en: I camped out at the same carrel for nine hours yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我在同一隔位「安营扎寨」了九个小时。

words.enDefinition: to promote yourself before a club election with posters and talks

examples.en: To campaign for a position, he made posters and chatted with members after practice.
examples.zh: 为了「竞选造势」，他做了海报，训练后还挨个找成员聊天。

examples.en: Candidates may campaign for a position only during the official election week.
examples.zh: 候选人只能在正式的选举周内「竞选造势」。

words.enDefinition: a student who represents a club or brand on campus

examples.en: Campus ambassadors host table events and answer questions from interested students.
examples.zh: 「校园大使」负责摆摊宣传，并解答感兴趣同学的问题。

examples.en: She became a campus ambassador for the debate league after nationals.
examples.zh: 全国赛结束后，她成了辩论联盟的「校园大使」。

collocations: apply to be a campus ambassador

words.enDefinition: a printed or digital map marking every campus building

examples.en: The campus map on the app shows accessible entrances too.
examples.zh: 应用里的「校园地图」也标出了无障碍入口。

examples.en: Circle your classrooms on the campus map before the first week.
examples.zh: 开学第一周前，先在「校园地图」上圈出你要去的教室。

collocations: mark buildings on the campus map

words.enDefinition: sworn officers with authority on campus property

examples.en: Campus police investigate the bike thefts reported on university property.
examples.zh: 「校警」负责调查校园内报案的自行车失窃。

examples.en: For any emergency on campus, call campus police right away.
examples.zh: 校园里的紧急情况，立刻拨打「校警」电话。

words.enDefinition: the campus department that handles safety and lost items

examples.en: Call campus security if you are locked out of the lab at night.
examples.zh: 深夜被锁在实验室外，就打「校园安保」电话。

examples.en: Campus security walks students back to the dorms after late classes.
examples.zh: 晚课后，「校园安保」会护送学生回宿舍。

words.enDefinition: a walk around campus that shows main buildings and services

examples.en: The campus tour ends at the student union, where lunch is provided.
examples.zh: 「校园参观」的终点是学生会馆，那里提供午餐。

examples.en: Book a campus tour online before you arrive for orientation.
examples.zh: 来参加迎新前，先在网上预约「校园参观」。

words.enDefinition: asked to confirm the audience sees your shared display

examples.en: He paused mid-slide and asked, 'Can you see my screen?'
examples.zh: 他讲到一半停下来问：「能看到我的屏幕吗？」

examples.en: Ask 'Can you see my screen?' early because silent minutes are worse.
examples.zh: 早点问一句「能看到我的屏幕吗」，免得冷场好几分钟。

collocations: ask can you see my screen

words.enDefinition: give up your place in line for a reserved item

examples.en: Cancel a hold if the edition the library bought doesn't match your syllabus.
examples.zh: 如果馆里买的版本和课程要求不符，就「取消预约」。

examples.en: It only takes a second to cancel a hold from your account page.
examples.zh: 在账户页面「取消预约」只需一秒钟。

collocations: cancel a hold from your account

words.enDefinition: give up your booked time slot ahead of the visit

examples.en: Cancel your appointment online if your class schedule suddenly changes.
examples.zh: 如果课表有变动，就在网上「取消预约」。

examples.en: Please cancel an appointment you cannot attend so someone else can use it.
examples.zh: 去不了的预约请及时「取消预约」，把时段让给其他同学。

words.enDefinition: a student approved to receive a degree this term

examples.en: The registrar emailed every candidate for graduation about clearance tasks.
examples.zh: 注册办公室给每位「毕业候选人」发了关于核验事项的邮件。

examples.en: As a candidate for graduation, she must settle all library fines.
examples.zh: 作为「毕业候选人」，她必须结清所有图书馆罚款。

words.enDefinition: the ID number you write on exam papers

examples.en: Write your candidate number on every page of the answer booklet.
examples.zh: 答题册的每一页都要写上你的「考生号」。

examples.en: Your candidate number keeps your exam anonymous throughout the marking process.
examples.zh: 「考生号」能让你的试卷在整个阅卷过程中保持匿名。

words.enDefinition: the traditional cap and robe worn on graduation day

examples.en: Order your cap and gown before the March deadline or pay extra.
examples.zh: 在三月的截止日期前订好「学位帽袍」，否则要加钱。

examples.en: Graduates wear a cap and gown according to their degree level.
examples.zh: 毕业生按学位层次穿相应的「学位帽袍」。

words.enDefinition: throwing caps into the air when the ceremony ends

examples.en: The cap toss on the quad is the favorite photo moment.
examples.zh: 大草坪上的「抛帽」是最受欢迎的拍照环节。

examples.en: Save the cap toss until the official closing of the ceremony.
examples.zh: 「抛帽」要留到典礼正式结束时再进行。

words.enDefinition: a final project that applies everything learned in the major

examples.en: Her capstone project pairs engineering students with a local hospital.
examples.zh: 她的「毕业综合项目」让工科学生与本地医院结对合作。

examples.en: The capstone project replaces the thesis for most applied majors.
examples.zh: 对大多数应用型专业来说，「毕业综合项目」可替代论文。

words.enDefinition: real-time or recorded subtitles added to lectures and videos

examples.en: Live captioning is available for lectures if you request it.
examples.zh: 只要提出申请，听课就能享受实时「字幕服务」。

examples.en: Recorded lectures include captioning, which helps when the accent is unfamiliar.
examples.zh: 录播课自带「字幕」，口音听不惯的时候很有帮助。

words.enDefinition: turning on a new student card's building and payment functions

examples.en: Card activation happens automatically once you are officially enrolled for the term.
examples.zh: 正式注册本学期学籍后，「卡片激活」会自动完成。

examples.en: If card activation fails, bring your passport to the services desk.
examples.zh: 如果「卡片激活」失败，请带着护照到服务台处理。

words.enDefinition: a boxed gift of snacks and comforts sent from home

examples.en: Student services mailed care packages to students staying on campus over the break.
examples.zh: 假期留校的学生，都收到了学生服务处寄来的「关怀包裹」。

examples.en: My parents sent a care package with instant noodles and winter gloves.
examples.zh: 父母寄来一个「关怀包裹」，里面有泡面和冬手套。

words.enDefinition: one-on-one guidance sessions about majors and career paths

examples.en: Career advising is free for all students during exam season too.
examples.zh: 考试季期间，「职业规划咨询」对全体学生同样免费。

examples.en: I signed up for career advising to plan my next steps.
examples.zh: 我报名了「职业规划咨询」，规划接下来的路怎么走。

words.enDefinition: the campus office offering guidance about majors and future work

examples.en: Book a session at the career center to explore your options.
examples.zh: 在「就业指导中心」预约一次咨询，探索一下自己的方向。

examples.en: The career center offers free advising, not just job listings.
examples.zh: 「就业指导中心」提供免费咨询，并不只是发布招聘信息。

collocations: an appointment at the career center

words.enDefinition: a staff member who helps students plan their career direction

examples.en: My career counselor suggested I try two different summer internships.
examples.zh: 「职业规划顾问」建议我试两个不同的暑期实习。

examples.en: Talk to a career counselor before you switch your major.
examples.zh: 换专业之前，先和「职业规划顾问」聊一聊。

words.enDefinition: an avoidable error caused by rushing or inattention

examples.en: Careless mistakes in the sign of the operation cost me six points.
examples.zh: 运算符号上的「粗心失误」让我丢了六分。

examples.en: Reread the last line of every calculation to catch careless mistakes.
examples.zh: 每步计算的末行都重读一遍，抓出「粗心失误」。

words.enDefinition: a staff member coordinating all support for one student's situation

examples.en: The case manager coordinated all my support after a hospital stay.
examples.zh: 住院回来后，「个案管理员」统筹了我所有的支持安排。

examples.en: Your case manager follows up until every request is resolved.
examples.zh: 「个案管理员」会持续跟进，直到每个请求都解决。

collocations: your case manager will follow up

words.enDefinition: teaching where classes analyze real cases instead of hearing lectures

examples.en: Business school runs on the case study method, so you must prepare every case.
examples.zh: 商学院全靠「案例教学法」运转，所以每个案例都必须提前准备。

examples.en: Under the case study method, the professor cold-calls instead of lecturing from slides.
examples.zh: 在「案例教学法」的课堂上，教授不照幻灯片讲课，而是随机点名提问。

collocations: teach by the case study method
the case study method in business

words.enDefinition: the edition of degree requirements your studies follow

examples.en: Your catalog year determines which degree requirements apply to you.
examples.zh: 你的「培养方案版本」决定适用哪一版学位要求。

examples.en: Switching your catalog year requires written approval from the registrar.
examples.zh: 更换「培养方案版本」需要注册办公室的书面批准。

words.enDefinition: a duplicate of a document that the office has verified and stamped

examples.en: The scholarship office wants a certified copy of your transcript, not a scan.
examples.zh: 奖学金办公室要成绩单的「认证副本」，不接受扫描件。

examples.en: Ask the registrar to make a certified copy while you wait at the counter.
examples.zh: 在柜台请注册办当场做一份「认证副本」。

words.enDefinition: a translation of foreign papers done by an approved translator

examples.en: The registrar accepted my certified translation of the Chinese high school report.
examples.zh: 注册办接受了我中文高中成绩单的「认证翻译件」。

examples.en: Foreign diplomas need a certified translation before the office can file them.
examples.zh: 外国文凭要有「认证翻译件」，办公室才能归档。

words.enDefinition: the ceremonial or executive head of a university

examples.en: The chancellor personally signs every degree certificate the university awards.
examples.zh: 每一份学位证书都由「校长」亲笔签署。

examples.en: Students met the chancellor at the annual town hall on the quad.
examples.zh: 学生们在草坪年度见面会上见到了「校长」。

words.enDefinition: a formal update telling the school where you now live

examples.en: Submit a change of address form within two weeks of moving.
examples.zh: 搬家后两周内要提交「地址变更」表格。

examples.en: A change of address keeps official letters from going to the wrong place.
examples.zh: 办理「地址变更」能避免官方信件寄错地方。

words.enDefinition: official switch from one major field to another

examples.en: File your change of major form before spring registration opens.
examples.zh: 春季选课开放前，先提交「转专业」申请表。

examples.en: Her change of major meant three new required courses next term.
examples.zh: 这次「转专业」意味着下学期要多修三门新必修课。

words.enDefinition: move to a different meeting time of the same course

examples.en: You can change sections online if seats open in another group.
examples.zh: 如果另一组有空位，你可以在网上「更换课段」。

examples.en: I want to change sections because Thursday labs clash with my shift.
examples.zh: 我想「更换课段」，周四的实验课和我的班次冲突了。

words.enDefinition: the regular meeting of a local branch of a society

examples.en: Chapter meetings follow a national agenda template, then add campus business.
examples.zh: 「分会例会」按全国统一的议程模板进行，再补充校区事务。

examples.en: Our chapter meeting includes a guest talk from a local engineer.
examples.zh: 我们的「分会例会」会请本地工程师做嘉宾分享。

words.enDefinition: a locker bank that charges your phone while you study

examples.en: Locker-style charging stations by the entrance keep phones safe while you study.
examples.zh: 入口旁的储物柜式「充电站」能让你安心学习、安全充电。

examples.en: My phone hit five percent, so I parked it in a charging station.
examples.zh: 手机只剩百分之五的电，我把它放进「充电站」里充。

words.enDefinition: a fun run where entry fees support a charitable cause

examples.en: Our club mans the water station at the city's annual charity run.
examples.zh: 城市年度「慈善跑」的水站由我们社团负责。

examples.en: Training together made the five-kilometer charity run feel easy this year.
examples.zh: 一起训练之后，今年五公里的「慈善跑」轻松多了。

collocations: sign up for a charity run

words.enDefinition: the side window in a meeting where typed messages appear

examples.en: Keep the chat panel open so you catch links the TA posts.
examples.zh: 把「聊天面板」开着，助教发的链接才不会错过。

examples.en: Half the good questions in lecture end up buried in the chat panel.
examples.zh: 课上很多好问题最后都沉底在「聊天面板」里。

collocations: scroll back through the chat panel

words.enDefinition: a page of notes used openly or secretly in exams

examples.en: The professor allows one handwritten cheat sheet for the statistics final.
examples.zh: 教授允许统计期末带一张手写「小抄」。

examples.en: He was caught with a cheat sheet in his sleeve and failed the course.
examples.zh: 他被发现袖子里藏着「小抄」，这门课直接挂掉。

collocations: get caught with a cheat sheet

words.enDefinition: a self-service touchscreen used to announce your arrival

examples.en: Use the check-in kiosk by scanning your student ID card.
examples.zh: 在「自助签到机」上刷一下学生证就能签到。

examples.en: The check-in kiosk prints a ticket with your wait time.
examples.zh: 「自助签到机」会打出一张显示等候时间的单子。

collocations: scan your ID at the kiosk

words.enDefinition: the front table where attendees sign in and collect materials

examples.en: Pick up your name tag at the check-in table by the main gate.
examples.zh: 在大门口的「签到台」领取你的名牌。

examples.en: The check-in table opens an hour before the first session.
examples.zh: 「签到台」在第一场活动开始前一小时开放。

collocations: sign in at the check-in table

words.enDefinition: borrow a book by scanning it under your own account

examples.en: Use the self-service kiosk to check out a book without waiting in line.
examples.zh: 用自助借书机「借书」，不用排队。

examples.en: You can check out a book with your student ID at the circulation desk.
examples.zh: 在借还服务台刷学生证就能「借书」。

collocations: check out a book at the kiosk
check out a book under my account
check out a book before the weekend

words.enDefinition: to confirm something with the person in charge

examples.en: Check with the department office before assuming the deadline moved.
examples.zh: 别急着以为截止日期变了，先和系办「问清楚」。

examples.en: Check with your supervisor before you book any conference travel.
examples.zh: 订参会行程之前，先「问过」导师。

words.enDefinition: to look up your posted scores in the student portal

examples.en: Check your grades tonight; the registrar said posting begins at five.
examples.zh: 今晚记得「查成绩」，教务处说五点开始出分。

examples.en: I check my grades weekly so nothing on the transcript ever surprises me.
examples.zh: 我每周都「查看成绩」，免得成绩单上出现意外。

collocations: check your grades after each quiz

words.enDefinition: currently borrowed by someone else and unavailable right now

examples.en: Every copy was checked out, so I placed a hold and waited two weeks.
examples.zh: 所有复本都「被借出」了，我只好预约等了两周。

examples.en: The catalog shows the DVD is checked out until next Tuesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 目录显示那张DVD「已借出」，下周二下午才会归还。

words.enDefinition: to add a short comment to an ongoing discussion

examples.en: Feel free to chime in with a quick example whenever the group gets abstract.
examples.zh: 每当讨论变得太抽象，欢迎随时「插话」补充一个具体例子。

examples.en: The quiet grad student chimed in once, and her point redirected the whole discussion.
examples.zh: 那位安静的研究生只「插了一句」，却让整场讨论换了方向。

words.enDefinition: a group that sings together, often in parts, at concerts

examples.en: Choir rehearsals are Tuesdays and Thursdays, with extra sectionals before concerts.
examples.zh: 「合唱团」周二周四排练，音乐会前还有分声部加练。

examples.en: No audition is required for the community choir, just regular attendance.
examples.zh: 社区「合唱团」不用选拔，保证出勤就行。

words.enDefinition: to weave quoted material smoothly into your own sentences

examples.en: Good writers integrate quotations by anchoring them to a claim in the previous sentence.
examples.zh: 高明的写法是「整合引文」，让引文锚定在上句的论点上。

examples.en: The tutor showed me how to integrate quotations instead of dropping them in cold.
examples.zh: 辅导老师教我如何「整合引文」，而不是生硬地把引文扔进去。

words.enDefinition: to prepare readers with a short phrase before quoted words begin

examples.en: Never let a quote open a paragraph; introduce a quote with your own claim first.
examples.zh: 别让引文直接开头，先亮出自己的论点来「引出引文」。

examples.en: Introduce a quote with the author's credentials so readers trust the evidence.
examples.zh: 「引出引文」时先说明作者背景，读者才会信任这个论据。

collocations: introduce a quote with a signal phrase

words.enDefinition: using the exact original wording with nothing altered

examples.en: Copy the definition verbatim and add the page number in your footnote.
examples.zh: 「一字不差」地照抄定义，并在脚注中标注页码。

examples.en: If it is not verbatim, it counts as paraphrase, so make that choice deliberately.
examples.zh: 若非「一字不差」照抄，就属于转述，要刻意做出选择。

words.enDefinition: expressing a source's idea through your own phrasing, not copied text

examples.en: Explain the theory in your own words, then cite the original chapter.
examples.zh: 先「用自己的话」讲清理论，再注明原始章节的出处。

examples.en: The professor can tell memorized textbook sentences from ideas explained in your own words.
examples.zh: 教授分得清背诵的教科书句子和「用自己的话」讲出的理解。

words.enDefinition: questioning a text's claims, methods, and evidence as you read

examples.en: Critical reading means asking who funded the study and what it leaves out.
examples.zh: 「批判性阅读」就要追问研究由谁资助、遗漏了什么。

examples.en: The seminar grade comes from critical reading notes submitted before each class.
examples.zh: 研讨课的成绩来自每次课前提交的「批判性阅读」笔记。

words.enDefinition: to judge whether a source is credible, current, and relevant

examples.en: Evaluate sources on authority and date before adding them to your annotated bibliography.
examples.zh: 把文献加进注释书目前，先按权威性和时效「评估来源」。

examples.en: The librarian gave us a checklist to evaluate sources in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 馆员给了一份清单，十分钟就能「评估来源」。

words.enDefinition: to confirm a source exists and says what you claim

examples.en: Verify a source before submitting; fabricated citations are an instant misconduct case.
examples.zh: 提交前务必「核实来源」，编造引用会直接构成学术不端。

examples.en: The TA circled one footnote and asked me to verify a source she could not find.
examples.zh: 助教圈出一条脚注，要求我「核实来源」，因为她查不到。

words.enDefinition: a source whose author, publisher, and evidence can be trusted

examples.en: A government report is usually a credible source for statistics on enrollment.
examples.zh: 政府报告通常是入学统计方面「可信的信息来源」。

examples.en: Anonymous blogs rarely count as credible sources in academic writing.
examples.zh: 匿名博客很少能算作学术写作中的「可信信息来源」。

words.enDefinition: a work written by researchers for an academic audience

examples.en: Distinguish a scholarly source from a magazine piece by checking for citations.
examples.zh: 看有没有参考文献，就能区分「学术性来源」和杂志文章。

examples.en: At least half of your list must be scholarly sources published within five years.
examples.zh: 文献列表至少一半必须是近五年发表的「学术性来源」。

words.enDefinition: a magazine or news item written for general readers, not researchers

examples.en: A popular source is fine for background, but arguments need scholarly evidence.
examples.zh: 「大众媒体来源」可作背景了解，但论证要用学术证据。

examples.en: The Atlantic article is a popular source, so pair it with the underlying study.
examples.zh: 《大西洋月刊》的文章属于「大众媒体来源」，要配上它引用的原始研究。

words.enDefinition: following rules that keep your work truthful and properly credited

examples.en: The syllabus dedicates a full page to academic honesty and citation expectations.
examples.zh: 课程大纲用整页篇幅讲「学术诚信」和引用要求。

examples.en: When in doubt about academic honesty, email the professor before submitting.
examples.zh: 拿不准「学术诚信」问题时，提交前先给教授发邮件。

words.enDefinition: reusing your own submitted work again without permission or disclosure

examples.en: Submitting last term's essay to a new course is self-plagiarism even though you wrote it.
examples.zh: 把上学期的文章交到新课属于「自我抄袭」，即使那是你自己写的。

examples.en: Ask the professor first; some allow self-plagiarism with prior written approval.
examples.zh: 先问过教授再说，有些课程允许经书面同意的「自我抄袭」。

words.enDefinition: borrowing without proper citation because of sloppy note-taking, not intent

examples.en: Unintentional plagiarism still counts, usually from notes that lose the quotation marks.
examples.zh: 「无意抄袭」照样违规，多半是因为笔记里丢了引号。

examples.en: Copy page numbers into your notes to prevent unintentional plagiarism later.
examples.zh: 做笔记时就抄下页码，避免日后出现「无意抄袭」。

words.enDefinition: restitching a source's sentences with small word swaps instead of real paraphrase

examples.en: Swapping synonyms sentence by sentence is patchwriting, and professors flag it quickly.
examples.zh: 逐句替换同义词就是「拼凑改写」，教授一眼就能识别。

examples.en: The tutor explained that patchwriting counts as plagiarism even with a citation.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释说，「拼凑改写」即使注明出处也算抄袭。

words.enDefinition: a website selling ready-made essays to students

examples.en: His roommate was suspended for submitting an essay bought from an essay mill.
examples.zh: 他室友因提交从「论文代写网站」购买的文章而被停学。

examples.en: Essay mill papers fail plagiarism scans because previous buyers already submitted them.
examples.zh: 「论文代写网站」的论文过不了查重，因为之前的买家已经交过。

words.enDefinition: paying another person to complete your assignment or exam

examples.en: Universities treat contract cheating as misconduct for both the buyer and the writer.
examples.zh: 学校把「花钱请人代写」视为买卖双方的学术不端。

examples.en: Sharing your campus login for contract cheating can end in expulsion.
examples.zh: 为「花钱请人代写」借出校园账号可能导致开除。

words.enDefinition: inventing results or observations that were never actually collected

examples.en: Data fabrication in a lab report can trigger a formal misconduct case.
examples.zh: 实验报告里的「编造数据」可能引发正式的学术不端调查。

examples.en: Fabricating interviews is data fabrication, even if the conclusions sound plausible.
examples.zh: 捏造访谈内容属于「编造数据」，即使结论听起来合理。

words.enDefinition: changing real results so they say more than they actually do

examples.en: Deleting outlier participants to save a hypothesis is falsifying data.
examples.zh: 为了保住假设而删掉离群被试，就是「篡改数据」。

examples.en: Falsifying data differs from fabrication: one edits real numbers, the other invents them.
examples.zh: 「篡改数据」不同于编造数据：前者改动真实数字，后者凭空捏造。

words.enDefinition: reusing passages from your own earlier papers in new submissions

examples.en: Journals screen text recycling with software, so rewrite rather than copy your methods section.
examples.zh: 期刊用软件筛查「文本重复使用」，方法部分请重写而非照搬。

examples.en: Minor text recycling of boilerplate is common, but disclose it to the editor.
examples.zh: 模板句的少量「文本重复使用」很常见，但要向编辑说明。

words.enDefinition: handing the same paper in for two courses without approval

examples.en: Double submission of one final essay for two seminars violates both syllabi.
examples.zh: 同一篇期末论文交两门研讨课属于「重复提交」，违反两份课程大纲。

examples.en: Ask both professors in writing; some permit double submission with disclosure.
examples.zh: 请两位教授书面确认，有些课程允许说明后的「重复提交」。

words.enDefinition: the habit of seeking only evidence that supports what you believe

examples.en: Confirmation bias creeps in when you search only for studies that agree with you.
examples.zh: 只搜支持自己观点的研究时，「确认偏误」就悄悄出现了。

examples.en: Counter confirmation bias by citing the strongest opposing article in your paper.
examples.zh: 在论文中引用最强的反方文章，可以对抗「确认偏误」。

words.enDefinition: false or misleading content spread without deliberate intent

examples.en: Health misinformation spreads fastest on the apps students use daily.
examples.zh: 健康类「错误信息」在学生常用的应用上传播最快。

examples.en: Check the original journal article before sharing, because summaries often carry misinformation.
examples.zh: 转发前先核对期刊原文，因为转述常夹杂「错误信息」。

words.enDefinition: to confirm claims against reliable evidence before trusting or citing them

examples.en: Fact-check every statistic against the original census report before it goes in your essay.
examples.zh: 每个统计数字都要对照普查原始报告「事实核查」后才能写进文章。

examples.en: The writing center tutors fact-check our citations line by line during appointments.
examples.zh: 写作中心的辅导老师会在预约时逐行对引文「事实核查」。

words.enDefinition: to check one source against another for agreement on facts

examples.en: Cross-reference the dates between the two articles before you quote either one.
examples.zh: 引用前先「相互印证」两篇文章中的日期。

examples.en: Wikipedia is a starting point: cross-reference its facts with the listed sources.
examples.zh: 维基百科只是起点：把其中事实与所列来源「相互印证」。

words.enDefinition: an extended research project seniors write to graduate with honors

examples.en: Her honors thesis on bilingual education runs to ninety pages with forty references.
examples.zh: 她的「荣誉学位论文」研究双语教育，长达九十页、引用四十条。

examples.en: Apply for the honors thesis seminar before junior year registration opens.
examples.zh: 大二选课开始前，就要申请「荣誉学位论文」研讨课。

words.enDefinition: the book-length original research required for a doctorate

examples.en: Her doctoral dissertation took five years of fieldwork in three provinces.
examples.zh: 她的「博士学位论文」花了五年在三个省份做田野调查。

examples.en: Doctoral dissertations are indexed in ProQuest, so full texts are searchable online.
examples.zh: 「博士学位论文」在 ProQuest 收录，全文可以在网上检索。

words.enDefinition: a short document outlining a planned study's question, method, and sources

examples.en: My research proposal needs a timeline, a budget, and a preliminary bibliography.
examples.zh: 我的「研究计划书」需要时间表、预算和初步文献目录。

examples.en: The committee returned my research proposal with questions about sampling.
examples.zh: 委员会退回我的「研究计划书」，要求补充抽样说明。

words.enDefinition: the rules protecting participants and integrity in academic studies

examples.en: Research ethics training is mandatory before any survey involving human participants.
examples.zh: 任何涉及人类被试的调查之前，都必须完成「研究伦理」培训。

examples.en: Our research ethics review required anonymizing every participant's real name.
examples.zh: 「研究伦理」审查要求匿名化所有参与者的姓名。

words.enDefinition: a participant's signed agreement to join a study after learning its risks

examples.en: Every interviewee signs the informed consent form before the recording starts.
examples.zh: 每位受访者都在录音开始前签署「知情同意书」。

examples.en: The ethics board rejected our draft because the informed consent language was unclear.
examples.zh: 伦理委员会驳回了草案，因为「知情同意」的表述不清楚。

words.enDefinition: a person sharing authorship of a paper or presentation

examples.en: My professor invited me to be co-author of the conference paper we revised together.
examples.zh: 教授邀请我担任我们共同修改的会议论文的「合著者」。

examples.en: List co-authors in the order agreed before submission, not by seniority alone.
examples.zh: 「合著者」按投稿前商定的顺序署名，而不只看资历。

words.enDefinition: a Word mode recording every edit for collaborators to review

examples.en: Turn on track changes so your advisor can see exactly what you revised.
examples.zh: 打开「修订模式」，导师就能看清你改了哪些地方。

examples.en: Review every suggestion under track changes carefully; some edits shift your meaning.
examples.zh: 逐条处理「修订模式」下的建议，有些改动会改变原意。

words.enDefinition: a long formal paper presenting your own analysis of a topic

examples.en: My sociology professor wants a ten-page research paper by the end of April.
examples.zh: 社会学教授要求四月底交一篇十页的「研究论文」。

examples.en: Before drafting your research paper, narrow the topic to what the sources can support.
examples.zh: 动笔写「研究论文」之前，先把题目缩小到资料撑得住的范围。

collocations: cite sources in a research paper

words.enDefinition: the specific question a study or paper sets out to answer

examples.en: After reading five articles, I still need to sharpen my research question.
examples.zh: 读完五篇文章后，我仍需把「研究问题」再聚焦一些。

examples.en: A good research question is narrow enough to answer within the word limit.
examples.zh: 好的「研究问题」要窄到能在字数限制内回答。

words.enDefinition: an area that existing studies have not yet examined
