examples.en: My proposal argues that the research gap lies in first-generation students' study habits.
examples.zh: 我的开题报告认为「研究空白」在于第一代大学生的学习习惯。

examples.en: The professor asked how my thesis fills a research gap in the field.
examples.zh: 教授问我的论文如何填补该领域的「研究空白」。

words.enDefinition: an original document or firsthand account from the period studied

examples.en: For the history essay, soldiers' wartime letters count as primary sources.
examples.zh: 历史课论文里，士兵的战时书信属于「一手资料」。

examples.en: Interviews I conduct myself are primary sources, while news reports about them are secondary.
examples.zh: 我自己做的访谈是「一手资料」，相关的新闻报道则是二手的。

words.enDefinition: a work that interprets primary materials, such as a review article

examples.en: Textbooks and review articles are secondary sources, so cite the original study when possible.
examples.zh: 教科书和综述属于「二手资料」，所以尽量引用原始研究。

examples.en: My professor allows at most three secondary sources in the annotated bibliography.
examples.zh: 教授要求注释书目里的「二手资料」最多不超过三个。

words.enDefinition: findings drawn from observation, experiments, or measurable data

examples.en: Her argument is persuasive because it rests on empirical evidence from three surveys.
examples.zh: 她的论证很有说服力，因为它建立在三份调查的「实证证据」之上。

examples.en: The literature review section should connect your hypothesis to existing empirical evidence.
examples.zh: 文献综述部分应把你的假设与已有「实证证据」联系起来。

words.enDefinition: research exploring experiences through interviews and observation rather than numbers

examples.en: Her qualitative research uses interviews with twenty international students about library anxiety.
examples.zh: 她的「质性研究」访谈了二十名留学生，探讨图书馆焦虑。

examples.en: Qualitative research findings are rich, but the sample is usually small.
examples.zh: 「质性研究」的发现很丰富，但样本通常较小。

words.enDefinition: research based on numbers, statistics, and measurable variables

examples.en: The methods course separates quantitative research, which uses statistics, from interview-based work.
examples.zh: 研究方法课把用统计的「定量研究」与基于访谈的研究区分开。

examples.en: His thesis combines quantitative research on grades with interviews about motivation.
examples.zh: 他的论文把成绩方面的「定量研究」与动机访谈结合起来。

words.enDefinition: a design combining numerical data with interviews or observation

examples.en: Our capstone uses mixed methods: a campus survey plus follow-up interviews.
examples.zh: 我们的毕业项目采用「混合研究方法」：全校问卷加后续访谈。

examples.en: The professor praised our mixed methods approach for balancing numbers with stories.
examples.zh: 教授称赞我们的「混合研究方法」兼顾了数字与个案故事。

words.enDefinition: an organized collection of records ready for analysis

examples.en: The professor shared a data set of five hundred survey responses for our project.
examples.zh: 教授分享了一个含五百份问卷回答的「数据集」供我们做项目。

examples.en: Cleaning the data set took longer than running the actual analysis.
examples.zh: 清理「数据集」花的时间比真正做分析还长。

words.enDefinition: unprocessed records collected directly from sources or instruments

examples.en: Submit your raw data as an appendix so the grader can check the calculations.
examples.zh: 把「原始数据」放在附录里提交，方便老师核对计算。

examples.en: Never edit raw data directly; work on a copy in Excel.
examples.zh: 不要直接改「原始数据」，要在 Excel 副本上操作。

words.enDefinition: the number of participants or cases included in a study

examples.en: The reviewer criticized our sample size of fifteen as too small for conclusions.
examples.zh: 审稿人批评我们十五人的「样本量」太小，得不出结论。

examples.en: A larger sample size would make the survey results more convincing.
examples.zh: 更大的「样本量」会让问卷结果更有说服力。

words.enDefinition: the comparison group in an experiment that receives no treatment

examples.en: Participants in the control group simply studied without the new app.
examples.zh: 「对照组」的参与者照常学习，不使用新应用。

examples.en: Our psychology experiment needs a control group to make the results meaningful.
examples.zh: 我们的心理学实验需要「对照组」，否则结果没有意义。

words.enDefinition: the likelihood a result reflects a real pattern rather than chance

examples.en: The difference in test scores reached statistical significance after we added more participants.
examples.zh: 增加被试之后，成绩差异达到了「统计显著性」。

examples.en: Report p-values when you claim statistical significance in your results section.
examples.zh: 在结果部分声称「统计显著性」时，要报告 p 值。

words.enDefinition: the results and conclusions that a study reports

examples.en: Summarize the article's research findings in two sentences before critiquing the methods.
examples.zh: 批判研究方法之前，先用两句话概括文章的「研究发现」。

examples.en: Our research findings suggest that freshmen rarely use the academic databases.
examples.zh: 我们的「研究发现」表明，大一学生很少用学术数据库。

words.enDefinition: a peer-reviewed periodical publishing original research articles

examples.en: For this assignment, at least five of your eight sources must come from academic journals.
examples.zh: 这次作业要求八个来源中至少五个来自「学术期刊」。

examples.en: Articles in academic journals list their authors' affiliations and an abstract at the top.
examples.zh: 「学术期刊」的文章开头会列出作者单位和摘要。

words.enDefinition: a single research paper published within a journal issue

examples.en: I found a 2022 journal article that supports exactly my argument about tutoring.
examples.zh: 我找到一篇2022年的「期刊论文」，正好支持我的论点。

examples.en: Each journal article ends with a reference list you can mine for more sources.
examples.zh: 每篇「期刊论文」末尾的参考文献列表都能顺藤摸瓜找更多资料。

words.enDefinition: a journal whose articles experts vet before publication

examples.en: Wikipedia is fine for orientation, but your evidence must come from peer-reviewed journals.
examples.zh: 维基百科可以入门，但论据必须来自「同行评审期刊」。

examples.en: Our librarian showed us how to filter results to peer-reviewed journals only.
examples.zh: 馆员教我们如何把检索结果筛选为仅限「同行评审期刊」。

words.enDefinition: expert checking of a manuscript before publication

examples.en: Once a paper passes peer review, it carries much more academic weight.
examples.zh: 论文一旦通过「同行评审」，学术分量就大得多。

examples.en: Peer review takes months, which is why preprints circulate earlier.
examples.zh: 「同行评审」耗时数月，所以预印本会更早流通。

words.enDefinition: a short paper presented and discussed at an academic conference

examples.en: My advisor wants to turn my thesis chapter into a conference paper.
examples.zh: 导师想让我把论文的一章改写成一篇「会议论文」。

examples.en: She presented her conference paper on code-switching at the linguistics conference in March.
examples.zh: 三月的语言学会议上，她宣读了关于语码转换的「会议论文」。

words.enDefinition: the published collection of papers given at a conference

examples.en: Cite the conference proceedings volume, not just the slide deck, in your references.
examples.zh: 参考文献要引「会议论文集」的卷次，而不只是幻灯片。

examples.en: Her talk isn't published yet, but the conference proceedings should appear online this summer.
examples.zh: 她的报告还没刊出，「会议论文集」今夏应该会上线。

words.enDefinition: a session where researchers discuss work displayed on posters

examples.en: Undergraduates from our lab will present two projects at Friday's poster session.
examples.zh: 我们实验室的本科生将在周五的「海报展示」介绍两个项目。

examples.en: Dress business casual for the poster session; professors from other universities always circulate.
examples.zh: 「海报展示」要穿商务休闲装，外校教授会来回交流。

words.enDefinition: the invited speaker who opens a conference with a major talk

examples.en: The keynote speaker this year is the sociologist who coined that famous term.
examples.zh: 今年的「主旨发言人」正是提出那个著名术语的社会学家。

examples.en: Graduate students can attend the keynote speaker's lecture for free with their student ID.
examples.zh: 研究生凭学生证可以免费听「主旨发言人」的讲座。

words.enDefinition: a paper shared online before peer review is complete

examples.en: The preprint is free on arXiv, but the final version sits behind a paywall.
examples.zh: 「预印本」在 arXiv 上免费，定稿版本却在付费墙内。

examples.en: Be careful citing a preprint; the published version may differ after peer review.
examples.zh: 引用「预印本」要谨慎，正式版经同行评审后可能有改动。

words.enDefinition: free public availability of research articles online

examples.en: Because the paper is open access, I can download the PDF legally from the journal site.
examples.zh: 这篇论文属于「开放获取」，我可以从期刊官网合法下载 PDF。

examples.en: Our library promotes open access journals so students without subscriptions can still read.
examples.zh: 图书馆推广「开放获取」期刊，没有订阅权限的学生也能阅读。

words.enDefinition: a barrier blocking full articles until you pay or log in

examples.en: I hit a paywall trying to download the article from my laptop at home.
examples.zh: 我在家用笔记本下载文章时遇到了「付费墙」。

examples.en: Log in through the library portal first; that usually bypasses the paywall.
examples.zh: 先通过图书馆门户登录，通常就能绕过「付费墙」。

words.enDefinition: the complete article or book, not just its abstract

examples.en: The database shows only the abstract, so I requested the full text through interlibrary loan.
examples.zh: 数据库只显示摘要，我通过馆际互借申请了「全文」。

examples.en: Click the Find Full Text button to check whether our library subscribes.
examples.zh: 点击「全文」获取按钮，看看图书馆是否订阅该刊。

words.enDefinition: a permanent web address uniquely identifying an academic paper

examples.en: Every reference in APA format should include the DOI when one exists.
examples.zh: 有「数字对象标识符」（DOI）的文献，在 APA 格式里都应标出。

examples.en: Copy the DOI from the article page and paste it into Zotero's magic wand field.
examples.zh: 从文章页面复制「数字对象标识符」（DOI），粘到 Zotero 的魔法棒输入框。

words.enDefinition: a stable database link that will not break later

examples.en: Save the permalink from the database record, not the long session URL in your browser bar.
examples.zh: 要保存数据库记录里的「永久链接」，而不是地址栏里带会话参数的长网址。

examples.en: The permalink broke because I copied it while logged in through the proxy.
examples.zh: 因为我是走代理登录时复制的，「永久链接」失效了。

words.enDefinition: a score measuring how often a journal's articles are cited

examples.en: My professor warned us not to judge an article by the journal's impact factor alone.
examples.zh: 教授提醒我们，不要只凭期刊「影响因子」判断文章好坏。

examples.en: Journals with a high impact factor reject most submissions, so plan backup venues.
examples.zh: 「影响因子」高的期刊大多会拒稿，所以要准备备选投稿去向。

words.enDefinition: the number of later papers that have cited a work

examples.en: Sort the results by citation count to see which studies influence the field most.
examples.zh: 按「被引次数」排序，看看哪些研究对领域影响最大。

examples.en: A high citation count usually means the paper is a safe, central source.
examples.zh: 「被引次数」高通常说明这篇论文是可靠的核心文献。

words.enDefinition: reviewing where authors and reviewers know nothing of each other

examples.en: For double-blind review, remove your name from the manuscript before uploading.
examples.zh: 「双盲评审」要求上传前把手稿上的姓名删掉。

examples.en: Our class ran a double-blind review so graders couldn't tell whose essay they were reading.
examples.zh: 我们班采用「双盲评审」，批改老师看不出文章是谁写的。

words.enDefinition: a published paper withdrawn because of errors or misconduct

examples.en: The database flagged one retracted paper in my saved folder, so I removed it.
examples.zh: 数据库提示我收藏夹里有一篇「撤稿论文」，我就移除了。

examples.en: Always check for a retraction notice before building an argument on a retracted paper.
examples.zh: 在基于「撤稿论文」构建论点前，务必查看撤稿声明。

words.enDefinition: a fake journal charging fees without genuine peer review

examples.en: That email inviting me to submit was from a predatory journal, not a real one.
examples.zh: 那封邀稿邮件来自「掠夺性期刊」，不是真正的学术刊物。

examples.en: Check each journal against our library's whitelist to avoid predatory journals.
examples.zh: 投稿前先对照图书馆的白名单，避开「掠夺性期刊」。

words.enDefinition: a searchable collection of scholarly articles the library subscribes to

examples.en: Our library pays for academic databases like JSTOR and PsycINFO, so start there instead of Google.
examples.zh: 图书馆付费购买了 JSTOR、PsycINFO 等「学术数据库」，请优先使用。

examples.en: Each academic database covers different fields, so ask a librarian which one fits your topic.
examples.zh: 每个「学术数据库」覆盖的领域不同，可以问馆员哪个适合你的题目。

words.enDefinition: the search tool listing every book and holding the library owns

examples.en: The library catalog shows the call number, so you can find the book on the shelves yourself.
examples.zh: 「馆藏目录」会显示索书号，你可以自己去书架上找书。

examples.en: Type the author's last name into the library catalog to see all their holdings.
examples.zh: 在「馆藏目录」里输入作者姓氏，就能看到馆藏的所有著作。

words.enDefinition: searching with AND, OR, and NOT operators to combine keywords

examples.en: Use a Boolean search with AND to require both climate and migration in the results.
examples.zh: 用「布尔检索」的 AND 运算符，让结果同时包含气候与移民。

examples.en: The librarian taught us Boolean search so we could narrow thousands of hits to a dozen.
examples.zh: 馆员教我们「布尔检索」，把上千条结果缩小到十几条。

words.enDefinition: the exact keyword and operator combination typed into a database

examples.en: Save your search string so you can rerun it in other databases later.
examples.zh: 把「检索式」存下来，之后可在其他数据库里重复运行。

examples.en: My search string used quotation marks around social media to keep the phrase together.
examples.zh: 我的「检索式」给 social media 加了引号，让它作为整体短语检索。

words.enDefinition: using quotation marks to force exact multi-word matches

examples.en: Put quotation marks around social media anxiety for a phrase search instead of separate words.
examples.zh: 给 social media anxiety 加引号做「短语检索」，而不是分开搜单词。

examples.en: A phrase search returned forty results, while the loose search returned four thousand.
examples.zh: 「短语检索」只返回四十条结果，松散检索却返回了四千条。

words.enDefinition: using a symbol like an asterisk to match word endings

examples.en: Typing migra* is truncation, so it retrieves migrant, migration, and migratory at once.
examples.zh: 输入 migra* 就是「截词检索」，能同时命中 migrant 和 migration。

examples.en: Truncation broadens results, so pair the asterisk with a narrow Boolean operator.
examples.zh: 「截词检索」会扩大结果，星号要配合窄化的布尔运算符使用。

words.enDefinition: a symbol replacing one or more letters in a search term

examples.en: Use a wildcard like wom?n to search both woman and women.
examples.zh: 用 wom?n 这样的「通配符」能同时搜到 woman 和 women。

examples.en: Each database has its own wildcard rules, so check the help page first.
examples.zh: 每个数据库的「通配符」规则不同，先看帮助页面。

words.enDefinition: a search page with separate boxes for several fields

examples.en: Switch to advanced search to limit each keyword to the title field.
examples.zh: 切换到「高级检索」，可以把关键词限定在标题字段。

examples.en: In advanced search you can combine three fields instead of one long line.
examples.zh: 在「高级检索」里可以组合三个字段，而不是写一长串。

words.enDefinition: a sidebar option limiting results by date, type, or language

examples.en: Apply a search filter for the last five years to keep sources current.
examples.zh: 加一个近五年的「筛选条件」，保证文献足够新。

examples.en: The peer-reviewed search filter saved me from wading through blog posts.
examples.zh: 同行评审的「筛选条件」让我不用再翻一堆博客文章。

words.enDefinition: the standardized term databases use to tag each article

examples.en: Once you find one good article, click its subject heading to find similar ones.
examples.zh: 找到一篇好文章后，点它的「主题词」就能找到类似文献。

examples.en: Subject headings differ across databases, so note the exact term for each one.
examples.zh: 不同数据库的「主题词」不一样，要分别记下准确用词。

words.enDefinition: following reference lists and citing articles to find related work

examples.en: Citation chaining backward through her reference list uncovered the classic 1998 study.
examples.zh: 沿着她的参考文献列表做「引文追溯」，找到了1998年的经典研究。

examples.en: Google Scholar's cited-by link makes forward citation chaining much faster.
examples.zh: 谷歌学术的被引用链接让正向「引文追溯」快得多。

words.enDefinition: using your university login to reach subscriptions from home

examples.en: Off-campus access stopped working until I renewed my library account online.
examples.zh: 我在网上续期图书馆账户后，「校外访问」才恢复正常。

examples.en: Sign in with your student ID to set up off-campus access for the databases.
examples.zh: 用学号登录，设置好数据库的「校外访问」权限。

words.enDefinition: a free search engine indexing scholarly articles and citations

examples.en: I set Google Scholar to show links to our library's full-text holdings.
examples.zh: 我把「谷歌学术」设置成显示我们图书馆的全文链接。

examples.en: Google Scholar profiles let you track a professor's publications and citation counts.
examples.zh: 「谷歌学术」主页可以追踪某位教授的论文和被引数据。

words.enDefinition: a subscription database archiving journals across humanities and social sciences

examples.en: JSTOR archives older issues, so look elsewhere for papers from the last two years.
examples.zh: 「JSTOR数据库」以过刊为主，近两年的论文要去别处找。

examples.en: Our library's JSTOR subscription saved me twenty dollars on one article alone.
examples.zh: 图书馆的「JSTOR数据库」订阅让我单篇文章就省了二十美元。

words.enDefinition: a service borrowing books or articles from other libraries for you

examples.en: Interlibrary loan got me the chapter our library didn't own, scanned in two days.
examples.zh: 通过「馆际互借」，我们馆没有的那一章两天内就扫描发来了。

examples.en: Submit an interlibrary loan request early, because delivery can take two weeks.
examples.zh: 「馆际互借」申请要趁早，因为寄送可能要两周。

words.enDefinition: the required system for formatting citations, such as APA or MLA

examples.en: Check the syllabus before you start; each professor picks a different citation style.
examples.zh: 动笔前先看课程大纲，每位教授规定的「引用格式」都不同。

examples.en: Switching citation styles is easy in Zotero once your references are imported.
examples.zh: 文献导入 Zotero 后，切换「引用格式」很容易。

words.enDefinition: the author-date citation system common in psychology and education

examples.en: APA style puts the year right after the author's name in every in-text citation.
examples.zh: 「APA格式」要求在文中引用的作者名后紧跟年份。

examples.en: The nursing department follows APA style, so my lab reports use author-date citations.
examples.zh: 护理系采用「APA格式」，所以实验报告用作者—年份式引用。

words.enDefinition: the citation system used in literature and humanities courses

examples.en: MLA style asks for the author and page number, not the year.
examples.zh: 「MLA格式」要求标注作者和页码，而不是年份。

examples.en: My literature professor grades the works cited page strictly by MLA style rules.
examples.zh: 文学教授会严格按照「MLA格式」给引用文献列表评分。

words.enDefinition: the citation system using footnotes, common in history courses

examples.en: Chicago style relies on footnotes, which history professors prefer for primary sources.
examples.zh: 「芝加哥格式」使用脚注，历史系教授更喜欢用它处理一手资料。

examples.en: The Chicago style manual offers two systems: notes-bibliography and author-date.
examples.zh: 「芝加哥格式」手册提供注释—书目和作者—年份两套体系。

words.enDefinition: the official style book defining a citation system's rules

examples.en: The APA publication manual's seventh edition changed how up to twenty authors are listed.
examples.zh: APA「官方格式手册」第七版改动了列出至多二十位作者的规则。

examples.en: Keep the publication manual next to your laptop while formatting references.
examples.zh: 排版参考文献时，把「官方格式手册」放在电脑旁。

collocations: latest edition of the publication manual

words.enDefinition: a short departmental document summarizing citation and formatting rules

examples.en: The history department's style guide condenses Chicago style into four pages.
examples.zh: 历史系的「格式指南」把芝加哥格式浓缩成了四页。

examples.en: Download the writing center's style guide before you format your first draft.
examples.zh: 排初稿格式之前，先下载写作中心的「格式指南」。

words.enDefinition: a model document showing correct formatting for a citation style

examples.en: Purdue OWL's sample paper shows exactly where the running head goes.
examples.zh: 普渡 OWL 的「示例论文」清楚标出页眉应在的位置。

examples.en: Compare your title page against the sample paper before submitting.
examples.zh: 提交前，把你的扉页与「示例论文」对照一遍。

words.enDefinition: a short source note placed inside the paper's body

examples.en: Every quotation needs an in-text citation with a page number in APA style.
examples.zh: 在 APA 格式里，每处引文都需要带页码的「文内引用」。

examples.en: My professor circled a whole paragraph and wrote, missing in-text citation.
examples.zh: 教授圈出我草稿的一整段，批注缺少「文内引用」。

collocations: in-text citation with a page number

words.enDefinition: a source note in parentheses at the sentence's end

examples.en: Put the parenthetical citation before the final period, not after it.
examples.zh: 「括号夹注」要放在句号之前，而不是之后。

examples.en: A parenthetical citation such as (Chen 45) is standard in MLA style.
examples.zh: 像 (Chen 45) 这样的「括号夹注」是 MLA 格式的标准写法。

words.enDefinition: a citation where the author's name is spoken in your sentence

examples.en: A narrative citation reads naturally: Chen argues that dorms shape study habits.
examples.zh: 「叙述式引用」读起来很自然：Chen 认为宿舍塑造学习习惯。

examples.en: Mix narrative citations with parenthetical ones so paragraphs do not feel mechanical.
examples.zh: 「叙述式引用」与括号夹注交替使用，段落才不会显得死板。

collocations: narrative citation with a signal verb

words.enDefinition: a short phrase introducing a quotation with the author's name

examples.en: A signal phrase like “According to Chen” keeps the quotation tied to your argument.
examples.zh: 像 According to Chen 这样的「引述语」能让引文紧扣你的论点。

examples.en: Vary your signal phrases; not every source can merely claim or state.
examples.zh: 「引述语」要多变换，别每条来源都只会用 claim 或 state。

collocations: introduce a quotation with a signal phrase

words.enDefinition: the MLA list of every source actually cited in the paper

examples.en: The works cited page starts on a new page with the title centered.
examples.zh: 「引用文献列表」要另起一页，标题居中。

examples.en: Alphabetize the works cited list by the first author's surname.
examples.zh: 「引用文献列表」按第一作者姓氏的字母顺序排列。

words.enDefinition: a list of sources consulted, whether or not directly cited

examples.en: Chicago style ends with a bibliography that may include background reading.
examples.zh: 芝加哥格式在文末附「文献目录」，可包含仅作背景阅读的书。

examples.en: The bibliography may list works you read for background but never cited.
examples.zh: 「文献目录」可以列出你读过但从未直接引用的著作。

words.enDefinition: a source list where each entry is followed by a summary paragraph

examples.en: Write three sentences per source for the annotated bibliography due Friday.
examples.zh: 周五要交的「注释文献目录」，每条来源写三句话。

examples.en: An annotated bibliography forced me to actually read each article before citing it.
examples.zh: 「注释文献目录」逼我在引用前认真读完每篇文章。

words.enDefinition: a note at the page bottom giving extra details or citation

examples.en: Put the archival details in a footnote so the main text stays readable.
examples.zh: 把档案细节放进「脚注」，正文才不会太啰嗦。

examples.en: Chicago style numbers each footnote with a superscript in the sentence.
examples.zh: 芝加哥格式在句中用上标编号标出每个「脚注」。

collocations: footnote at the bottom of the page

words.enDefinition: a note collected at the paper's end instead of each page

examples.en: Our professor prefers endnotes, so all notes gather before the bibliography.
examples.zh: 教授要求用「尾注」，所有注释都集中在文献目录之前。

examples.en: Converting footnotes to endnotes takes just one click in Word.
examples.zh: 在 Word 里一键就能把脚注转换成「尾注」。

words.enDefinition: a long quotation set off as its own indented paragraph

examples.en: Any quotation longer than four lines becomes a block quote in APA style.
examples.zh: 在 APA 格式里，超过四行的引文要排成「整段引文」。

examples.en: Do not overuse the block quote; professors want mostly your own voice.
examples.zh: 不要滥用「整段引文」，教授想看到的主要是你自己的论述。

words.enDefinition: paired marks showing someone's exact spoken or written words

examples.en: Copy three-word phrases into quotation marks too, not just whole sentences.
examples.zh: 三个词的短语也要放进「引号」，而不只是整句。

examples.en: Periods and commas go inside the quotation marks in American English.
examples.zh: 美式英语里，句号和逗号要放在「引号」内。

words.enDefinition: an author's words copied exactly inside quotation marks

examples.en: Balance each direct quote with your own analysis, or the paragraph reads like a copy-paste.
examples.zh: 每处「直接引文」都要配上自己的分析，否则段落像复制粘贴。

examples.en: Limit each direct quote to one or two sentences in a short essay.
examples.zh: 短文里每处「直接引文」控制在一两句以内。

collocations: direct quote with a page number

words.enDefinition: three dots showing words were cut from a quotation

examples.en: Use an ellipsis to cut the middle of the sentence without changing its meaning.
examples.zh: 用「省略号」删掉句子中段，但不能改变原意。

examples.en: An ellipsis at the start of a quote looks sloppy, so begin at a natural break.
examples.zh: 「省略号」放在引文开头显得潦草，应从自然停顿处开始引用。

words.enDefinition: marks used to insert clarifying words inside a quotation

examples.en: Use square brackets to replace a pronoun with the actual name inside the quote.
examples.zh: 在引文里用「方括号」把代词换成真实姓名。

examples.en: Square brackets show readers that the insertion is yours, not the author's.
examples.zh: 「方括号」告诉读者，插入的文字是你的，不是原作者的。

words.enDefinition: a bracketed note showing an odd phrase appeared that way originally

examples.en: Add [sic] after a typo you quote so readers know it is the author's error.
examples.zh: 引用原作的错字后加上「原文如此」（[sic]），读者就知道那是作者的笔误。

examples.en: Never quietly correct the source; mark it with [sic] instead.
examples.zh: 不要悄悄改掉原文，应加「原文如此」（[sic]）标注。

words.enDefinition: a short form meaning and others, used for three or more authors

examples.en: APA style lists every author the first time; afterwards use et al.
examples.zh: APA 格式首次列出全部作者，之后用「等人」（et al.）。

examples.en: In formal writing, cite three or more authors as Chen et al., not as a full list.
examples.zh: 正式写作里，三位以上作者引用为 Chen「等人」（et al.），不必全列。

words.enDefinition: a footnote word meaning the same source as the previous note

examples.en: Use ibid when consecutive footnotes cite the same book, then add the new page.
examples.zh: 相邻脚注引同一本书时用「同上」（ibid），再标新页码。

examples.en: Ibids save space, but Chicago style now discourages long chains of them.
examples.zh: 「同上」能省篇幅，但芝加哥格式现在不鼓励连着用一长串。

words.enDefinition: the printed page location cited after a quotation

examples.en: MLA style requires the page number in every citation, even for a paraphrase.
examples.zh: MLA 格式每处引用都要标「页码」，转述也不例外。

examples.en: The PDF's stable layout keeps the page number reliable for citations.
examples.zh: PDF 版式固定，「页码」作为引用位置更可靠。

words.enDefinition: the first and last pages of an article in a reference entry

examples.en: The reference entry must include the article's full page range after the issue number.
examples.zh: 参考文献条目要在期号之后标出文章完整的「页码范围」。

examples.en: Copy the page range from the database record, not from your printed excerpt.
examples.zh: 「页码范围」要从数据库记录里抄，不要按打印的节选填。

words.enDefinition: the yearly series number of a journal, listed before the issue

examples.en: APA style italicizes the volume number but not the issue number in parentheses.
examples.zh: APA 格式里「卷号」要斜体，括号内的期号不用。

examples.en: Copy the volume number from the article's header, not from the search results list.
examples.zh: 「卷号」要从文章页眉里抄，不要照搬检索结果列表。

words.enDefinition: the number of a journal issue within its volume

examples.en: The issue number goes in parentheses right after the volume in APA references.
examples.zh: APA 参考文献里，「期号」用括号紧跟在卷号之后。

examples.en: Without the issue number, readers may retrieve the wrong article with the same title.
examples.zh: 缺了「期号」，读者可能检索到同名的另一篇文章。

words.enDefinition: reference formatting where the first line sits left and later lines indent

examples.en: Every entry on the works cited page needs a hanging indent of half an inch.
examples.zh: 引用文献列表上每条记录都需要半英寸的「悬挂缩进」。

examples.en: Set the hanging indent once in paragraph settings, and Word applies it to new entries.
examples.zh: 在段落设置里一次性设好「悬挂缩进」，新增条目会自动应用。

words.enDefinition: capitalizing main words in a title, as book titles require

examples.en: Journal titles in APA references use title case, while article titles use sentence case.
examples.zh: APA 参考文献中，期刊名用「标题式大小写」，文章标题则用句首大写。

examples.en: MLA style applies title case to almost every title in your works cited list.
examples.zh: MLA 格式里，引用文献列表中几乎所有标题都用「标题式大小写」。

words.enDefinition: slanted type used for book titles and journal names

examples.en: Book titles take italics, but chapter titles stay plain in most styles.
examples.zh: 多数引用格式中，书名用「斜体」，章节名则不用。

examples.en: Don't italicize the issue number; only the journal name and volume take italics.
examples.zh: 期号不要用「斜体」，只有期刊名和卷号才用斜体。

words.enDefinition: citing a source found quoted inside another author's work

examples.en: Write as cited in when you make a secondary citation instead of pretending you read the original.
examples.zh: 做「转引」时要写 as cited in，不要假装读过原始文献。

examples.en: Secondary citations are a last resort; hunt for the original study in the databases first.
examples.zh: 「转引」是下策，应先在数据库里找原始研究。

collocations: as cited in for secondary citations

words.enDefinition: to quote a source inaccurately, changing its wording or meaning

examples.en: Professors notice when students misquote an article to fit their argument.
examples.zh: 学生为贴合论点而「误引」文章时，教授一眼就能看出来。

examples.en: Always reread the original page before quoting, because paraphrasing from memory can misquote.
examples.zh: 引用前务必重读原文，凭记忆转述容易「误引」。

words.enDefinition: giving clear credit to the source of an idea or phrase

examples.en: Proper attribution means naming the author, even when you paraphrase in your own words.
examples.zh: 做到「注明出处」就要提到作者，即使你用自己的话转述。

examples.en: The rubric awards points for accurate attribution of every borrowed idea.
examples.zh: 评分标准规定，每个借用观点的「注明出处」都计分。

words.enDefinition: software storing references and inserting formatted citations while you write

examples.en: A citation manager like Zotero saves hours of formatting at three in the morning.
examples.zh: 像 Zotero 这样的「文献管理软件」能省下凌晨三点调格式的时间。

examples.en: Our writing center workshop introduced every citation manager the library supports.
examples.zh: 写作中心的工作坊介绍了图书馆支持的所有「文献管理软件」。

words.enDefinition: a free citation manager grabbing sources straight from the browser

examples.en: Zotero's browser connector saves the article's metadata and PDF with one click.
examples.zh: 「Zotero」的浏览器插件一键就能保存文章的元数据和 PDF。

examples.en: I sync my Zotero library across devices so thesis writing continues in the computer lab.
examples.zh: 我把「Zotero」文库多端同步，在机房也能接着写论文。

words.enDefinition: a citation manager popular with science students for organizing PDFs

examples.en: Mendeley groups my readings by project and highlights PDFs alongside them.
examples.zh: 「Mendeley」按项目为文献分组，还能在 PDF 上做高亮。

examples.en: My lab mates prefer Mendeley because it suggests related papers while we read.
examples.zh: 实验室同学更喜欢「Mendeley」，因为阅读时它会推荐相关论文。

words.enDefinition: inserting citations into a document directly from a manager plugin

examples.en: With cite while you write, the reference list updates itself as you draft.
examples.zh: 用「边写边引」插件，草稿写到哪里，参考文献列表就自动更新到哪里。

examples.en: Learn cite while you write early in the semester, not during finals week.
examples.zh: 「边写边引」要开学初就学，别拖到考试周。

words.enDefinition: a website building a formatted reference from a URL or ISBN

examples.en: Check every citation generator result by hand; they frequently mess up capitalization.
examples.zh: 「引文生成器」的结果都要手动核对，大小写经常出错。

examples.en: I used a citation generator for the rough draft, then fixed the entries in Zotero.
examples.zh: 初稿我用「引文生成器」生成引文，之后在 Zotero 里逐条修正。

words.enDefinition: to move citation records into your manager from a database or file

examples.en: Import references directly from EBSCO using the exported RIS file.
examples.zh: 用导出的 RIS 文件从 EBSCO「导入文献」。

examples.en: Import references in bulk instead of typing authors one by one.
examples.zh: 「导入文献」要批量进行，别逐条手输作者名。

collocations: import references via a RIS file

words.enDefinition: to save citation records out of a database into a file

examples.en: Select the checkbox beside each hit before you export citations from the database.
examples.zh: 从数据库「导出引文」前，先勾选每条命中的记录。

examples.en: Export citations in BibTeX format for the LaTeX-based thesis template.
examples.zh: 论文的 LaTeX 模板要求用 BibTeX 格式「导出引文」。

words.enDefinition: to apply a style like APA or MLA to references automatically

examples.en: With one click you can format citations in APA style across the whole document.
examples.zh: 一键就能给整篇文档按 APA 样式「套用引用格式」。

examples.en: The plugin can format citations and build the bibliography at the same time.
examples.zh: 插件可以同时「套用引用格式」并自动生成文献目录。

words.enDefinition: to combine two saved records describing the same source

examples.en: Zotero flags duplicate entries; merge duplicates after each big import.
examples.zh: Zotero 会标记重复条目，每次大批量导入后要「合并重复文献」。

examples.en: Merge duplicates carefully so you don't lose the page numbers one record carried.
examples.zh: 「合并重复文献」要小心，别弄丢某条记录里的页码。

words.enDefinition: a shared workspace where teammates collect and tag sources together

examples.en: Our group library keeps every source for the presentation in one searchable place.
examples.zh: 「群组文献库」把展示要用的所有文献集中在一处，随时可查。

examples.en: Ask your teammates to add abstracts to the group library before the next meeting.
examples.zh: 请组员在下次会议前把摘要补充到「群组文献库」里。

words.enDefinition: to save the article file itself under its citation record

examples.en: Right-click the entry and attach a PDF so notes stay with the reference.
examples.zh: 右键该条目并「添加PDF附件」，笔记就能跟着文献走。

examples.en: If you only import metadata, remember to attach a PDF from the database later.
examples.zh: 如果只导入了元数据，记得之后再从数据库「添加PDF附件」。

collocations: attach a PDF to an entry

words.enDefinition: collect your lost property from the lost and found office

examples.en: You can claim a lost item at the campus services desk with your ID.
examples.zh: 带上证件，就可以在校园服务台「认领失物」。

examples.en: I went to the desk first thing in the morning to claim a lost item.
examples.zh: 我一大早就赶到服务台「认领失物」。

collocations: claim a lost item in person
claim a lost item within thirty days

words.enDefinition: a small receipt proving you reported or retrieved an item

examples.en: Keep your claim ticket until you pick up your lost phone.
examples.zh: 取回丢失的手机之前，请保管好「认领凭证」。

examples.en: They gave me a claim ticket with a reference number on it.
examples.zh: 他们给了我一张写着编号的「认领凭证」。

words.enDefinition: the mean exam score across the whole class

examples.en: The class average on the midterm came out at sixty-eight percent.
examples.zh: 这次期中的「班级平均分」是百分之六十八。

examples.en: Scores here are judged against the class average, not a fixed scale.
examples.zh: 这里的成绩参照「班级平均分」评定，而不是固定标准。

collocations: ten points above the class average

words.enDefinition: the middle score of the whole class on an assessment

examples.en: The class median on the bio final was 71, so the professor curved it.
examples.zh: 生物期末的「班级中位数」是71分，教授因此调了分。

examples.en: Comparing your score to the class median beats guessing from the raw number.
examples.zh: 把你的分数和「全班中位数」比一比，比盯着原始分瞎猜强。

collocations: curve based on the class median

words.enDefinition: a student elected to voice their class's concerns to faculty

examples.en: As class representative, she relayed exam scheduling complaints to the department.
examples.zh: 作为「班级代表」，她把考试排期问题反馈给了系里。

examples.en: Class representatives meet the dean once a month with collected feedback.
examples.zh: 「班级代表」每月带着汇总意见与院长见一次面。

words.enDefinition: a ring bearing the school crest, bought near graduation

examples.en: He ordered a class ring with his major engraved inside.
examples.zh: 他订了一枚内圈刻着专业的「毕业纪念戒指」。

examples.en: Class ring orders are taken in the student union every spring.
examples.zh: 「毕业纪念戒指」每年春季在学生活动中心接受订购。

words.enDefinition: your year level, like freshman or junior, for registration

examples.en: Your class standing decides when you can register for popular courses.
examples.zh: 你的「年级」决定了你什么时候能注册热门课程。

examples.en: Transfer credits can bump your class standing to sophomore overnight.
examples.zh: 转学分能让你的「年级资格」一夜之间升到大二。

words.enDefinition: resolve the problem that caused a block so you can register

examples.en: Clear the hold at the service counter before your registration slot.
examples.zh: 注册时段之前，先到服务台「解除账户限制」。

examples.en: It took two emails and one visit to clear the hold.
examples.zh: 发了两封邮件又跑了一趟，才「解除账户限制」。

collocations: clear a hold with the office

words.enDefinition: delete temporary browser files so a website loads properly

examples.en: Support told me to clear the cache and restart the browser before the quiz.
examples.zh: 客服让我测验前先「清除缓存」再重启浏览器。

examples.en: The grades weren't showing until I cleared the cache on my laptop.
examples.zh: 直到我「清除缓存」之后，成绩才显示出来。

words.enDefinition: a teaching-focused professor hired for professional experience

examples.en: Our patent law course is taught by a clinical professor with twenty years of practice.
examples.zh: 我们的专利法课由执业二十年的「实务教授」讲授。

examples.en: Clinical professors usually focus on teaching rather than publishing research.
examples.zh: 「实务教授」通常侧重教学而非发表论文。

words.enDefinition: careful line-by-line analysis of how a text works

examples.en: Our literature seminar spent forty minutes on a close reading of the opening paragraph.
examples.zh: 我们的文学课花了四十分钟，对开篇段落进行「文本细读」。

examples.en: Close reading pays off when the professor asks why the author chose that exact word.
examples.zh: 当教授追问作者为何偏用那个词时，你就知道「文本细读」的功夫没有白费。

collocations: a close reading of the passage

words.enDefinition: an exam where no notes or books are allowed

examples.en: The anatomy final is a closed-book exam, so start memorizing early.
examples.zh: 解剖学期末是「闭卷考试」，所以要尽早开始背记。

examples.en: Law exams here are closed-book exams with a short list of permitted statutes.
examples.zh: 这里的法律考试是「闭卷考试」，只允许带一小部分法条入场。

words.enDefinition: text of the spoken words shown on a video

examples.en: Turn on closed captions when the professor mumbles or talks too fast.
examples.zh: 教授吐字不清或语速太快时，就打开「隐藏式字幕」。

examples.en: The closed captions garbled several technical terms, so double-check the slides.
examples.zh: 「字幕」把好几个术语识别错了，记得对照幻灯片检查。

words.enDefinition: section no longer accepting enrollment

examples.en: The Tuesday lab shows as a closed section in the portal.
examples.zh: 周二的实验课在系统里显示为「已关闭课段」。

examples.en: Closed sections sometimes reopen when departments raise the enrollment caps.
examples.zh: 系里提高选课上限后，「已关闭课段」有时会重新开放。

words.enDefinition: a form some clubs require before admitting new members

examples.en: The consulting club reviews every club application and invites shortlisted students to interviews.
examples.zh: 咨询社要审阅每一份「社团申请」，并邀请入围的学生面试。

examples.en: I submitted my club application for the investment society a week before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我在截止日期前一周提交了投资学会的「社团申请」。

words.enDefinition: a plan for how a club will spend its money

examples.en: The club budget allocates most funds to competition fees and travel.
examples.zh: 社团「预算」的大部分经费用于比赛报名费和差旅。

examples.en: We drafted the club budget together and submitted it to student government.
examples.zh: 我们一起起草了「社团预算」并提交给了学生自治会。

words.enDefinition: the document stating a club's purpose, roles, and rules

examples.en: Amendments to the club constitution need a two-thirds vote at a general meeting.
examples.zh: 修改「社团章程」需要在全体大会上获得三分之二票数。

examples.en: New clubs must submit a constitution before the university grants them funding.
examples.zh: 新社团必须先提交「章程」，学校才会批经费。

words.enDefinition: the membership fee a club charges each term or year

examples.en: Club dues cover competition travel, so we keep them under twenty dollars a term.
examples.zh: 社团「会费」涵盖比赛差旅，所以我们把标准控制在每学期二十美元以内。

examples.en: Hardship waivers let students pay reduced club dues if money is tight.
examples.zh: 手头紧的学生可以申请减免部分「会费」。

words.enDefinition: an elected student holding a leadership role in a club

examples.en: Every club officer must complete a short training from the student activities office.
examples.zh: 每位「社团干事」都要完成学生活动办公室的简短培训。

examples.en: Each club officer handles tasks like booking rooms, social media, and welcoming new members.
examples.zh: 每位「社团干事」分别负责订教室、运营社媒或迎接新成员。

words.enDefinition: the elected student who leads a club for a term

examples.en: The club president runs the weekly meeting and signs off on every budget request.
examples.zh: 「社长」主持每周例会，并在每份预算申请上签字。

examples.en: Our club president negotiated free practice space with the athletics office.
examples.zh: 我们的「社长」与体育办公室谈下了免费训练场地。

words.enDefinition: officially signing a new club up with the university

examples.en: Club registration opens in September, so our founding team must submit a constitution.
examples.zh: 「社团注册」九月开放，我们的创始团队必须提交章程。

examples.en: Without completing club registration, we cannot book rooms or request funding.
examples.zh: 没有完成「社团注册」，我们就不能订活动室或申请经费。

words.enDefinition: the officer who takes minutes and handles club correspondence

examples.en: The club secretary emails the minutes to everyone within a day of each meeting.
examples.zh: 「社团秘书」会在每次开会后一天内把记录邮件发给大家。

examples.en: As club secretary, Priya books rooms and keeps the shared calendar updated.
examples.zh: 作为「社团秘书」，Priya 负责订教室并更新共享日历。

words.enDefinition: a student-run sports team more serious than intramurals but not varsity

examples.en: Club sports travel to weekend tournaments but leave scheduling to student officers.
examples.zh: 「体育社团」会去外地打周末锦标赛，但日程由学生干事安排。

examples.en: I joined the club sport volleyball team because varsity tryouts felt too intense.
examples.zh: 我加入了排球「体育社团」，因为校队选拔太卷了。

words.enDefinition: a printed shirt that shows club membership and spirit

examples.en: Wear your club t-shirt to the fair so prospective members can spot us.
examples.zh: 招新会那天穿上「社团文化衫」，准成员一眼就能认出我们。

examples.en: The new club t-shirt design won a vote at the general meeting.
examples.zh: 新版「文化衫」设计在全体大会上投票胜出。

words.enDefinition: A short event where prospective members try a club activity before deciding whether to join.

examples.en: I booked a club taster session to see whether I liked playing with the orchestra.
examples.zh: 我预约了一个「社团体验活动」，看看自己是否喜欢和管弦乐团一起演奏。

examples.en: The ceramics group offered a club taster session with enough materials for twelve new students.
examples.zh: 陶艺社举办了一次「社团体验活动」，材料够十二名新生使用。

collocations: sign up for a club taster session

words.enDefinition: the officer who manages a club's money and records

examples.en: The club treasurer keeps receipts for everything we buy for events.
examples.zh: 社团「财务」会保存活动采买的所有收据。

examples.en: Our club treasurer flagged food spending as over budget already by October.
examples.zh: 到十月，我们的「财务」就发现餐饮开销超了预算。

words.enDefinition: a room on campus reserved for a club's own use

examples.en: The clubroom doubles as a practice space with our keyboard and music stands.
examples.zh: 「社团活动室」里放着我们的电子琴和谱架，也能当练习室用。

examples.en: Keys to the clubroom are held by the secretary and the president.
examples.zh: 「社团活动室」的钥匙由社长和秘书保管。

words.enDefinition: an event where student clubs recruit new members each term

examples.en: At the clubs fair, every booth promised free pizza and fun weekly events.
examples.zh: 在「社团招新会」上，每个摊位都许诺免费披萨和有趣的周常活动。

examples.en: The international students' association stood out at the clubs fair with a lion dance.
examples.zh: 国际学生协会在「社团招新会」上表演舞狮，特别显眼。

words.enDefinition: A supervisor who shares responsibility with another supervisor for guiding a student's research.

examples.en: My co-supervisor reviewed the survey questions before I discussed them with my main adviser.
examples.zh: 我和主导师讨论调查问题之前，「共同指导导师」已经审阅了这些问题。

examples.en: The department assigned a co-supervisor who had experience with the methods I planned to use.
examples.zh: 院系为我安排了一位「共同指导导师」，熟悉我计划使用的方法。

words.enDefinition: the written rules about acceptable student behavior

examples.en: The code of conduct covers plagiarism as well as campus behavior.
examples.zh: 「行为准则」既涵盖校园行为，也涵盖抄袭问题。

examples.en: Every student agrees to the code of conduct during enrollment.
examples.zh: 每个学生注册入学时都要同意「行为准则」。

words.enDefinition: a spilled-drink mark that counts as damage on library books

examples.en: A coffee stain on page 120 turned into a twenty-dollar damage charge.
examples.zh: 第120页上的一块「咖啡渍」让我赔了二十美元。

examples.en: Keep lids on drinks, because one coffee stain ruins the whole loan.
examples.zh: 饮料要带盖，一滴「咖啡渍」就能毁了整本书。

collocations: a coffee stain on page ten

words.enDefinition: students who start a program in the same year

examples.en: My cohort has eleven students, and we take every class together.
examples.zh: 我们「同届」有十一个人，每门课都一起上。

examples.en: Each cohort chooses one representative for the department's monthly meetings.
examples.zh: 每届「同届学生」要选出一名代表参加系务会议。

words.enDefinition: the frozen fear when a professor suddenly names you

examples.en: Cold-call panic fades once you learn to buy time with 'let me think aloud'.
examples.zh: 学会先说一句“容我边想边说”争取时间，「被点名的恐慌」就会消退。

examples.en: She manages her cold-call panic by keeping one prepared comment in her notes.
examples.zh: 她在笔记里常备一条观点，用来缓解「被点名时的慌乱」。

words.enDefinition: your final undergraduate average as reported on applications

examples.en: Graduate admissions weigh junior-year courses most heavily within your college GPA.
examples.zh: 研究生招生在「大学绩点」里最看重大三的课。

examples.en: Her 3.4 college GPA cleared the program's stated cutoff with room to spare.
examples.zh: 她3.4的「本科绩点」稳稳过了项目的明线。

words.enDefinition: a regular department talk where researchers present current work

examples.en: The Friday colloquium is where visiting researchers present their latest work to the department.
examples.zh: 周五的「学术研讨会」是访问学者向全系展示最新成果的场合。

examples.en: Graduate students are expected to ask at least one question at every colloquium.
examples.zh: 研究生每场「学术研讨会」都至少要提一个问题。

words.enDefinition: printing in full color, which costs extra per page

examples.en: Color printing costs fifty cents a page, so save it for charts.
examples.zh: 「彩色打印」每页50美分，留给图表用就好。

examples.en: The color printer on level one handles color printing for posters too.
examples.zh: 一楼的彩色打印机也能做海报类的「彩色打印」。

collocations: send color printing to level one

words.enDefinition: to return at another time when staff are free

examples.en: The clerk is at lunch, so please come back later.
examples.zh: 办事员去吃午饭了，请「晚点再来」。

examples.en: Forms are processed after three, so come back later today.
examples.zh: 表格三点后才处理，今天「晚点再来」一趟。

collocations: asked me to come back later

words.enDefinition: to stop being withdrawn and start joining in

examples.en: Our discussion group is friendly enough for anyone to come out of their shell.
examples.zh: 我们的讨论小组氛围友好，谁都能「不再拘谨」。

examples.en: After two months of tutorials, he finally came out of his shell and argued back.
examples.zh: 上了两个月辅导课后，他终于「走出了自己的壳」，敢开口争论了。

collocations: come out of your shell gradually
help someone come out of their shell
finally come out of your shell

words.enDefinition: a professor's invitation to meet in their office

examples.en: Come to my office and we'll go over your essay outline.
examples.zh: 「来我办公室」，我们一起过一遍论文提纲。

examples.en: If my office hours don't work, come to my office another afternoon.
examples.zh: 答疑时间不合适，就改天下午「来我办公室」。

collocations: feel free to come to my office
come to my office before the deadline

words.enDefinition: the formal ceremony at which degrees are officially conferred

examples.en: The commencement ceremony begins at nine sharp in the stadium.
examples.zh: 「学位授予典礼」九点整在体育场开始。

examples.en: Her whole family flew in to attend the commencement ceremony.
examples.zh: 她全家飞过来参加「学位授予典礼」。

words.enDefinition: the printed booklet listing graduates and ceremony order

examples.en: Your name appears in the commencement program exactly as filed.
examples.zh: 「毕业典礼手册」上的名字与你登记的完全一致。

examples.en: Check the commencement program for the processional order and speaker times.
examples.zh: 在「毕业典礼手册」里查看入场顺序和嘉宾致辞时间。

words.enDefinition: the invited guest who addresses graduates at commencement

examples.en: This year's commencement speaker is an alumna who founded a tech company.
examples.zh: 今年的「毕业典礼演讲嘉宾」是一位创办了科技公司的女校友。

examples.en: The commencement speaker told graduates to stay curious after campus.
examples.zh: 「毕业典礼演讲嘉宾」告诉毕业生们离开校园后要保持好奇。

words.enDefinition: how much time and effort a club expects from members

examples.en: Ask about the commitment level before joining; some teams practice daily.
examples.zh: 加入前先问清「投入程度」，有些队伍每天都要训练。

examples.en: The recruitment flyer states a medium commitment level of five hours weekly.
examples.zh: 招新传单写明「投入程度」中等，每周五小时。

words.enDefinition: the professor who leads your thesis or dissertation committee

examples.en: The committee chair signs off on every milestone before the defense.
examples.zh: 答辩前每个节点都要由「委员会主席」签字确认。

examples.en: Email the committee chair to book your proposal meeting next month.
examples.zh: 发邮件给「委员会主席」，预约下个月的开题会议。

words.enDefinition: shared opinions that opposing sides can agree on first

examples.en: Start from common ground before you challenge the author's central claim.
examples.zh: 先从「共同立场」出发，再去挑战作者的核心论断。

examples.en: After an hour of arguing, both sides found common ground on the second question.
examples.zh: 争论一小时后，双方在第二个问题上找到了「共同点」。

collocations: common ground between the two camps

words.enDefinition: logged time spent volunteering that some programs require

examples.en: Volunteering at the shelter counts toward your community service hours for graduation.
examples.zh: 在收容所做志愿可以计入毕业要求的「社区服务时长」。

examples.en: She logged fifty community service hours with the tutoring club this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期她通过辅导社团攒了五十小时「社区服务时长」。

words.enDefinition: the official step-by-step process for reporting a problem

examples.en: The complaint procedure is explained step by step on the website.
examples.zh: 网站上一步一步说明了「投诉流程」。

examples.en: Follow the complaint procedure before posting about the issue online.
examples.zh: 在网上发帖吐槽之前，先按「投诉流程」来。

collocations: the complaint procedure takes two weeks

words.enDefinition: dropping every course and leaving the university for that term

examples.en: A complete withdrawal after the refund date still costs most of the tuition.
examples.zh: 退款日后办理「整学期退学」，大部分学费仍要照付。

examples.en: Choose a complete withdrawal only when finishing the term is impossible.
examples.zh: 只有实在无法完成学期时，才选择「整学期退学」。

words.enDefinition: a graduate exam covering a student's whole field

examples.en: Doctoral students take their comprehensive exams after finishing all required courses.
examples.zh: 博士生在修完全部必修课后参加「综合考试」。

examples.en: He spent the summer reading for comprehensive exams in three subject areas.
examples.zh: 他整个暑假都在为三个领域的「综合考试」读书备考。

words.enDefinition: using the laptop's own microphone and speakers for sound in a call

examples.en: Choose computer audio when you join, or Zoom will dial your phone.
examples.zh: 入会时选「电脑音频」，不然Zoom会拨打你手机。

examples.en: My computer audio wasn't working, so I switched to my earbuds' mic.
examples.zh: 「电脑音频」出了问题，我改用耳机上的麦克风。

words.enDefinition: an exam taken on a computer at a center

examples.en: The language certificate switched to a computer-based test last year.
examples.zh: 这项语言证书去年改成了「机考」。

examples.en: You still get scratch paper even in the computer-based test.
examples.zh: 即使是「机考」，也会发草稿纸。

words.enDefinition: a focused subject area inside your chosen major

examples.en: Her finance concentration requires four specialized courses in the junior year.
examples.zh: 她的金融「专业方向」要求大三修四门专门课程。

examples.en: Students declare a concentration at the end of sophomore year.
examples.zh: 学生在大二结束时确定「专业方向」。

words.enDefinition: admission granted only if you later meet stated conditions

examples.en: The conditional offer becomes final once my final transcript arrives.
examples.zh: 等我的最终成绩单寄到，「有条件录取」就转为正式录取。

examples.en: Her conditional offer requires an overall IELTS band of seven.
examples.zh: 她的「有条件录取」要求雅思总分七分。

words.enDefinition: the official calendar date your degree takes effect

examples.en: The conferral date appears on both the diploma and the transcript.
examples.zh: 「授予日期」会同时出现在证书和成绩单上。

examples.en: Her conferral date is August fifteenth even though ceremonies ended in May.
examples.zh: 虽然典礼五月就结束了，她的「授予日期」是八月十五日。

words.enDefinition: an automatic message confirming that your request was received

examples.en: You will get a confirmation email after each form submission.
examples.zh: 每次提交表格后都会收到「确认邮件」。

examples.en: The confirmation email lists the office to contact if something is wrong.
examples.zh: 「确认邮件」里写明了出问题时该联系的部门。

words.enDefinition: to wrongly merge two different ideas into one

examples.en: The editorial conflates correlation with cause, which the seminar spent an hour untangling.
examples.zh: 这篇社论把相关「混同于」因果，研讨课花了一小时才理清。

examples.en: Do not conflate the author's personal views with the narrator's voice in the novel.
examples.zh: 别把作者本人的观点和小说叙述者的声音「混为一谈」。

words.enDefinition: phone and email details the school uses to reach you

examples.en: Check that your contact information is current before finals week.
examples.zh: 期末周之前，确认「联系方式」是否仍然有效。

examples.en: Never leave outdated contact information, or you might miss a probation notice.
examples.zh: 别让「联系方式」过期，否则可能错过学业察看通知。

words.enDefinition: grades built up through coursework during the term

examples.en: Under continuous assessment, every lab report counts toward your final mark.
examples.zh: 在「平时考核」制度下，每份实验报告都计入期末总评。

examples.en: Continuous assessment suits steady workers better than one big final does.
examples.zh: 相比一锤子买卖的期末大考，「平时考核」更适合稳扎稳打的人。

words.enDefinition: a weekly drop-in hour for practicing casual conversation

examples.en: The language society hosts a conversation hour for Mandarin learners on Wednesdays.
examples.zh: 语言社团每周三为中文学习者举办一场「会话角」。

examples.en: I volunteer at the conversation hour to help newcomers practice small talk.
examples.zh: 我在「会话角」做志愿者，帮新生练习日常寒暄。

collocations: drop in at the conversation hour

words.enDefinition: a student who practices casual speaking with you regularly

examples.en: Sign up online to get a conversation partner for English practice.
examples.zh: 在网上报名，就能配到一位练英语的「会话伙伴」。

examples.en: My conversation partner and I meet at the café every Friday.
examples.zh: 我和「会话伙伴」每周五在咖啡馆碰面。

words.enDefinition: central required course within your major

examples.en: Organic chemistry is a core course for all pre-med students.
examples.zh: 有机化学是所有医学预科生的「核心课程」。

examples.en: Register early because core courses fill up the fastest each term.
examples.zh: 尽早注册，「核心课程」每学期都最先满员。

words.enDefinition: fixed set of courses all students complete

examples.en: Their core curriculum includes philosophy, academic writing, and quantitative reasoning.
examples.zh: 他们的「核心课程体系」包括哲学、学术写作和定量推理。

examples.en: Transfer credits sometimes count toward parts of the core curriculum.
examples.zh: 转学分有时能抵充「核心课程体系」的部分内容。

words.enDefinition: course you must take at the same time as another

examples.en: The lab is a corequisite, so register for both CRNs together.
examples.zh: 实验课是「同修课程」，两个课程号要一起注册。

examples.en: You can't enroll in the lecture without adding its corequisite.
examples.zh: 不加选「同修课程」，你就选不了这门大课。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled one-on-one session with a campus counselor

examples.en: I booked a counseling appointment for Thursday afternoon after my last class.
examples.zh: 我把「心理咨询预约」约在周四下午最后一节课之后。

examples.en: Cancel your counseling appointment online if something unexpected comes up.
examples.zh: 如果临时有事，就上网取消「心理咨询预约」。

words.enDefinition: the campus office where students can talk with counselors

examples.en: The counseling center offers free sessions for all enrolled students.
examples.zh: 「心理咨询中心」为所有在校学生提供免费咨询。

examples.en: Walk into the counseling center if you need to talk to someone today.
examples.zh: 如果今天就想找人聊聊，可以直接走进「心理咨询中心」。

collocations: refer a student to the counseling center

words.enDefinition: to be included when your grade average is computed

examples.en: Pass/fail courses do not count toward your GPA, only your credits.
examples.zh: 按合格制修的课不「计入绩点」，只算学分。

examples.en: Repeated courses sometimes count toward your GPA twice under older policies.
examples.zh: 按老政策，重修的课有时会两次「计入绩点」。

collocations: courses that count toward your GPA

words.enDefinition: an opposing argument raised against a claim or proposal

examples.en: The strongest counterargument came from the student who had just presented in favor.
examples.zh: 最有力的「反方论点」恰恰来自刚做完支持方展示的学生。

examples.en: Anticipate the obvious counterargument, or the professor will raise it for you.
examples.zh: 要预判显而易见的「反驳论点」，否则教授会替你提出来。

words.enDefinition: an example that disproves or weakens a general claim

examples.en: One counterexample from Japan weakened the professor's sweeping claim about exam culture.
examples.zh: 一个来自日本的「反例」动摇了教授关于考试文化的笼统论断。

examples.en: A good counterexample forces the presenter to narrow the claim instead of abandoning it.
examples.zh: 一个好的「反例」会促使展示者收窄论断，而非全盘放弃。

words.enDefinition: a contrasting view offered to balance someone's argument

examples.en: Let me offer a counterpoint from the employers' side of the debate.
examples.zh: 请允许我从辩论中雇主一方提出一个「对立观点」。

examples.en: Every counterpoint he raised made the presenter refine her claim instead of defending it blindly.
examples.zh: 他提出的每个「相反观点」都促使展示者打磨论断，而不是盲目辩护。

words.enDefinition: an official notice a professor posts for the whole class

examples.en: Read the course announcement carefully because the quiz moved to Thursday.
examples.zh: 仔细读「课程公告」，测验改到周四了。

examples.en: Many students missed the course announcement about the room change, so the TA emailed us.
examples.zh: 很多同学没看到教室调整的「课程公告」，助教只好再发邮件。

words.enDefinition: university canceling a course, usually for low enrollment

examples.en: Check your email daily during add/drop week for any course cancellation.
examples.zh: 退补选周每天查邮件，留意有没有「课程取消」。

examples.en: A course cancellation forced me into a nine a.m. statistics section.
examples.zh: 一次「课程取消」逼得我选了早上九点的统计课段。

collocations: course cancellation due to low enrollment

words.enDefinition: official listing of every course a school offers

examples.en: Search the course catalog for classes that fit your work schedule.
examples.zh: 在「课程目录」里搜索符合你作息的课。

examples.en: The course catalog lists prerequisites, credits, and which terms each class runs.
examples.zh: 「课程目录」列出先修要求、学分以及各课的开课学期。

words.enDefinition: letters and numbers identifying a course, like MATH 101

examples.en: Enter the exact course code, or the portal won't find it.
examples.zh: 输入准确的「课程代码」，否则系统找不到。

examples.en: The same course code appears on your transcript after you finish.
examples.zh: 修完之后，同一个「课程代码」会出现在你的成绩单上。

words.enDefinition: the staff member who administers a multi-section course

examples.en: Email the course coordinator if you want to switch sections.
examples.zh: 想换讨论班，就给「课程协调员」发邮件。

examples.en: The course coordinator collects every make-up exam request from students.
examples.zh: 学生的补考申请统一由「课程协调员」收取。

words.enDefinition: the home screen listing your courses and upcoming deadlines

examples.en: The course dashboard shows red dots on anything due within two days.
examples.zh: 「课程主页」上两天内要交的作业都会标红点。

examples.en: I check my course dashboard before breakfast to see what's due.
examples.zh: 我早饭前先看一眼「课程主页」，确认今天要交什么。

words.enDefinition: short summary of what a course covers

examples.en: The course description mentions a weekly lab, so plan your schedule.
examples.zh: 「课程简介」提到每周有实验课，排课表时要留意。

examples.en: Read the course descriptions carefully before enrolling, not just the catchy titles.
examples.zh: 选课前认真读「课程简介」，别只看吸引人的课名。

words.enDefinition: judgment that a course elsewhere matches a local one

examples.en: The registrar granted course equivalency for my statistics class from Sydney.
examples.zh: 注册办公室认定我在悉尼修的统计课与本校课程「等效」。

examples.en: Check the equivalency database before appealing a course equivalency decision.
examples.zh: 申诉「课程等效认定」结果前，先查一下等效课程数据库。

words.enDefinition: a student survey rating a course and professor

examples.en: Please fill out the course evaluation before the Friday deadline.
examples.zh: 请在周五截止前填写「课程评教」。

examples.en: Professors read the course evaluations when they plan next term.
examples.zh: 教授规划下学期课程时会参考「课程评教」。

words.enDefinition: the final grade recorded for one complete course

examples.en: Your course grade combines homework, labs, and the final into one letter.
examples.zh: 你的「单科成绩」把作业、实验和期末合成一个等级。

examples.en: An incomplete stays on record until the course grade is finalized.
examples.zh: 未完成成绩会留在档案里，直到「课程成绩」确定为止。

words.enDefinition: record of every course you have taken so far

examples.en: Your course history helps advisors spot repeated or missing courses.
examples.zh: 「修课记录」能帮导师发现重复或遗漏的课程。

examples.en: Export your course history before meeting with the transfer evaluator.
examples.zh: 见转学分评估老师之前，先导出你的「修课记录」。

words.enDefinition: number and difficulty of courses you take at once

examples.en: A heavy course load plus a part-time job is exhausting.
examples.zh: 「课业负担」重还要打工，实在让人疲惫。

examples.en: Your advisor can help you plan a manageable course load each term.
examples.zh: 导师能帮你规划每学期适度的「课程负担」。

words.enDefinition: files, readings, and videos the professor shares for class

examples.en: All the course materials are posted under the weekly tabs on the site.
examples.zh: 所有「课程资料」都放在网站的每周标签页下面。

examples.en: Download the course materials before class in case the campus Wi-Fi acts up.
examples.zh: 课前先把「课程资料」下载好，以防校园网出问题。

words.enDefinition: a self-contained course unit with its own materials and tasks

examples.en: The new course module opens Monday with a quiz and a short essay.
examples.zh: 新的「课程模块」周一开放，包含一次测验和一篇短文。

examples.en: Each course module ends with a checklist so you know you finished everything.
examples.zh: 每个「课程模块」结尾都有清单，方便确认全部完成。

words.enDefinition: a printed bundle of readings compiled for one specific class

examples.en: The course pack for marketing is cheaper to print at the library than to buy.
examples.zh: 市场学课的「课程讲义包」在图书馆自助打印比买便宜。

examples.en: Our professor put the whole course pack on file at the circulation desk.
examples.zh: 教授把整份「课程讲义包」存在借还服务台。

collocations: course pack at the print desk

words.enDefinition: the webpage for one class on the school platform

examples.en: The professor updated the course page with this week's reading last night.
examples.zh: 教授昨晚在「课程页面」上更新了本周的阅读材料。

examples.en: Everything for the class lives on the course page, including old exams.
examples.zh: 这门课的所有内容都在「课程页面」上，包括往年考题。

words.enDefinition: assigned articles and chapters for a class, often posted online

examples.en: Scan the QR code in the syllabus to find this week's course readings.
examples.zh: 扫大纲里的二维码，就能找到本周的「课程阅读材料」。

examples.en: Half of the course readings are scanned PDFs uploaded by the professor.
examples.zh: 一半的「课程阅读材料」是教授上传的扫描PDF。

words.enDefinition: the process of signing up for next term's courses

examples.en: Course registration opens at seven on Monday morning, so set your alarm.
examples.zh: 「选课注册」周一早上七点开放，记得定好闹钟。

examples.en: My course registration failed twice because the portal crashed right at seven.
examples.zh: 系统七点整崩了，我的「选课注册」失败了两次。

words.enDefinition: pre-registration step listing the courses you want

examples.en: Submit your course request list before the department plans sections.
examples.zh: 在系里规划课段之前，提交你的「选课意向」清单。

examples.en: Course requests don't guarantee seats, but they do guide scheduling.
examples.zh: 「选课意向申请」不保证名额，但会影响排课。

words.enDefinition: books a professor sets aside for a specific class

examples.en: Course reserves for econ 201 check out for just two hours at a time.
examples.zh: 经济学201的「课程预留图书」每次只能借两小时。

examples.en: Ask at the desk for course reserves because they never sit in the regular stacks.
examples.zh: 「课程预留图书」不放在普通书库里，请到柜台询问。

words.enDefinition: portal tool for finding courses with filters

examples.en: Use the course search filters to find classes after four only.
examples.zh: 用「课程搜索」筛选器，只找四点以后的课。

examples.en: The course search shows live seat counts for every section.
examples.zh: 「课程搜索」会显示每个课段的实时余位。

words.enDefinition: choosing which courses to take each term

examples.en: Course selection for sophomores opens Thursday morning at eight sharp.
examples.zh: 大二的「选课」周四早上八点整开放。

examples.en: Careful course selection keeps your workload balanced across the week.
examples.zh: 用心「选课」能让一周的课业负担更均衡。

words.enDefinition: approved swap of one required course for another

examples.en: The department approved a course substitution for my overseas statistics class.
examples.zh: 系里批准我用国外修的统计课做「课程替代」。

examples.en: File the course substitution form before your final semester begins.
examples.zh: 最后一学期开始前，提交「课程替代」申请表。

words.enDefinition: outline of topics, grading, and deadlines for one course

examples.en: Read the course syllabus carefully before the add/drop deadline hits.
examples.zh: 在退补选截止日之前，仔细读一遍「课程大纲」。

examples.en: The course syllabus shows the grading breakdown and exam dates.
examples.zh: 「课程大纲」列明了评分构成和考试日期。

words.enDefinition: official name of a course in the catalog

examples.en: The course title sounds fun, but check the workload first.
examples.zh: 这个「课程名称」听起来有趣，但先看看课业量。

examples.en: Course titles occasionally change when departments redesign their major requirements.
examples.zh: 系里调整培养要求时，「课程名称」偶尔会变。

words.enDefinition: dropping a course after the deadline, with a W grade

examples.en: A course withdrawal after midterms still shows a W on your record.
examples.zh: 期中之后「退课」，成绩单上仍会记一个 W。

examples.en: Talk to financial aid before a course withdrawal; it may affect your aid.
examples.zh: 「退课」前先问问资助办公室，可能会影响你的资助资格。

words.enDefinition: try to get into a full course by asking directly

examples.en: You can crash a course by emailing the professor, even if it shows full.
examples.zh: 即使系统显示满员，发邮件给教授也可能「挤进满员的课」。

examples.en: First-years crash a course when nothing else fits their schedule.
examples.zh: 实在没有合适的课时，大一新生就会试着「挤课」。

collocations: crash a course during the first week

words.enDefinition: a service converting foreign academic records into local equivalents

examples.en: Her credential evaluation from WES took about four business weeks.
examples.zh: 她在 WES 的「学历认证评估」花了大约四个工作周。

examples.en: A credential evaluation converts Chinese grades into a US GPA.
examples.zh: 「学历认证评估」会把中国成绩换算成美国的绩点。

words.enDefinition: maximum credits you may take in one term

examples.en: The credit cap is eighteen, but honors students can exceed it.
examples.zh: 「学分上限」是十八，但荣誉项目学生可以超出。

examples.en: Petition to lift the credit cap if you're ahead on requirements.
examples.zh: 如果你学分超前，可以申请提高「学分上限」。

words.enDefinition: official review deciding how transfer credits apply

examples.en: The credit evaluation took three weeks after my transcripts arrived.
examples.zh: 成绩单寄到之后，「学分认定」花了三周。

examples.en: Request an official credit evaluation before registering for any overlapping courses.
examples.zh: 注册任何内容重复的课程前，先申请官方「学分认定」。

words.enDefinition: unit measuring course weight, usually one hour weekly

examples.en: Most lecture courses are worth three credit hours each semester.
examples.zh: 大多数讲授课每学期值三个「学分学时」。

examples.en: Lab science courses often carry four credit hours because of labs.
examples.zh: 理科实验课常因包含实验而值四个「学分学时」。

words.enDefinition: total credits you take in a single term

examples.en: Keep your credit load balanced so assignments don't pile up.
examples.zh: 「学分量」要安排均衡，作业才不会堆积如山。

examples.en: Her credit load jumped to eighteen credits after adding two labs.
examples.zh: 加了两门实验课后，她的「学分量」升到了十八个学分。

words.enDefinition: taking more credits than the standard limit allows

examples.en: A credit overload requires dean approval and a consistently strong GPA.
examples.zh: 「超修学分」需要院长批准，而且绩点要一直很高。

examples.en: She took a credit overload to finish her double major on time.
examples.zh: 为了按时完成双专业，她「超修」了学分。

words.enDefinition: all credit hours you have enrolled in, finished or not

examples.en: Your GPA equals grade points earned divided by credits attempted each term.
examples.zh: 你的GPA等于所获绩点除以每学期的「修读学分」。

examples.en: Withdrawn courses still count in credits attempted but earn no grade points.
examples.zh: 退掉的课仍计入「修读学分」，但不产生等级点数。

words.enDefinition: credit hours successfully completed with passing grades

examples.en: Pass/fail courses with a P still add credits earned toward graduation.
examples.zh: 合格制课程拿到P照样「修得学分」，计入毕业要求。

examples.en: The degree audit compares credits earned against the 120-credit requirement.
examples.zh: 学程审核把「修得学分」和120学分的毕业要求作对比。

words.enDefinition: a phone service for students in urgent emotional distress

examples.en: Save the counseling center's crisis line number in your phone.
examples.zh: 把咨询中心的「心理危机热线」号码存进手机里。

examples.en: The crisis line is answered around the clock during exam weeks.
examples.zh: 考试周期间，「心理危机热线」全天都有人接听。

words.enDefinition: a careful judgment of a work's strengths and weaknesses

examples.en: Our TA models a good critique: one strength, one weakness, one suggestion.
examples.zh: 我们的助教示范了何为好的「点评」：一个优点、一个不足、一条建议。

examples.en: The professor gave my presentation a blunt critique without ever making it personal.
examples.zh: 教授对我的展示给出了直率的「批评」，却始终对事不对人。

words.enDefinition: five-digit number identifying one course section in the system

examples.en: Type the exact five-digit CRN into the registration page to enroll.
examples.zh: 在选课页面输入准确的五位「课程号」才能选上课。

examples.en: The lecture and its lab have different CRNs, so register for both.
examples.zh: 大课和实验课的「课程号」不同，两个都要注册。

words.enDefinition: same course offered under two department codes

examples.en: The cross-listed course counts toward either the sociology or the policy major.
examples.zh: 这门「跨系并列课程」可以计入社会学或政策学专业。

examples.en: Cross-listed courses appear twice in the catalog with different course codes.
examples.zh: 「跨系并列课程」在目录里会以不同课程代码出现两次。

words.enDefinition: taking courses at a nearby partner university

examples.en: Through cross-registration, I take Japanese at the college across town.
examples.zh: 通过「跨校选课」，我可以在城另一头的学院修日语。

examples.en: Cross-registration paperwork needs signatures from the registrars at both universities.
examples.zh: 「跨校选课」的材料需要两所大学注册办公室的签字。

words.enDefinition: a large campus event where many clubs share their cultures

examples.en: The spring cultural festival fills the quad with food stalls and performances.
examples.zh: 春季「文化节」让中央草坪摆满美食摊和演出舞台。

examples.en: Our cultural festival booth offered calligraphy and free milk tea samples.
examples.zh: 我们「文化节」摊位提供书法体验和免费奶茶试喝。

words.enDefinition: a student club celebrating one culture's food, arts, and traditions

examples.en: The Filipino cultural society hosts adobo cooking workshops every semester.
examples.zh: 菲律宾「文化社团」每学期都办阿多波烹饪工作坊。

examples.en: Cultural societies often collaborate for the big spring festival on the quad.
examples.zh: 各「文化社团」经常合作，在中央草坪办春季大型节庆。

words.enDefinition: a showcase evening of food, dance, and fashion from one culture

examples.en: Culture night sold four hundred tickets and featured twelve student performances.
examples.zh: 「文化之夜」卖出四百张票，呈现了十二个学生节目。

examples.en: I modeled traditional dress for the first time at culture night.
examples.zh: 我第一次在「文化之夜」上展示传统服饰。

words.enDefinition: the first Latin honor, awarded for solid academic performance

examples.en: She made her parents proud by graduating cum laude from business school.
examples.zh: 她以「优等毕业荣誉」从商学院毕业，让父母非常自豪。

examples.en: Cum laude is the first of the three Latin honors at graduation.
examples.zh: 「优等毕业荣誉」是毕业时三档拉丁荣誉中的第一档。

words.enDefinition: all credit hours completed across every term so far

examples.en: The audit shows 96 cumulative credits against the 120 needed to graduate.
examples.zh: 审核单显示我已有96个「累计学分」，毕业需要120个。

examples.en: Cumulative credits, not semesters, decide when you can register as a senior.
examples.zh: 决定你能否按大四优先注册的是「累计学分」，而非学期数。

words.enDefinition: a final testing material from the entire course

examples.en: Review every unit from September because the cumulative final covers the whole course.
examples.zh: 「综合性期末考」覆盖整门课，九月以来的每个单元都要复习。

examples.en: I started reviewing for the cumulative final a month early.
examples.zh: 我提前一个月就开始复习「综合性期末考」的内容。

words.enDefinition: your overall GPA across every term attended so far

examples.en: The letter says my cumulative GPA must stay above 2.0 to keep financial aid.
examples.zh: 信上说我的「累计绩点」必须保持在2.0以上才能保留助学金。

examples.en: A strong junior year pulled her cumulative GPA back up to 3.4.
examples.zh: 大三的强势表现把她的「累计绩点」拉回3.4。

words.enDefinition: collecting reserved items outside without entering the building

examples.en: I used curbside pickup when the lobby was closed for renovations.
examples.zh: 大堂翻修闭门期间，我用了「馆外取书」服务。

examples.en: Call the number on the sign and staff bring curbside pickup orders out within minutes.
examples.zh: 拨打标牌上的电话，馆员几分钟内就会把「馆外取书」的订单送出来。

collocations: curbside pickup at the east entrance

words.enDefinition: the grade you are earning in a course right now

examples.en: Check your current grade before deciding whether to withdraw from economics.
examples.zh: 决定是否退掉经济课前，先看看「当前成绩」。

examples.en: My current grade in bio is 74, so the final really matters.
examples.zh: 生物课我的「当前成绩」是74分，期末就非常关键了。

words.enDefinition: to adjust exam scores upward relative to the class average

examples.en: The professor promised to curve an exam if the class median fell below 65.
examples.zh: 教授承诺如果「班级中位数」低于65就给考试调分。

examples.en: They curved the midterm by adding six points to every raw score.
examples.zh: 期中考试时老师按「调分」给每份卷子加了6分。

words.enDefinition: a grade raised or set after a class-wide adjustment

examples.en: My curved grade in orgo jumped from a 68 to a B minus.
examples.zh: 有机化学「调分后成绩」从68分跳到了B减。

examples.en: The registrar posts curved grades only after the department signs off.
examples.zh: 「调分后成绩」要等系里签字后才发布。

collocations: a curved grade on the midterm

words.enDefinition: the workers who clean campus buildings

examples.en: The custodial staff deep-cleans the whole library during spring break.
examples.zh: 春假期间，「保洁团队」会给整个图书馆做深度清洁。

examples.en: Leave the classroom tidy because the custodial staff works overnight.
examples.zh: 教室用完要收拾好，「保洁团队」晚上还要工作。

collocations: report spills to the custodial staff

words.enDefinition: a returned item with stains, torn pages, or broken binding

examples.en: The clerk flagged a damaged book because water warped half the pages.
examples.zh: 图书管理员发现一本「污损图书」，一半书页都被水泡皱了。

examples.en: Return a damaged book immediately and explain what happened to avoid extra charges.
examples.zh: 「污损的书」要马上归还并说明情况，以免被加收费用。

words.enDefinition: a student team performing choreographed routines at campus events

examples.en: The dance crew holds open workshops before auditions so beginners can learn combos.
examples.zh: 「舞蹈队」在选拔前开设公开工作坊，带新手学动作组合。

examples.en: Our dance crew won the inter-university showcase with a hip-hop medley.
examples.zh: 我们「舞蹈队」凭一段嘻哈串烧拿下校际展演冠军。

words.enDefinition: a relaxed campus activity that helps students unwind before exams

examples.en: The counseling center runs a de-stress event with games before finals.
examples.zh: 期末前，咨询中心会举办带游戏的「减压活动」。

examples.en: The de-stress event included chair massages and a coloring station.
examples.zh: 这次「减压活动」有椅上按摩和涂色角落。

words.enDefinition: a senior official who leads a college or school

examples.en: The dean approved our class trip to the state archive.
examples.zh: 「院长」批准了我们去州档案馆的班级参访。

examples.en: Complaints about a grade can be escalated to the dean.
examples.zh: 对成绩有异议，可以升级提交给「院长」。

words.enDefinition: the administrator responsible for student life and welfare offices

examples.en: The dean of students handles appeals about conduct and hardship cases.
examples.zh: 「学生事务长」负责处理行为问题和生活困难申诉。

examples.en: Email the dean of students if your scholarship situation changes suddenly.
examples.zh: 奖学金情况突变时，发邮件给「学生事务长」。

words.enDefinition: a semester honor list for students with top grades

examples.en: Making the dean's list requires a term GPA of 3.5 or higher.
examples.zh: 期末绩点达到 3.5 以上才能登上「优秀生名单」。

examples.en: She framed the dean's list letter that her department mailed home.
examples.zh: 她把系里寄到家的「优秀生名单」通知信装裱了起来。

words.enDefinition: the administrative office that handles college-level approvals

examples.en: Take the signed form to the dean's office on the third floor.
examples.zh: 把签好字的表格交到三楼的「院长办公室」。

examples.en: The dean's office approved my late withdrawal after reviewing the documents.
examples.zh: 「院长办公室」审阅材料后批准了我的逾期退课。

words.enDefinition: the polite email opening for a named professor

examples.en: Dear Professor Lee, I hope your semester is going well.
examples.zh: 邮件开头写「Dear Professor」，再加教授的姓氏。

examples.en: Begin every email with Dear Professor rather than just Hi.
examples.zh: 每封邮件都以「Dear Professor」开头，别只写Hi。

words.enDefinition: the official letter stating the outcome of your request

examples.en: The decision letter arrived exactly ten days after the hearing.
examples.zh: 「决定通知信」在听证后第十天准时寄到。

examples.en: Download the decision letter from the portal under my documents.
examples.zh: 在系统的“我的文件”里下载「决定通知信」。

words.enDefinition: officially choose your main field of study

examples.en: Most students declare a major by the end of sophomore year.
examples.zh: 大多数学生会在大二结束前「确定专业」。

examples.en: You can't register for advanced courses until you declare a major.
examples.zh: 在「确定专业」之前，你不能注册进阶课程。

collocations: declare a major before junior year

words.enDefinition: the scheduled day of your thesis or dissertation defense

examples.en: The defense date must be announced at least two weeks ahead.
examples.zh: 「答辩日期」必须至少提前两周公布。

examples.en: We pushed the defense date back a week after revisions.
examples.zh: 修改之后，我们把「答辩日期」推迟了一周。

words.enDefinition: postpone the term you officially begin studying

examples.en: You can defer enrollment once for up to one academic year.
examples.zh: 你可以「延迟入学」一次，最长一年。

examples.en: He chose to defer enrollment after his family situation changed.
examples.zh: 家里情况有变，他选择了「延迟入学」。

words.enDefinition: starting your program a later term after being accepted

examples.en: The university granted deferred admission so I could start next January.
examples.zh: 学校批准了我的「延期入学」，我可以一月再开始。

examples.en: Deferred admission is common for students completing military service or gap years.
examples.zh: 服兵役或休间隔年的学生常申请「延期入学」。

words.enDefinition: an exam postponed because illness or misfortune affected you

examples.en: She was granted a deferred exam after surgery during finals week.
examples.zh: 期末周动完手术后，她获准参加「缓考」。

examples.en: Apply for a deferred exam through the student portal with medical evidence.
examples.zh: 通过学生门户附上医疗证明申请「缓考」。

words.enDefinition: report comparing your credits against graduation requirements

examples.en: Always run a fresh degree audit before each advising appointment.
examples.zh: 每次导师面谈前，务必先跑一遍最新的「学位审核」。

examples.en: My degree audit flagged one missing writing requirement for graduation.
examples.zh: 「学位审核」提示我还缺一项毕业要求的写作课。

words.enDefinition: the status shown once the university grants the degree

examples.en: The registrar's website shows degree awarded within a week of conferral.
examples.zh: 注册处网站会在授予后一周内显示「已授学位」。

examples.en: Employers verify the degree awarded date through the national database.
examples.zh: 雇主通过全国数据库核实「已授学位」的日期。

words.enDefinition: the printed certificate itself, distinct from the qualification earned

examples.en: Some countries ask for a degree certificate plus an apostilled transcript.
examples.zh: 有些国家要求提供「学位证书」加海牙认证的成绩单。

examples.en: Your degree certificate and final transcript are issued separately by the registry.
examples.zh: 「学位证书」和最终成绩单由注册处分别签发。

words.enDefinition: the British system ranking final degrees into classes

examples.en: UK universities announce your degree classification based on final-year marks.
examples.zh: 英国大学会根据毕业年级的成绩公布你的「学位等级」。

examples.en: A first is the highest degree classification most employers look for.
examples.zh: 一等是大多数雇主最看重的「学位等级」。

words.enDefinition: the official act by which the university awards degrees

examples.en: Degree conferral happens in May, August, and December each year.
examples.zh: 每年五月、八月和十二月进行「学位授予」。

examples.en: Your diploma is printed only after the official degree conferral.
examples.zh: 证书只有在正式「学位授予」之后才会印制。

words.enDefinition: a term-by-term course map leading to graduation

examples.en: My advisor updated my degree plan for the next four semesters.
examples.zh: 导师为我更新了今后四个学期的「学位规划」。

examples.en: A clear degree plan helps you avoid extra tuition fees.
examples.zh: 清晰的「学位规划」能帮你避免多交学费。

words.enDefinition: the degree being added to your official academic record

examples.en: Degree posting happens about four weeks after the conferral date.
examples.zh: 「学位入档」大约在授予日期四周后完成。

examples.en: Your transcript shows the degree posting once grades are finalized.
examples.zh: 成绩定档后，成绩单上就会出现「学位入档」记录。

words.enDefinition: a report listing completed and outstanding degree requirements

examples.en: Run a degree progress report before meeting your advisor each term.
examples.zh: 每学期见导师前，先跑一份「学位进度报告」。

examples.en: The degree progress report flagged two elective courses I still need.
examples.zh: 「学位进度报告」标出了我还缺的两门选修课。

words.enDefinition: credits and courses needed to graduate
