examples.en: The degree audit shows which degree requirements you still need.
examples.zh: 学位审核会显示你还差哪些「学位要求」。

examples.en: Meet with your advisor yearly to review degree requirement progress.
examples.zh: 每年和导师复盘一次「学位要求」的完成进度。

words.enDefinition: an official confirmation that your degree was really awarded

examples.en: Employers use the degree verification service to confirm your credentials.
examples.zh: 雇主通过「学位核实」服务确认你的学历真伪。

examples.en: You can order degree verification online through the registrar's portal.
examples.zh: 你可以在注册处门户在线申请「学位核实」。

words.enDefinition: the staff manager who runs a department's daily operations

examples.en: The department administrator ordered new chairs for the staff lounge.
examples.zh: 「系行政主管」为教师休息室添置了新椅子。

examples.en: Budget questions go to the department administrator, not the professors.
examples.zh: 经费问题找「系行政主管」，别去麻烦教授。

words.enDefinition: consent from the academic department to enroll

examples.en: Cross-listed courses sometimes require department approval before you can enroll.
examples.zh: 跨系并列的课有时需要「系里批准」才能选。

examples.en: She got department approval to take a graduate seminar as a junior.
examples.zh: 她获得「系里批准」，大三就能修研究生研讨课。

words.enDefinition: an office worker supporting a department's staff

examples.en: The department assistant schedules all the meetings for the professors.
examples.zh: 系里教授们的会议都由「系行政助理」安排。

examples.en: Ask the department assistant for the professor's current office hours.
examples.zh: 教授最新的答疑时间可以问「系行政助理」。

words.enDefinition: the professor who leads an academic department

examples.en: The department chair signed my petition for the closed seminar seat.
examples.zh: 「系主任」在我的研讨课名额特批申请上签了字。

examples.en: Email the department chair only after the instructor and advisor say no.
examples.zh: 只有任课教师和导师都拒绝后，才发邮件给「系主任」。

words.enDefinition: the front office of an academic department where forms start

examples.en: The department office keeps spare add/drop forms behind the counter.
examples.zh: 「系办公室」柜台后面备有加退课表格。

examples.en: Ask the department office which advisor handles petitions this month.
examples.zh: 问问「系办公室」，这个月由哪位导师负责特批申请。

words.enDefinition: honors granted by your major department for excellence

examples.en: Departmental honors in economics required a thesis and a 3.7 major GPA.
examples.zh: 经济学「系荣誉」要求提交论文且专业绩点3.7。

examples.en: Apply for departmental honors through your advisor by junior year.
examples.zh: 想申请「院系荣誉」，大三前就要通过导师报名。

words.enDefinition: the padded folder handed to graduates on stage

examples.en: You receive an empty diploma cover on stage, not the actual diploma.
examples.zh: 台上领到的只是空的「证书封套」，并非证书本体。

examples.en: The diploma cover is embossed with the university crest in gold.
examples.zh: 「证书封套」上烫金压印着校徽。

collocations: diploma cover with the university crest

words.enDefinition: the official document certifying that you completed the degree

examples.en: The diploma arrives by mail about eight weeks after commencement.
examples.zh: 「毕业证书」大约在典礼八周后邮寄到家。

examples.en: Frame your diploma and hang it above your desk at home.
examples.zh: 把「毕业证书」装进框里，挂在家中书桌上方。

words.enDefinition: a special frame for displaying your diploma on a wall

examples.en: The campus bookstore sells a diploma frame engraved with the seal.
examples.zh: 校园书店卖刻有校徽的「证书相框」。

examples.en: He bought a walnut diploma frame before his parents visited.
examples.zh: 父母来访前，他买了一个胡桃木「证书相框」。

words.enDefinition: having the university post your diploma to an address

examples.en: Diploma mailing to China can take up to eight weeks.
examples.zh: 「证书邮寄」到中国可能需要长达八周。

examples.en: Update your diploma mailing address before you leave campus housing.
examples.zh: 搬出校内宿舍前，更新你的「证书邮寄」地址。

words.enDefinition: the version of your name printed on the diploma

examples.en: Submit your diploma name before the registrar's deadline in early March.
examples.zh: 在三月初的截止日前提交你的「证书姓名」。

examples.en: Her diploma name includes her full Chinese name in pinyin.
examples.zh: 她的「证书姓名」是她中文姓名的完整拼音。

words.enDefinition: collecting your diploma in person from the registrar

examples.en: Diploma pickup is available at the service counter from June onward.
examples.zh: 六月起可以到服务柜台办理「证书自取」。

examples.en: Bring photo ID for diploma pickup, or authorize someone in writing.
examples.zh: 「证书自取」要带带照片的证件，或书面委托他人。

words.enDefinition: ordering a new diploma after the original is lost

examples.en: Diploma replacement costs fifty dollars and takes four to six weeks.
examples.zh: 「证书补办」收费五十美元，需要四到六周。

examples.en: She requested a diploma replacement after hers was damaged in a move.
examples.zh: 搬家时证书损坏后，她申请了「证书补办」。

words.enDefinition: the office arranging academic supports for students with disabilities

examples.en: Register with disability services before the semester starts to arrange support.
examples.zh: 学期开始前，先到「残障学生服务处」登记以便安排支持。

examples.en: Disability services arranges note-takers and extended time for all exams.
examples.zh: 「残障学生服务处」会安排笔记协助和延长考试时间。

words.enDefinition: a grade below what your effort led you to expect

examples.en: After weeks of revising, a disappointing grade on the essay hit hard.
examples.zh: 改了几周稿子，论文却拿到「令人失望的成绩」，挺受打击。

examples.en: She turned the disappointing grade into a regrade request that succeeded.
examples.zh: 她把那次「失望的成绩」变成了成功的重判申请。

collocations: a disappointing grade on the essay

words.enDefinition: punishment imposed after serious rule breaking

examples.en: Copying on the final can lead to disciplinary action, including suspension.
examples.zh: 期末考试抄袭可能招致「纪律处分」，甚至停学。

examples.en: The committee decided no disciplinary action was needed once she explained the mix-up.
examples.zh: 她解释清楚误会之后，委员会决定不予「纪律处分」。

words.enDefinition: an online forum where students post and reply on course topics

examples.en: Post your answer on the discussion board by Thursday and reply to two classmates.
examples.zh: 周四前把答案发到「课程讨论区」，并回复两位同学。

examples.en: The TA flagged my discussion board comment as a model reply for the class.
examples.zh: 助教把我在「课程讨论区」的评论标为全班范例回复。

words.enDefinition: one topic on a discussion board with its original post and replies

examples.en: Start your discussion board thread with a question, not a summary.
examples.zh: 「讨论区主题帖」开头最好抛出问题，别只写总结。

examples.en: My discussion board thread got forty replies after I posted the practice questions.
examples.zh: 我发了练习题之后，「主题帖」收到四十多条回复。

collocations: reply to the discussion board thread

words.enDefinition: the student responsible for steering one week's discussion

examples.en: As discussion leader, I emailed two questions and opened the class with a short quote.
examples.zh: 担任「讨论主持人」时，我提前发了两个问题，并用一句短引文开场。

examples.en: Being discussion leader once a term pushes even shy students to prepare deeply.
examples.zh: 每学期轮值一次「讨论主持人」，再害羞的学生也得深入准备。

words.enDefinition: a short written reply students upload for online discussion

examples.en: My discussion post earned full marks after I quoted one line and disagreed with it.
examples.zh: 我的「讨论帖」引用了原文一句话并提出异议，结果拿了满分。

examples.en: Write your discussion post before reading others' replies so your argument stays original.
examples.zh: 先写好自己的「讨论帖」再看别人的回复，这样观点才能保持原创。

words.enDefinition: prepared questions that guide what a class talks about

examples.en: The discussion leader emails three discussion questions the night before every seminar.
examples.zh: 每次研讨课前一晚，讨论主持人都会发来三道「讨论题」。

examples.en: I prepare answers to the discussion questions even for classes that never call on me.
examples.zh: 即使有些课从不点名，我也会提前准备「讨论题」的答案。

words.enDefinition: small weekly group for reviewing lecture material

examples.en: Attendance in your discussion section counts toward the final grade.
examples.zh: 「讨论课段」的出勤会计入期末总评。

examples.en: TAs lead each discussion section and answer questions before quizzes.
examples.zh: 每个「讨论课段」由助教主持，测验前会答疑。

words.enDefinition: the name other people see next to you in a meeting

examples.en: The professor asked everyone to change their display name to their real name.
examples.zh: 教授要求大家把「显示名称」改成真实姓名。

examples.en: My display name still shows my English nickname from high school.
examples.zh: 我的「显示名称」还是高中时的英文昵称。

words.enDefinition: formally challenge a charge you believe is wrong

examples.en: Dispute a fine within two weeks if the machine misread your return time.
examples.zh: 如果机器读错了你的归还时间，两周内可以「申诉罚款」。

examples.en: She went back to dispute a fine after proving the book drop stamped the correct day.
examples.zh: 她证实还书箱的盖章日期无误后，回去找馆员「申诉罚款」。

words.enDefinition: the group of professors supervising and examining a dissertation

examples.en: Her dissertation committee includes two professors from another university in Canada.
examples.zh: 她的「博士论文委员会」里有两位来自加拿大另一所大学的教授。

examples.en: Form your dissertation committee before the end of your first year.
examples.zh: 要在第一学年结束前组成你的「博士论文委员会」。

words.enDefinition: the extended research work written for a doctorate

examples.en: Her dissertation analyzes groundwater quality across three farming regions in Kenya.
examples.zh: 她的「博士论文」分析了肯尼亚三个农业区的地下水水质。

examples.en: He finally defended his dissertation after four years of fieldwork.
examples.zh: 四年田野工作之后，他终于完成了「博士论文」答辩。

words.enDefinition: the doctoral research plan defended before fieldwork begins

examples.en: Her dissertation proposal passed at the second committee review meeting.
examples.zh: 她的「博士论文开题」在委员会第二次审核时通过。

examples.en: A clear dissertation proposal saves you a year of wasted fieldwork.
examples.zh: 清晰的「博士论文开题」能帮你省去一年无效的田野工作。

words.enDefinition: a formal award for outstanding work within your major

examples.en: Distinction in the major appears on the transcript next to your degree.
examples.zh: 「专业方向荣誉」会标注在成绩单的学位旁边。

examples.en: Only twelve students earned distinction in the major this year.
examples.zh: 今年只有12人获得「专业方向荣誉」。

collocations: criteria for distinction in the major
distinction in the major on the diploma

words.enDefinition: an honorary title for a small number of top faculty

examples.en: Only three faculty members in the whole university hold the distinguished professor title.
examples.zh: 全校只有三位教师拥有「杰出教授」头衔。

examples.en: The distinguished professor still teaches one freshman seminar every year.
examples.zh: 这位「杰出教授」每年仍教一门大一研讨课。

collocations: hold the rank of distinguished professor

words.enDefinition: to split a shared task into parts each member handles

examples.en: We divided up the work by strengths: slides, sources, and delivery.
examples.zh: 我们按各自长处「分工」：幻灯片、资料检索和现场讲述。

examples.en: Divide up the work on day one, or two people will do everything later.
examples.zh: 第一天就「分好工」，不然到后面就成了两个人干所有活。

collocations: divide up the slides and research

words.enDefinition: to actually read assigned texts before class begins

examples.en: In a seminar you cannot hide, because everyone can tell who did the reading.
examples.zh: 研讨课上藏不住，谁都看得出谁「完成了课前阅读」。

examples.en: Doing the reading takes two hours, but facing a cold call unprepared is worse.
examples.zh: 「完成课前阅读」要花两小时，但没准备就被点名提问更糟糕。

words.enDefinition: the highest university degree based on original research

examples.en: Earning a doctoral degree took her six years of coursework and research.
examples.zh: 拿到「博士学位」花了她六年时间的课程和科研。

examples.en: Only students with a doctoral degree can supervise dissertations in most departments.
examples.zh: 在大多数院系，只有持「博士学位」的人才能指导博士论文。

words.enDefinition: official papers used to prove your case in an appeal

examples.en: Bring documentary evidence such as flight itineraries or hospital notes.
examples.zh: 带上行程单或医院记录等「书面证据」。

examples.en: The committee accepted her emails as documentary evidence of the outage.
examples.zh: 委员会接受她的邮件作为系统故障的「书面证据」。

words.enDefinition: fold a page corner down to mark your place

examples.en: Don't dog-ear library pages; grab a free bookmark at the desk instead.
examples.zh: 别把图书馆的书页「折角」，柜台有免费书签。

examples.en: The previous borrower dog-eared half the novel, and I still had to return it.
examples.zh: 前一位借书人把半本小说都「折了角」，可我还是得原样归还。

words.enDefinition: a campus collection event gathering goods for students in need

examples.en: The donation drive collects canned food outside the dining hall.
examples.zh: 「捐赠活动」在食堂门口收集罐头食品。

examples.en: Our dorm won the donation drive with four hundred canned goods.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍楼捐了四百件罐头，赢了这次「捐赠活动」。

words.enDefinition: two full degree programs pursued at the same time

examples.en: He is enrolled in a double degree combining law and computer science.
examples.zh: 他正在修读法律与计算机科学的「双学位」。

examples.en: A double degree usually takes five years instead of four.
examples.zh: 「双学位」通常要读五年而不是四年。

words.enDefinition: completing two majors at the same time

examples.en: A double major in economics and math takes careful planning.
examples.zh: 经济与数学「双专业」需要细致的规划。

examples.en: Her double major means summer courses to fit every requirement.
examples.zh: 修「双专业」意味着她得靠暑期课程满足所有要求。

words.enDefinition: save lecture slides from the course site to your computer

examples.en: Download the slides before class so you can annotate them offline.
examples.zh: 课前先「下载课件」，方便离线做笔记。

examples.en: She downloaded the slides on campus because her apartment Wi-Fi is unreliable.
examples.zh: 她趁在学校「下载课件」，公寓的网太不稳定。

collocations: the slides are available to download
download the slides as a PDF

words.enDefinition: to explain clearly how two similar things differ

examples.en: The professor drew a distinction between correlation and causation before we analyzed the data.
examples.zh: 看数据之前，教授先在相关与因果之间「作出了区分」。

examples.en: Draw a distinction between the author's claims and the media's summary of them.
examples.zh: 要把作者的主张和媒体的概括「区分开来」。

words.enDefinition: the stated clothing expectations for an event or club

examples.en: The spring formal dress code is business casual, no jeans or sneakers.
examples.zh: 春季舞会的「着装要求」是商务休闲，不要牛仔裤和运动鞋。

examples.en: Cultural attire is always welcome, whatever the dress code says.
examples.zh: 无论「着装要求」怎么写，民族服饰一律欢迎。

words.enDefinition: the final full practice performed exactly like the real show

examples.en: Dress rehearsal runs Friday evening; costumes, lights, and full makeup required.
examples.zh: 「带妆彩排」周五晚上进行，要备好服装、灯光和全套妆造。

examples.en: We fixed the sound cues at dress rehearsal, so opening night went smoothly.
examples.zh: 我们在「彩排」时修好了音效提示，首演之夜一切顺利。

words.enDefinition: officially remove a course from your schedule

examples.en: Think twice before you drop a course after the first exam.
examples.zh: 第一次考试后再想「退课」，务必三思。

examples.en: I dropped one course to protect my GPA during a rough semester.
examples.zh: 那学期太难熬了，我「退掉」一门课来保住绩点。

collocations: drop a course before the deadline

words.enDefinition: post a link or question in the meeting chat box

examples.en: Don't interrupt, just drop it in the chat and the TA will answer.
examples.zh: 别打断，把问题「发到聊天区」，助教会回复。

examples.en: She dropped the reading link in the chat so nobody had to search.
examples.zh: 她把阅读链接「发到了聊天区」，大家不用自己找。

collocations: drop the link in the chat
drop your question in the chat

words.enDefinition: to ignore your worst score when averaging the rest

examples.en: The professor drops the lowest grade among the ten quizzes.
examples.zh: 教授会在十次小测里「去掉最低分」。

examples.en: Dropping the lowest grade saved my semester average twice this year.
examples.zh: 今年「去掉最低分」两次救了我的学期平均分。

collocations: policy of dropping the lowest grade
drop the lowest grade before averaging

words.enDefinition: the deadline by which borrowed items must go back

examples.en: The receipt emails list the due date for loans so nothing slips your mind.
examples.zh: 借书回执邮件会写明「借书到期日」，免得你忘记。

examples.en: The due date for loans was pushed back a week because of the holiday.
examples.zh: 因为放假，这次的「借书到期日」往后推了一周。

collocations: check the due date for loans
extend the due date for loans
miss the due date for loans

words.enDefinition: an alert set before a loan is due back

examples.en: Set a due-date reminder two days before the return deadline.
examples.zh: 在归还截止前两天设一个「到期提醒」。

examples.en: My due-date reminder pinged while I was still fifty pages from finishing.
examples.zh: 「到期提醒」响的时候，我还差五十页没读完。

words.enDefinition: a digital version of a book readable on your devices

examples.en: If the print copy is checked out, the e-book is usually available instantly.
examples.zh: 如果纸质书被借走，「电子书」一般能马上看。

examples.en: Download the chapter as an e-book and annotate it on your tablet.
examples.zh: 把这一章下载成「电子书」，在平板上做批注。

words.enDefinition: an early notice from a professor flagging a struggling student

examples.en: My chemistry professor filed an early alert after I missed two labs.
examples.zh: 缺了两次实验课后，化学教授给我发了「学业预警」。

examples.en: Respond to an early alert quickly, because advisors only have a short window.
examples.zh: 收到「学业预警」要尽快回应，导师的处理窗口很短。

words.enDefinition: a binding US application plan with an earlier answer date

examples.en: Early decision binds you to attend if the university accepts you.
examples.zh: 「约束性提前录取」是有约束力的，一旦录取就必须就读。

examples.en: She applied early decision to her first-choice university in November.
examples.zh: 十一月，她以「提前录取」方式申请了第一志愿大学。

words.enDefinition: signing up for courses before the general registration window

examples.en: Honors students get early registration, which helps them grab popular sections.
examples.zh: 荣誉项目学生享有「提前注册」，方便抢到热门课段。

examples.en: Use your early registration slot to lock in the lab section you need.
examples.zh: 抓住「提前注册」的机会，锁定你需要的实验课段。

words.enDefinition: a high grade needing little effort, or such a class

examples.en: Everyone said astronomy for non-majors is an easy A, and they were right.
examples.zh: 大家都说非专业的天文课是门「送分课」，事实证明没错。

examples.en: I need one easy A this term to protect my GPA.
examples.zh: 这学期我需要一门能「轻松拿A」的课来保住绩点。

collocations: treat a course as an easy A

words.enDefinition: an instructor known for awarding generous grades

examples.en: Take Doctor Alvarez for the elective; everyone says she is an easy grader.
examples.zh: 选修课选Alvarez博士，大家都说她是「给分宽松的老师」。

examples.en: An easy grader can lift your semester GPA without extra study time.
examples.zh: 遇上「给分松的老师」，不加班加点也能拉高学期绩点。

words.enDefinition: change your own post after publishing it on a forum

examples.en: You can edit your post until the deadline, so fix typos anytime.
examples.zh: 截止前都可以「编辑帖子」，随时改错别字。

examples.en: I edited my post to add the source the TA mentioned.
examples.zh: 我「编辑了帖子」，补上了助教提到的文献。

collocations: edit your post before the deadline

words.enDefinition: to explain a point more fully with added detail

examples.en: The TA asked me to elaborate instead of letting me stop at one sentence.
examples.zh: 助教让我「详细阐述」，没让我一句话就蒙混过关。

examples.en: Elaborate on your evidence before you attack the author's conclusion.
examples.zh: 在攻击作者结论之前，先把你的证据「阐述充分」。

words.enDefinition: a short talk explaining why you deserve a club role

examples.en: Keep your election speech under three minutes and mention one concrete plan.
examples.zh: 「竞选演讲」要控制在三分钟以内，并提到一个具体计划。

examples.en: Her election speech about weekend volunteering trips won over the room.
examples.zh: 她那段关于周末志愿行程的「竞选演讲」打动了全场。

words.enDefinition: course you choose freely beyond your requirements

examples.en: Film appreciation is easily my favorite elective course this semester.
examples.zh: 电影赏析轻松当选我这学期最爱的「选修课」。

examples.en: Use elective courses to explore interesting fields outside your major.
examples.zh: 借助「选修课」探索专业以外的领域。

words.enDefinition: a transcript delivered securely by email or a document network

examples.en: The electronic transcript arrived at the admissions office within an hour.
examples.zh: 「电子成绩单」一小时内就送达了招生办公室。

examples.en: Most graduate programs now accept an electronic transcript instead of paper.
examples.zh: 大多数研究生项目现在接受「电子成绩单」替代纸质版。

words.enDefinition: an automatic email alerting you to new activity on a platform

examples.en: Turn on email notifications so you never miss a course announcement.
examples.zh: 打开「邮件通知」，就不会漏掉课程公告了。

examples.en: I set email notifications for grades because the app's alerts are unreliable.
examples.zh: 成绩的「邮件通知」我都开着，因为App提醒不靠谱。

words.enDefinition: one-time money for sudden costs that grants do not cover

examples.en: An emergency grant covered my dental work when savings ran out.
examples.zh: 存款见底时，一笔「应急补助金」付了我的牙科费用。

examples.en: Emergency grants usually do not have to be repaid afterward.
examples.zh: 「应急补助金」通常不需要偿还。

collocations: an emergency grant for medical costs

words.enDefinition: a small short-term loan for urgent financial gaps

examples.en: The university offers an emergency loan of up to five hundred dollars.
examples.zh: 学校提供最高五百美元的「应急贷款」。

examples.en: I repaid my emergency loan at the cashier's window by June.
examples.zh: 六月之前，我在出纳窗口还清了「应急贷款」。

words.enDefinition: based on observation, measurement, or data rather than theory

examples.en: The seminar wants empirical support, not just a clever reading of the theory.
examples.zh: 研讨课要的是「实证」支撑，而不只是对理论的机巧解读。

examples.en: Her empirical evidence came from two years of classroom observation data.
examples.zh: 她的「实证」证据来自两年的课堂观察数据。

words.enDefinition: a formal dinner where a club celebrates the year's achievements

examples.en: At the end-of-year banquet, seniors receive certificates and share farewell speeches.
examples.zh: 在「年终晚宴」上，毕业生领证书并发表告别演讲。

examples.en: This year's end-of-year banquet doubled as our officer transition ceremony.
examples.zh: 今年的「年终晚宴」同时充当了干事换届仪式。

words.enDefinition: officially add yourself to a course's student list

examples.en: You can't enroll in a course without meeting its prerequisites first.
examples.zh: 不满足先修要求，你就没法「选修」这门课。

examples.en: She decided to enroll in a course outside her major for fun.
examples.zh: 她决定「选修」一门专业外的课，纯属兴趣。

words.enDefinition: your assigned time slot to begin registering online

examples.en: My enrollment appointment is Tuesday at two, way later than my roommate's.
examples.zh: 我的「选课预约时段」在周二下午两点，比室友晚多了。

examples.en: Check when your enrollment appointment starts so you don't miss it.
examples.zh: 查好你的「选课预约时段」从什么时候开始，别错过了。

words.enDefinition: maximum number of students allowed in a course

examples.en: The enrollment cap for the seminar is fifteen, so register early.
examples.zh: 这门研讨课的「选课上限」是十五人，要尽早注册。

examples.en: Instructors sometimes raise the enrollment cap when demand is clearly high.
examples.zh: 需求明显很高时，老师有时会提高「选课上限」。

words.enDefinition: notice confirming the courses you successfully registered for

examples.en: Check your enrollment confirmation carefully; I was dropped from chemistry.
examples.zh: 仔细核对「选课确认」，我的化学课就被系统退掉了。

examples.en: Your enrollment confirmation email lists every CRN you successfully registered.
examples.zh: 「选课确认」邮件会列出你成功注册的所有课程号。

words.enDefinition: the specific day your registration opens

examples.en: Mark your enrollment date on the calendar so you're ready at dawn.
examples.zh: 把「选课日期」标在日历上，当天早起待命。

examples.en: Enrollment dates differ by class standing, with seniors going first.
examples.zh: 「选课日期」按年级划分，大四学生最先选。

words.enDefinition: final date to enroll in courses for a term

examples.en: The enrollment deadline for winter courses is the third of December.
examples.zh: 冬季课程的「选课截止日」是十二月三日。

examples.en: Email your advisor before the enrollment deadline if a course is full.
examples.zh: 如果某门课满了，要在「选课截止日」前邮件联系导师。

words.enDefinition: whether you are currently registered, full-time, or withdrawn

examples.en: Your enrollment status must stay full-time to keep your visa valid.
examples.zh: 「注册状态」必须保持全日制，签证才有效。

examples.en: The registrar updated my enrollment status after I dropped a course.
examples.zh: 我退了一门课后，注册办公室更新了我的「注册状态」。

words.enDefinition: official proof that you are currently enrolled

examples.en: Download your enrollment verification for the bank and the visa office.
examples.zh: 下载「在读证明」，银行和签证处都要用。

examples.en: Enrollment verification requests are processed instantly through the student portal.
examples.zh: 「在读证明」的申请在学生门户里可以即时办理。

words.enDefinition: an official letter proving you are currently enrolled

examples.en: My bank needs an enrollment verification letter to open the student account.
examples.zh: 银行需要「在读证明信」才能给我开学生账户。

examples.en: Download the enrollment verification letter from the portal for your loan paperwork.
examples.zh: 办理贷款文件时，从系统里下载「在读证明信」。

collocations: enrollment verification letter for the bank

words.enDefinition: hours when your personal registration is open

examples.en: Your enrollment window opens at seven and stays open all night.
examples.zh: 你的「选课窗口」七点开启，整夜都有效。

examples.en: Once the enrollment window closes, only late adds with permission remain.
examples.zh: 「选课窗口」关闭后，就只剩需要许可的逾期加选了。

words.enDefinition: an exam required for admission to a program

examples.en: She spent a full year preparing for the medical school entrance exam.
examples.zh: 她花了一整年准备医学院的「入学考试」。

examples.en: Some graduate programs require an entrance exam alongside your transcripts.
examples.zh: 有些研究生项目除成绩单外还要求「入学考试」。

words.enDefinition: borrowing cameras, recorders, or other gear through the library

examples.en: Equipment checkout covers cameras, tripods, and audio recorders for class projects.
examples.zh: 「设备借用」提供相机、三脚架和录音笔，供课程项目使用。

examples.en: Book equipment checkout online because camcorders vanish fast before presentation week.
examples.zh: 「设备借用」要在网上预约，展示周前摄像机很快被借光。

words.enDefinition: pass an unresolved problem to a higher office for action

examples.en: If the front desk cannot help, escalate the issue to the associate registrar.
examples.zh: 如果前台解决不了，就把问题「升级上报」给副主任。

examples.en: Do not hesitate to escalate an issue when deadlines are at stake.
examples.zh: 涉及截止日期时，别犹豫，尽快「将问题升级上报」。

words.enDefinition: an exam answered in long written responses

examples.en: History courses here favor essay exams over multiple choice questions.
examples.zh: 这里的历史课偏爱「论述题考试」而不是选择题。

examples.en: In an essay exam, a clear thesis in the opening paragraph earns marks.
examples.zh: 「论述题考试」里，开头段论点清晰就能拿分。

words.enDefinition: late-night bus loops that run until around midnight

examples.en: The evening shuttle runs until midnight from the library steps.
examples.zh: 「夜间班车」从图书馆台阶前一直运营到午夜。

examples.en: Take the evening shuttle if your study session runs late.
examples.zh: 自习到很晚的话，就坐「夜间班车」回去。

words.enDefinition: a group that organizes the details of club events

examples.en: The event planning committee meets Tuesdays to divide tasks for culture night.
examples.zh: 「活动策划委员会」每周二开会，为文化之夜分配任务。

examples.en: Join the event planning committee if you like logistics, budgets, and checklists.
examples.zh: 如果你喜欢统筹、预算和清单，就加入「活动策划委员会」吧。

words.enDefinition: an approved exam arrangement such as extra time or separate rooms

examples.en: My exam accommodation includes a separate room and extra time.
examples.zh: 我的「考试便利安排」包括独立考场和延长时间。

examples.en: Book your exam accommodation at least two weeks before each test.
examples.zh: 每场考试至少提前两周预订「考试便利安排」。

words.enDefinition: the organization that sets and marks external exams

examples.en: Our final qualifications are issued by the Cambridge exam board.
examples.zh: 我们的最终学历证书由剑桥「考试委员会」颁发。

examples.en: The exam board publishes the grade boundaries every August online.
examples.zh: 「考试委员会」每年八月都会在线公布等级分数线。

words.enDefinition: the strict silence and rules enforced in exams

examples.en: We ran the mock under full exam conditions, phones off and silence throughout.
examples.zh: 模拟考完全按「考场规则」进行，全程静音、手机关机。

examples.en: Practice essays under exam conditions to get used to writing quickly by hand.
examples.zh: 按「考场规则」练写文章，习惯快速手写作答。

words.enDefinition: two of your exams scheduled at the same time

examples.en: Report any exam conflict to the registrar within a week of the timetable release.
examples.zh: 时间表公布后一周内，如有「考试冲突」要上报教务处。

examples.en: My exam conflict was fixed by moving one paper to the late session.
examples.zh: 我的「考试冲突」通过把一门考试调到晚场解决了。

words.enDefinition: the charge for registering to sit an exam

examples.en: The exam fee for the standardized test went up this year.
examples.zh: 这项标准化考试的「考试费」今年涨价了。

examples.en: Some departments refund the exam fee if you withdraw before the deadline.
examples.zh: 如果在截止日期前退考，有些院系会退还「考试费」。

words.enDefinition: a large room where many students sit exams

examples.en: Five hundred students filled the exam hall for the economics final.
examples.zh: 五百名学生坐满了经济学期末考的「考试大厅」。

examples.en: Leave your bag at the front of the exam hall before finding your seat.
examples.zh: 进「考试大厅」先把包放在前排，再去找自己的座位。

words.enDefinition: the printed set of questions for one exam

examples.en: Do not open the exam paper until the invigilator tells you to start.
examples.zh: 监考员宣布开始之前，不要翻开「试卷」。

examples.en: This exam paper was much harder than the past papers we practiced.
examples.zh: 这次的「试卷」比我们练过的历年真题难多了。

words.enDefinition: the weeks at term's end reserved for exams

examples.en: The library stays open around the clock during exam period.
examples.zh: 「考试期间」图书馆全天开放。

examples.en: No assignments fall due during exam period, so we can focus on revision.
examples.zh: 「考试期间」没有作业截止，大家可以专心复习。

words.enDefinition: the preparation work done before an exam

examples.en: The tutoring center offers free exam prep sessions for calculus.
examples.zh: 辅导中心为微积分考试提供免费的「考前准备」课程。

examples.en: Good exam prep starts with the syllabus, not with the textbook.
examples.zh: 有效的「考前准备」要从课程大纲入手，而不是抱着课本硬啃。

words.enDefinition: a group session on planning and pacing revision before exams

examples.en: The learning center offers an exam prep workshop before every midterm season.
examples.zh: 学习中心每逢期中考前都会开设「备考工作坊」。

examples.en: The exam prep workshop taught me how to make a revision plan.
examples.zh: 「备考工作坊」教会了我怎样制定复习计划。

collocations: an exam prep workshop before finals

words.enDefinition: officially signing up to sit an exam

examples.en: Exam registration closes on Friday, so confirm your exam seats today.
examples.zh: 「考试报名」周五截止，今天就去确认考试安排。

examples.en: You must complete exam registration for the certification test two months ahead.
examples.zh: 参加资格认证考试，必须提前两个月完成「考试报名」。

words.enDefinition: the shortage of study seats when everyone revises at once

examples.en: The exam-season seating crunch means you need to arrive before nine sharp.
examples.zh: 「期末抢座难」，你得在九点整前到馆。

examples.en: During the exam-season seating crunch, students queue outside before the doors open.
examples.zh: 期末「抢座大战」时，学生们开馆前就在门口排队。

collocations: the worst seating crunch in December

words.enDefinition: a giveaway pack of snacks and study supplies before finals

examples.en: The student union hands out an exam survival kit during finals week.
examples.zh: 期末周，学生会馆会发放「考试加油包」。

examples.en: My exam survival kit had earplugs, granola bars, and a highlighter.
examples.zh: 我的「考试加油包」里有耳塞、燕麦棒和荧光笔。

collocations: pick up an exam survival kit
an exam survival kit with snacks

words.enDefinition: the skill of answering exams for maximum marks

examples.en: Good exam technique means answering the easiest questions first to bank marks early.
examples.zh: 好的「作答技巧」是先做最容易的题，尽早把分拿到手。

examples.en: Her exam technique improved a lot after the learning center workshop.
examples.zh: 上完学习中心的工作坊后，她的「作答技巧」进步了很多。

words.enDefinition: the official schedule of when each exam happens

examples.en: Check the exam timetable before booking flights home for the holidays.
examples.zh: 订假期回家的机票前，先查「考试时间表」。

examples.en: The exam timetable went live today, and my two hardest papers are back to back.
examples.zh: 「考试时间表」今天公布，我最难的两门考试背靠背连着。

words.enDefinition: the building and room where an exam is held

examples.en: The exam venue changed to the sports center, so check your email.
examples.zh: 「考试地点」换到了体育中心，记得查看邮件。

examples.en: Arrive at the exam venue thirty minutes early to find the right building.
examples.zh: 提前三十分钟到达「考试地点」，留时间找对教学楼。

words.enDefinition: the week when most scheduled exams take place

examples.en: Exam week runs from December twelfth to the nineteenth this year.
examples.zh: 今年的「考试周」从十二月十二日持续到十九日。

examples.en: Cafeterias across campus extend their opening hours during exam week.
examples.zh: 「考试周」期间，全校食堂都延长了营业时间。

words.enDefinition: a professor who sets and marks an examination

examples.en: The examiner read every single essay twice before finalizing grades.
examples.zh: 「考官」每篇论文都读了两遍才定分。

examples.en: One examiner asks the questions while the other takes notes.
examples.zh: 一位「考官」提问，另一位负责记录。

words.enDefinition: credits earned abroad that count at your home university

examples.en: Get your exchange credit pre-approved before you leave for Tokyo.
examples.zh: 去东京交换之前，先把「交换学分」预批好。

examples.en: Exchange credits from partner universities usually transfer back without issues.
examples.zh: 伙伴院校的「交换学分」通常能顺利转回本校。

words.enDefinition: the small team of officers who run a club

examples.en: The executive board meets Sundays to plan events before the general meeting.
examples.zh: 「干事会」每周日碰头，在全体大会前敲定活动安排。

examples.en: Any spending over fifty dollars needs approval from the executive board.
examples.zh: 超过五十美元的支出都要经「干事会」批准。

words.enDefinition: the annual vote that chooses next year's club officers

examples.en: The executive election happens at the last general meeting of the spring term.
examples.zh: 「干事选举」在春季学期最后一次全体大会上进行。

examples.en: Candidates for the executive election each get three minutes to speak.
examples.zh: 参加「干事选举」的候选人每人有三分钟发言时间。

words.enDefinition: to say more about a point you or someone else made

examples.en: Could you expand on your second point about sample size and funding?
examples.zh: 关于样本量和经费的第二点，你能「再展开讲讲」吗？

examples.en: The professor asked her to expand on the connection she noticed between the two papers.
examples.zh: 教授请她「进一步展开」她发现的两篇论文之间的联系。

words.enDefinition: the term in which you plan to finish

examples.en: Please update your expected graduation date in the student portal.
examples.zh: 请在学生门户里更新你的「预计毕业日期」。

examples.en: My expected graduation date moved to December after I dropped a course.
examples.zh: 退掉一门课后，我的「预计毕业日期」推迟到了十二月。

words.enDefinition: extra opening time added during busy study periods

examples.en: The library runs extended hours until 2 a.m. throughout finals week.
examples.zh: 期末周图书馆「延时开放」到凌晨两点。

examples.en: Extended hours start Monday, so the overnight study rooms will be busier.
examples.zh: 周一开始「延时开放」，通宵自习室会更抢手。

words.enDefinition: extra minutes on timed exams, usually fifty percent more

examples.en: With extended time, I get fifty percent more minutes on exams.
examples.zh: 有了「延长考试时间」，我考试可以多用一半的时间。

examples.en: Extended time must be arranged before the exam schedule is posted.
examples.zh: 「延长考试时间」必须在考试安排公布前办好。

words.enDefinition: serious events beyond your control, like illness or bereavement

examples.en: Serious illness counts as extenuating circumstances for a late withdrawal.
examples.zh: 重病属于可申请逾期退课的「特殊情况」。

examples.en: Document your extenuating circumstances with official letters, not just descriptions.
examples.zh: 「特殊情况」要用官方信函佐证，不能只靠口头描述。

words.enDefinition: an outside professor who fairly examines your thesis

examples.en: The external examiner flew in from Toronto for the defense.
examples.zh: 「校外评审」从多伦多飞来参加答辩。

examples.en: An external examiner helps keep grading standards consistent across universities.
examples.zh: 「校外评审」有助于保持各大学评分标准一致。

collocations: an external examiner at the viva

words.enDefinition: any organized student activity outside regular coursework

examples.en: Clubs, intramurals, and student government all count as extracurricular activities.
examples.zh: 社团、校内联赛和学生自治会都算「课外活动」。

examples.en: Resume reviewers like to see one extracurricular activity with real leadership responsibility.
examples.zh: 简历评审更想看到一段有真实领导职责的「课外活动」。

words.enDefinition: someone who guides a group discussion without lecturing

examples.en: Each week one student acts as facilitator and keeps the group on the reading.
examples.zh: 每周由一名学生担任「讨论引导者」，让小组紧扣阅读材料。

examples.en: A good facilitator asks follow-up questions instead of offering her own conclusions.
examples.zh: 好的「引导者」会追问，而不是急着抛出自己的结论。

words.enDefinition: the department that fixes campus buildings and rooms

examples.en: Email the facilities office about the broken heater in the seminar room.
examples.zh: 研讨室的暖气坏了，给「后勤设施处」发邮件报修。

examples.en: The facilities office replaced the flickering lights over winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假期间，「后勤处」更换了闪烁的灯管。

collocations: report a problem to the facilities office

words.enDefinition: all the teaching staff of a university collectively

examples.en: The faculty voted to keep the pass-fail option for freshmen.
examples.zh: 「全体教师」投票决定大一继续保留及格制。

examples.en: Faculty are expected to reply to student emails within two days.
examples.zh: 学校要求「教师」两天内回复学生邮件。

words.enDefinition: a professor who guides a club and signs official forms

examples.en: Our faculty advisor helped us negotiate funding with the student government.
examples.zh: 我们的「指导老师」帮我们向学生自治会争取到了经费。

examples.en: The university requires every registered club to have a faculty advisor.
examples.zh: 学校要求每个注册社团都要有一名「指导老师」。

words.enDefinition: any professor, lecturer, or instructor at a university

examples.en: Every faculty member posts office hours on their office door.
examples.zh: 每位「教员」都会把答疑时间贴在办公室门上。

examples.en: All faculty members vote on the curriculum changes each spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天，「教员们」都会就课程调整投票。

words.enDefinition: the elected body where professors govern academic matters

examples.en: The faculty senate debated the new AI policy for months.
examples.zh: 「教授评议会」就新的人工智能政策争论了几个月。

examples.en: Any course requirement changes need the faculty senate's approval first.
examples.zh: 课程要求若有修改，须先经「教授评议会」批准。

words.enDefinition: to score below the required pass level

examples.en: If you fail an exam, you can usually resit it in August.
examples.zh: 如果「考试不及格」，通常八月可以补考。

examples.en: He was crushed to fail an exam for the first time in his life.
examples.zh: 人生第一次「考试不及格」，他整个人都懵了。

collocations: fail an exam by two points

words.enDefinition: a grade below the pass line that earns no credit

examples.en: A failing grade in organic chemistry forced me to rethink my pre-med track.
examples.zh: 有机化学的「不及格成绩」让我重新考虑了预医方向。

examples.en: She replaced a failing grade through the grade forgiveness policy last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天她靠成绩替换政策处理掉了那个「不及格成绩」。

collocations: a failing grade in a required course

words.enDefinition: a student organization for shared religious practice and discussion

examples.en: Faith groups on campus often provide free Friday dinners and discussion circles.
examples.zh: 校园里的「信仰社团」常在周五提供免费晚餐和交流小组。

examples.en: Her faith group organized a weekend service trip to the coastal town.
examples.zh: 她的「信仰社团」组织了去海滨小镇的周末服务之旅。

words.enDefinition: a common reasoning error that makes an argument invalid

examples.en: The TA walked us through each fallacy in the editorial, from false dilemma to slippery slope.
examples.zh: 助教带我们逐一指出社论里的「逻辑谬误」，从虚假两难到滑坡谬误。

examples.en: Name the fallacy calmly; calling someone illogical never wins a seminar debate.
examples.zh: 冷静指出「谬误」何在；骂人不讲逻辑赢不下研讨课辩论。

words.enDefinition: make a video play faster to skip ahead through it

examples.en: Fast-forward through the ten minutes of announcements at the start.
examples.zh: 开头十分钟的通知部分直接「快进」。

examples.en: I fast-forwarded the setup steps but slowed down for the worked example.
examples.zh: 安装步骤我「快进」了，例题讲解部分放慢看。

words.enDefinition: the last date to settle required fees without a penalty

examples.en: Missing the fee deadline puts a hold on your registration.
examples.zh: 错过「缴费截止日期」，注册会被加上限制。

examples.en: The fee deadline for spring is posted on the important dates page.
examples.zh: 春季「缴费截止日期」公布在重要日期页面上。

words.enDefinition: a short questionnaire rating a service after you use it

examples.en: Fill in the short feedback form after your appointment ends.
examples.zh: 预约结束后，请填写简短的「意见反馈表」。

examples.en: The feedback form takes two minutes and always stays anonymous.
examples.zh: 「意见反馈表」两分钟就能填完，而且是匿名的。

words.enDefinition: officially report a problem to the office that handles it

examples.en: You can file a complaint online, but paper forms are still accepted.
examples.zh: 你可以在线「提交投诉」，纸质表格也仍然受理。

examples.en: File a complaint only after trying to solve it directly with the office.
examples.zh: 先尝试与部门直接沟通解决，无果再「提交投诉」。

collocations: file a complaint with the department

words.enDefinition: items asking you to complete missing words

examples.en: The vocabulary section is ten fill in the blank items from chapter four.
examples.zh: 词汇部分是十道出自第四章的「填空题」。

examples.en: For fill in the blank, check whether they want the infinitive or the conjugated form.
examples.zh: 做「填空题」要看清要求，该填动词原形还是变位形式。

collocations: a fill in the blank item
complete the fill in the blank

words.enDefinition: the major exam held at the end of a course

examples.en: Our final exam is three hours long and covers everything from the whole term.
examples.zh: 我们的「期末考试」长达三小时，考查整学期的内容。

examples.en: The professor moved the final exam to the gym because of the repairs.
examples.zh: 因为场馆维修，教授把「期末考试」挪到了体育馆。

words.enDefinition: the overall course result from all assessments

examples.en: Your final grade posts to the portal two days after the exam.
examples.zh: 考试结束两天后，「最终成绩」会发布到教务系统。

examples.en: The final grade weights the exam at sixty percent of the total.
examples.zh: 「最终成绩」里考试占总分的百分之六十。

words.enDefinition: the transcript issued after final grades and degree posting

examples.en: Graduate admissions ask for your final transcript showing the degree awarded.
examples.zh: 研究生招生要求提交注明已授学位的「最终成绩单」。

examples.en: The final transcript is ready two weeks after degree posting.
examples.zh: 「最终成绩单」在学位入档两周后就能开出。

words.enDefinition: a student in the last year of a degree program

examples.en: As a final-year student, she books weekly meetings with her advisor.
examples.zh: 作为「毕业班学生」，她每周预约一次导师面谈。

examples.en: Final-year students get first pick of thesis advisors in October.
examples.zh: 「毕业班学生」十月可优先挑选论文导师。

words.enDefinition: the last week of term packed with final exams

examples.en: Campus goes quiet during finals week as everyone camps out in the library.
examples.zh: 「期末考试周」校园格外安静，大家都驻扎在图书馆里。

examples.en: I have three finals in four days, so finals week will be brutal.
examples.zh: 四天里三门期末考，这个「期末考试周」注定难熬。

words.enDefinition: a block caused by unpaid tuition or other fees

examples.en: The bursar placed a financial hold on accounts with unpaid tuition.
examples.zh: 出纳处给欠缴学费的账户设置了「财务冻结」。

examples.en: A financial hold will stop your diploma from being mailed.
examples.zh: 「财务冻结」会导致你的证书无法邮寄。

collocations: a financial hold on your account

words.enDefinition: to become confident enough to voice your own views

examples.en: Seminar discussions helped me find my voice after a term of sitting silently.
examples.zh: 沉默了一学期后，研讨课讨论帮我「找到了自己的声音」。

examples.en: Her TA encouraged her to find her voice by starting with short prepared comments.
examples.zh: 助教鼓励她从简短的准备性发言开始，「敢于发出自己的声音」。

collocations: find your voice in class discussions

words.enDefinition: the highest British degree class, typically seventy percent and above

examples.en: Getting first-class honours requires averaging seventy percent across your final modules.
examples.zh: 拿到「一等学位」需要毕业模块平均达到七十分。

examples.en: He celebrated earning first-class honours in economics at his graduation.
examples.zh: 毕业时他拿到了经济学「一等学位」，好好庆祝了一番。

words.enDefinition: a student whose parents never attended university themselves

examples.en: As a first-generation student, she learned the enrollment system alone.
examples.zh: 作为「第一代大学生」，她独自摸索选课系统。

examples.en: First-generation students can also join a free transition workshop series.
examples.zh: 「第一代大学生」可以参加免费的过渡系列工作坊。

words.enDefinition: calling each other by first names, not titles

examples.en: After two semesters, I'm on a first-name basis with my calculus professor.
examples.zh: 两个学期下来，我和微积分教授已经「直呼其名」了。

examples.en: American professors often put students on a first-name basis immediately.
examples.zh: 美国教授常常一开始就让学生「直呼其名」。

words.enDefinition: small discussion course required for new students

examples.en: My first-year seminar capped its enrollment at just twelve students.
examples.zh: 我们的「新生研讨课」选课人数上限只有十二人。

examples.en: First-year seminars usually count toward the writing general education requirement.
examples.zh: 「新生研讨课」通常可计入写作类通识要求。

words.enDefinition: to mark an online question to revisit later

examples.en: Flag a question and come back to it after finishing the section.
examples.zh: 先「标记题目」，等做完这一部分再回头处理。

examples.en: Flag a question whenever you stall, and clear all flags before submitting.
examples.zh: 卡壳时就「标记题目」，提交前再把所有标记清掉。

words.enDefinition: to add details that make a basic idea complete

examples.en: The outline is solid, but you need to flesh out the middle section.
examples.zh: 大纲没问题，但中间部分还得「充实」一下。

examples.en: We fleshed out the two strongest proposals during the second breakout room.
examples.zh: 第二轮分组讨论时，我们把最强的两个方案「细化」了。

words.enDefinition: a posted chart showing what is shelved on each floor

examples.en: Check the floor directory by the elevators to find the psychology section.
examples.zh: 在电梯旁的「楼层指引」上找到心理学藏区。

examples.en: The floor directory lists quiet zones, group pods, and every subject call range.
examples.zh: 「楼层指引」标出了静音区、研讨舱和各类目的索书号范围。

words.enDefinition: to fail an exam, especially badly

examples.en: Anyone can flunk an exam they never really prepared for.
examples.zh: 从没认真准备过的人，考试不「考砸」才怪。

examples.en: She was shocked to flunk an exam after acing every quiz.
examples.zh: 每次小测都拿高分，却在正式考试里「考砸」，她非常意外。

words.enDefinition: the rules about snacks and beverages inside the library

examples.en: The food and drink policy allows covered drinks but no snacks near the computers.
examples.zh: 按「饮食规定」，可以带盖饮料，但电脑区不许吃零食。

examples.en: Read the food and drink policy before bringing noodles into the study lounge.
examples.zh: 想带泡面进自习休息区之前，先读一遍「饮食规定」。

collocations: follow the food and drink policy
food and drink policy on the website

words.enDefinition: a campus service offering free groceries to students in need

examples.en: The campus food bank opens every Thursday behind the student center.
examples.zh: 校园「食物银行」每周四在学生中心后面开放。

examples.en: No one checks your income at the food bank; just bring a bag.
examples.zh: 去「食物银行」不查收入，带个袋子去就行。

words.enDefinition: a collection event that gathers canned food for charity

examples.en: The residence halls compete to collect the most cans during the food drive.
examples.zh: 「食品募捐」期间，各宿舍楼比赛谁收的罐头多。

examples.en: Our food drive filled three crates for the neighborhood pantry.
examples.zh: 我们的「食品募捐」给社区食物站装满了三个箱子。

words.enDefinition: not having reliable access to enough affordable, healthy food

examples.en: Food insecurity is common among students who pay rent first.
examples.zh: 先交房租的学生，常常面临「食物短缺」的困扰。

examples.en: The survey showed that food insecurity rises right before tuition is due.
examples.zh: 调查显示，交学费前夕「食物短缺」问题会加重。

words.enDefinition: so you can keep a copy of a document

examples.en: Keep the stamped receipt for your records in case of disputes.
examples.zh: 请保留盖章收据「供你存档」，以备出现争议。

examples.en: The clerk printed a second copy of the form for your records.
examples.zh: 柜员多打印了一份表格，「供你存档」。

words.enDefinition: a policy limiting how many students may earn each grade

examples.en: Law schools use a forced curve, so only a set share earn A's.
examples.zh: 法学院实行「强制曲线分布」，只有固定比例的人能拿A。

examples.en: Under the forced curve, my 91 became a B plus instead of an A.
examples.zh: 在「强制曲线」下，我的91分只能算B加而不是A。

words.enDefinition: the act of handing in a completed official form

examples.en: You will get a confirmation email after each form submission.
examples.zh: 每次「表格提交」后都会收到确认邮件。

examples.en: A late form submission can delay your enrollment verification letter.
examples.zh: 「表格提交」过晚，你的在读证明信可能会延迟。

words.enDefinition: an official written report of a problem, not a casual chat

examples.en: A formal complaint must name the office and describe the dates involved.
examples.zh: 「正式投诉」必须写明所涉部门和相关日期。

examples.en: She filed a formal complaint after the office ignored three emails.
examples.zh: 办公室无视了三封邮件后，她提交了「正式投诉」。

words.enDefinition: low-stakes checks that guide ongoing learning

examples.en: Weekly quizzes are formative assessment, so mistakes there cost almost nothing.
examples.zh: 每周小测属于「形成性评估」，出错几乎不扣分。

examples.en: Good formative assessment shows what to fix before the final exam.
examples.zh: 好的「形成性评估」能让你在期末考前发现该补的漏洞。

words.enDefinition: a page of formulas provided in math or science exams

examples.en: The formula sheet is attached to the front of the physics paper.
examples.zh: 「公式表」附在物理试卷的最前面。

examples.en: Learn how to use every line on the formula sheet before exam day.
examples.zh: 考试前要练熟「公式表」上每一条公式的用法。

words.enDefinition: one of the people who started a club originally

examples.en: As a founding member, she still chairs the club's anniversary planning.
examples.zh: 作为「创始成员」，她至今还负责统筹社团周年庆。

examples.en: The founding members wrote the first constitution in a dorm common room.
examples.zh: 「创始成员」们当年是在宿舍公共活动室写出第一版章程的。

words.enDefinition: a male social organization with chapters at many universities

examples.en: My brother joined a fraternity partly for the scholarship and study groups.
examples.zh: 我哥加入了一个「兄弟会」，一部分原因是那里有奖学金和学习小组。

examples.en: Fraternity houses on this campus host charity events every semester.
examples.zh: 校园里的「兄弟会」会所每学期都会举办慈善活动。

words.enDefinition: a group member who shares the grade but not the work

examples.en: Every group has one free rider who disappears until the day of the presentation.
examples.zh: 每个小组都有一名「搭便车的」，直到展示当天才现身。

examples.en: Our TA lets members report free riders, which lowers that person's individual score.
examples.zh: 我们的助教允许组员举报「不出力蹭分的人」，这会拉低其个人分数。

collocations: a free rider in the group

words.enDefinition: to suddenly stop thinking or speaking because of nerves

examples.en: I froze up mid-sentence when the professor asked me to define the key term.
examples.zh: 教授让我定义那个核心概念时，我「卡壳」了，话说到一半停住。

examples.en: Even well-prepared students freeze up when the question comes out of nowhere.
examples.zh: 即使准备充分，学生遇到突袭式提问也会「僵住」。

collocations: freeze up during a cold call
freeze up in front of everyone

words.enDefinition: the staff member who processes requests at a counter

examples.en: The front desk clerk scanned my ID and handed me my package.
examples.zh: 「前台职员」扫了一下我的证件，把包裹递给了我。

examples.en: Ask the front desk clerk to note your new phone number.
examples.zh: 请「前台职员」把你的新电话号码记下来。

collocations: the front desk clerk on duty
show your ID to the clerk

words.enDefinition: employees who greet and help visitors at a desk

examples.en: The front desk staff can print your enrollment verification letter.
examples.zh: 「前台工作人员」可以帮你打印在读证明。

examples.en: Ask the front desk staff where Professor Lee's office is.
examples.zh: 教授办公室在哪，可以直接问「前台工作人员」。

collocations: front desk staff at the department office

words.enDefinition: course with every single seat taken

examples.en: The economics lecture is a full course, so join the waitlist now.
examples.zh: 经济学大课已是「满员课程」，赶紧加入候补名单。

examples.en: A full course sometimes reopens during the first week when schedules shift.
examples.zh: 开学第一周大家调整课表时，「满员课程」有时会重新放出名额。

collocations: a full course with a waitlist

words.enDefinition: standard maximum credits expected of a full-time student

examples.en: International students must maintain a full course load to stay compliant.
examples.zh: 国际学生必须保持「满额课程负担」才符合规定。

examples.en: A full course load here means fifteen credits each semester.
examples.zh: 这里的「满额课程负担」指每学期十五个学分。

words.enDefinition: every point available on a question or paper

examples.en: She got full marks on the multiple choice section again.
examples.zh: 她在选择题部分又一次拿了「满分」。

examples.en: Full marks on this essay are rare, since the average sits around sixty percent.
examples.zh: 这篇论述很少有人拿「满分」，平均分通常在百分之六十上下。

words.enDefinition: the highest regular faculty rank above associate professor

examples.en: After twenty years of research, she finally made full professor last spring.
examples.zh: 潜心研究二十年后，她终于在去年春天升上「正教授」。

examples.en: Full professors often lead the research groups everyone wants to join.
examples.zh: 「正教授」往往领导着人人想进的课题组。

collocations: reach the rank of full professor

words.enDefinition: faculty employed full-time, usually with benefits

examples.en: Full-time faculty keep regular office hours, so email them anytime.
examples.zh: 「全职教师」有固定答疑时间，随时可以邮件联系。

examples.en: Only full-time faculty can supervise senior theses in our department.
examples.zh: 在我们系，只有「全职教师」能指导毕业论文。

words.enDefinition: enrollment level, usually twelve credits or more, required of visa students

examples.en: Dropping below twelve credits can cost international students their full-time status.
examples.zh: 国际学生学分低于十二分，可能失去「全日制身份」。

examples.en: Check with the international student office before changing your full-time status.
examples.zh: 调整「全日制身份」之前，先咨询国际学生办公室。

words.enDefinition: student enrolled in at least the standard minimum credits

examples.en: Twelve credits is the floor to count as a full-time student.
examples.zh: 十二个学分是「全日制学生」的最低标准。

examples.en: Dropping below full-time student status can affect scholarships and visas.
examples.zh: 低于「全日制学生」标准可能影响奖学金和签证。

words.enDefinition: a formal ask for money from student government or the university

examples.en: The funding request covered venue rental for our charity concert.
examples.zh: 这份「经费申请」涵盖了慈善音乐会的场地租金。

examples.en: Funding requests are reviewed monthly, so plan your event timeline backwards.
examples.zh: 「经费申请」每月集中审批一次，活动日程要倒着排。

words.enDefinition: an event organized to raise money for a club or cause

examples.en: Our car wash fundraiser paid for new jerseys for the whole intramural team.
examples.zh: 我们的洗车「筹款活动」为整支校内球队换了新队服。

examples.en: The fundraiser brought in six hundred dollars, double what we hoped for.
examples.zh: 这次「筹款活动」进账六百美元，是预期的两倍。

words.enDefinition: the officer who organizes events that raise money for a club

examples.en: The fundraising chair scheduled the bake sale for the busiest day on campus.
examples.zh: 「筹款负责人」把义卖安排在了校园人流量最大的一天。

examples.en: Under our fundraising chair, the club covered travel costs for the whole team.
examples.zh: 在「筹款负责人」的努力下，社团为全队支付了差旅费。

words.enDefinition: a meeting layout showing everyone's video in small boxes at once

examples.en: Switch to gallery view so you can see who's nodding along in discussion.
examples.zh: 切到「九宫格视图」，就能看到讨论时谁在点头。

examples.en: In gallery view I counted only six cameras on in a class of forty.
examples.zh: 在「九宫格视图」里一看，四十人的课只有六个人开了摄像头。

words.enDefinition: a relaxed evening of board games and snacks with the club

examples.en: Game night Fridays are how our club unwinds after competition season.
examples.zh: 周五的「游戏之夜」是我们赛季结束后放松的方式。

examples.en: Bring your favorite board game to game night in the clubroom.
examples.zh: 带上你最喜欢的桌游来活动室参加「游戏之夜」吧。

words.enDefinition: a year off between school and university, often for travel or work

examples.en: Taking a gap year is easier if you request deferred admission first.
examples.zh: 先申请延期入学，休「间隔年」会更省心。

examples.en: Her gap year of volunteering actually helped her choose a major.
examples.zh: 「间隔年」做志愿者的经历反而帮她选定了专业。

words.enDefinition: the main circulating shelves, separate from reserves or reference

examples.en: Most novels sit in the general collection on floors three through five.
examples.zh: 大部分小说都在三到五楼的「普通书库」。

examples.en: Unlike course reserves, items in the general collection check out for weeks.
examples.zh: 与课程预留书不同，「普通书库」的书可以借好几周。

words.enDefinition: courses outside your major that everyone must complete

examples.en: The writing seminar satisfies a general education requirement for freshmen.
examples.zh: 这门写作研讨课满足大一新生的「通识教育要求」。

examples.en: Knock out your general education requirements early with summer courses.
examples.zh: 尽早利用暑期课程修完「通识要求」。

words.enDefinition: a meeting all members attend to vote on big decisions

examples.en: The budget for next year is approved at the fall general meeting.
examples.zh: 明年的预算将在秋季「全体大会」上表决。

examples.en: Constitution changes require a two-thirds majority at a general meeting.
examples.zh: 修改章程需要在「全体大会」上拿到三分之二多数同意。

words.enDefinition: an unusually kind class-wide adjustment to exam scores

examples.en: The orgo final came with a generous curve that lifted many B's into A minus territory.
examples.zh: 有机化学期末的「调分很宽松」，把不少B抬进了A减区间。

examples.en: Do not count on a generous curve; the department has tightened its policy.
examples.zh: 别指望「宽松的曲线」，系里已经收紧了政策。

collocations: a generous curve on the final
the professor gave a generous curve

words.enDefinition: to manage to say something when others dominate the talk

examples.en: When one student hogs the discussion, nobody else can get a word in edgewise.
examples.zh: 一旦有人霸占讨论，别人就「一句话都插不上」。

examples.en: I finally got a word in edgewise after the TA called for shorter comments.
examples.zh: 助教呼吁发言简短之后，我终于「插上了一句话」。

collocations: can't get a word in edgewise
barely get a word in edgewise
finally get a word in edgewise

words.enDefinition: to return to the main topic after drifting away

examples.en: The TA got us back on track by pointing at the week's second discussion question.
examples.zh: 助教指着本周第二道讨论题，把我们「拉回正题」。

examples.en: We kept drifting into housing costs until the facilitator got us back on track.
examples.zh: 我们一再聊到房租开销，直到引导者把我们「带回正题」。

collocations: get the discussion back on track
bring the class back on track

words.enDefinition: to be chosen by the teacher to answer in class

examples.en: My heart races whenever I get called on before I have finished thinking.
examples.zh: 每当还没想好就被「点到名」，我的心跳就狂飙。

examples.en: If you get called on without an answer, describe what you are still working through.
examples.zh: 如果被「点到名」却还没答案，就说说你正卡在哪一步。

collocations: get called on in every class

words.enDefinition: to be drawn away from the planned topic by something else

examples.en: We got sidetracked comparing campuses and never reached the last discussion question.
examples.zh: 我们「聊偏了」，光顾着比较各个校园，最后一道讨论题没来得及。

examples.en: Groups get sidetracked easily when nobody keeps an eye on the clock.
examples.zh: 没人盯着时间的话，小组很容易「被带偏」。

words.enDefinition: to build a relationship with your instructors

examples.en: Get to know your professor early; you'll need letters later.
examples.zh: 早点和教授多「交流」，以后写推荐信用得上。

examples.en: Office hours are the easiest way to get to know your professor.
examples.zh: 答疑时间是「多与教授交流」的最简单途径。

collocations: get to know your professors early
get to know the professor during office hours
encourage students to get to know their professors

words.enDefinition: to present research to an audience

examples.en: Professor Amari will give a talk on memory models this Friday.
examples.zh: 阿玛丽教授本周五将「做讲座」，主题是记忆模型。

examples.en: Practice several times before you give a talk at a conference.
examples.zh: 在会议上「做报告」之前，一定要多练几遍。

collocations: invite someone to give a talk

words.enDefinition: to start discussing something unrelated to the main topic

examples.en: Our sociology seminar went off on a tangent about campus parking for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 我们的社会学课「跑题」跑了十分钟，从论文一路聊到校园停车。

examples.en: It's easy to go off on a tangent when everyone starts sharing personal stories.
examples.zh: 大家一开始讲自己的经历，就很容易「扯远」。

collocations: go off on a tangent about
pull the class back from a tangent

words.enDefinition: the combined status required for study abroad and internships
acceptedEnVariants: in good academic and disciplinary standing

examples.en: Study abroad applicants must be in good academic and disciplinary standing.
examples.zh: 留学交换申请者必须「学业品行良好」。

examples.en: The internship form asks your dean to confirm good academic and disciplinary standing.
examples.zh: 实习表格需要院长确认你「学业品行都良好」。

collocations: in good academic and disciplinary standing
confirm good academic and disciplinary standing
maintain good academic and disciplinary standing

words.enDefinition: the normal status of a student meeting all requirements

examples.en: You must remain in good standing to keep the merit scholarship.
examples.zh: 要保住优秀奖学金，必须保持「良好学籍」。

examples.en: A letter of good standing from the registrar is required for the exchange program.
examples.zh: 参加交换项目需要注册办出具的「良好学籍」证明。

words.enDefinition: a small gift bag of samples, coupons, and campus items

examples.en: Each goodie bag contained a water bottle, coupons, and a planner.
examples.zh: 每个「礼品袋」里都装着水壶、优惠券和一本日程本。

examples.en: Grab a goodie bag at the welcome booth before they run out.
examples.zh: 快去迎新展台领「礼品袋」，晚了就发完了。

words.enDefinition: borrowing regalia from the campus store for a fee

examples.en: Gown rental costs forty dollars and includes the cap and tassel.
examples.zh: 「袍服租借」四十美元，含学位帽和流苏。

examples.en: She picked up her gown rental order at the campus bookstore.
examples.zh: 她在校园书店取了「袍服租借」的订单。

words.enDefinition: the process of turning grades and credits into a GPA

examples.en: The registrar's website has a worksheet that explains GPA calculation step by step.
examples.zh: 教务处网站有一份工作表，逐步解释「绩点计算」。

examples.en: Repeated courses follow a special rule in the university's GPA calculation.
examples.zh: 重修课程在学校「绩点计算」中遵循特殊规则。

words.enDefinition: an online tool that estimates your GPA from expected grades

examples.en: I ran the GPA calculator with straight A's to see if 3.5 was reachable.
examples.zh: 我在「绩点计算器」里按全A试了试，看3.5够不够得着。

examples.en: The advising office links a GPA calculator for planning next semester's target.
examples.zh: 辅导办公室挂了个「绩点计算器」链接，用来规划下学期目标。

collocations: run the numbers through a GPA calculator

words.enDefinition: changing grades from one national system into another scale

examples.en: Graduate schools request a GPA conversion for transcripts issued overseas.
examples.zh: 研究生院要求对海外成绩单做「绩点换算」。

examples.en: Use the official chart for GPA conversion, since WES rounds differently.
examples.zh: 做「绩点换算」要用官方对照表，因为WES的取整方式不同。

words.enDefinition: the minimum GPA an application or program will consider

examples.en: The department's GPA cutoff for funded spots is 3.5 this year.
examples.zh: 该系有奖学金名额的「绩点门槛」今年是3.5。

examples.en: Missing the GPA cutoff by 0.02 still feels brutal in March.
examples.zh: 差0.02没过「绩点线」，三月份想起来还是很难受。

words.enDefinition: the shortfall when your cumulative GPA falls below the required level

examples.en: After two failed courses I am carrying a GPA deficit of 0.3.
examples.zh: 挂了两门课之后，我身上背着0.3的「绩点亏空」。

examples.en: Clearing the GPA deficit means retaking the courses with D's or F's.
examples.zh: 清除「绩点亏空」的办法就是重修拿了D或F的课。

words.enDefinition: a short-term drop in your grade average

examples.en: A one-semester GPA dip rarely sinks a graduate application on its own.
examples.zh: 单学期的「绩点下滑」很少单凭这一点毁掉研究生申请。

examples.en: Explain the GPA dip in your personal statement, since committees understand illness.
examples.zh: 在个人陈述里解释「绩点下滑」的原因，招生官能理解生病的情况。

words.enDefinition: the effect a single grade has on your average

examples.en: A three-credit elective has a small GPA impact compared to a core course.
examples.zh: 和核心课相比，三学分选修对「绩点的影响」很小。

examples.en: Before switching to pass/fail, students weigh the GPA impact of a likely C.
examples.zh: 改合格制之前，学生会权衡可能拿C对「绩点的影响」。

collocations: the GPA impact of one course

words.enDefinition: the minimum grade point average needed to graduate

examples.en: Students below the 2.0 GPA requirement cannot graduate this term.
examples.zh: 低于 2.0「绩点要求」的学生这学期无法毕业。

examples.en: Each program lists its own GPA requirement for the major.
examples.zh: 每个项目都会列出主修专业自己的「绩点要求」。

words.enDefinition: an official change made to a posted score or letter

examples.en: The curve was a five-point grade adjustment for the whole section.
examples.zh: 这次「成绩调整」是给整个小班统一加5分。

examples.en: Ask about a grade adjustment only if the points were actually miscounted.
examples.zh: 只有在分数确实算错时才去申请「成绩调整」。

words.enDefinition: ongoing worry about scores and their consequences

examples.en: Grade anxiety peaked for me the night before fall grades posted.
examples.zh: 秋季成绩出分前夜，我的「成绩焦虑」达到顶点。

examples.en: Counseling services run workshops on managing grade anxiety each midterm season.
examples.zh: 每逢期中季，心理中心都会开「成绩焦虑」管理工作坊。

words.enDefinition: a formal challenge to an assigned course grade

examples.en: File a grade appeal within ten working days of the results release.
examples.zh: 成绩公布后十个工作日内提交「成绩申诉」。

examples.en: Her grade appeal succeeded after the department found a totaling error.
examples.zh: 系里查出总分算错后，她的「成绩申诉」成功了。

words.enDefinition: the cutoff score separating two letter grades

examples.en: The grade boundary for an A landed at ninety-two this year.
examples.zh: 今年A等的「等级分数线」定在了九十二分。

examples.en: Because the exam was hard, the grade boundary shifted down two points.
examples.zh: 这次考试偏难，「等级分数线」下调了两分。

collocations: the grade boundary for an A

words.enDefinition: the itemized parts that add up to your course grade

examples.en: The grade breakdown on the syllabus lists homework at twenty percent.
examples.zh: 课程大纲上的「成绩构成」写着作业占20%。

examples.en: I misread the grade breakdown and thought the final was optional.
examples.zh: 我看错了「分数构成」，以为期末考是选考的。

collocations: the grade breakdown in the syllabus

words.enDefinition: a small raise in a grade from scaling or rounding

examples.en: The curve gave everyone a two-point grade bump before posting.
examples.zh: 出分前，曲线让每人的分数都有了一点「上调」。

examples.en: Rounding my 79.5 gave a one-letter grade bump to a B.
examples.zh: 79.5四舍五入后让我的等级「上调了一档」，变成了B。

words.enDefinition: a grouped set of assignments like quizzes or labs in the gradebook

examples.en: The gradebook shows each grade category with its weight for the final.
examples.zh: 在线记分册显示每个「成绩类别」及其在期末的权重。

examples.en: Drop the lowest score within each grade category before averaging.
examples.zh: 平均之前，每个「计分类别」里先去掉最低分。

collocations: drop the lowest in a grade category

words.enDefinition: the form an instructor files to correct a posted grade

examples.en: The professor submitted a grade change form after finding the addition error.
examples.zh: 教授发现加总错误后提交了「改分申请表」。

examples.en: A grade change form goes through the registrar, not through the portal.
examples.zh: 「成绩更改表」走教务处流程，不走学生系统。

collocations: a grade change form after regrading

words.enDefinition: a policy or culture of keeping average grades low

examples.en: That department is famous for grade deflation, so a B there means a lot.
examples.zh: 那个系以「压分」出名，所以在那儿拿B含金量很高。

examples.en: Graduate committees note grade deflation when they read transcripts from certain schools.
examples.zh: 研究生委员会看到某些学校的成绩单时会考虑「分数紧缩」的情况。

words.enDefinition: a mismatch between your records and the posted grade

examples.en: I found a grade discrepancy between my points sheet and the portal.
examples.zh: 我发现我的记分表和系统之间有「成绩出入」。

examples.en: Report any grade discrepancy to the TA with screenshots attached.
examples.zh: 发现「分数不符」就截图向助教报告。

collocations: a grade discrepancy of five points

words.enDefinition: a formal disagreement between a student and a posted grade

examples.en: A grade dispute starts with the instructor and escalates to the department.
examples.zh: 「成绩争议」先找任课老师解决，解决不了再升级到系里。

examples.en: He filed a grade dispute over the group project's individual scores.
examples.zh: 他就小组项目里的个人得分提交了「成绩争议」。

collocations: a grade dispute over the final

words.enDefinition: the spread of grades across a whole class

examples.en: The grade distribution showed a tight cluster in the B range.
examples.zh: 「成绩分布」显示大家密集集中在B档。

examples.en: Check the grade distribution before assuming the exam was unfair.
examples.zh: 先看看「成绩分布」，再下结论说考试不公。

words.enDefinition: a student who constantly begs for extra points after grading

examples.en: Nobody wants to be the grade grubber who emails after every quiz.
examples.zh: 没人想成为每次小测后都发邮件「抠分的学生」。

examples.en: Even the professor can spot a grade grubber from the first polite complaint.
examples.zh: 连教授都能从第一次客气的申诉里认出「纠缠分数的学生」。

words.enDefinition: your complete term-by-term list of grades in one view

examples.en: The portal's grade history page shows every term since freshman year.
examples.zh: 系统的「成绩记录」页显示大一以来的每个学期。

examples.en: Scrolling through my grade history, I watched the upward trend after sophomore year.
examples.zh: 翻看「历史成绩」，能看到大二之后明显的上升趋势。

words.enDefinition: the trend of average grades rising higher over time

examples.en: Grade inflation means a B today would have been a C a generation ago.
examples.zh: 「分数通胀」意味着今天的B相当于上一代人的C。

examples.en: Admissions officers adjust for grade inflation when comparing applicants from different schools.
examples.zh: 招生官比较不同学校申请者时会校正「分数通胀」因素。

collocations: a school known for grade inflation

words.enDefinition: the field recording whether a course is graded, pass/fail, or audit

examples.en: The portal lists your grade mode for each class: graded, pass/fail, or audit.
examples.zh: 系统里列出了每门课的「计分模式」：等级制、合格制还是旁听。

examples.en: Changing your grade mode after the deadline requires a petition.
examples.zh: 截止日期后想改「计分模式」就得提交特批申请。

collocations: grade mode of graded or pass/fail

words.enDefinition: a second-check process that keeps marking standards consistent

examples.en: British universities use grade moderation to compare marking across markers.
examples.zh: 英国大学用「成绩复核」来统一不同阅卷人的标准。

examples.en: My essay went through grade moderation before the final mark was confirmed.
examples.zh: 我的论文在最终分数确认前经过了「评分复核」。

words.enDefinition: an automatic message telling you a new grade is posted

examples.en: I set up grade notifications so each posted score lands in my inbox.
examples.zh: 我设置了「成绩通知」，每次出分都会进我的邮箱。

examples.en: Turn off grade notifications during finals week if they make you anxious.
examples.zh: 如果让你焦虑，期末周就把「出分提醒」关掉。

words.enDefinition: the withdrawal mark recorded when you drop a course late

examples.en: A grade of W appears on my transcript but does not touch my GPA.
examples.zh: 我的成绩单上有一个「退课W标记」，但不影响绩点。

examples.en: Two grades of W in one term raised a flag with my advisor.
examples.zh: 一学期两个「W退课标记」引起了导师的注意。

collocations: a grade of W on the transcript

words.enDefinition: to set grades relative to class performance

examples.en: The professor will grade on a curve, so only the top fifteen percent get an A.
examples.zh: 教授会「按曲线调分」，只有前百分之十五能拿A。

examples.en: If everyone does badly, grading on a curve can actually raise your grade.
examples.zh: 如果大家都考得差，「按曲线调分」反而可能抬高你的成绩。

collocations: grade the midterm on a curve
decide to grade on a curve

words.enDefinition: to score students' essays and problem sets

examples.en: Professor Osei spends her Sundays grading papers for two sections.
examples.zh: 奥塞教授每周日都在给两个班「批改作业」。

examples.en: TAs grade papers within a week so the feedback stays useful.
examples.zh: 助教一周内「批改完作业」，反馈才有时效。

words.enDefinition: the numerical value a letter grade converts to per credit

examples.en: Most universities assign 4.0 grade points per credit hour for an A.
examples.zh: 多数大学里A折合每学分4.0个「等级点数」。

examples.en: Multiply each course's grade points by its credits, then add them up.
examples.zh: 把每门课的「等级点数」乘以学分，再全部相加。

words.enDefinition: the average of grade points across all courses, shown as a number

examples.en: My grade point average slipped to 2.9 after a rough sophomore year.
examples.zh: 大二不顺之后，我的「平均绩点」掉到了2.9。

examples.en: Most graduate programs list a 3.0 grade point average as the minimum.
examples.zh: 大多数研究生项目把「平均绩点」3.0列为最低线。

words.enDefinition: total grade points accumulated across all completed courses

examples.en: Grade points earned divided by credits attempted gives your GPA.
examples.zh: 用「所获绩点」除以修读学分，就得到你的GPA。

examples.en: The unofficial transcript lists grade points earned for every completed term.
examples.zh: 非官方成绩单逐学期列出「所获绩点」。

collocations: divide grade points earned by credits

words.enDefinition: the moment final grades appear in the student system

examples.en: Grade posting for fall term starts December 22 at noon.
examples.zh: 秋季学期「成绩发布」从12月22日中午开始。

examples.en: Delays in grade posting usually mean the registrar is processing incompletes.
examples.zh: 「成绩发布」延迟通常意味着教务处还在处理缓评。

collocations: grade posting in the student portal

words.enDefinition: a tool that estimates your final grade from current scores

examples.en: The grade predictor says I need an 82 on the final for an A minus.
examples.zh: 「成绩预测工具」显示我期末要考82分才能拿A减。

examples.en: Our LMS has a grade predictor built into the grades page.
examples.zh: 我们的学习系统在成绩页面自带「成绩预测器」。

words.enDefinition: stress caused by expectations attached to grades

examples.en: Grade pressure from scholarship renewals made every quiz feel final-exam serious.
examples.zh: 奖学金续评带来的「成绩压力」让每次小测都像期末一样沉重。

examples.en: Peer grade pressure fades once you stop comparing transcripts in the group chat.
examples.zh: 不再在群聊里比成绩单后，来自同伴的「分数压力」就淡了。

words.enDefinition: the announced day final grades become visible to students

examples.en: The grade release date for spring term is May 16.
examples.zh: 春季学期「成绩公布日」是5月16日。

examples.en: Circle the grade release date, because transcript requests spike right after it.
examples.zh: 在日历上圈出「出分日期」，之后开成绩单证明的人会暴增。

words.enDefinition: a policy letting a retaken course grade replace the old one

examples.en: Under grade replacement, the new calculus grade erases the old F.
examples.zh: 根据「成绩替换」政策，新的微积分成绩会覆盖原来的 F。

examples.en: Ask if grade replacement is limited to two courses in total.
examples.zh: 问问「成绩替换」是否总共只限两门课。

words.enDefinition: an end-of-term summary of the grades you received

examples.en: The grade report emails out a week after finals end.
examples.zh: 「成绩通知单」在期末考试结束一周后邮件发出。

examples.en: My parents asked for a copy of the semester grade report.
examples.zh: 我父母要了一份学期「成绩报告单」的副本。

words.enDefinition: bumping a score up to the next letter at a threshold

examples.en: The syllabus explicitly says there is no grade rounding at term's end.
examples.zh: 课程大纲明确写了期末「不做成绩四舍五入」。

examples.en: Some professors practice grade rounding for averages within 0.5 of a letter.
examples.zh: 有些教授会对离等级线不到0.5分的平均分做「成绩取整」。

words.enDefinition: the surprise of a first grade far below high school results

examples.en: Grade shock is real when your first college essay returns a C plus.
examples.zh: 大学第一篇论文只拿回C加时，「成绩落差」的冲击是真实的。

examples.en: Most freshmen recover from grade shock by midterms of second semester.
examples.zh: 多数新生到第二学期期中就能走出「成绩落差」。

words.enDefinition: the process of instructors uploading final grades to the registrar

examples.en: Grade submission closes within forty-eight hours after each final exam ends.
examples.zh: 每场期末考结束后48小时内要完成「成绩提交」。

examples.en: Late grade submission is why my transcript still shows an empty column.
examples.zh: 老师「提交成绩」晚了，所以我的成绩单那栏还空着。

words.enDefinition: a spreadsheet or app for logging scores during the term

examples.en: I keep a grade tracker so nothing surprises me at the end of term.
examples.zh: 我一直用「成绩记录表」，免得期末被分数吓一跳。

examples.en: My grade tracker says I can still pull the chemistry grade to a B.
examples.zh: 我的「成绩追踪表」显示化学成绩还能拉到B。

words.enDefinition: the share each assessment counts toward results

examples.en: The grade weighting gives the final exam fifty percent of the total.
examples.zh: 按「成绩权重」，期末考占总分的一半。

examples.en: Check the grade weighting before deciding which midterm to prioritize.
examples.zh: 决定先抓哪门期中之前，先看清「成绩权重」。

words.enDefinition: the online record of scores for every assignment in a course

examples.en: The online gradebook updates overnight after the TAs finish marking each week.
examples.zh: 助教每周批改完，网上「记分册」隔夜就会更新。

examples.en: Check the gradebook before the withdrawal deadline so nothing catches you off guard.
examples.zh: 退课截止前先看看「在线成绩册」，免得措手不及。

words.enDefinition: a student hired only to score homework and exams

examples.en: The department hired two graders for the four-hundred-student economics course.
examples.zh: 这门四百人的经济学课，系里雇了两名「批改员」。

examples.en: Graders must follow the professor's answer key closely when scoring.
examples.zh: 「批改员」打分必须严格依照教授的答案要点。

words.enDefinition: a marking mistake in totaling or applying the rubric

examples.en: A grading error added my points twice on question six.
examples.zh: 第六题出了「评分错误」，我的分数被加了两遍。

examples.en: Compare your scanned paper with the posted scores before claiming a grading error.
examples.zh: 主张存在「评分错误」之前，先把自己的试卷扫描件和公布分数核对一遍。

collocations: a grading error on question six

words.enDefinition: the exact calculation that produces the course grade

examples.en: The grading formula weights the final at forty percent of the course.
examples.zh: 「计分公式」把期末权重设为整门课的40%。

examples.en: Plug your scores into the grading formula to estimate your final letter.
examples.zh: 把你的分数代入「计分公式」，就能估算出期末等级。

collocations: the grading formula in the syllabus

words.enDefinition: choice between letter grades and pass/fail credit

examples.en: You can switch your grading option in the portal until week eight.
examples.zh: 第八周之前，你可以在系统里更改「评分方式」。

examples.en: Some courses don't offer a pass/fail grading option at all.
examples.zh: 有些课程完全不提供「合格/不合格」这种评分方式。

words.enDefinition: the official rules for how a course's grades are assigned

examples.en: The grading policy in the syllabus explains late penalties and regrades.
examples.zh: 课程大纲里的「评分政策」解释了迟交罚分和重判规则。

examples.en: Department-wide grading policy keeps two sections of the same course comparable.
examples.zh: 全系统一的「评分政策」让同一门课的不同班可比。

words.enDefinition: the chart converting percentages into letter grades

examples.en: On this grading scale, ninety-three is the cutoff for an A.
examples.zh: 按这张「评分等级表」，九十三分是A等的门槛。

examples.en: The syllabus includes the grading scale plus the weight of each assessment.
examples.zh: 课程大纲附有「评分等级表」以及各项考核的权重。

words.enDefinition: the document set submitted to enter a graduate program

examples.en: My graduate application includes transcripts, two references, and a writing sample.
examples.zh: 我的「研究生申请」包括成绩单、两封推荐信和一份写作样本。

examples.en: I tracked every graduate application deadline in one shared spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 我用一个共享表格跟踪每份「研究生申请」的截止日期。

words.enDefinition: a grad student paid to support teaching or admin work

examples.en: Graduate assistants at the department office answer student emails all day.
examples.zh: 系办的「研究生助理」整天回复学生邮件。

examples.en: As a graduate assistant, she gets free tuition and a small stipend.
examples.zh: 作为「研究生助理」，她免学费还能拿少量津贴。

words.enDefinition: receive your degree without attending the ceremony in person

examples.en: Students abroad can graduate in absentia and receive diplomas by mail.
examples.zh: 在国外的学生可以「缺席毕业」，证书邮寄到家。

examples.en: She chose to graduate in absentia because her visa expired in June.
examples.zh: 因为签证六月到期，她选择了「缺席毕业」。

words.enDefinition: a grad student with full responsibility for a section

examples.en: As a graduate instructor, Maria teaches two discussion sections herself.
examples.zh: 玛丽亚作为「研究生讲师」，独立带两个讨论班。

examples.en: Graduate instructors receive formal teaching training before the semester starts.
examples.zh: 开学前「研究生讲师」要接受正式的教学培训。

words.enDefinition: a specific master's or PhD course of study

examples.en: Their graduate program in biostatistics admits only twenty students yearly.
examples.zh: 他们的生物统计「研究生项目」每年只录取二十人。

examples.en: Ask the graduate program coordinator about funding for international students.
examples.zh: 向「研究生项目」协调员询问国际学生的资助情况。

words.enDefinition: the university branch offering master's and doctoral study

examples.en: She is applying to graduate school for the fall 2027 intake.
examples.zh: 她正在申请2027年秋季入学的「研究生院」。

examples.en: Graduate school applications ask for transcripts, references, and a purpose statement.
examples.zh: 「研究生院」申请需要成绩单、推荐信和目的陈述。

words.enDefinition: a grad student assisting a professor with teaching duties

examples.en: The graduate teaching assistant runs the lab sessions and grades quizzes.
examples.zh: 「研究生助教」负责实验课并批改小测。

examples.en: Email the graduate teaching assistant first; she handles homework questions.
examples.zh: 作业问题先发邮件给「研究生助教」，由她答疑。

collocations: work as a graduate teaching assistant

words.enDefinition: finish your degree with honors noted on the record

examples.en: She managed to graduate with honors despite switching majors in sophomore year.
examples.zh: 尽管大二转了专业，她还是「以优异成绩毕业」。

examples.en: Students who graduate with honors wear a special cord at commencement.
examples.zh: 「以优异成绩毕业」的学生在典礼上会佩戴特殊的肩绳。
