examples.en: Laptop loans run four hours and require your student ID at the desk.
examples.zh: 「笔记本电脑外借」时长四小时，需在柜台出示学生证。

examples.en: My laptop died mid-essay, so a laptop loan saved my deadline.
examples.zh: 写论文时电脑没电了，多亏「笔记本外借」救了截止日期。

words.enDefinition: a cable lock that secures your laptop to a desk

examples.en: Borrow a laptop lock at the desk if you step away from the carrel.
examples.zh: 如果要离开隔位，去柜台借一把「笔记本锁」。

examples.en: A laptop lock deters theft when you grab food between chapters.
examples.zh: 章节之间去吃饭时，「笔记本锁」能防贼。

collocations: secure your laptop with a lock

words.enDefinition: the family name used with a title like Professor

examples.en: Address Professor Osei by her last name unless she invites otherwise.
examples.zh: 称呼奥塞教授要用「姓氏」，除非她另有表示。

examples.en: Write your last name on every page of the exam paper.
examples.zh: 考卷每一页都要写上你的「姓氏」。

words.enDefinition: a graduation application filed after the deadline with an extra fee

examples.en: His late graduation application came with an extra fifty-dollar processing fee.
examples.zh: 他的「逾期毕业申请」多交了五十美元手续费。

examples.en: She filed a late graduation application after missing the March deadline.
examples.zh: 错过三月截止日后，她提交了「逾期毕业申请」。

words.enDefinition: registering after the official period, often with a fee

examples.en: I missed the deadline and had to pay a late registration fee.
examples.zh: 我错过了截止日期，只好交「逾期注册」费。

examples.en: Late registration runs through the first week with department approval.
examples.zh: 经系里批准，「逾期注册」可持续到开学第一周。

words.enDefinition: bringing an item back after its due date has passed

examples.en: A late return blocks new checkouts until you clear the fine at the desk.
examples.zh: 「逾期归还」后，结清罚款前不能再借新书。

examples.en: One late return during midterms cost me five dollars in fines.
examples.zh: 期中期间一次「逾期归还」让我花了五美元罚款。

words.enDefinition: The period after a deadline in which submissions may still be accepted.

examples.en: The late submission window closes on Friday, so I will upload the revised worksheet tomorrow.
examples.zh: 「允许迟交的时段」周五结束，我明天会上传修改后的练习单。

examples.en: I checked the late submission window before asking whether the portal would still accept my file.
examples.zh: 我先查了「允许迟交的时段」，然后才问提交系统是否还能接收文件。

collocations: submit within the late submission window

words.enDefinition: dropping a course after the official deadline, recorded as W or F

examples.en: A late withdrawal needs the dean's approval and a solid written reason.
examples.zh: 「逾期退课」需要院长批准和一条充分的书面理由。

examples.en: The late withdrawal shows as a W on my transcript, not an F.
examples.zh: 这次「逾期退课」在我的成绩单上记为 W，而不是 F。

words.enDefinition: graduation honors with Latin names awarded by GPA tier

examples.en: She graduated with Latin honors, which appear on her diploma and transcript.
examples.zh: 她以「拉丁荣誉等级」毕业，这一荣誉印在证书和成绩单上。

examples.en: Each school sets GPA cutoffs for the three levels of Latin honors.
examples.zh: 每个学校都为「拉丁荣誉等级」的三档设定了绩点门槛。

words.enDefinition: an undergraduate trained to help peers in class

examples.en: Learning assistants circulate during the physics workshop to help groups.
examples.zh: 物理工作坊上，「学习助理」巡回为各小组答疑。

examples.en: Becoming a learning assistant earns credit and a small payment.
examples.zh: 担任「学习助理」既拿学分又有少量报酬。

words.enDefinition: a modern open floor mixing study space, tech help, and tutoring

examples.en: The learning commons on floor two has couches, whiteboards, and a tech bar.
examples.zh: 二楼的「学习共享空间」有沙发、白板和技术服务台。

examples.en: Group projects run smoother in the learning commons than in the silent stacks.
examples.zh: 在「学习共享空间」做小组项目比在静音书库顺畅多了。

words.enDefinition: the online platform where a university runs its courses

examples.en: Check the learning management system every morning for new announcements.
examples.zh: 每天早上先去「学习管理系统」上看有没有新通知。

examples.en: Our professor posts slides, quizzes, and grades on the learning management system.
examples.zh: 教授把课件、测验和成绩都放在「学习管理系统」上。

collocations: log into the learning management system
post on the learning management system

words.enDefinition: to skip a question without writing anything

examples.en: Never leave a question blank, because a reasonable guess might earn points.
examples.zh: 千万别「空着不答」，合理的猜测也可能得分。

examples.en: It is better to guess than to leave a question blank in multiple choice.
examples.zh: 做选择题，宁可猜一个也不要「空着不答」。

words.enDefinition: approved time away from the university, usually up to a year

examples.en: Request a leave of absence before the term starts to avoid failing grades.
examples.zh: 想「休学」要在学期开始前申请，以免课程记挂科。

examples.en: Her leave of absence for family reasons was approved within a week.
examples.zh: 她因家事申请的「休学」一周内就批了。

words.enDefinition: forget to mute, so everyone hears your background noise

examples.en: He left his mic on and the whole class heard him ordering bubble tea.
examples.zh: 他「忘了关麦克风」，全班都听见他在点奶茶。

examples.en: If you leave your mic on, even your keyboard sounds fill the meeting.
examples.zh: 只要「忘关麦克风」，连你敲键盘的声音全班都听得见。

words.enDefinition: the system that automatically records lectures and uploads them

examples.en: Our lecture capture only films the projector screen, not the professor.
examples.zh: 我们的「录播系统」只拍投影幕布，不拍教授。

examples.en: Check lecture capture before skipping class because some professors stop the recording.
examples.zh: 翘课前先确认「录播系统」开着，有的教授会手动停录。

words.enDefinition: a large tiered room where big classes meet

examples.en: Intro psychology meets in the biggest lecture hall on campus.
examples.zh: 心理学导论课在学校最大的「阶梯教室」上。

examples.en: Grab a seat early or the lecture hall fills up fast.
examples.zh: 早点占座，不然「阶梯教室」很快就坐满了。

collocations: the back of the lecture hall

words.enDefinition: the slide file a professor shows during class

examples.en: Our professor posts the PowerPoint slides online after every lecture.
examples.zh: 我们教授每次课后都会把「PPT幻灯片」传到网上。

examples.en: I add my own notes directly on the PowerPoint slides.
examples.zh: 我直接在「PPT幻灯片」上加自己的笔记。

collocations: the PowerPoint slides for today's class

words.enDefinition: record which students are present in class

examples.en: The TA takes attendance during the first five minutes of class.
examples.zh: 助教在上课前五分钟「点名」。

examples.en: Some professors take attendance at every single lecture, so don't skip.
examples.zh: 有的教授每节课都「点名记考勤」，所以别翘课。

words.enDefinition: reading each student's name aloud to check presence

examples.en: Roll call takes forever in a class of two hundred students.
examples.zh: 两百人的班做「点名」要花好长时间。

examples.en: The TA started roll call right at nine o'clock sharp.
examples.zh: 助教九点整准时开始「点名」。

words.enDefinition: a short fun activity that helps strangers start talking

examples.en: Our first seminar started with a slightly awkward icebreaker game.
examples.zh: 研讨课第一节做了一个有点尴尬的「破冰活动」。

examples.en: The icebreaker helped me learn the names of three classmates.
examples.zh: 这个「破冰活动」让我记住了三位同学的名字。

words.enDefinition: the relaxed first week when professors mainly review course plans

examples.en: During syllabus week, most classes end twenty minutes earlier than scheduled.
examples.zh: 「开学轻松第一周」大多数课都会比课表提前二十分钟下课。

examples.en: Everyone makes friends during syllabus week before the real workload starts.
examples.zh: 趁着「开学轻松第一周」，大家抓紧交朋友，正课还没开始。

words.enDefinition: lift your hand to speak or answer in class

examples.en: Raise your hand if you want the professor to repeat the question.
examples.zh: 想让教授再讲一遍问题就「举手」。

examples.en: I raised my hand, but the TA called on someone else first.
examples.zh: 我「举手」了，但助教先点了别人。

words.enDefinition: an unexpected question aimed at a random unprepared student

examples.en: I got a cold call in statistics even though my hand was down.
examples.zh: 统计课上我被「随机点名提问」了，明明我没举手。

examples.en: Everyone sits up straighter when the professor is known for cold calls.
examples.zh: 这位教授以「随机点名」出名，大家坐得都端正多了。

words.enDefinition: choose one student to answer a question

examples.en: The professor called on a student sitting in the front row.
examples.zh: 教授「点了」坐在前排的一个学生回答。

examples.en: The tutor might call on a student who has not volunteered to answer.
examples.zh: 导师可能会「点一名学生回答」，即使那名学生没有举手。

collocations: call on someone in the back

words.enDefinition: scheduled times when students can visit a professor

examples.en: Office hours are listed on the first page of the syllabus.
examples.zh: 「教授答疑时间」写在教学大纲第一页。

examples.en: I stopped by office hours to ask about my essay feedback.
examples.zh: 我趁「答疑时间」去问了一下论文的反馈。

words.enDefinition: reserve a time slot to meet a professor

examples.en: You have to book office hours through the online scheduling system.
examples.zh: 你需要在预约系统上「预约答疑时间」。

examples.en: I tried to book office hours before the slots filled up for midterms.
examples.zh: 期中考试前，我趁名额还没满「预约答疑时间」。

words.enDefinition: write down key points during a lecture

examples.en: I take notes by hand because typing on a laptop distracts me.
examples.zh: 我习惯手写「记笔记」，用电脑打字容易分心。

examples.en: Take notes during the lecture, or you'll miss all the examples.
examples.zh: 上课一定要「记笔记」，不然会漏掉所有例子。

words.enDefinition: the habit of writing down important points in class

examples.en: Good note-taking makes reviewing for exams so much easier later.
examples.zh: 「做笔记」做得好，后面复习考试就轻松多了。

examples.en: My note-taking improved a lot after I learned the outline method.
examples.zh: 学会大纲法之后，我「做笔记」的水平提高了不少。

words.enDefinition: a question that checks what a statement really means

examples.en: Can I ask a clarifying question about the second step?
examples.zh: 关于第二步，我可以提个「澄清性提问」吗？

examples.en: No clarifying question is too small to ask during office hours.
examples.zh: 答疑时间问多小的「澄清性问题」都不嫌小。

collocations: a clarifying question about the instructions

words.enDefinition: an extra question built on the previous answer

examples.en: The guest speaker welcomed follow-up questions for twenty minutes after her talk.
examples.zh: 演讲嘉宾的报告结束后，花了二十分钟接受大家「追问」。

examples.en: I asked a follow-up question about the study's sample size.
examples.zh: 我就研究的样本量「追问」了一个问题。

words.enDefinition: review material from classes you failed to attend

examples.en: I spent the whole weekend catching up on missed lectures before the quiz.
examples.zh: 测验前，我整个周末都在「补落下的课」。

examples.en: Borrowing a friend's notes helps you catch up on missed lectures faster.
examples.zh: 借同学的笔记能更快「补上落下的课」。

collocations: catch up on missed lectures over the weekend

words.enDefinition: a class talk given by an invited outside expert

examples.en: Our marketing class has a guest lecture from an alum this Friday.
examples.zh: 周五市场营销课有一位校友来讲「特邀讲座」。

examples.en: Attendance is mandatory for tomorrow's guest lecture, so arrive early.
examples.zh: 明天的「特邀讲座」必须到场，记得早点去。

words.enDefinition: an outside expert invited to address a class

examples.en: The guest speaker drove three hours to talk to our seminar.
examples.zh: 「主讲嘉宾」开了三个小时车来给我们研讨课做分享。

examples.en: Our guest speaker stayed an extra twenty minutes for questions.
examples.zh: 「主讲嘉宾」多留了二十分钟回答问题。

words.enDefinition: a class visit to a museum, company, or natural site

examples.en: Our geology class has a field trip to the river canyon on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六地质课要去河谷「实地考察」。

examples.en: Sign the field trip waiver by Friday, or you can't go.
examples.zh: 周五前签好「实地考察」同意书，不然去不了。

collocations: a field trip to a museum

words.enDefinition: a scheduled hands-on practical class in a laboratory

examples.en: Every lab session starts with a ten-minute safety briefing at the door.
examples.zh: 每次「实验课」进门后都有十分钟的安全讲解。

examples.en: You must wear closed-toe shoes to every chemistry lab session.
examples.zh: 上化学「实验课」必须穿包趾鞋。

words.enDefinition: a whole-group conversation about the day's topic or reading

examples.en: The professor grades us on how much we join the class discussion.
examples.zh: 教授按我们「课堂讨论」的参与度打分。

examples.en: Today's class discussion completely changed how I see the novel.
examples.zh: 今天的「课堂讨论」完全改变了我对这本小说的看法。

words.enDefinition: a printed sheet the professor distributes in class

examples.en: Grab a handout from the pile next to the door.
examples.zh: 从门边那摞纸里拿一份「课堂讲义」。

examples.en: The handout summarizes every formula we covered on today's slides.
examples.zh: 这份「讲义」总结了今天幻灯片上的所有公式。

collocations: an extra copy of the handout

words.enDefinition: a smooth classroom board written on with erasable markers

examples.en: The professor filled the whiteboard with derivations in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 教授十分钟就在「白板」上写满了推导过程。

examples.en: Can someone take a photo of the whiteboard before it gets erased?
examples.zh: 「白板」被擦掉之前，谁能拍张照吗？

words.enDefinition: the seats farthest from the front of the room

examples.en: From the back row, you can barely read the slides.
examples.zh: 坐「后排」几乎看不清幻灯片上的字。

examples.en: I moved from the back row to the front to focus better.
examples.zh: 为了更专心，我把座位从「后排」换到了前面。

words.enDefinition: attend a class you are not enrolled in

examples.en: First-years often sit in on a lecture before choosing their major.
examples.zh: 很多新生在定专业前会去「旁听课」。

examples.en: Can I sit in on your lecture tomorrow? I'm considering the class.
examples.zh: 我明天能去「旁听」你的课吗？我在考虑选这门课。

collocations: sit in on the first lecture

words.enDefinition: a graduate student who leads sections and grades work

examples.en: Email the teaching assistant first; the professor gets too many messages.
examples.zh: 有事先给「助教」发邮件，教授的邮件太多了。

examples.en: Our teaching assistant runs a review session every Thursday evening.
examples.zh: 我们的「助教」每周四晚上组织复习。

words.enDefinition: a teaching-focused faculty member for a course

examples.en: Our statistics lecturer uses real news stories to explain every concept.
examples.zh: 我们的统计「讲师」总用真实新闻来讲解概念。

examples.en: The visiting lecturer stayed twenty minutes late to answer questions.
examples.zh: 那位来访「讲师」晚走了二十分钟答疑。

words.enDefinition: another student taking the same course as you

examples.en: My classmate lent me her notes when I was out sick.
examples.zh: 我生病没来时，「同班同学」把笔记借给了我。

examples.en: I always sit next to a classmate from my dorm.
examples.zh: 我总是和宿舍的「同学」坐在一起。

words.enDefinition: the student who shares your lab workspace

examples.en: My lab partner and I split the measurements to save time.
examples.zh: 我和「实验搭档」分工测量来节省时间。

examples.en: Ask the TA to switch you to a new lab partner.
examples.zh: 可以找助教把你换到新的「实验搭档」那组。

words.enDefinition: the seats closest to the professor

examples.en: The front row is always empty in the eight a.m. class.
examples.zh: 早八的课「前排」永远没人坐。

examples.en: Sitting in the front row makes it easier to ask questions.
examples.zh: 坐「前排」更容易提问。

words.enDefinition: fixed seats chosen for each student in advance

examples.en: The professor uses assigned seating to learn our names faster.
examples.zh: 教授用「指定座位」来更快记住我们的名字。

examples.en: There's no assigned seating, so come early for a good spot.
examples.zh: 这门课没有「指定座位」，想坐好位置就来早点。

words.enDefinition: a diagram showing where every student sits

examples.en: The TA updated the seating chart after three students dropped the class.
examples.zh: 三名学生退课后，助教更新了「座位表」。

examples.en: Check the seating chart taped next to the door on day one.
examples.zh: 第一天先看看贴在门边的「座位表」。

collocations: a seating chart by the door

words.enDefinition: keep a chair free for someone arriving later

examples.en: Can you save a seat for me? I'm coming from the library.
examples.zh: 帮我「占个座」好吗？我从图书馆过来。

examples.en: Save a seat near the outlet so I can charge my laptop.
examples.zh: 帮我「占」个靠插座的座位，我要给笔记本充电。

collocations: save a seat near the front

words.enDefinition: look for an empty chair when class starts

examples.en: Come ten minutes early, or you'll struggle to find a seat.
examples.zh: 早到十分钟，不然你很难「找到座位」。

examples.en: Finding a seat in a packed lecture hall takes real skill.
examples.zh: 在挤满人的大教室里「找座位」真是个技术活。

words.enDefinition: sit down in an available chair

examples.en: Please take a seat anywhere in the first three rows.
examples.zh: 请随意「就座」，前三排都可以。

examples.en: Students were still taking their seats when the professor began.
examples.zh: 教授开讲时，大家还在「找位子坐」。

words.enDefinition: exchange chairs with another student

examples.en: Can we switch seats? Your view of the projector is better.
examples.zh: 我们「换下座位」好吗？你那边看投影更清楚。

examples.en: The TA asked the two chatting students to switch seats immediately.
examples.zh: 助教让两个说话的学生马上「换了座位」。

words.enDefinition: a room you enter by mistake

examples.en: I knew it was the wrong classroom when nobody recognized the slides.
examples.zh: 没人认识这些幻灯片，我才意识到「走错了教室」。

examples.en: Syllabus week is full of students wandering into the wrong classroom.
examples.zh: 开学第一周，到处都是「走错教室」的学生。

words.enDefinition: with all your classmates watching and listening

examples.en: Speaking in front of the class gets easier every single week.
examples.zh: 「当着全班」发言，每周都会容易一点。

examples.en: She demonstrated the whole experiment in front of the class without notes.
examples.zh: 她不用讲稿就「当着全班的面」演示了整个实验。

collocations: speak in front of the class
present in front of the class
nervous in front of the class

words.enDefinition: a dark classroom board written on with chalk

examples.en: Our math professor still prefers an old chalkboard to PowerPoint slides.
examples.zh: 我们的数学教授宁愿用老式「黑板」，也不用幻灯片。

examples.en: Copy the diagram from the chalkboard before someone erases it.
examples.zh: 趁没被擦掉，快把「黑板」上的图抄下来。

words.enDefinition: a machine that displays slides on a large screen

examples.en: The projector in this room always blurs the small text.
examples.zh: 这间教室的「投影仪」总是把小字弄糊。

examples.en: The TA couldn't get the projector to connect to her laptop.
examples.zh: 助教怎么都没法让「投影仪」连上她的笔记本。

words.enDefinition: a handheld device that casts a moving red dot on slides

examples.en: The professor waved the laser pointer all over the slide.
examples.zh: 教授拿着「激光笔」在幻灯片上晃来晃去。

examples.en: Hold the laser pointer steady when you point at the graph.
examples.zh: 指图表时请把「激光笔」拿稳。

words.enDefinition: a small standing desk for the speaker at the front

examples.en: The professor stepped away from the podium to draw on the board.
examples.zh: 教授离开「讲台」去黑板上画图。

examples.en: There's a laptop and a microphone on the lecture hall podium.
examples.zh: 大教室的「讲台」上放着笔记本电脑和麦克风。

words.enDefinition: a handheld device for answering in-class polls

examples.en: Bring your clicker to every statistics lecture for the in-class polls.
examples.zh: 每节统计课都带上「课堂答题器」，课上要用它答题。

examples.en: I forgot my clicker, so I answered the polls with the class app.
examples.zh: 我忘带「答题器」了，就用课堂App做了答题。

words.enDefinition: the complete set of slides for one lecture

examples.en: The whole slide deck for chapter five is already online.
examples.zh: 第五章的整套「幻灯片课件」已经传到网上了。

examples.en: She reused last year's slide deck without updating the dates.
examples.zh: 她直接沿用了去年的「课件」，连日期都没改。

words.enDefinition: a printed sheet of practice problems or tasks

examples.en: You should finish the worksheet before the end of today's class.
examples.zh: 请在今天下课前完成这份「课堂练习单」。

examples.en: The TA handed out a practice worksheet on quadratic equations.
examples.zh: 助教发了一份二次方程的「练习单」。

words.enDefinition: a circulating list where students sign to confirm presence

examples.en: Pass the attendance sheet to the end of your row.
examples.zh: 把「签到表」传到你那排最右边。

examples.en: Sign the attendance sheet, or you'll be marked absent for today.
examples.zh: 一定要在「签到表」上签名，不然今天会记旷课。

words.enDefinition: the official history of who attended which classes

examples.en: Your attendance record affects your participation grade in this course.
examples.zh: 这门课的「出勤记录」会影响平时成绩。

examples.en: Ask the department to correct any error in your attendance record.
examples.zh: 「出勤记录」有误的话，可以找系里更正。

words.enDefinition: a posted list where people claim time slots

examples.en: There's a sign-up sheet on her door for office hours slots.
examples.zh: 她办公室门上有一张答疑时段的「登记表」。

examples.en: Write your name on the sign-up sheet for presentation slots.
examples.zh: 想选报告时段，就把名字写在「登记表」上。

collocations: a sign-up sheet on the door
add your name to the sign-up sheet

words.enDefinition: the official list of students enrolled in a course

examples.en: The professor reads names from the class roster on day one.
examples.zh: 第一天教授照着「班级名册」念名字。

examples.en: You won't appear on the class roster until registration clears.
examples.zh: 注册流程走完之前，「班级名册」上不会有你。

words.enDefinition: the notes a student writes during class

examples.en: I review my lecture notes within a day of each class.
examples.zh: 每次课后一天内，我会复习「课堂笔记」。

examples.en: She shares her lecture notes with the whole class group chat.
examples.zh: 她把「课堂笔记」分享到了班级群聊里。

words.enDefinition: simple writing tools instead of a laptop

examples.en: Leave the laptop at home; pen and paper works fine.
examples.zh: 别带电脑了，用「笔和纸」就够了。

examples.en: I remember more when I take notes with pen and paper.
examples.zh: 用「纸笔」记笔记，我记住的东西更多。

collocations: pen and paper instead of a laptop

words.enDefinition: one short listed item on a slide or handout

examples.en: Keep each bullet point on the slide to five words or fewer.
examples.zh: 幻灯片上每条「要点」最好不超过五个词。

examples.en: He just read every bullet point straight off the slide.
examples.zh: 他就是把幻灯片上的「要点」一条条念了出来。

words.enDefinition: protective plastic glasses worn in science labs

examples.en: You can't enter the lab without safety goggles and closed shoes.
examples.zh: 不戴「护目镜」和包趾鞋不能进实验室。

examples.en: You can buy safety goggles at the campus bookstore for eight dollars.
examples.zh: 「护目镜」在校内书店八美元就能买到。

words.enDefinition: the long worktable where experiments are done

examples.en: Our lab bench has a sink and its own set of drawers.
examples.zh: 我们这组「实验台」带水槽和抽屉。

examples.en: Clean your lab bench thoroughly before you leave the lab.
examples.zh: 离开实验室前要把「实验台」清理干净。

words.enDefinition: the booklet of procedures for a lab course

examples.en: Read the lab manual before every session, or you'll fall behind.
examples.zh: 每次实验前都要读「实验手册」，不然会跟不上。

examples.en: The lab manual costs about twenty dollars at the campus bookstore.
examples.zh: 这本「实验手册」在校内书店卖二十美元左右。

words.enDefinition: a white protective coat worn in laboratories

examples.en: Borrow a lab coat from the rack by the door.
examples.zh: 从门边的架子上借一件「实验服」。

examples.en: Chemistry students must wear a lab coat over their regular clothes.
examples.zh: 化学课学生必须在衣服外面再穿「实验服」。

words.enDefinition: a device that magnifies tiny samples for study

examples.en: Each pair of students shares one microscope at the bench.
examples.zh: 每两名学生共用一台「显微镜」。

examples.en: Focus the microscope slowly, or you'll lose the cell again.
examples.zh: 「显微镜」要慢慢调焦，不然又找不到细胞了。

words.enDefinition: an extra class held to prepare for an exam

examples.en: The TA is holding a review session the night before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前一晚，助教会安排「复习课」。

examples.en: The review session covered everything from the first four weeks.
examples.zh: 这次「复习课」把前四周的内容都过了一遍。

collocations: a review session before the exam

words.enDefinition: a set of related talks spread over several weeks

examples.en: The economics department runs a free lecture series every fall.
examples.zh: 经济系每年秋天办免费的「系列讲座」。

examples.en: I attended the entire lecture series on climate policy this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天那套气候政策的「系列讲座」我全听了。

words.enDefinition: a talk open to the whole campus and community

examples.en: The Nobel winner is giving a public lecture on Thursday night.
examples.zh: 那位诺奖得主周四晚上有一场「公开讲座」。

examples.en: Public lectures are a free way to hear top researchers.
examples.zh: 「公开讲座」是免费听顶尖学者报告的好机会。

words.enDefinition: a short unannounced test given at the start of class

examples.en: The professor started today's class with a five-minute pop quiz.
examples.zh: 教授今天上课先来了个五分钟的「随堂测验」。

examples.en: A pop quiz counts toward your final grade in this course.
examples.zh: 「随堂测验」会计入这门课的总评。

collocations: a pop quiz at the start

words.enDefinition: an extra meeting rescheduled after a cancelled class

examples.en: The Monday makeup class is in the same room at five.
examples.zh: 周一的「补课」还在原教室，五点开始。

examples.en: Check your email for this week's makeup class time and room.
examples.zh: 本周「补课」的时间和教室请查收邮件。

words.enDefinition: Cancellation of an individual scheduled class meeting.

examples.en: The class cancellation affected Friday's meeting, and we still had to attend the Monday lecture.
examples.zh: 这次「单次停课」只影响周五的课，周一的讲座还是要去。

examples.en: We received a class cancellation notice before most students had left for campus.
examples.zh: 大多数学生还没出门去学校，我们就收到了「单次停课」通知。

words.enDefinition: a course mixing in-person and online sessions

examples.en: My Tuesday seminar is a hybrid class; we meet in person twice a month.
examples.zh: 我周二的研讨课是「混合式课程」，每月只线下见两次。

examples.en: Hybrid classes let you watch recorded lectures from your dorm.
examples.zh: 「混合式课程」可以让你在宿舍看录播。

words.enDefinition: a class session delivered live or recorded on the internet

examples.en: The professor posts each online lecture by seven the evening before.
examples.zh: 教授在前一晚七点前上传「网课」视频。

examples.en: I watch the online lecture at double speed to save time.
examples.zh: 我用两倍速看「网课」来省时间。

words.enDefinition: videos watched before class, practice done in person

examples.en: In a flipped classroom, you watch the videos before class starts.
examples.zh: 「翻转课堂」要求上课前先看完视频。

examples.en: The flipped classroom format frees class time for problem solving.
examples.zh: 「翻转课堂」把课上时间留给做题。

words.enDefinition: a small group space for timed discussions during class

examples.en: We discussed the case study in breakout rooms for fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 我们分组在「讨论室」里讨论了十五分钟的案例。

examples.en: Each breakout room had to nominate one person to report back.
examples.zh: 每个「分组讨论室」要推选一人汇报。

collocations: report back from your breakout room

words.enDefinition: the number of students enrolled in a course

examples.en: The class size is capped at thirty for the writing seminar.
examples.zh: 写作研讨课的「班级人数」上限三十人。

examples.en: A small class size means every student gets more speaking time.
examples.zh: 「班级人数」少，每个学生的开口机会就多。

words.enDefinition: the first meeting of a course in a term

examples.en: On the first day of class, most professors let everyone out early.
examples.zh: 「开学第一天」，大多数教授都会早下课。

examples.en: I bought the textbook before the first day of class and barely used it.
examples.zh: 我在「开学第一天」前就买了教材，结果几乎没用上。

collocations: on the first day of class
before the first day of class

words.enDefinition: the final scheduled meeting of a course

examples.en: On the last day of class, the professor reviews the whole course.
examples.zh: 「最后一节课」上，教授会把整门课串讲一遍。

examples.en: The last day of class is Friday, and the final exam is Monday.
examples.zh: 周五是「最后一节课」，周一就期末考了。

collocations: on the last day of class
before the last day of class
the last day of class review

words.enDefinition: time set aside for audience questions after a talk

examples.en: The Q&A session after the guest lecture ran twenty minutes long.
examples.zh: 特邀讲座后的「问答环节」拖了二十分钟。

examples.en: Nobody asked anything during the Q&A session, so it ended early.
examples.zh: 「问答环节」没人提问，就提前结束了。

words.enDefinition: a campus room full of computers for student use

examples.en: The computer lab on the third floor stays open until midnight.
examples.zh: 三楼的「机房」开放到半夜。

examples.en: Print your lab report in the computer lab before class.
examples.zh: 上课前到「机房」把实验报告打印出来。

words.enDefinition: listen and watch carefully instead of drifting off

examples.en: Pay special attention whenever the professor repeats a point twice.
examples.zh: 教授把一个点讲两遍时，要格外「集中注意力」。

examples.en: It's hard to pay attention in a three-hour afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 下午连上三小时的课，很难「专心」。

words.enDefinition: join discussions and activities during a lesson

examples.en: Participating in class counts for twenty percent of our grade.
examples.zh: 「课堂发言」占我们成绩的百分之二十。

examples.en: Many international students feel nervous when they participate in class.
examples.zh: 很多留学生一想到要「课堂发言」就紧张。

words.enDefinition: marks awarded for speaking and joining class activities

examples.en: Class participation makes up twenty percent of our final grade.
examples.zh: 「课堂参与」占总评的百分之二十。

examples.en: She earned full marks for class participation by commenting every week.
examples.zh: 她每周都发言，「课堂参与分」拿了满分。

words.enDefinition: read text out loud so others can hear

examples.en: The professor asked a volunteer to read the quote aloud.
examples.zh: 教授请一位自愿的同学「朗读」那段引文。

examples.en: Reading aloud in a second language feels scary at first.
examples.zh: 用外语「朗读」一开始会让人害怕。

words.enDefinition: keep pace with the professor's explanation

examples.en: Follow along with the handout while I explain the proof.
examples.zh: 我讲证明时，请大家对照讲义「跟上讲解」。

examples.en: I lost my place in the notes and couldn't follow along.
examples.zh: 我笔记记乱了位，后来就「跟不上」了。

words.enDefinition: a quick vote made by raising hands

examples.en: By a show of hands, who has finished the reading?
examples.zh: 「举个手」看看，读完阅读材料的有多少人？

examples.en: The professor took a show of hands before choosing the debate topic.
examples.zh: 教授先「举手表决」来定辩论题目。

words.enDefinition: a guess supported by knowledge and reasoning

examples.en: I don't know the answer, but I'll make an educated guess.
examples.zh: 我不知道答案，但可以做个「有依据的推测」。

examples.en: Even an educated guess is better than sitting there in silence.
examples.zh: 哪怕是「合理推测」，也比全程沉默强。

words.enDefinition: a guess made with no real basis

examples.en: On the multiple-choice section, even a wild guess sometimes earns credit.
examples.zh: 选择题部分哪怕「瞎猜」有时也能得分。

examples.en: Question four was a total wild guess; I had no idea.
examples.zh: 第四题纯属「瞎猜」，我完全没头绪。

collocations: a wild guess on the quiz

words.enDefinition: suddenly fail to remember or think of an answer

examples.en: I drew a blank the moment the professor called my name.
examples.zh: 教授点到我名字的那一刻，我「大脑一片空白」。

examples.en: Even after studying all night, I drew a blank on the first question.
examples.zh: 复习了一整晚，第一题我还是「什么都想不起来」。

collocations: draw a blank on the test

words.enDefinition: forget what you were about to say next

examples.en: Excuse me, I lost my train of thought — where was I?
examples.zh: 不好意思，我「思路断了」——刚说到哪儿了？

examples.en: Someone's phone rang, and I lost my train of thought mid-sentence.
examples.zh: 有人手机响了，我讲到一半「思路就断了」。

collocations: lose my train of thought mid-sentence

words.enDefinition: offer to answer without being called on

examples.en: Nobody volunteered an answer, so the professor waited in silence.
examples.zh: 没人「主动回答」，教授就安静地等着。

examples.en: Volunteering an answer at least once a week boosts your participation score.
examples.zh: 每周至少「主动答一次题」，能提高你的课堂参与分。

words.enDefinition: say something briefly while someone else is talking

examples.en: She interjected politely to add a counterexample from her own research.
examples.zh: 她礼貌地「插话」，补充了一个自己研究里的反例。

examples.en: Don't be afraid to interject with a short question in seminars.
examples.zh: 研讨课上别怕用简短的问题「插话」。

words.enDefinition: check and share what each person wrote or understood

examples.en: Want to compare notes after class? I missed the second half.
examples.zh: 课后「对一下笔记」好吗？我后半节没听。

examples.en: We compared notes and discovered we'd each caught different examples.
examples.zh: 我们一「对笔记」，发现各自记到的例子不一样。

words.enDefinition: make an audio or video copy of a class session

examples.en: Ask permission before you record a lecture on your phone.
examples.zh: 用手机「录课」前要先征得教授同意。

examples.en: I record the lecture so I can replay the fast parts later.
examples.zh: 我会「录下讲课内容」，回头把讲得快的地方再放一遍。

collocations: record the lecture on your phone

words.enDefinition: deliberately not attend a scheduled class

examples.en: I skipped class twice this month and missed two quizzes.
examples.zh: 这个月我「翘」了两次课，错过了两次测验。

examples.en: Skipping one lecture is fine, but skipping class every week catches up with you.
examples.zh: 偶尔「翘课」一次没事，但每周都翘迟早要还的。

words.enDefinition: enter quietly and unnoticed after class has started

examples.en: I tried to sneak in through the back door after arriving ten minutes late.
examples.zh: 我迟到了十分钟，想从后门「悄悄溜进」教室。

examples.en: Don't sneak in during a pop quiz; just email the professor instead.
examples.zh: 随堂测验的时候就别「溜进来」了，直接给教授发邮件吧。

words.enDefinition: arriving after the class has already begun

examples.en: I was late to class because the campus bus never came.
examples.zh: 校车一直不来，我「上课迟到」了。

examples.en: Being late to class twice counts as one absence in this course.
examples.zh: 这门课「迟到」两次算一次缺勤。

words.enDefinition: remain in the room once the lesson ends

examples.en: Stay after class if you want help with the assignment.
examples.zh: 想让老师帮忙看作业就「课后留下来」。

examples.en: The professor asked me to stay after class to discuss my essay.
examples.zh: 教授让我「课后留下」，谈谈我的论文。

collocations: stay after class for a minute
stay after class to ask questions

words.enDefinition: go before the class officially ends

examples.en: May I leave class early? I have a visa appointment at three.
examples.zh: 我可以「早退」吗？三点有个签证预约。

examples.en: The professor let us leave class early before the long weekend.
examples.zh: 长周末前，教授让我们「提前下课」了。

words.enDefinition: finish the lesson and be free to go

examples.en: What time do we get out of class today, three or four?
examples.zh: 今天我们几点「下课」，三点还是四点？

examples.en: I get out of class at two, so a Tuesday lunch works.
examples.zh: 我周二两点「下课」，中午一起吃饭没问题。

collocations: get out of class at two

words.enDefinition: continue past the planned finishing time

examples.en: The lecture ran over by ten minutes because of all the questions.
examples.zh: 因为提问太多，这节课「拖堂」了十分钟。

examples.en: Professors who always run over make back-to-back schedules really painful.
examples.zh: 老师总「拖堂」的话，连堂的课表就很难受了。

words.enDefinition: take turns speaking in order around the classroom

examples.en: We went around the room sharing one question each about the reading.
examples.zh: 我们「轮流发言」，每人提一个关于阅读材料的问题。

examples.en: Going around the room takes forever in a class of thirty.
examples.zh: 三十人的班「轮流发言」要好长时间。

collocations: go around the room with introductions

words.enDefinition: turn off your phone's sound before class begins

examples.en: Please silence your phone before we start the documentary screening.
examples.zh: 纪录片放映前，请把「手机调静音」。

examples.en: Remember to silence your phone; my ringtone went off once and it was mortifying.
examples.zh: 记得把「手机调成静音」，我有一次铃声响了，尴尬死了。

words.enDefinition: draw aimless pictures in your notes when bored

examples.en: I doodle in the margins when the lecture gets slow.
examples.zh: 讲得慢的时候，我就在页边「涂鸦」。

examples.en: My notes are half doodles by the end of Friday afternoon class.
examples.zh: 周五下午的课上到结束，笔记一半都是「涂鸦」。

words.enDefinition: think about something unrelated while you should be listening

examples.en: I totally daydreamed through the second half of the statistics lecture.
examples.zh: 统计课后半节我全程「走神」。

examples.en: Sit closer to the front if you tend to daydream.
examples.zh: 爱「走神」的话，就坐得离讲台近一点。

words.enDefinition: write notes or diagrams where everyone can see them

examples.en: Who wants to come up and write their answer on the board?
examples.zh: 谁愿意上来把答案「写在黑板上」？

examples.en: The professor wrote the key formula on the board three times.
examples.zh: 教授把关键公式在「黑板」上写了三遍。

collocations: write your answer on the board
write the formula on the board
come up and write on the board

words.enDefinition: a personal system of quick symbols for note-taking

examples.en: I've developed my own shorthand for terms that repeat every lecture.
examples.zh: 我自创了一套「速记」符号，用来记每节课反复出现的术语。

examples.en: My shorthand made sense to me, but nobody else could read it.
examples.zh: 我的「速记」只有自己看得懂，别人完全认不出。

words.enDefinition: write something quickly and untidily

examples.en: I scribbled down the due dates before the slide changed.
examples.zh: 幻灯片切换之前，我「匆匆记下」了截止日期。

examples.en: She scribbled down the professor's email address in the margin.
examples.zh: 她把教授的邮箱「匆匆记」在了页边。

words.enDefinition: write out exactly what is shown or said

examples.en: Copy down the practice problem before the TA erases the board.
examples.zh: 趁助教还没擦黑板，把练习题「抄下来」。

examples.en: We copied down the citation format from the last slide.
examples.zh: 我们把最后一张幻灯片上的引用格式「抄写」了下来。

words.enDefinition: turn handwritten notes into a typed document

examples.en: I type up my messy handwritten notes every Sunday afternoon.
examples.zh: 每周日下午，我把潦草的手写笔记「整理成电子版」。

examples.en: She typed up the lecture notes and shared the file with everyone.
examples.zh: 她把课堂笔记「整理成电子版」，发给了全班。

collocations: type up everything before the exam

words.enDefinition: short remarks written in the margins of a page

examples.en: My margin notes turned out more useful than my full sentences.
examples.zh: 结果我的「页边笔记」比整句笔记还有用。

examples.en: Compare your margin notes with the reading questions before the seminar.
examples.zh: 研讨课前，把自己的「页边笔记」和阅读题对照一下。

words.enDefinition: a missed class that the professor has approved

examples.en: Email the professor before the deadline to request an excused absence.
examples.zh: 想申请「获准的缺勤」，要在截止时间前给教授发邮件。

examples.en: Two excused absences are allowed per term in this course.
examples.zh: 这门课每学期允许两次「获批的缺勤」。

words.enDefinition: a missed class with no approved reason

examples.en: Every unexcused absence lowers your participation grade by two points.
examples.zh: 每次「无故缺勤」会扣两分课堂参与分。

examples.en: Three unexcused absences can get you dropped from the course.
examples.zh: 「无故缺勤」三次可能会被这门课除名。

collocations: an unexcused absence counts against you

words.enDefinition: the course rules about missing or attending class

examples.en: The attendance policy allows two free misses before the penalties start.
examples.zh: 「考勤规定」允许自由缺勤两次，之后才开始扣分。

examples.en: Check the attendance policy in the syllabus before you book flights.
examples.zh: 订机票之前，先看看大纲里的「考勤规定」。

collocations: the attendance policy in the syllabus

words.enDefinition: being present at every single class meeting

examples.en: Perfect attendance earned me five bonus points at the end of term.
examples.zh: 这学期的「全勤」让我拿到了五分加分。

examples.en: I lost perfect attendance by sleeping through one morning lecture.
examples.zh: 一节早课睡过头，我的「全勤」就没了。

words.enDefinition: fail to attend a scheduled lecture

examples.en: If you miss a lecture, the recording usually goes online that night.
examples.zh: 就算「错过一节课」，录播一般当晚就会上线。

examples.en: I missed two lectures with the flu and fell behind fast.
examples.zh: 流感让我「缺了两节课」，进度一下子跟不上了。

collocations: miss a lecture because of illness

words.enDefinition: tasks completed together by a small team in class

examples.en: Half of today's session is group work on the case study.
examples.zh: 今天一半的课时是案例「小组合作」。

examples.en: I like group work, but someone always refuses to contribute.
examples.zh: 我喜欢「小组合作」，但总有人不出力。

words.enDefinition: an activity done with the person beside you

examples.en: Do the pair work with the student sitting next to you.
examples.zh: 和旁边的同学做「结对练习」。

examples.en: Pair work is a low-pressure way to practice speaking in class.
examples.zh: 「两人结对练习」是压力较小的课堂口语练习方式。

words.enDefinition: a short task completed during the lesson

examples.en: Today's class activity is a ten-minute debate with your partner.
examples.zh: 今天的「课堂活动」是和搭档进行十分钟辩论。

examples.en: Check the schedule so you're prepared for each class activity.
examples.zh: 看好课表，每次「课堂活动」前做好准备。

words.enDefinition: a small group that meets regularly to study

examples.en: Our study group meets in the library every Wednesday night.
examples.zh: 我们「学习小组」每周三晚上在图书馆碰头。

examples.en: Join a study group before the midterm; it keeps you accountable.
examples.zh: 期中前加入一个「学习小组」，能互相督促。

words.enDefinition: a quick poll the professor runs in class

examples.en: The professor ran a quick class survey about the reading pace.
examples.zh: 教授就阅读进度做了一次快速「课堂调查」。

examples.en: Fill out the class survey by Friday so she can adjust the schedule.
examples.zh: 周五前填好「课堂调查」，方便她调整进度。

words.enDefinition: a sample sentence showing how a word is used

examples.en: Can you give us an example sentence using tonight's vocabulary?
examples.zh: 能用今晚的词汇给我们「造个例句」吗？

examples.en: Write one original example sentence for each new word tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚每个新词都要写一个原创「例句」。

words.enDefinition: a sound like um that fills a pause while speaking

examples.en: Try to cut filler words like 'um' from your presentation.
examples.zh: 做报告时尽量少用“嗯”这类「口头语」。

examples.en: Everyone uses filler words when speaking in a second language.
examples.zh: 用外语发言时，谁都免不了带点「口头语」。

words.enDefinition: a private meeting between a professor and one student

examples.en: Book a one-on-one meeting with the professor about your paper topic.
examples.zh: 关于论文选题，跟教授约个「一对一交流」吧。

examples.en: The TA offers one-on-one meetings for students nervous about asking in public.
examples.zh: 助教为不好意思当众提问的学生提供「一对一辅导」。

words.enDefinition: problems with computers, sound, or connections during class

examples.en: The lecture started fifteen minutes late because of technical difficulties.
examples.zh: 因为「技术故障」，这节课晚了十五分钟才开始。

examples.en: If you have technical difficulties during the online lecture, email the TA.
examples.zh: 上网课遇到「技术问题」，就给助教发邮件。

words.enDefinition: a course held in the evening

examples.en: My night class runs from six to nine on Tuesdays.
examples.zh: 我周二晚上六点到九点有「晚课」。

examples.en: Pack a dinner if you have a three-hour night class.
examples.zh: 上三小时的「晚课」，记得带好晚饭。

words.enDefinition: a course held early in the day

examples.en: I register for morning classes because I focus best before noon.
examples.zh: 我专挑「早课」注册，因为中午前我效率最高。

examples.en: Nothing good ever happens in an eight a.m. morning class.
examples.zh: 早八的「早课」真没什么好事发生。

words.enDefinition: the books and articles a course assigns

examples.en: The reading list has twelve books, but only three are required.
examples.zh: 「阅读书单」上有十二本书，其中只有三本必读。

examples.en: She posted the reading list a week before classes started.
examples.zh: 开课前一周，她就发布了「书单」。

words.enDefinition: take the seat beside a particular person

examples.en: Mind if I sit next to you? Every other seat is taken.
examples.zh: 我能「坐你旁边」吗？其他位置都有人了。

examples.en: I always sit next to the classmate with the neatest notes.
examples.zh: 我总挑笔记记得最工整的同学，「坐在」他旁边。

collocations: may I sit next to you

words.enDefinition: pause briefly to organize what you want to say

examples.en: Give me a second to collect my thoughts before I answer.
examples.zh: 容我想几秒，「整理一下思路」再回答。

examples.en: He paused to collect his thoughts, then gave a clear answer.
examples.zh: 他停下来「理了理思路」，然后给出了清晰的回答。

collocations: a moment to collect my thoughts

words.enDefinition: the single most important point to remember

examples.en: The key takeaway from today's lecture is on the final slide.
examples.zh: 今天这节课的「核心要点」就在最后一张幻灯片上。

examples.en: Write one key takeaway at the top of your notes.
examples.zh: 在笔记最上面写下今天的一条「核心要点」。

words.enDefinition: a short easy task that opens the lesson

examples.en: Every seminar starts with a five-minute warm-up activity in pairs.
examples.zh: 每次研讨课都以两人五分钟的「热身活动」开始。

examples.en: Today's warm-up activity reviewed all the vocabulary from last week.
examples.zh: 今天的「热身活动」把上周的词汇都过了一遍。

words.enDefinition: A short written plan of the main topics and their order in a lecture.

examples.en: The lecturer posted a lecture outline so students could organise their notes before class.
examples.zh: 老师发布了「讲课提纲」，方便学生在课前把笔记安排好。

examples.en: I used the lecture outline to check which topics were covered while I was away.
examples.zh: 我查看「讲课提纲」，了解请假期间讲了哪些主题。

words.enDefinition: a saved video of a lecture you can watch after class

examples.en: The lecture recording is usually posted within two hours after class.
examples.zh: 「课程回放」一般在课后两小时内上传。

examples.en: I fell asleep during class but caught up with the lecture recording that night.
examples.zh: 上课时睡着了，当晚看「课程回放」补上了。

words.enDefinition: main large-group meeting of a course

examples.en: The morning lecture section filled before my appointment even started.
examples.zh: 还没轮到我的选课时段，上午的「讲授课段」就满了。

examples.en: Choose a lecture section whose pace and professor suit you.
examples.zh: 选一个节奏和老师都合你意的「讲授课段」。

words.enDefinition: your official name exactly as it appears on identity papers

examples.en: Your diploma will print your legal name, so check it for typos first.
examples.zh: 毕业证上印的是你的「法定姓名」，先检查有没有拼写错误。

examples.en: Use your legal name on forms, even if friends call you by a nickname.
examples.zh: 表格上要填「法定姓名」，哪怕朋友都叫你昵称。

words.enDefinition: written clearly enough to be read easily

examples.en: Graders cannot award marks they cannot read, so keep your writing legible.
examples.zh: 阅卷老师看不清就给不了分，字迹一定要「工整清晰」。

examples.en: If your handwriting is not legible, the grader may skip your correct steps.
examples.zh: 如果字迹不「工整清晰」，阅卷老师可能直接跳过你写对的步骤。

words.enDefinition: a relaxed collection of bestsellers and fiction for fun, not coursework

examples.en: The leisure reading corner stocks bestsellers and graphic novels upstairs.
examples.zh: 楼上的「休闲阅读区」摆着畅销书和漫画小说。

examples.en: Take a study break with something from leisure reading instead of doomscrolling.
examples.zh: 学习间隙去「休闲阅读区」挑本书，别一直刷手机。

words.enDefinition: not strict, especially about deadlines or grades

examples.en: Professor Ramos is lenient about deadlines, but learn the material well.
examples.zh: 拉莫斯教授对截止日期「要求宽松」，但你要真正学懂。

examples.en: Do not assume a lenient professor will write you a strong letter.
examples.zh: 别以为老师「要求宽松」就一定会给你写有力的推荐信。

words.enDefinition: a course result expressed as a letter

examples.en: Your letter grade combines the midterm, the final, and the homework.
examples.zh: 你的「等级成绩」由期中、期末和作业综合而成。

examples.en: She needs a B or better, since the program requires that letter grade.
examples.zh: 项目要求「等级成绩」达到B或以上，她必须考到这个水平。

words.enDefinition: a temporary letter proving completion before the diploma arrives

examples.en: International students request a letter of completion for visa purposes.
examples.zh: 国际学生为办签证申请「结业证明信」。

examples.en: The letter of completion states my degree and conferral date.
examples.zh: 「结业证明信」上写明了我的学位和授予日期。

collocations: a letter of completion for your visa

words.enDefinition: the printed heading with the university name and logo

examples.en: The letter must be on letterhead or the embassy will not accept it.
examples.zh: 信必须有「信头」，否则使馆不会受理。

examples.en: You can download a letterhead template from the office intranet.
examples.zh: 可以在办公室内网下载「信头」模板。

words.enDefinition: your online profile showing loans, holds, and fines

examples.en: Check your library account online to see which books you still have out.
examples.zh: 上网查看「图书馆账户」，看看还有哪些书没还。

examples.en: Unpaid fines appeared in my library account the morning after I missed a return.
examples.zh: 逾期还书的第二天早上，我的「图书馆账户」里就出现了未交罚款。

words.enDefinition: the mobile app for renewals, holds, and room bookings

examples.en: Renew loans and check seat availability through the library app.
examples.zh: 通过「图书馆App」续借图书、查看座位余量。

examples.en: The library app scans the back cover barcode to check books out.
examples.zh: 「图书馆App」扫一下书底条形码就能自助借书。

words.enDefinition: a hold on your account that stops borrowing until resolved

examples.en: An unpaid fine put a library block on my account two days before finals.
examples.zh: 期末前两天，一笔未交罚款给我的账户上了「借阅冻结」。

examples.en: The library block lifted the morning after I paid the replacement fee.
examples.zh: 交完赔偿费的第二天早上，「借阅冻结」就解除了。

collocations: a library block on your account

words.enDefinition: the ID card you use to borrow materials from campus libraries

examples.en: Your student ID doubles as your library card at the checkout desk.
examples.zh: 在借还服务台，你的学生证就是「借书卡」。

examples.en: Bring your library card when you pick up interlibrary loans at the front desk.
examples.zh: 去前台取馆际互借图书时要带上你的「借书卡」。

words.enDefinition: the number on your card used to log in to library services

examples.en: Type your library card number and PIN to renew books from home.
examples.zh: 在家续借图书时，输入你的「借书卡号」和密码。

examples.en: The barcode on the back is just your library card number in scannable form.
examples.zh: 背面的条形码其实就是可扫描版的「借书卡号」。

words.enDefinition: a public workstation with campus software any student can use

examples.en: Log into a library computer to run SPSS without buying a license.
examples.zh: 用「馆内电脑」跑SPSS，不用自己买授权。

examples.en: Save everything to cloud storage because library computers wipe at midnight.
examples.zh: 所有文件要存云端，「馆内电脑」午夜会清空数据。

collocations: save files from a library computer

words.enDefinition: the daily opening and closing times of the library

examples.en: Library hours shrink to eight until eight over winter break, so plan ahead.
examples.zh: 寒假期间「图书馆开放时间」缩短为早八点到晚八点，要提前规划。

examples.en: Check library hours before the holiday weekend because the branches close earlier.
examples.zh: 假日周末前查一下「图书馆开放时间」，各分馆会提早闭馆。

words.enDefinition: a guided walk teaching new students the library's layout and services

examples.en: Take the library orientation tour during welcome week before the crowds arrive.
examples.zh: 开学周人还不多，先参加「图书馆导览」。

examples.en: The library orientation tour showed us the silent floors and the printing desk.
examples.zh: 「图书馆导览」带我们看了静音楼层和打印服务台。

collocations: sign up for the orientation tour

words.enDefinition: a registered person who uses library services and borrows items

examples.en: Library patrons can suggest titles the collection is missing through the website.
examples.zh: 「图书馆读者」可以通过网站推荐馆里缺的书目。

examples.en: The email went out to every library patron with items due that week.
examples.zh: 那封邮件发给了所有当周有书到期的「图书馆读者」。

words.enDefinition: a free short class teaching one research or tool skill

examples.en: The library workshop on citation managers is free and runs every month.
examples.zh: 关于文献管理工具的「图书馆培训讲座」免费，每月举办一次。

examples.en: Sign up for the library workshop on systematic searching before your thesis proposal.
examples.zh: 开题前去参加图书馆的「系统检索培训讲座」。

words.enDefinition: lab or discussion automatically tied to a lecture

examples.en: The portal enrolls you in the linked section with one click.
examples.zh: 在系统里点一下，就能选上「配套课段」。

examples.en: Each lecture has a linked section for labs on different days.
examples.zh: 每门大课都有不同日子上实验的「配套课段」。

words.enDefinition: a lecture broadcast in real time for students watching elsewhere

examples.en: The live lecture stream froze halfway, so half the class missed the derivation.
examples.zh: 「直播课堂」中途卡住了，一半同学没看到那步推导。

examples.en: Commuter students watch the live lecture stream from home on snowy days.
examples.zh: 下雪天，走读的同学在家看「直播课堂」。

words.enDefinition: a poll answered during class with results shown instantly

examples.en: The live poll showed most of us got the practice question wrong.
examples.zh: 「现场投票」显示大多数人练习题都做错了。

examples.en: Join the live poll from your phone while watching the lecture.
examples.zh: 看课时用手机参与「现场投票」。

words.enDefinition: how long an item can stay checked out before returning

examples.en: The standard loan period is four weeks, and renewals add another four.
examples.zh: 标准「借阅期限」是四周，续借再加四周。

examples.en: Laptops have a shorter loan period than books, usually just four hours.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑的「借阅期限」比书短，通常只有四小时。

words.enDefinition: the specific locker number allocated to you when renting

examples.en: Your locker assignment will be emailed within two business days.
examples.zh: 「储物柜分配」结果会在两个工作日内邮件通知你。

examples.en: Check your locker assignment number before you buy a padlock.
examples.zh: 买挂锁之前，先确认你的「储物柜分配」。

words.enDefinition: the rental charge for using a storage locker

examples.en: The locker fee is ten dollars per month, payable online.
examples.zh: 「储物柜租金」每月十美元，可以在线支付。

examples.en: The locker fee is non-refundable once the semester officially starts.
examples.zh: 学期一开始，「储物柜租金」就不予退还。

words.enDefinition: paying for a semester locker to store books inside the library

examples.en: Locker rental costs five dollars a semester at the circulation desk.
examples.zh: 「储物柜租用」每学期五美元，在借还台办理。

examples.en: With locker rental, I stop hauling heavy textbooks across campus daily.
examples.zh: 租了「储物柜」后，我不用每天把厚教材搬来搬去。

words.enDefinition: far past the return deadline with fines piling up

examples.en: My statistics textbook is long overdue, so the fines doubled last week.
examples.zh: 那本统计学教材我已经「逾期很久」，罚款上周翻倍了。

examples.en: Books that stay long overdue eventually get billed as lost with a replacement fee.
examples.zh: 「逾期很久」的书最终会按丢失处理，要赔书款。

words.enDefinition: face the webcam while speaking so you seem to make eye contact

examples.en: Look at the camera when you present instead of reading off your screen.
examples.zh: 做展示时请「看向镜头」，别一直盯着屏幕念稿。

examples.en: Looking at the camera instead of your second monitor makes you look engaged.
examples.zh: 「看着镜头」而不是盯着副屏，会显得更投入。

collocations: look at the camera when speaking
remember to look at the camera
look at the camera not the screen

words.enDefinition: to have points deducted for errors or omissions

examples.en: You lose marks if you skip units in physics calculations.
examples.zh: 物理计算里漏写单位会「被扣分」。

examples.en: Many students lose marks by spelling key terms incorrectly, so double-check terminology.
examples.zh: 很多学生因为关键术语拼写错误「被扣分」，一定要反复核对。

words.enDefinition: have your saved work disappear, often after a page crashes

examples.en: The browser refreshed itself and I lost my progress on the quiz.
examples.zh: 浏览器自己刷新了，我的测验「进度全丢了」。

examples.en: Save a draft often so a crash doesn't lose your progress.
examples.zh: 勤保存草稿，免得页面崩溃「丢了进度」。

words.enDefinition: a borrowed item you cannot find and must pay for

examples.en: Report a lost book right away so fines stop accruing on your account.
examples.zh: 一旦「遗失图书」要立刻报告，罚款才不会再累积。

examples.en: She declared the chemistry manual a lost book after searching her dorm twice.
examples.zh: 在宿舍翻了两遍之后，她把那本化学手册登记为「遗失图书」。

words.enDefinition: a grade average below what programs or employers expect

examples.en: A low GPA does not end your grad school plans if the rest is strong.
examples.zh: 只要其他条件够硬，「低绩点」并不意味着研究生梦碎。

examples.en: The advisor helped me frame my low GPA as an upward trend story.
examples.zh: 导师帮我把「偏低绩点」讲成了逐步上升的故事。

collocations: a low GPA in freshman year

words.enDefinition: the middle Latin honor, above cum laude for higher GPAs

examples.en: His 3.8 GPA qualified him for magna cum laude at commencement.
examples.zh: 他 3.8 的绩点使他够格获得「极优等毕业荣誉」。

examples.en: Magna cum laude is printed on the diploma below the degree name.
examples.zh: 「极优等毕业荣誉」会印在证书上学位名称的下方。

words.enDefinition: the street address where the university sends letters and cards

examples.en: Confirm your mailing address so the diploma does not go to your old flat.
examples.zh: 确认一下「邮寄地址」，免得毕业证寄到旧住址。

examples.en: International students list a local mailing address instead of one back home.
examples.zh: 国际学生填本地的「邮寄地址」，别填国内地址。

words.enDefinition: an email list a club uses for official announcements

examples.en: Join the mailing list to receive rehearsal notes and event invitations each week.
examples.zh: 加入「邮件列表」，每周接收排练通知和活动邀请。

examples.en: She manages the mailing list and prunes addresses that bounce twice.
examples.zh: 她负责管理「邮件列表」，并清退两次退信的地址。

collocations: add members to the mailing list

words.enDefinition: the largest central library on a university campus

examples.en: Meet me at the main library entrance before our two o'clock study session.
examples.zh: 两点自习前在「主馆」门口等我。

examples.en: The main library stays open all night, but the music branch closes early.
examples.zh: 「主馆」通宵开放，但音乐分馆很早就关门。

words.enDefinition: the primary office where a department's staff work

examples.en: Hand in the completed form at the main office by Friday.
examples.zh: 填好的表格周五前交到「总办公室」。

examples.en: The main office posts each professor's current weekly office hours.
examples.zh: 「总办公室」会张贴各位教授最新的每周答疑时间。

words.enDefinition: the GPA calculated only from courses in your major

examples.en: My overall GPA is 3.2, but my major GPA is a solid 3.6.
examples.zh: 我的总绩点是3.2，但「专业课绩点」有稳稳的3.6。

examples.en: The honors committee looks at your major GPA, not your electives.
examples.zh: 荣誉评定委员会看的是「专业绩点」，不是选修课。

words.enDefinition: to present reasons supporting a position or proposal

examples.en: Your response paper should make a case for one interpretation, not list three.
examples.zh: 你的回应论文应当「为一种解读进行论证」，而不是罗列三种。

examples.en: He made a case for extending the deadline by citing the campus outage.
examples.zh: 他举出校园断网一事，「为延长期限提出了充分理由」。

words.enDefinition: an extra session for members who missed regular practice

examples.en: If you miss Tuesday, join the make-up practice on Friday morning.
examples.zh: 如果错过了周二，就参加周五上午的「补训」。

examples.en: The coach runs make-up practice for members returning from winter break.
examples.zh: 教练为寒假归队的成员安排了「补训」。

words.enDefinition: a workshop room with 3D printers and tools for student projects

examples.en: The basement makerspace has 3D printers, laser cutters, and sewing machines.
examples.zh: 地下室的「创客空间」配有3D打印机、激光切割机和缝纫机。

examples.en: Take the free training session before using anything in the makerspace.
examples.zh: 使用「创客空间」的设备前，先参加免费培训。

words.enDefinition: a second sitting for students who missed the original

examples.en: He missed the final with the flu and took the makeup exam in January.
examples.zh: 他因流感错过期末考，一月参加了「补考」。

examples.en: Makeup exams are usually harder, so never skip the original without a reason.
examples.zh: 「补考」通常更难，没有正当理由千万别错过正式考试。

words.enDefinition: a large band that plays while marching at sports events

examples.en: Marching band camp starts a week before classes with eight-hour outdoor rehearsals.
examples.zh: 「行进管乐队」集训在开学前一周开始，每天户外排练八小时。

examples.en: The marching band performs at every home game, rain or shine.
examples.zh: 无论风雨，每场主场比赛「行进管乐队」都会登台演出。

words.enDefinition: tick an item in the platform to record that you finished it

examples.en: Mark each item as done in the module so the progress bar fills.
examples.zh: 模块里的每一项都要「标记完成」，进度条才会涨。

examples.en: I marked the orientation module as done before my first advising meeting.
examples.zh: 第一次约导师之前，我把入学模块全部「标记完成」了。

collocations: mark as done before the deadline

words.enDefinition: a graduate degree pursued after finishing a bachelor's

examples.en: He plans to pursue a master's degree in data science after graduation.
examples.zh: 他打算毕业后继续攻读数据科学「硕士学位」。

examples.en: A master's degree usually takes one or two years of full-time study.
examples.zh: 「硕士学位」通常需要一到两年的全日制学习。

collocations: a master's degree in data science

words.enDefinition: the research paper required by many master's programs

examples.en: Defending your master's thesis usually takes about ninety minutes in total.
examples.zh: 「硕士论文」答辩通常总共约九十分钟。

examples.en: His master's thesis compared commuting patterns in three Asian cities.
examples.zh: 他的「硕士论文」比较了三个亚洲城市的通勤模式。

words.enDefinition: an item pairing terms from two columns

examples.en: The matching question asks you to pair fifteen authors with their works.
examples.zh: 这道「匹配题」要求把十五位作者与作品一一配对。

examples.en: Save the matching question for last, because leftover options help you eliminate pairs.
examples.zh: 「匹配题」留到最后做，剩下的选项能帮你排除错配。

words.enDefinition: a drop-in room where tutors help with math problems

examples.en: Drop by the math lab any time before the homework deadline.
examples.zh: 作业截止前，随时可以去「数学辅导室」。

examples.en: The math lab is busiest the night before problem sets are due.
examples.zh: 习题集截止前一晚，「数学辅导室」人最多。

collocations: visit the math lab before the deadline

words.enDefinition: formal enrollment as a degree-seeking student

examples.en: Matriculation happens online now, so no more queueing at the registrar's office.
examples.zh: 现在「入学注册」都在网上完成，不用去注册办公室排队了。

examples.en: Bring photo ID to finish your matriculation during orientation week.
examples.zh: 迎新周办理「入学注册」时，记得携带带照片的证件。

words.enDefinition: leaving the term early for documented health reasons

examples.en: A medical withdrawal needs a doctor's letter, not just an email.
examples.zh: 「因病退学」需要医生的证明信，光发邮件不行。

examples.en: After the surgery, she requested a medical withdrawal for the fall term.
examples.zh: 手术后，她申请了秋季学期的「因病退学」。

words.enDefinition: the person who controls a meeting and lets people in

examples.en: The TA is the meeting host, so message her if the room won't let you in.
examples.zh: 助教是「会议主持人」，进不去房间就私信她。

examples.en: The meeting host can mute all of us during the guest lecture.
examples.zh: 嘉宾讲课时，「会议主持人」可以先全体静音。

words.enDefinition: the number you enter to join a specific online meeting

examples.en: Type the meeting ID and passcode from the email to get in.
examples.zh: 输入邮件里的「会议号」和密码就能进去。

examples.en: I copied the wrong meeting ID and ended up in a stranger's study group.
examples.zh: 我抄错了「会议号」，进了一个陌生人的学习小组。

words.enDefinition: a shared web address for joining an online meeting

examples.en: The TA sends a fresh meeting link every week before the review session.
examples.zh: 助教每周复习课前都会发一个新的「会议链接」。

examples.en: Please don't share the meeting link with anyone outside the class roster.
examples.zh: 请不要把「会议链接」转发给选课名单以外的人。

words.enDefinition: a short summary of decisions sent to members after meetings

examples.en: The secretary sends a meeting recap so absent members know what was decided.
examples.zh: 秘书会发一份「会议回顾」，让缺席成员了解会议决定。

examples.en: Read the meeting recap in the newsletter before voting on the venue.
examples.zh: 投票选场地前，先看看通讯里的「会议回顾」。

words.enDefinition: a saved video of an online meeting for people who missed it

examples.en: She shares the meeting recording after every group call for the member in Beijing.
examples.zh: 每次小组通话后，她都会把「会议录像」分享给在北京的那位组员。

examples.en: Watch the meeting recording in the shared folder before Thursday's class.
examples.zh: 周四上课前，去共享文件夹里看「会议录像」。

collocations: the meeting recording is in the folder

words.enDefinition: the official list of everyone belonging to a club

examples.en: The treasurer updates the member roster every term for the student activities office.
examples.zh: 财务每学期都会为学生活动办公室更新「成员名册」。

examples.en: New recruits are added to the member roster once their dues clear.
examples.zh: 新人交清会费后就会被记入「成员名册」。

words.enDefinition: a card proving you belong to a club or society

examples.en: Show your membership card at the door to get the discount rate.
examples.zh: 在门口出示「会员卡」就能享受优惠价。

examples.en: Digital membership cards live in the club app now instead of plastic ones.
examples.zh: 现在「会员卡」都是社团应用里的电子版了，不再用塑料卡。

words.enDefinition: a campaign to grow a club's paid membership

examples.en: Our spring membership drive added thirty new members to the photography club.
examples.zh: 春季「会员招募活动」为摄影社新增了三十名成员。

examples.en: The membership drive ends Friday, so we're tabling outside the library all week.
examples.zh: 「会员招募活动」周五截止，所以我们整周都在图书馆外摆摊。

words.enDefinition: a sudden freeze in thinking under pressure

examples.en: I hit a mental block on question three and wasted ten minutes.
examples.zh: 第三题我「思维卡壳」，白白浪费了十分钟。

examples.en: Move on when a mental block hits, then return with fresh eyes.
examples.zh: 「思维卡壳」时先跳过去，回头再看思路自然就顺了。

collocations: a mental block in the exam

words.enDefinition: the student who receives guidance in a mentoring pair

examples.en: As a mentee, you set the agenda for each monthly meeting.
examples.zh: 作为「受导学生」，每月见面的议题由你来定。

examples.en: Mentees who ask specific questions get much more out of the program.
examples.zh: 会提具体问题的「受导学生」，从项目中收获要多得多。

collocations: match a mentee with a mentor

words.enDefinition: an experienced person who guides a student's growth

examples.en: Dr. Patel became my mentor during my first research project.
examples.zh: 在第一个科研项目中，帕特尔博士成了我的「良师」。

examples.en: Ask your mentor before switching out of the honors track.
examples.zh: 退出荣誉项目之前，先听听「良师」的意见。

words.enDefinition: a relationship where an experienced person guides a junior one

examples.en: Under Professor Romero's mentorship, my academic writing improved very fast.
examples.zh: 在罗梅罗教授的「悉心指导」下，我的学术写作进步飞快。

examples.en: The department offers a formal mentorship program for first-year students.
examples.zh: 系里为大一新生设有正式的「师长指导」项目。

words.enDefinition: a quick test that your microphone picks up your voice

examples.en: Do a mic check before the group presentation, not during it.
examples.zh: 小组展示前先做「麦克风测试」，别到时候才测。

examples.en: The TA ran a mic check with each presenter before we went live.
examples.zh: 正式开始前，助教给每位展示同学都做了「麦克风测试」。

collocations: a mic check before the presentation

words.enDefinition: film strips storing old newspapers and documents for machine reading

examples.en: Nineteenth-century newspapers are on microfilm in the special collections reading room.
examples.zh: 十九世纪的报纸以「缩微胶片」形式保存在特藏阅览室。

examples.en: The microfilm reader prints fuzzy pages, so screenshot the viewer instead.
examples.zh: 「缩微胶片」阅读机打印的页面很模糊，不如直接截屏。

words.enDefinition: a surprise quiz that pops up in the middle of a lecture

examples.en: A mid-lecture quiz popped up during the statistics stream and panicked everyone.
examples.zh: 统计课上突然弹出「课中随堂测」，大家都慌了。

examples.en: The mid-lecture quiz counts toward participation, so don't zone out.
examples.zh: 「课中随堂测」计入参与分，千万别走神。

words.enDefinition: a short holiday in the middle of the term

examples.en: Registrar offices stay open with shorter hours during the mid-semester break.
examples.zh: 「期中假」期间注册办照常办公，只是缩短了时间。

examples.en: Most students travel home for the mid-semester break in October.
examples.zh: 十月「期中假」，大多数学生回家。

words.enDefinition: an exam held in the middle of a term

examples.en: The midterm covers chapters one to five and counts for thirty percent of the grade.
examples.zh: 「期中考试」覆盖第一到第五章，占总成绩的百分之三十。

examples.en: I picked up my graded midterm today and scored higher than I expected.
examples.zh: 我今天拿到了批改完的「期中考试」卷子，分数比预期高。

words.enDefinition: the grade reported after midterm exams

examples.en: My midterm grade was a B minus, so the final matters even more.
examples.zh: 我的「期中成绩」是B减，期末就更关键了。

examples.en: The portal posts midterm grades two weeks before the withdrawal deadline.
examples.zh: 教务系统会在退课截止前两周公布「期中成绩」。

words.enDefinition: to lose your thoughts completely for a moment under pressure

examples.en: My mind went blank the moment the TA asked me to summarize the argument.
examples.zh: 助教让我总结论点的那一刻，我「大脑一片空白」。

examples.en: When your mind goes blank, repeat the question and buy yourself a few seconds.
examples.zh: 「大脑一片空白」时，先复述问题，给自己争取几秒钟。

words.enDefinition: fewest students needed for a course to run

examples.en: The Japanese seminar was canceled because minimum enrollment wasn't reached.
examples.zh: 日语研讨课因为没达到「最低开课人数」被取消了。

examples.en: Courses below minimum enrollment sometimes merge into a single section.
examples.zh: 未达「最低开课人数」的课程有时会合并成一个课段。

words.enDefinition: the lowest grade accepted for credit, entry, or progression

examples.en: The nursing program sets a minimum grade of B minus in every science course.
examples.zh: 护理项目要求每门理科课的「最低成绩」是B减。

examples.en: Check the catalog for the minimum grade needed to count the elective.
examples.zh: 查一下校规目录里这门选修课计入学位所需的「最低成绩要求」。

words.enDefinition: small required revisions after a viva, completed within weeks

examples.en: The examiners passed her thesis with minor corrections to two chapters.
examples.zh: 评审通过她的论文，只需对两章做「少量修改」。

examples.en: Minor corrections must be uploaded within three months of the viva.
examples.zh: 「少量修改」须在口试答辩后三个月内上传。

words.enDefinition: to fail to attend a scheduled exam

examples.en: If you miss an exam for illness, apply for a deferred sitting immediately.
examples.zh: 如果因病「错过考试」，要立刻申请缓考。

examples.en: Oversleeping is not an accepted excuse when you miss an exam.
examples.zh: 因为睡过头而「错过考试」，可不是能被批准的理由。

collocations: miss an exam due to illness
miss an exam without a valid excuse

words.enDefinition: a book the catalog says is shelved but nobody can locate

examples.en: Staff run a search for missing books every Friday when the catalog says on shelf.
examples.zh: 每逢周五，馆员都会去寻找目录显示在架却找不到的「缺失图书」。

examples.en: Mark it as a missing book at the desk and they will email you if found.
examples.zh: 可以在柜台登记为「查架图书」，找到后他们会邮件通知你。

words.enDefinition: a blank where a course grade should appear on record

examples.en: There's a missing grade for my statistics lab on the portal.
examples.zh: 系统里我统计实验课的「成绩缺失」了。

examples.en: Email the professor immediately about the missing grade before it delays graduation clearance.
examples.zh: 赶紧给教授发邮件说明「缺失的成绩」，免得拖慢毕业审核。

collocations: a missing grade on the transcript

words.enDefinition: a casual social event where members meet people from other clubs

examples.en: The engineering society's fall mixer is the best place to find project partners.
examples.zh: 工程学会的秋季「联谊会」是找项目搭档的最佳场合。

examples.en: Our mixer with the business society features trivia and free pizza.
examples.zh: 我们和商科社团的「联谊会」有问答游戏和免费披萨。

words.enDefinition: sending documents to campus printers from a phone or laptop

examples.en: Mobile printing lets you send files from your phone before you even arrive.
examples.zh: 用「手机打印」，人还没到就能把文件发去打印站。

examples.en: Mobile printing failed twice, so I emailed the PDF to my roommate instead.
examples.zh: 「手机打印」失败两次，我干脆把PDF邮件发给了室友。

words.enDefinition: a rehearsal exam run under real exam conditions

examples.en: Our department runs a December mock exam so everyone learns the format.
examples.zh: 系里十二月安排了一场「模拟考试」，让大家都熟悉题型。

examples.en: I scored badly on the mock exam, which pushed me to revise harder.
examples.zh: 「模拟考试」我考砸了，这反而促使我加倍复习。

words.enDefinition: an ideal sample answer examiners use for marking

examples.en: Read the model answer first, then compare it with your own response.
examples.zh: 先读「参考范文」，再和你自己写的答案对比。

examples.en: The tutor shared a model answer showing how to structure an essay question.
examples.zh: 辅导老师分享了一份「参考范文」，示范论述题该如何搭结构。

words.enDefinition: the person who runs a panel and manages questions and timing

examples.en: The moderator cut the debate short so every panelist could answer once more.
examples.zh: 「主持人」缩短了辩论时间，好让每位嘉宾再答一轮。

examples.en: As moderator, she redirected the panel whenever two speakers began attacking each other.
examples.zh: 身为「主持人」，每当嘉宾开始互相攻击，她就转移话题。

words.enDefinition: choosing your modules for the term at UK universities

examples.en: Module selection at Manchester closes two weeks before term starts.
examples.zh: 曼彻斯特大学的「模块选课」在开学前两周截止。

examples.en: Module selection opens online, and popular modules fill within hours.
examples.zh: 「模块选课」在线上开放，热门模块几小时就被抢光。

words.enDefinition: a long speech performed by one actor in an audition

examples.en: Prepare a two-minute monologue for the drama club audition next Friday.
examples.zh: 下周五话剧社选拔，请准备一段两分钟的「独白」。

examples.en: Her comedic monologue about cafeteria food got laughs from the whole panel.
examples.zh: 她那段吐槽食堂的喜剧「独白」逗笑了整个评审组。

words.enDefinition: practice court where law students argue appeals before judges

examples.en: Moot court gives law students practice arguing appeals in front of volunteer judges.
examples.zh: 「模拟法庭」让法学院学生在志愿法官面前练习上诉辩护。

examples.en: She joined the moot court team to get comfortable speaking under real pressure.
examples.zh: 她加入「模拟法庭」队，练习在真正的压力下发言。

words.enDefinition: an issue no longer worth discussing because it is settled

examples.en: Whether the old policy was fair is a moot point now that the deadline passed.
examples.zh: 旧政策是否公平已经是「无需再议的问题」，因为截止日期已过。

examples.en: He kept quoting the old rubric, but that is a moot point since the course moved online.
examples.zh: 他一直引用旧的评分标准，但课程已经改成线上，那已是「无需再议的问题」。

words.enDefinition: the flat square cap worn at graduation ceremonies

examples.en: Graduates tilt the mortarboard to the right after degrees are conferred.
examples.zh: 学位授予后，毕业生把「方形学位帽」拨向右边。

examples.en: She decorated her mortarboard with glitter and a thank-you message.
examples.zh: 她在「方形学位帽」上贴了亮片和感谢语。

words.enDefinition: switch classes or meetings from in person to remote

examples.en: The university moved all classes online during the ice storm.
examples.zh: 冻雨期间，学校把所有课程「转为线上」。

examples.en: If the campus closes, the professor will move the seminar online.
examples.zh: 如果校园关闭，教授会把研讨课「转为线上」。

words.enDefinition: questions offering several options with one correct answer

examples.en: The biology midterm has fifty questions, all in multiple choice format.
examples.zh: 生物期中考有五十道题，全部是「选择题」。

examples.en: Eliminate two wrong options first, because multiple choice rewards strategy too.
examples.zh: 先排除两个错误选项，「选择题」也很讲策略。

words.enDefinition: a sticker or badge showing your name at events

examples.en: Wear your name tag all week so people know what to call you.
examples.zh: 整周都戴着「名牌」，这样大家知道该怎么称呼你。

examples.en: I wrote my preferred name on the name tag in marker.
examples.zh: 我用马克笔在「名牌」上写下了自己惯用的名字。

collocations: write your name on the name tag

words.enDefinition: to reduce many options to a likely few

examples.en: Narrow down the four options to two before you guess.
examples.zh: 猜答案之前，先把四个选项「缩小范围」到两个。

examples.en: Crossing out obviously wrong answers helps you narrow down your choices quickly.
examples.zh: 划掉明显错误的选项，能帮你快速「缩小范围」。

words.enDefinition: a structured event where students meet professionals and peers

examples.en: The finance society's networking event connects members with local firm recruiters.
examples.zh: 金融社团的「人脉拓展活动」让成员对接本地公司招聘官。

examples.en: Bring business cards and two questions to every networking event you attend.
examples.zh: 参加每场「人脉拓展活动」都带上名片和两个问题。

words.enDefinition: a display shelf showing books the library recently bought

examples.en: I skim the new arrivals shelf by the entrance before every study session.
examples.zh: 每次自习前我都会在入口旁的「新书架」上翻一翻。

examples.en: The new arrivals shelf rotates monthly with fresh fiction and popular science.
examples.zh: 「新书架」每月更新一轮新小说和科普书。

collocations: new arrivals shelf near the entrance
featured on the new arrivals shelf

words.enDefinition: the official welcome program that introduces campus services and expectations

examples.en: New student orientation ends with a fair where every office has a booth.
examples.zh: 「新生迎新活动」以一场各部门摆摊的展会收尾。

examples.en: Missing new student orientation means registering for courses on your own.
examples.zh: 错过「新生迎新活动」，选课就只能靠自己摸索了。

collocations: a session at new student orientation

words.enDefinition: a regular email update about a club's news and events

examples.en: Our monthly newsletter lists upcoming volunteer shifts and photos from past events.
examples.zh: 我们的月度「社团通讯」会列出志愿班次和以往活动的照片。

examples.en: Subscribe to the newsletter so you don't miss the early-bird formal tickets.
examples.zh: 订阅「社团通讯」，别错过舞会早鸟票。

words.enDefinition: walk-ins welcome without booking ahead

examples.en: Her office hours are no appointment needed, so just drop in.
examples.zh: 她的答疑时间「无需预约」，直接去就行。

examples.en: The sign on the door says no appointment needed before the midterm.
examples.zh: 门上告示写着期中考前「无需预约」。

collocations: no appointment needed for office hours

words.enDefinition: headphones that block background sound so you can hear clearly

examples.en: Noise-cancelling headphones save me when my neighbors start vacuuming mid-lecture.
examples.zh: 室友上课中途吸尘，全靠「降噪耳机」救场。

examples.en: Wear noise-cancelling headphones in the library so the lecture stays clear.
examples.zh: 在图书馆听课戴上「降噪耳机」，声音清楚多了。

words.enDefinition: a form used to officially put someone up for a role

examples.en: Download the nomination form from the club website and get one member signature.
examples.zh: 从社团网站下载「提名表」，并找一名成员签名。

examples.en: Nominations close Friday, so submit your nomination form to the secretary by then.
examples.zh: 提名周五截止，记得在那之前把「提名表」交给秘书。

words.enDefinition: class taken for learning without earning credits

examples.en: The writing center offers a free non-credit course for internationals.
examples.zh: 写作中心为国际学生开设了免费的「非学分课程」。

examples.en: A non-credit course won't affect your GPA or credit load.
examples.zh: 「非学分课程」不影响你的绩点和学分量。

words.enDefinition: student taking courses without pursuing a degree

examples.en: Non-degree students register last, after all the degree-seeking student groups.
examples.zh: 「非学位学生」最后注册，排在所有学位生之后。

examples.en: She enrolled as a non-degree student to test the program first.
examples.zh: 她先以「非学位学生」身份选课，试试这个项目。

words.enDefinition: food that keeps for months without refrigeration, like canned goods

examples.en: Bring non-perishable items like rice, pasta, or canned beans to the drive.
examples.zh: 参加捐赠时，请带大米、意面或罐装豆类等「耐储存食品」。

examples.en: Check the wish list online before donating any non-perishable items.
examples.zh: 捐「耐储存食品」之前，先看一看需求清单。

words.enDefinition: a transcript mark that neither adds to nor lowers your GPA

examples.en: A W is a non-punitive grade, so it leaves your GPA untouched.
examples.zh: W属于「非惩罚性成绩」，不会动你的绩点。

examples.en: Incomplete turns punitive if you never finish, so read the non-punitive grade rules.
examples.zh: 未完成成绩拖着不补会变成惩罚性的，所以要读读「非惩罚性成绩」的规定。

words.enDefinition: an organization serving a public cause rather than making profit

examples.en: Our club partners with a local nonprofit that refurbishes laptops for schools.
examples.zh: 我们社团与一家本地「非营利组织」合作，为学校翻新旧笔记本电脑。

examples.en: Nonprofits often recruit volunteers directly from campus clubs each September.
examples.zh: 每年九月，「非营利组织」常直接来校园社团招志愿者。

words.enDefinition: the group member who writes down the key points

examples.en: We rotate the note-taker so nobody gets stuck typing up the minutes every week.
examples.zh: 我们轮流当「记录员」，免得有人每周都倒霉负责整理纪要。

examples.en: The note-taker posted a summary of our breakout room before the class ended.
examples.zh: 下课前，「记录员」就把我们分组讨论的要点汇总发了出来。

words.enDefinition: a small but important difference in meaning or quality

examples.en: The TA pushed us to capture the nuance between tolerance and indifference.
examples.zh: 助教要求我们抓住宽容与冷漠之间的「细微差别」。

examples.en: Her comment added nuance to a debate that had turned too binary.
examples.zh: 她的发言让这场变得非黑即白的辩论多了一层「微妙差异」。

words.enDefinition: a grade expressed as a number rather than a letter

examples.en: The portal shows a numeric grade until the registrar converts it to letters.
examples.zh: 系统先显示「数字成绩」，之后教务处才换算成字母等级。

examples.en: A 78 numeric grade sits right at the edge of a C plus.
examples.zh: 78分的「数字成绩」正卡在C加的边缘。

words.enDefinition: not visible because your video or camera is switched off

examples.en: The professor went off camera for a minute to deal with her dog.
examples.zh: 教授「关掉镜头」处理了一下她的狗。

examples.en: Students say a lot more off camera than they do during discussion.
examples.zh: 「镜头外」同学们说的话，比讨论时多得多。

collocations: go off camera for a second

words.enDefinition: a remote facility storing less-used items retrievable by request

examples.en: This journal sits in off-site storage, so delivery to the main library takes two days.
examples.zh: 这本期刊在「馆外书库」，调到主馆需要两天。

examples.en: Request items from off-site storage online and pick them up at the front desk.
examples.zh: 「馆外书库」的书可以在网上申请调阅，到前台取。

words.enDefinition: an official letter admitting you to a program

examples.en: She received an offer of admission from the engineering faculty.
examples.zh: 她收到了工学院的「录取通知」。

examples.en: You must accept the offer of admission before the reply deadline.
examples.zh: 必须在答复截止日期前接受「录取通知」。

words.enDefinition: the staff member who manages a department office's schedules

examples.en: The office coordinator booked the seminar room for our review session.
examples.zh: 「办公室协调员」为复习课订好了研讨室。

examples.en: Direct all room-booking questions to the office coordinator by email.
examples.zh: 订教室的问题请一律邮件联系「办公室协调员」。

words.enDefinition: the door of a professor's office, often with notices

examples.en: Office hours are usually posted on the professor's office door.
examples.zh: 教授的「办公室门」上通常贴着答疑时间。

examples.en: A sign on her office door says back in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 她的「办公室门」上挂着字条：十分钟后回来。

words.enDefinition: A list on which students reserve time to meet a teacher during office hours.

examples.en: I put my name on the office-hour sign-up sheet and picked the slot after lunch.
examples.zh: 我在「答疑时段登记表」上填了名字，选了午饭后的时段。

examples.en: The professor added two extra slots to the office-hour sign-up sheet before the assignment deadline.
examples.zh: 老师在作业截止前给「答疑时段登记表」增加了两个空档。

collocations: slot on the office-hour sign-up sheet

words.enDefinition: the building and room where someone works

examples.en: The syllabus lists the professor's office location and weekly hours.
examples.zh: 课程大纲写明了教授的「办公室位置」和每周答疑时间。
