examples.en: Her office location moved to the fourth floor of Aldrich Hall.
examples.zh: 她的「办公室位置」改到了阿尔德里奇楼四层。

words.enDefinition: someone who shares your office or desk space

examples.en: My office mate is a fourth-year PhD student in economics.
examples.zh: 我的「办公室室友」是经济学四年级博士生。

examples.en: Office mates share a printer and take turns buying coffee.
examples.zh: 「办公室室友」共用打印机，还轮流买咖啡。

collocations: share an office with an office mate

words.enDefinition: the landline in a professor's or office room

examples.en: Call the office phone if your email gets no reply for days.
examples.zh: 邮件几天没回，就打「办公电话」。

examples.en: Her office phone goes straight to voicemail during her lectures.
examples.zh: 她上课时段，「办公电话」直接转语音信箱。

words.enDefinition: handing over files, passwords, and duties to new officers

examples.en: We schedule officer transition dinners so outgoing leaders can advise the incoming team.
examples.zh: 我们会安排「干事换届」聚餐，让离任负责人向新团队传授经验。

examples.en: A smooth officer transition keeps the club from losing institutional knowledge.
examples.zh: 顺利的「干事换届」能避免社团流失经验。

words.enDefinition: messages the university sends through its official channels

examples.en: All official communication goes to your university email, not your personal one.
examples.zh: 所有「官方通知」都发到校园邮箱，而不是你的私人邮箱。

examples.en: Ignore scholarship offers from random Gmail accounts, since official communication never uses them.
examples.zh: 陌生 Gmail 发来的奖学金邮件别信，「官方通知」绝不会用私人邮箱发送。

words.enDefinition: paper issued by the university that carries authority or a seal

examples.en: Bring an official document like your acceptance letter to prove your enrollment.
examples.zh: 带上录取通知书这类「官方文件」来证明你在读。

examples.en: Photocopies are not accepted; only an official document with the seal counts.
examples.zh: 复印件不行，只有盖章的「官方文件」才有效。

words.enDefinition: a formal letter on university letterhead that other institutions accept

examples.en: Request an official letter if the embassy needs proof of enrollment.
examples.zh: 大使馆需要在读证明的话，就申请一份「正式公函」。

examples.en: The official letter arrived signed and stamped in the mail.
examples.zh: 签章齐全的「正式公函」寄到了。

words.enDefinition: the embossed or inked stamp that makes a document official

examples.en: The certificate is not valid without the official seal in red ink.
examples.zh: 没有红色「公章」，证书无效。

examples.en: Check for the official seal before mailing any certified copy.
examples.zh: 寄出任何认证副本之前，先检查有没有盖「公章」。

words.enDefinition: a certified transcript sealed and signed by the registrar

examples.en: Graduate schools require an official transcript in a sealed envelope.
examples.zh: 研究生院要求提交密封信封里的「官方成绩单」。

examples.en: Order an official transcript online and pay the five-dollar fee.
examples.zh: 在线订购「官方成绩单」并支付五美元费用。

collocations: official transcript in a sealed envelope

words.enDefinition: a neutral officer who helps resolve student conflicts confidentially

examples.en: The ombudsperson listened to my grade dispute when everything else stalled.
examples.zh: 当一切都僵住时，「校园申诉专员」倾听了我对成绩的争议。

examples.en: Talking to the ombudsperson is confidential and does not trigger any discipline.
examples.zh: 与「校园申诉专员」的谈话是保密的，不会引发任何处分。

words.enDefinition: reserved for you and waiting at the pickup shelf

examples.en: Your request is on hold at the pickup shelf until Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 你预约的书在取书架上「留」到周五下午。

examples.en: Three people are ahead of me, so the novel is still on hold.
examples.zh: 排在我前面还有三个人，那本小说还在「预约等待」中。

collocations: on hold at the front desk

words.enDefinition: sharing the same understanding or plan as others

examples.en: Before the presentation, our group met to make sure everyone was on the same page.
examples.zh: 展示前我们开了个短会，确保每个人「想法一致」。

examples.en: The TA checked that we were all on the same page about the new rubric.
examples.zh: 助教确认我们对新的评分标准「理解一致」。

collocations: get everyone on the same page
on the same page about deadlines
keep the group on the same page

words.enDefinition: physically shelved and available rather than borrowed or missing

examples.en: The app says it's on the shelf, but I couldn't find it anywhere in QA.
examples.zh: App 显示「在架可借」，但我在QA区怎么也找不到。

examples.en: If it shows on the shelf yet is missing, staff will search for you.
examples.zh: 如果显示「在架」却找不到，馆员会帮你查架。

words.enDefinition: private tutoring sessions with a single tutor and student

examples.en: One-on-one tutoring for statistics is available on weekday evenings this term.
examples.zh: 统计学的「一对一辅导」安排在工作日晚上。

examples.en: Sign up for one-on-one tutoring if group sessions move too fast.
examples.zh: 如果小组课进度太快，就报名「一对一辅导」。

words.enDefinition: a single office where students handle many errands together

examples.en: The new help hub is a one-stop shop for enrollment and ID questions.
examples.zh: 新的办事大厅是处理注册和证件问题的「一站式服务点」。

examples.en: Students like the center because it is a one-stop shop for paperwork.
examples.zh: 同学们都喜欢这个中心，因为办各种手续它是「一站式服务点」。

collocations: a one-stop shop for student services
turn the office into a one-stop shop

words.enDefinition: a team assignment completed together through calls and shared files

examples.en: Our online group project lives in a shared folder and a weekly call.
examples.zh: 我们的「线上小组项目」靠共享文件夹加每周通话推进。

examples.en: Time zones nearly killed our online group project until we settled on Sunday mornings.
examples.zh: 时差差点毁掉我们的「线上小组项目」，最后定在周日上午。

collocations: an online group project over Zoom

words.enDefinition: taking courses through the internet instead of in a classroom

examples.en: Online learning works fine for lectures but hands-on labs are harder.
examples.zh: 理论课用「在线学习」没问题，动手实验就难了。

examples.en: I saved two hours of commuting a day thanks to online learning.
examples.zh: 多亏「在线学习」，我每天省了两小时通勤。

words.enDefinition: a short timed test on the course website

examples.en: Each module ends with a ten-question online quiz due Sunday night.
examples.zh: 每个单元以十道题的「在线测验」收尾，周日晚上截止。

examples.en: The online quiz locks at midnight, so never leave it to the last minute.
examples.zh: 「在线测验」午夜就会锁定，千万别拖到最后一刻。

words.enDefinition: section taught remotely over video instead of in class

examples.en: The online section freed my Tuesdays for hospital volunteering shifts.
examples.zh: 选了「线上课段」，周二就能腾出来去医院做志愿。

examples.en: Online sections fill just as fast as in-person ones now.
examples.zh: 现在「线上课段」和线下课段一样抢手。

words.enDefinition: an exam where notes and textbooks may be consulted

examples.en: The statistics final is an open-book exam, but you still need real understanding.
examples.zh: 统计期末是「开卷考试」，但你还是得真正弄懂才行。

examples.en: In an open-book exam, knowing where facts live matters more than memorizing them.
examples.zh: 「开卷考试」里，知道资料在哪比死记硬背更重要。

words.enDefinition: a welcome to drop in without an appointment

examples.en: Professor Reyes keeps an open-door policy throughout the exam weeks.
examples.zh: 整个考试周，雷耶斯教授都实行「开门政策」。

examples.en: An open-door policy means you can drop by without emailing first.
examples.zh: 所谓「开门政策」，就是不用先发邮件，随时可以去找。

words.enDefinition: a question with many possible answers rather than one

examples.en: Good discussion leaders favor open-ended questions that nobody can answer with a yes or no.
examples.zh: 高明的讨论主持人偏爱「开放式问题」，让人没法用是否作答。

examples.en: The TA replaced the quiz with one open-ended question about the week's reading.
examples.zh: 助教用一道关于本周阅读的「开放式问题」取代了小测。

collocations: an open-ended question about the reading

words.enDefinition: a day when a club welcomes visitors to look around

examples.en: The drama club's open house lets newcomers tour the theater and meet current members.
examples.zh: 话剧社的「开放日」欢迎新生参观剧场并认识现任成员。

examples.en: Stop by our open house this Saturday; no experience is needed to join.
examples.zh: 周六来我们的「开放日」吧，加入不需要任何经验。

words.enDefinition: a casual event where anyone can perform a short set

examples.en: The poetry club's open mic welcomes first-time readers as warmly as veterans.
examples.zh: 诗歌社的「开放麦」对新人和老手同样欢迎。

examples.en: He tested new material at the open mic before the comedy competition.
examples.zh: 喜剧比赛前，他在「开放麦」上试了新段子。

collocations: sign up for the open mic

words.enDefinition: seat still available in a course section

examples.en: Grab the open seat in Friday's lab before someone else does.
examples.zh: 赶在别人前面抢下周五实验课的「空余名额」。

examples.en: Refresh the portal at noon; open seats appear when students drop.
examples.zh: 中午刷新一下系统，有同学退课就会出现「空余名额」。

words.enDefinition: to invite everyone present to start asking or commenting

examples.en: The professor opened the floor after twenty minutes of presentation and questions.
examples.zh: 讲授和提问二十分钟后，教授「开放了自由讨论」。

examples.en: Before we open the floor, let me answer the question about last week's rubric.
examples.zh: 在「开放自由发言」之前，先让我回答上周关于评分标准的问题。

words.enDefinition: the spoken question-and-answer part of thesis approval

examples.en: The oral defense lasts ninety minutes and is open to classmates.
examples.zh: 「口头答辩」九十分钟，对本班同学开放旁听。

examples.en: Nervous candidates should rehearse their oral defense with friends first.
examples.zh: 容易紧张的考生应该先和朋友演练「口头答辩」。

words.enDefinition: an exam taken by speaking with an examiner

examples.en: The language oral exam lasts fifteen minutes with two examiners asking questions.
examples.zh: 语言「口试」十五分钟，由两位考官提问。

examples.en: I was nervous before the oral exam, but the examiner was friendly.
examples.zh: 「口试」前我特别紧张，好在考官很友善。

words.enDefinition: a large student ensemble with strings, winds, and percussion

examples.en: The university orchestra holds seating auditions at the start of each year.
examples.zh: 大学「管弦乐团」在每学年初进行席位选拔。

examples.en: Our orchestra collaborates with the choir for a winter concert every December.
examples.zh: 每年十二月，「管弦乐团」都会与合唱团合作冬季音乐会。

words.enDefinition: a trained student who guides new students during orientation

examples.en: Our orientation leader showed us the shortcut to the science building.
examples.zh: 我们的「迎新学长」带我们走了去科学楼的近路。

examples.en: Orientation leaders answer any question, from dining plans to bus routes.
examples.zh: 从餐饮套餐到公交路线，「迎新学长」什么问题都会耐心解答。

collocations: apply to be an orientation leader

words.enDefinition: a scheduled meeting explaining one aspect of starting university

examples.en: Each orientation session lasts about an hour and ends with questions.
examples.zh: 每场「迎新说明会」约一小时，最后留有提问时间。

examples.en: Attendance at the first orientation session is required for all new students.
examples.zh: 所有新生都必须参加第一场「迎新说明会」。

collocations: sign up for an orientation session

words.enDefinition: the packed first week of campus events for incoming students

examples.en: Orientation week is packed with campus tours and info booths.
examples.zh: 「迎新周」里到处都是校园参观和信息咨询台。

examples.en: Get your ID card sorted during orientation week before classes start.
examples.zh: 趁上课前，在「迎新周」把学生证办好。

words.enDefinition: the first version of a paper, not a photocopy or scan

examples.en: Bring the original document; they only scan it and hand it right back.
examples.zh: 带上「原件」，他们只是扫描一下就还给你。

examples.en: The admissions office kept my original document until I confirmed my enrollment.
examples.zh: 在我确认入学之前，招生办一直保留着我的「原件」。

words.enDefinition: when a video's sound and picture don't match up in time

examples.en: The recording was out of sync, so the formula appeared before he explained it.
examples.zh: 回放「音画不同步」，公式比讲解先出现。

examples.en: If the audio is out of sync, reload the recording from the module page.
examples.zh: 如果「音画不同步」，就从模块页面重新加载回放。

collocations: the audio is out of sync

words.enDefinition: the money charged for each day a loan is late

examples.en: The overdue fine is twenty-five cents a day for regular circulating books.
examples.zh: 普通流通图书的「逾期罚款」是每天25美分。

examples.en: My overdue fine hit eight dollars before I noticed the due date passed.
examples.zh: 等我注意到到期日已过，「逾期罚款」已经攒到八美元。

words.enDefinition: an automated email warning that a loan is past due

examples.en: Overdue notices go to your campus email every three days after the due date.
examples.zh: 过了到期日后，每三天就会有一封「逾期通知」发到你的校园邮箱。

examples.en: I ignored two overdue notices before the fines finally got my attention.
examples.zh: 我无视了两封「逾期通知」，直到罚款多到引起重视。

words.enDefinition: reverse an earlier ruling after reviewing new evidence

examples.en: The committee voted to overturn the decision after seeing her medical note.
examples.zh: 看到她的医疗证明后，委员会投票「推翻原决定」。

examples.en: A committee will rarely overturn a decision without fresh written evidence.
examples.zh: 没有新的书面证据，委员会很少会「推翻决定」。

words.enDefinition: to spread your effort evenly across the exam

examples.en: Pace yourself so the final essay gets its fair share of time.
examples.zh: 要「合理分配时间」，让最后一篇论述分到足够的时间。

examples.en: Glance at the clock every twenty minutes and pace yourself across the sections.
examples.zh: 每二十分钟看一眼表，跨部分「合理分配时间」。

words.enDefinition: to form pairs with nearby classmates for a quick task

examples.en: The TA told us to pair up and compare our reading responses for five minutes.
examples.zh: 助教让我们「两两分组」，花五分钟互相比较读书报告。

examples.en: Pair up with someone you have not spoken to yet in this seminar.
examples.zh: 和这门研讨课上还没说过话的同学「两人一组」吧。

words.enDefinition: several invited experts answering audience questions on a stage

examples.en: After each panel discussion, students line up at the microphone to ask one question.
examples.zh: 每场「嘉宾座谈」结束后，学生都排队到话筒前提一个问题。

examples.en: I was too nervous to speak at the panel discussion on AI and hiring.
examples.zh: 在那场关于人工智能与招聘的「嘉宾座谈」上，我紧张得没敢发言。

words.enDefinition: one of the invited speakers sitting on a panel

examples.en: Each panelist got two minutes to respond before the audience joined in.
examples.zh: 每位「座谈嘉宾」有两分钟回应时间，之后观众才能加入。

examples.en: One panelist admitted she had failed her first-year exams, which surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 一位「嘉宾」坦言自己大一挂过科，让所有人吃了一惊。

words.enDefinition: the forms and documents an office requires you to complete

examples.en: Bring all your paperwork in one folder to avoid a second trip.
examples.zh: 把所有「手续材料」装进一个文件夹，免得跑第二趟。

examples.en: The internship paperwork took longer than the job search itself.
examples.zh: 实习的「手续材料」比找工作本身还耗时。

words.enDefinition: to restate someone's idea in your own simpler words

examples.en: Before you disagree, paraphrase the author's claim so the class knows you read it.
examples.zh: 反驳之前先「用自己的话复述」作者的主张，让全班知道你读过。

examples.en: She paraphrased the dense paragraph in two sentences and the whole group relaxed.
examples.zh: 她用两句话把那段艰深的段落「转述」出来，全组都松了口气。

words.enDefinition: student taking fewer credits than full-time requires

examples.en: As a part-time student, I spread my degree over five years.
examples.zh: 作为「非全日制学生」，我把学业拉长到了五年。

examples.en: Part-time students usually register after full-timers during the priority rounds.
examples.zh: 优先选课轮次中，「非全日制学生」通常排在全日制学生之后。

words.enDefinition: a portion of the grade based on how much you speak

examples.en: My participation grade is twenty percent, so staying silent all term is not an option.
examples.zh: 「课堂参与分」占两成，整学期保持沉默是行不通的。

examples.en: The TA explained that a good participation grade rewards quality comments, not constant talking.
examples.zh: 助教解释说，「课堂参与分」看重发言质量，而不是喋喋不休。

words.enDefinition: grading choice earning credit without a letter grade

examples.en: Take that hard philosophy course under the pass/fail option instead.
examples.zh: 那门很难的哲学课，改用「合格/不合格制」修吧。

examples.en: The pass/fail option deadline usually falls around midsemester, so decide early.
examples.zh: 「合格/不合格制」的截止时间通常在期中前后，要尽早决定。

words.enDefinition: the minimum score needed to pass an exam

examples.en: The pass mark for the licensing exam is seventy percent.
examples.zh: 执照考试的「及格线」是百分之七十。

examples.en: You need every quiz point to stay comfortably above the pass mark.
examples.zh: 想稳稳站在「及格线」之上，每次小测的分数都不能丢。

collocations: the pass mark is seventy percent

words.enDefinition: the percentage of candidates who pass an exam

examples.en: Only forty percent of first-timers pass, so the pass rate is famously low.
examples.zh: 首考通过的人只有四成，这个「通过率」出了名的低。

examples.en: The department celebrated when the module's pass rate climbed to eighty percent.
examples.zh: 这门课的「通过率」升到百分之八十时，全系都开了庆祝会。

collocations: the pass rate for first-time candidates

words.enDefinition: to pass a course at an exceptionally high standard

examples.en: She passed with distinction on the honors seminar's final portfolio.
examples.zh: 她在荣誉研讨课的期末作品集上「以优异成绩通过」。

examples.en: Students who pass with distinction get a note added to the transcript.
examples.zh: 「优秀通过」的学生会在成绩单上加注说明。

collocations: pass with distinction in a seminar
a result of passed with distinction

words.enDefinition: to pass an exam with an excellent result

examples.en: Review the past papers thoroughly and you may pass with flying colors.
examples.zh: 把历年真题刷透，你就能「以高分通过」。

examples.en: He passed with flying colors despite missing two weeks of lectures.
examples.zh: 虽然缺了两周的课，他还是「以高分通过」。

collocations: pass the exam with flying colors
with flying colors on the first attempt

words.enDefinition: a scheme marking courses only as pass or fail

examples.en: Under pass/fail grading, the transcript shows a P instead of a letter.
examples.zh: 在「合格制计分」下，成绩单上显示P而不是字母等级。

examples.en: Pass/fail grading shields your GPA, but grad schools sometimes prefer letter grades.
examples.zh: 「合格/不及格制」保护绩点，但研究生院有时更想看字母等级。

words.enDefinition: any grade that counts as successfully completing a course

examples.en: You only need a passing grade in the lab to keep your credit.
examples.zh: 实验课只要拿到「合格成绩」就能保住学分。

examples.en: A D is technically a passing grade, but it will drag your GPA down.
examples.zh: D严格来说也算「及格成绩」，但会拖低你的绩点。

words.enDefinition: an exam paper from an earlier year used for revision

examples.en: Working through past papers is the fastest way to spot recurring questions.
examples.zh: 刷「历年真题」是找出常考题的最快方法。

examples.en: The library keeps past papers for most modules in its online archive.
examples.zh: 图书馆的线上档案保存着大多数课程的「历年真题」。

words.enDefinition: stop a recorded lecture briefly to take notes or think

examples.en: Pause the lecture whenever the professor writes a formula on the screen.
examples.zh: 教授在屏幕上写公式时，就「暂停」记一下笔记。

examples.en: I paused the lecture mid-sentence to look up the unfamiliar term.
examples.zh: 我「暂停」了课程视频，去查那个生词。

collocations: pause the lecture to take notes

words.enDefinition: give the library money owed for late or damaged items

examples.en: You can pay a fine at the circulation desk or online with a card.
examples.zh: 可以在借还台「交罚款」，也可以在网上刷卡支付。

examples.en: If the kiosk rejects your card, walk over and pay a fine in cash at the desk.
examples.zh: 如果自助机刷不了卡，就去柜台用现金「交罚款」。

collocations: pay a fine at the desk

words.enDefinition: a senior student who guides new students

examples.en: My peer mentor showed me how to email professors properly.
examples.zh: 我的「同伴导师」教我怎么得体地给教授写邮件。

examples.en: Peer mentors live in the same dorm as their first-year group.
examples.zh: 「同伴导师」和自己带的大一组住在同一栋宿舍。

words.enDefinition: an organized pairing of new students with experienced student guides

examples.en: The peer mentor program pairs new first-year students with upperclassmen.
examples.zh: 「同伴导师项目」让大一新生和高年级学生结对。

examples.en: Apply to the peer mentor program at the start of fall semester.
examples.zh: 秋季学期开学时，就可以申请「同伴导师项目」。

collocations: apply to the peer mentor program

words.enDefinition: a student who tutors classmates in courses they excelled in

examples.en: My peer tutor explained integration step by step until it clicked.
examples.zh: 「同伴辅导员」一步步给我讲积分，直到我恍然大悟。

examples.en: Peer tutors are students who earned an A in the same course.
examples.zh: 「同伴辅导员」都是同一门课拿过A的同学。

words.enDefinition: your rank against other test takers in percent

examples.en: A ninetieth-percentile score means you beat ninety percent of test takers.
examples.zh: 第九十「百分位数」意味着你超过了百分之九十的考生。

examples.en: Admissions teams look at your percentile, not just your raw score.
examples.zh: 招生团队看的是你的「百分位数」，而不只是原始分。

words.enDefinition: a result with no points lost anywhere

examples.en: He achieved a perfect score on the quantitative section again this year.
examples.zh: 他今年又在数学部分拿到了「满分」。

examples.en: A perfect score does not guarantee admission, but it certainly helps.
examples.zh: 「满分」不能保证录取，但肯定有帮助。

collocations: a perfect score on the section

words.enDefinition: to do your best work when the stakes are high

examples.en: Timed practice teaches you to perform under pressure on exam day.
examples.zh: 限时练习让你学会在考试当天「在压力下发挥」。

examples.en: Some students genuinely perform under pressure, while others need calm to think.
examples.zh: 有些学生确实能「在压力下发挥」，另一些则需要平静才能思考。

collocations: train yourself to perform under pressure

words.enDefinition: the area where current magazines and journals are displayed

examples.en: The periodicals section keeps this month's magazines on racks near the windows.
examples.zh: 「期刊区」把当月杂志放在靠窗的架子上。

examples.en: Older journals move from the periodicals section into bound volumes on level four.
examples.zh: 过期期刊会从「期刊区」转到四楼的合订本区。

collocations: periodicals section on the ground floor

words.enDefinition: code from a department that lets you bypass restrictions

examples.en: The department emailed me a permission number for the capped seminar.
examples.zh: 系里给我发了一个「选课许可号」，用于选限额研讨课。

examples.en: Without a permission number, the portal blocks any restricted course.
examples.zh: 没有「选课许可号」，系统会挡下所有受限课程。

words.enDefinition: details that identify you, such as name, address, and birthdate

examples.en: Update your personal information in the portal after you move apartments.
examples.zh: 搬了公寓后，记得在系统里更新「个人信息」。

examples.en: The office will not release your personal information to family members.
examples.zh: 办公室不会把你的「个人信息」透露给家人。

words.enDefinition: an essay describing your background, interests, and motivations

examples.en: Her personal statement opened with a story from her internship.
examples.zh: 她的「个人陈述」以一段实习经历开篇。

examples.en: Keep the personal statement under five thousand characters for UCAS.
examples.zh: 申请 UCAS 时「个人陈述」要控制在五千字符以内。

words.enDefinition: a signed request asking the university or council to change something

examples.en: Our petition for longer library hours gathered eight hundred signatures in one week.
examples.zh: 我们要求延长图书馆开放时间的「请愿书」一周就收集了八百个签名。

examples.en: The council debated the petition at its next public meeting.
examples.zh: 学生会在下次公开会议上讨论了这份「请愿书」。

words.enDefinition: a doctoral course of study with coursework and dissertation research

examples.en: She was admitted to the PhD program in chemistry starting this fall.
examples.zh: 她被今年秋季入学的化学「博士项目」录取了。

examples.en: Applying to a PhD program usually requires reference letters and a statement of purpose.
examples.zh: 申请「博士项目」通常需要推荐信和目的陈述。

collocations: be admitted to a PhD program

words.enDefinition: a short internal number for an office phone

examples.en: The professor's phone extension is printed on the course syllabus.
examples.zh: 教授的「电话分机号」印在课程大纲上。

examples.en: Dial the main office and ask for the phone extension of Professor Lee.
examples.zh: 先拨总机，再请对方转「电话分机」找李教授。

words.enDefinition: a machine that makes paper copies for a small fee

examples.en: The photocopy machine on level one accepts coins and campus cards.
examples.zh: 一楼的「复印机」既收硬币也刷校园卡。

examples.en: There's always a queue at the photocopy machine the week before finals.
examples.zh: 期末前一周，「复印机」前总要排队。

collocations: photocopy machine by the reference desk

words.enDefinition: to notice a small remark and respond to it

examples.en: The professor picked up on my passing comment and turned it into the next debate.
examples.zh: 教授「接住了我随口一句话」，把它变成了下一轮辩论的题目。

examples.en: Pick up on what quieter classmates say; their brief notes often hide good questions.
examples.zh: 多「接话」安静同学说的内容，他们简短的笔记里常藏着好问题。

collocations: pick up on an earlier remark

words.enDefinition: an email telling you an item is ready to collect

examples.en: The pickup notice hit my inbox this morning about the interlibrary loan.
examples.zh: 今天早上邮箱收到了那本馆际互借书的「取书通知」。

examples.en: Check spam folders for pickup notices because the library server gets filtered sometimes.
examples.zh: 记得查查垃圾邮件，图书馆的「取书通知」有时会被过滤掉。

words.enDefinition: the days you have to collect an item before it is reshelved

examples.en: You get a five-day pickup window before reserved items go back on the shelf.
examples.zh: 预约的书有五天「取书时限」，过期就重新上架。

examples.en: Miss the pickup window and the book moves to the next person waiting.
examples.zh: 错过「取书时限」，书就会流转给下一位预约者。

words.enDefinition: to attach your idea to what someone just said

examples.en: Can I piggyback on that and add one counterexample from my own fieldwork?
examples.zh: 我可以「顺着这一点」补充一个我田野调查里的反例吗？

examples.en: She piggybacked on the previous comment to introduce her critique of the methodology.
examples.zh: 她「借着前一位的评论」，引出了自己对方法论的批评。

words.enDefinition: a message fixed to the top of a page so nobody misses it

examples.en: The professor kept a pinned post with the Zoom link and office hours.
examples.zh: 教授置顶了一个「置顶帖」，里面是Zoom链接和答疑时间。

examples.en: Check the pinned post first because it answers most questions about the final.
examples.zh: 先看「置顶帖」，它解答了关于期末考的大部分问题。

words.enDefinition: to speak suddenly after staying quiet for a while

examples.en: Halfway through the debate, a first-year piped up with the sharpest question so far.
examples.zh: 辩论进行到一半，一个新生「突然开口」，问了至今最尖锐的问题。

examples.en: Nobody expects you to pipe up if you tell the TA beforehand that you are shy.
examples.zh: 如果你提前告诉助教你比较害羞，没人会指望你「突然发言」。

collocations: pipe up from the back row

words.enDefinition: reserve a borrowed-out item so it is saved for you
acceptedEnVariants: put a hold on a book

examples.en: Place a hold online and the library emails you when the copy lands.
examples.zh: 在网上「预约借书」，书一到馆图书馆就会给你发邮件。

examples.en: Someone beat me to the last copy, so I went online to place a hold.
examples.zh: 最后一本被人先借走了，我马上上网「预约借书」。

collocations: place a hold on a book
place a hold from the catalog

words.enDefinition: exam deciding which course level you start at

examples.en: Take the online math placement test before your advising appointment.
examples.zh: 在导师面谈之前，先完成在线「数学分级测试」。

examples.en: Language placement tests decide whether you start at intermediate level.
examples.zh: 语言「分级测试」决定你是从中级还是初级学起。

words.enDefinition: approved list of courses mapped to graduation

examples.en: File an updated plan of study before your junior year registration.
examples.zh: 大三选课之前，先提交更新版的「学业计划」。

examples.en: Your plan of study maps every requirement to a specific term.
examples.zh: 「学业计划」把每项要求落实到具体学期。

words.enDefinition: how fast a recorded video plays compared with normal speed

examples.en: I watch every lecture recording at double playback speed before the exam.
examples.zh: 考前我用「倍速播放」把所有回放刷一遍。

examples.en: Adjust the playback speed to 1.5x for the slow review lectures.
examples.zh: 复习课讲得慢，把「倍速」调到1.5倍就行。

words.enDefinition: arguing the opposite side on purpose to test the group's thinking

examples.en: The professor was just playing devil's advocate; she actually agreed with our critique.
examples.zh: 教授只是在「故意唱反调」，其实她认同我们的批评。

examples.en: Playing devil's advocate is easier than defending a position you truly hold.
examples.zh: 「故意唱反调」比捍卫你真心持有的立场要容易。

collocations: play devil's advocate to test an idea

words.enDefinition: the knockout rounds that decide a league's season winner

examples.en: One more win would have sent us to the playoff bracket.
examples.zh: 再赢一场，我们就能进「季后赛」对阵表了。

examples.en: The intramural playoff schedule is posted the week before final exams.
examples.zh: 「季后赛」赛程表在期末考前一周公布。

words.enDefinition: a system awarding grades like B plus and C minus

examples.en: Plus/minus grading means an 89 is a B plus, worth only 3.3.
examples.zh: 「加减等级制」意味着89分是B加，只值3.3绩点。

examples.en: Our school switched to plus/minus grading two years ago, and GPAs dipped.
examples.zh: 学校两年前改用「加减等级制」，大家的绩点都降了一点。

words.enDefinition: how many points an assignment is worth in total

examples.en: Check the point value before skipping a small homework set.
examples.zh: 放弃某次小作业前，先看看它的「分值」。

examples.en: The final project has a point value of 200, a third of the course.
examples.zh: 期末项目的「分值」是200分，占整门课的三分之一。

collocations: the point value of an assignment

words.enDefinition: to find weak spots that make an argument unreliable

examples.en: The professor poked holes in my methodology until I finally saw the confound.
examples.zh: 教授不断「挑我方法论上的毛病」，直到我终于看清那个混淆变量。

examples.en: We spent the seminar poking holes in a famous study that later failed replication.
examples.zh: 整节研讨课我们都在给那项著名研究「找漏洞」，它后来果然未能重复验证。

words.enDefinition: special permission to break a standard rule in one case

examples.en: Her late add was approved as a one-time policy exception.
examples.zh: 她的逾期加选作为一次性「破例批准」获得了通过。

examples.en: Most policy exceptions require a signature from the department chair.
examples.zh: 多数「破例批准」都需要系主任签字。

words.enDefinition: ask the whole class a quick question through a voting app

examples.en: The professor polls the class every ten minutes to keep us awake.
examples.zh: 教授每十分钟「发起一次课堂投票」，防止我们犯困。

examples.en: Polling the class showed half of us were confused by the derivation.
examples.zh: 「课堂投票」显示，一半同学没看懂那个推导。

collocations: poll the class to check understanding

words.enDefinition: the tally of answers shown after everyone votes

examples.en: The poll results appeared on screen and half the class picked B.
examples.zh: 「投票结果」一公布，全班一半人都选了B。

examples.en: The professor walked us through the poll results before explaining the answer.
examples.zh: 教授先带我们看「投票结果」，再讲解答案。

words.enDefinition: a browser setting that stops websites opening new pop-up windows

examples.en: Turn off your pop-up blocker or the quiz window won't open.
examples.zh: 关掉「弹窗拦截器」，不然测验窗口弹不出来。

examples.en: My pop-up blocker kept the poll from loading during the lecture.
examples.zh: 上课时「弹窗拦截器」把投票页面挡住了，一直加载不出来。

words.enDefinition: to ask a question, especially one worth discussing

examples.en: Each presenter must pose a question the rest of the seminar has to tackle.
examples.zh: 每位展示者都要「提出一个问题」，让研讨课其他人来攻克。

examples.en: She posed a question about ethics that kept our group talking past the deadline.
examples.zh: 她「抛出的伦理问题」让我们小组讨论得忘了截止时间。

collocations: pose a question to the class

words.enDefinition: write a response under someone's post on a discussion board

examples.en: Post a reply that adds evidence instead of just agreeing.
examples.zh: 「回帖」要有论据，别只是简单附和。

examples.en: Remember to post a reply to two classmates before Sunday night.
examples.zh: 周日晚之前记得给两位同学「回帖」。

collocations: post a reply to two classmates
post a reply before the deadline

words.enDefinition: a recent PhD doing further research on a temporary contract

examples.en: Our postdoc taught the morning section while Professor Lee was away.
examples.zh: 李教授外出期间，由「博士后」代讲上午的小班课。

examples.en: Postdocs usually stay two or three years before finding faculty jobs.
examples.zh: 「博士后」一般待两三年再去应聘教职。

words.enDefinition: large-format printing for research posters and presentations

examples.en: Poster printing for the research symposium costs about ten dollars per sheet.
examples.zh: 学术海报展的「海报打印」每张大约十美元。

examples.en: Submit your poster file two days early, because poster printing takes time.
examples.zh: 「海报打印」耗时，海报文件要提前两天提交。

collocations: submit a file for poster printing

words.enDefinition: study undertaken after a bachelor's degree, such as a master's

examples.en: He chose postgraduate study in the UK for its one-year master's.
examples.zh: 因为一年制硕士，他选择了在英国进行「研究生学习」。

examples.en: Postgraduate study requires early planning of funding, housing, and visas.
examples.zh: 「研究生学习」需要尽早规划经费、住宿和签证。

words.enDefinition: a hands-on test of skills rather than knowledge

examples.en: The nursing course ends with a practical exam in the skills lab.
examples.zh: 护理课程以技能实验室里的「实操考试」收尾。

examples.en: In the chemistry practical exam, you have ninety minutes for three experiments.
examples.zh: 化学「实操考试」要求九十分钟内完成三个实验。

words.enDefinition: a full-length trial exam used for revision

examples.en: Do at least one timed practice exam before the real thing.
examples.zh: 正式考试前，至少做一套限时「模拟测试」。

examples.en: The department website posts a practice exam with worked solutions every year.
examples.zh: 系网站每年都会发布一份附详解的「模拟测试」。

words.enDefinition: drill questions done while preparing for exams

examples.en: Work through the practice questions at the end of each chapter.
examples.zh: 把每章末尾的「练习题」都过一遍。

examples.en: The tutor emailed us fifty practice questions styled like the real exam.
examples.zh: 辅导老师发来了五十道仿照真题风格的「练习题」。

collocations: practice questions at the end of the chapter

words.enDefinition: an ungraded online quiz for testing yourself before the real one

examples.en: Take the practice quiz twice before attempting the graded one.
examples.zh: 正式测验之前，先把「练习测验」做两遍。

examples.en: The practice quiz uses questions from the same bank as the final.
examples.zh: 「练习测验」的题目和期末考出自同一个题库。

words.enDefinition: supervised practical course connected to fieldwork

examples.en: The counseling practicum places you in a real school for ten hours weekly.
examples.zh: 咨询「实践课」安排你每周到真实学校实习十小时。

examples.en: Register for the practicum early because each site takes few students.
examples.zh: 「实践课」要尽早注册，每个实习点只收少量学生。

words.enDefinition: a short quiz due before class to prove you did the reading

examples.en: The pre-class quiz locks at nine a.m., so no last-minute reading.
examples.zh: 「课前小测」九点关闭，别想临时抱佛脚。

examples.en: Our professor uses the pre-class quiz to decide what to review.
examples.zh: 教授根据「课前小测」的错题决定课上复习什么。

words.enDefinition: early course sign-up before official registration opens

examples.en: Submit your pre-registration form so the department can plan sections.
examples.zh: 提交「预选课」表，系里才能规划课段。

examples.en: Pre-registration doesn't guarantee a seat, but it gives you priority.
examples.zh: 「预注册」不保证有位置，但能给你优先权。

words.enDefinition: the name you choose to be called in class and email

examples.en: Set your preferred name in the portal so professors see it on rosters.
examples.zh: 在系统里设置「常用名」，教授的点名册上就会显示它。

examples.en: The registrar updated my preferred name, but my legal name stays on transcripts.
examples.zh: 注册办更新了我的「常用名」，但成绩单上仍保留法定姓名。

words.enDefinition: to get materials and answers ready before a session

examples.en: I prep for class on the bus, rereading my notes and one highlighted quote.
examples.zh: 我在公交车上「做课前准备」，重读笔记和一条画了线的引文。

examples.en: The syllabus says to prep for class by writing two questions about the reading.
examples.zh: 课程大纲要求「课前准备」时写下两个关于阅读材料的问题。

collocations: prep for class the night before
prep for class with two questions

words.enDefinition: course you must finish before taking another

examples.en: Organic chemistry lists general chemistry I as a hard prerequisite.
examples.zh: 有机化学把「普通化学 I」列为严格的先修课程。

examples.en: The portal blocks enrollment automatically if you're missing a prerequisite.
examples.zh: 缺少「先修课程」时，系统会自动禁止选课。

words.enDefinition: official permission to skip a required prior course

examples.en: My AP score earned me a prerequisite waiver for calculus.
examples.zh: 我的 AP 成绩帮我拿到了微积分的「先修豁免」。

examples.en: Ask the department for a prerequisite waiver if you have equivalent experience.
examples.zh: 如果你有同等学习经历，可以向系里申请「先修豁免」。

words.enDefinition: deliver the section of a group presentation assigned to you

examples.en: Don't panic because I can present your part if your flight lands late.
examples.zh: 别慌，你航班晚点的话，我可以替你「讲你那部分」。

examples.en: Practice until you can present your part without reading every line.
examples.zh: 多练几遍，做到「讲自己那部分」时不用逐字念稿。

words.enDefinition: a bookable room with a screen for rehearsing talks

examples.en: Reserve the presentation practice room to rehearse your slides with a timer.
examples.zh: 订一间「演练室」，对着计时器排练幻灯片。

examples.en: The presentation practice room records you, so you can watch your gestures after.
examples.zh: 「演练室」还能录像，练完可以回看自己的手势。

collocations: rehearse in the presentation practice room

words.enDefinition: the lead professor in charge of a research project

examples.en: The principal investigator announced the new grant at our lab meeting.
examples.zh: 「课题负责人」在组会上宣布了新经费到位。

examples.en: Undergrads email the principal investigator to ask about joining the lab.
examples.zh: 本科生想进组，就给「课题负责人」发邮件。

words.enDefinition: the prepaid money your account spends when printing beyond quota

examples.en: Add print credit online before the weekend rush at the print stations.
examples.zh: 周末打印站高峰前，先在线给「打印余额」充值。

examples.en: My print credit ran out mid-essay, and the machine refused the last page.
examples.zh: 论文打到一半「打印余额」用完了，最后一页机器直接拒打。

words.enDefinition: print on both sides of each sheet to save pages

examples.en: Print double-sided to stretch your semester quota across the whole term.
examples.zh: 「双面打印」能让一学期的打印额度撑得更久。

examples.en: Remember to print double-sided in the settings, or you'll waste fifty sheets.
examples.zh: 记得在设置里选「双面打印」，不然要浪费五十张纸。

words.enDefinition: a document sent to the shared printers, released at the station

examples.en: Send the PDF from your laptop, then release your print job at the station.
examples.zh: 先在笔记本上发送PDF，再到打印站「释放打印任务」。

examples.en: My print job sat in the queue for ten minutes because the toner ran out.
examples.zh: 因为没墨了，我的「打印任务」在队列里卡了十分钟。

words.enDefinition: the waiting line of documents ahead of yours at the printer

examples.en: The print queue backs up for twenty minutes around noon every day.
examples.zh: 每天中午前后，「打印队列」会积压二十分钟。

examples.en: Check the print queue before resending, or you'll print your essay twice.
examples.zh: 重发之前先看看「打印队列」，不然论文会打两份。

collocations: print queue at the front station

words.enDefinition: the free page allowance each student receives for printing

examples.en: Your printing quota resets to fifty free pages at the start of every month.
examples.zh: 每月月初，「打印额度」会重置为五十页免费页数。

examples.en: I exceeded my printing quota, so the last ten pages charged my card.
examples.zh: 「打印额度」用超了，最后十页扣了我的卡。

words.enDefinition: earlier enrollment slots given to certain student groups

examples.en: Student athletes and honors students usually qualify for priority registration.
examples.zh: 体育特长生和荣誉项目学生通常可以「优先选课」。

examples.en: Apply for priority registration if you're a veteran or a student parent.
examples.zh: 如果你是退伍军人或学生家长，可以申请「优先选课」。

words.enDefinition: a direct note to one person that the class can't see

examples.en: Send the TA a private message if your issue involves grades.
examples.zh: 涉及成绩的问题，直接给助教发「私信」。

examples.en: She sent me a private message with her notes after I missed class.
examples.zh: 我缺课后，她用「私信」把笔记发给了我。

words.enDefinition: ruling out wrong options to reach the answer

examples.en: Use the process of elimination when you are stuck between two choices.
examples.zh: 在两个选项之间拿不定主意时，就用「排除法」。

examples.en: The process of elimination got me the answer even without remembering the rule.
examples.zh: 即使记不清规则，靠「排除法」我也推出了答案。

words.enDefinition: a small charge for handling a request or document

examples.en: Each extra transcript copy carries a five-dollar processing fee at the counter.
examples.zh: 在柜台加印成绩单，每份要收五美元「手续费」。

examples.en: The processing fee is waived for students with financial hardship.
examples.zh: 经济困难学生的「手续费」可以减免。

words.enDefinition: how long an office needs to finish your request

examples.en: Processing time for transcripts is three to five business days.
examples.zh: 成绩单的「处理时间」为三至五个工作日。

examples.en: Ask about the processing time before you pay for express service.
examples.zh: 加急付费之前，先问清「处理时间」。

words.enDefinition: the American word for an exam supervisor

examples.en: The proctor checked every student ID before handing out the papers.
examples.zh: 「监考人员」发卷前逐一核对了学生证件。

examples.en: If your calculator dies mid-exam, quietly signal the proctor for help.
examples.zh: 考试中途计算器没电，就悄悄示意「监考人员」求助。

words.enDefinition: an exam supervised in person or online by a proctor

examples.en: The online course requires a proctored exam at an approved test center.
examples.zh: 这门网课要求在指定考点参加「有监考的考试」。

examples.en: Your webcam stays on during the proctored exam so the proctor can see you.
examples.zh: 「有监考的考试」期间摄像头必须开着，监考员要能看到你。

words.enDefinition: a retired professor who keeps an honorary title

examples.en: Professor Wright is professor emeritus now but still attends every department seminar.
examples.zh: 赖特教授如今是「荣休教授」，系里研讨仍场场必到。

examples.en: The professor emeritus still advises a couple of doctoral students.
examples.zh: 这位「荣休教授」仍在指导两名博士生。

words.enDefinition: a staff member helping a program with admin tasks

examples.en: The program assistant booked the rooms for our poster session.
examples.zh: 「项目助理」为海报展订好了场地。

examples.en: Program assistants process all the forms that professors never see.
examples.zh: 教授从不过目的表格都由「项目助理」处理。

words.enDefinition: the staff member who manages a degree program's paperwork

examples.en: The program coordinator signed off on all my transfer credits.
examples.zh: 「项目协调员」批准了我的全部转学分。

examples.en: Program coordinators answer the questions that professors won't, like deadlines.
examples.zh: 像截止日期这类问题，教授不管，都问「项目协调员」。

words.enDefinition: the professor who oversees an academic program

examples.en: The program director approved my proposal for an independent study.
examples.zh: 「项目主任」批准了我的独立研究申请。

examples.en: Direct any complaints about the curriculum to the program director.
examples.zh: 对课程设置的意见请反映给「项目主任」。

words.enDefinition: an early-term grade showing whether you are on track

examples.en: First-year students receive progress grades at the midpoint of every fall term.
examples.zh: 大一学生每学期中段会收到「阶段成绩」。

examples.en: A low progress grade triggers a meeting with your academic advisor.
examples.zh: 「进度成绩」太低会触发和学业导师的约谈。

words.enDefinition: the grade you are likely to receive by term's end

examples.en: With two A's on the midterms, my projected grade is a solid B plus.
examples.zh: 两次期中都拿了A，我的「预估成绩」是稳稳的B加。

examples.en: The syllabus shows how to compute your projected grade before the final.
examples.zh: 课程大纲教你在期末前怎么算「预估成绩」。

words.enDefinition: individual sessions improving how English sounds to listeners

examples.en: Pronunciation coaching sessions focus on the sounds you find hardest.
examples.zh: 「发音辅导」课专门攻克你觉得最难发的音。

examples.en: Book pronunciation coaching at the language center before your presentation.
examples.zh: 做演讲之前，先到语言中心预约「发音辅导」。

words.enDefinition: a document such as a passport that shows who you are

examples.en: Bring proof of identity, like your passport, to collect the new ID card.
examples.zh: 领取新学生证时要带护照等「身份证明」。

examples.en: They will not release records without proof of identity and a signature.
examples.zh: 没有「身份证明」和签名，他们不会发放档案。

words.enDefinition: evidence that a lost item actually belongs to you

examples.en: Bring proof of ownership like a photo of the serial number.
examples.zh: 认领时要带上序列号照片这类「所有权证明」。

examples.en: Without proof of ownership, the office cannot release the bike.
examples.zh: 没有「所有权证明」，办公室不能把自行车发还。

words.enDefinition: a student thinking about joining a club or team

examples.en: Prospective members can attend two practices for free before paying dues.
examples.zh: 「准成员」可以先免费参加两次训练，之后再交会费。

examples.en: The officer in charge collected emails from every prospective member at the table.
examples.zh: 负责招新的干事在摊位前收集了每位「准成员」的邮箱。

words.enDefinition: a temporary grade that can still change after review

examples.en: Provisional grades for the module appear online before the exam board meets.
examples.zh: 模块的「暂定成绩」会在考试委员会开会前先上网。

examples.en: Treat the provisional grade as final only after the transcript is issued.
examples.zh: 成绩单签发之前，别把「临时成绩」当成最终结果。

words.enDefinition: the senior academic officer who oversees colleges and faculty

examples.en: The provost approved extra tutoring funds for students on probation.
examples.zh: 「教务长」批准为察看期学生增设辅导经费。

examples.en: A university-wide email from the provost announced the new grading policy.
examples.zh: 「教务长」的全校邮件公布了新的评分政策。

words.enDefinition: to lift a weak course grade through later work

examples.en: Two strong problem sets can still pull up your grade before the final.
examples.zh: 两次高质量的习题还能在期末前「把成绩拉上来」。

examples.en: She pulled up her grade from a D plus to a B minus after office hours.
examples.zh: 她靠多去答疑把「成绩拉了上来」，从D加升到B减。

collocations: pull up your grade late in term
pull the grade up to a B
hard to pull up your grade

words.enDefinition: to do your fair share of a group's work

examples.en: Group projects work when everyone pulls their weight and says so honestly.
examples.zh: 只要人人都「尽了本分」且坦诚沟通，小组作业就会顺利。

examples.en: He finally pulled his weight after the TA asked each member to list contributions.
examples.zh: 助教要求每人列出贡献清单后，他总算「出了自己该出的力」。

collocations: pull your weight in a group

words.enDefinition: a suggestion asking the library to buy a specific title

examples.en: Submit a purchase request and the subject librarian replies within a week.
examples.zh: 提交一份「图书荐购」，学科馆员一周内会回复。

examples.en: The library bought my professor's monograph after three students filed purchase requests.
examples.zh: 三名学生都提交了「荐购」后，图书馆买下了教授的专著。

words.enDefinition: to force someone to answer immediately without preparation

examples.en: The professor put me on the spot by asking which author I found least convincing.
examples.zh: 教授当场问我觉得哪位作者最没说服力，简直「让人当场难堪」。

examples.en: Good TAs avoid putting shy students on the spot during the first few weeks.
examples.zh: 好的助教在开学头几周不会「逼害羞的学生当场回答」。

collocations: put a student on the spot
hate being put on the spot

words.enDefinition: to connect a caller to another person

examples.en: Hold on please, and I'll put you through to Professor Lee's office.
examples.zh: 请稍等，我帮您「转接」到李教授办公室。

examples.en: The receptionist put me through to the bursar's office directly.
examples.zh: 接待员把我的电话直接「转接」到了财务处。

collocations: put you through to the office

words.enDefinition: a gatekeeper exam for staying in a doctoral program

examples.en: Failing the qualifying exam twice usually means leaving the program.
examples.zh: 「资格考试」两次不过，通常就意味着要退出项目。

examples.en: Her qualifying exam is scheduled for October before a faculty panel.
examples.zh: 她的「资格考试」定在十月，由教师小组主考。

words.enDefinition: schedule dividing the academic year into four short terms

examples.en: Under the quarter system, courses move fast and finals come quickly.
examples.zh: 「学季制」下课程节奏很快，期末也来得早。

examples.en: Transferring from a quarter system school means converting your credits.
examples.zh: 从「学季制」学校转过来，学分还需要换算。

words.enDefinition: to ask a professor to explain or review a posted grade

examples.en: Email the TA first if you want to question a grade on the problem set.
examples.zh: 如果你想「质疑习题集的分数」，先给助教发邮件。

examples.en: Most students question a grade politely and get the mistake fixed in a day.
examples.zh: 多数学生礼貌地「对成绩提出疑问」，一天内就能改好。

words.enDefinition: a large pool of questions for practice or exams

examples.en: The instructor draws the weekly quizzes from a rotating question bank.
examples.zh: 老师每周的小测都从一个轮换的「题库」里抽题。

examples.en: Buy access to the online question bank for extra drilling.
examples.zh: 可以购买在线「题库」权限，多刷一些题。

collocations: a question bank of past items

words.enDefinition: a line of people waiting to be served

examples.en: There was a long queue outside the registrar's office this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上教务处门口「排队」的人特别多。

examples.en: Join the queue early because the counter opens at nine sharp.
examples.zh: 柜台九点整开门，所以要早点来「排队」。

collocations: at the front of the queue

words.enDefinition: a brief question asked politely of a busy person

examples.en: Professor, do you have a minute for a quick question?
examples.zh: 教授，能占一分钟问个「小问题」吗？

examples.en: I emailed a quick question instead of waiting for office hours.
examples.zh: 我没等答疑时间，直接邮件问了个「小问题」。

words.enDefinition: a zone for solo work where talking is kept minimal

examples.en: The quiet study space on level two bans group work and phone calls.
examples.zh: 二楼的「安静自习区」禁止小组讨论和打电话。

examples.en: Find a quiet study space early, because they fill by ten during midterms.
examples.zh: 「安静自习区」要早点去占，期中期间十点前就满了。

words.enDefinition: a phone or web app teachers use to run fast quiz games

examples.en: The professor runs the warm-up through a quiz app with a leaderboard.
examples.zh: 教授用一个带排行榜的「答题App」做课前热身。

examples.en: Download the quiz app before class since registration eats up time.
examples.zh: 课前先下载好「答题App」，注册很费时间。

words.enDefinition: one complete run through an online quiz that gets scored

examples.en: You only get one quiz attempt, so double-check every answer.
examples.zh: 只有一次「答题机会」，每道题都要检查清楚。

examples.en: My second quiz attempt erased my first score, so read the rules carefully.
examples.zh: 第二次「答题机会」会覆盖第一次的成绩，务必看清规则。

words.enDefinition: the minimum members present needed for official club votes

examples.en: We can't vote on the budget tonight because we don't have a quorum.
examples.zh: 今晚到会人数不够「法定人数」，预算没法表决。

examples.en: The constitution sets quorum at one third of active members.
examples.zh: 章程规定「法定人数」为正式会员的三分之一。

words.enDefinition: a ticket drawing at an event where winners get prizes

examples.en: The fundraiser raffle offers prizes donated by local restaurants and shops.
examples.zh: 筹款「抽奖」的奖品由本地餐馆和商铺捐赠。

examples.en: Buy three raffle tickets for five dollars; proceeds fund our service trip.
examples.zh: 「抽奖券」三张五美元，收入用于我们的公益之旅。

words.enDefinition: to improve your grade average over later terms

examples.en: Two elective credits in music appreciation helped raise my GPA by 0.1.
examples.zh: 选了两学分的音乐欣赏，帮我把「绩点拉高」了0.1。

examples.en: Retaking the stats course is the fastest way to raise your GPA this year.
examples.zh: 重修统计课是今年「拉高绩点」最快的办法。

words.enDefinition: to talk in a long, disorganized way without a clear point

examples.en: I rambled for two minutes before the moderator gently asked what my main point was.
examples.zh: 我「东拉西扯」了两分钟，主持人才温和地问我的重点到底是什么。

examples.en: Ranting is rare in seminars, but rambling through an unprepared answer is common.
examples.zh: 研讨课上很少有人发火，但没准备时「说得漫无边际」很常见。

words.enDefinition: a friendly, trusting relationship built over time

examples.en: Office hours are a good way to build rapport with your professors.
examples.zh: 多去答疑是和教授建立「融洽关系」的好办法。

examples.en: Her rapport with students makes even hard lectures easy to follow.
examples.zh: 她与学生的「默契」让再难的课也容易跟上。

collocations: a good rapport with the professor

words.enDefinition: points earned before any scaling or conversion

examples.en: Your raw score is simply the number of questions you answered correctly.
examples.zh: 「原始分」就是你答对题目的数量。

examples.en: The conversion table turns each raw score into a scaled score.
examples.zh: 换算表会把每个「原始分」折算成标准分。

collocations: raw score out of one hundred

words.enDefinition: sign up again for courses after a break or cancellation

examples.en: You must re-enroll within a year or reapply for admission.
examples.zh: 必须在一年内「重新注册」，否则要重新申请入学。

examples.en: She planned to re-enroll for the spring semester after her internship.
examples.zh: 实习结束后，她打算春季学期「重新注册」。

words.enDefinition: a small informal group meeting regularly to discuss chosen texts

examples.en: Our reading group meets every Tuesday to argue about one paper over cheap coffee.
examples.zh: 我们的「读书会」每周二碰头，一边喝便宜咖啡一边争论一篇论文。

examples.en: The philosophy reading group welcomed me even though I had never taken the course.
examples.zh: 尽管我没修过那门课，哲学「读书会」还是欢迎我加入。

words.enDefinition: days before finals with no classes for review

examples.en: Reading period gives us four days to review before finals begin.
examples.zh: 「停课复习期」让我们在期末开考前有四天时间复习。

examples.en: Most professors refuse to set assignment deadlines during reading period.
examples.zh: 大多数教授不会在「停课复习期」安排作业截止。

words.enDefinition: a large formal room with long tables for silent reading

examples.en: The historic reading room with green brass lamps stays open until midnight.
examples.zh: 那间装着绿色铜灯的老式「阅览室」开到午夜。

examples.en: Whispering is fine in the reading room, but calls must go outside.
examples.zh: 在「阅览室」里可以小声说话，打电话必须出去。

words.enDefinition: a mid-term week with no classes, meant for catching up on reading

examples.en: During reading week, the library stays open around the clock.
examples.zh: 「阅读周」期间，图书馆全天开放。

examples.en: Use reading week to outline your term papers, not just to rest.
examples.zh: 「阅读周」要用来拟课程论文提纲，别只顾休息。

words.enDefinition: the process of returning after suspension, withdrawal, or a long break

examples.en: Readmission after academic suspension usually requires a written improvement plan.
examples.zh: 「学业停学」后重新入学，通常需要一份书面改进计划。

examples.en: Submit the readmission application at least two months before the term.
examples.zh: 至少提前两个月提交「重新入学」申请。

words.enDefinition: to answer an argument against it firmly but respectfully

examples.en: Learn to rebut politely; disagreeing with the idea is not attacking the person.
examples.zh: 要学会「礼貌地反驳」：反对观点不等于攻击个人。

examples.en: She learned to rebut politely, citing two studies the panel had ignored.
examples.zh: 她学会了「有礼有节地反驳」，引用了两场座谈被忽视的研究。

words.enDefinition: a response that argues against what someone else claimed

examples.en: Her rebuttal quoted the dataset the original presenter had conveniently skipped.
examples.zh: 她的「反驳」引用了原展示者恰好略过的数据集。

examples.en: Keep your rebuttal short: one concession, one objection, one piece of evidence.
examples.zh: 「反驳」要短：一个让步、一个异议、一条证据。

words.enDefinition: a message demanding an early return because someone else needs it

examples.en: I got a recall notice because a professor put the book on course reserve.
examples.zh: 因为教授把这本书列为课程用书，我收到了「催还通知」。

examples.en: A recall notice shortens your loan, so return the item within ten days.
examples.zh: 收到「催还通知」后借期会缩短，要在十天内归还。

words.enDefinition: a person who greets visitors and answers the phone

examples.en: Tell the receptionist you are here for your two o'clock advising slot.
examples.zh: 告诉「前台接待员」你是来赴两点选课咨询的。

examples.en: The receptionist handed me a form and pointed to the waiting area.
examples.zh: 「接待员」递给我一张表格，指了指等候区。

words.enDefinition: small practice session reviewing lecture problems

examples.en: The weekly recitation walks through problem sets before every quiz.
examples.zh: 每周「习题课」会在测验前带大家过一遍习题。

examples.en: Sign up for a recitation time that leaves your Fridays free.
examples.zh: 选一个让你周五完全空闲的「习题课」时段。

words.enDefinition: a soundproof room for recording presentations or language practice

examples.en: Book the recording booth to practice your Spanish oral exam quietly.
examples.zh: 订一间「录音间」，安静地练西班牙语口语考试。

examples.en: The recording booth comes with a microphone and headphones included.
examples.zh: 「录音间」自带麦克风和耳机。

words.enDefinition: a formal ask for copies of documents from your file

examples.en: Submit a records request if your old school still holds transcripts.
examples.zh: 旧学校还扣着成绩单的话，就提交「档案调取申请」。

examples.en: Peak periods slow every records request by a few days.
examples.zh: 高峰期会拖慢每一份「档案调取申请」几天。

words.enDefinition: a concentrated effort by a club to attract new members

examples.en: The debate society launched a recruitment drive during the first week of classes.
examples.zh: 辩论社在开学第一周启动了「招新活动」。

examples.en: Our recruitment drive doubled the membership compared to last spring.
examples.zh: 我们这次的「招新活动」让会员数比去年春天翻了一倍。

words.enDefinition: a booth a club staffs to meet and recruit new members

examples.en: Our recruitment table outside the dining hall drew a crowd with free stickers.
examples.zh: 我们设在食堂外的「招新摊位」用免费贴纸吸引了不少人围观。

examples.en: Two officers staff the recruitment table during every lunch hour this week.
examples.zh: 本周每个午休时段都有两名干事值守「招新摊位」。

words.enDefinition: approved enrollment below full-time, often for visa reasons

examples.en: With dean's approval, a reduced course load won't violate your visa status.
examples.zh: 经院长批准，「减量选课」不会违反你的签证身份。

examples.en: She requested a reduced course load during her medical recovery.
examples.zh: 身体恢复期间，她申请了「减量选课」。

collocations: reduced course load for medical reasons

words.enDefinition: an encyclopedia or handbook kept in the library for use inside only

examples.en: Reference books like encyclopedias can't be checked out, so plan to photocopy pages.
examples.zh: 百科全书这类「工具书」不能外借，只能复印相关页。

examples.en: Ask the reference desk where the statistics handbooks and other reference books sit.
examples.zh: 到咨询台问一下统计手册等「工具书」放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: the non-circulating section of dictionaries, encyclopedias, and handbooks

examples.en: The reference collection stays beside the reference desk on the second floor.
examples.zh: 「工具书区」设在二楼咨询台旁。

examples.en: Items in the reference collection are stamped non-circulating on the spine.
examples.zh: 「工具书区」的书脊上都盖着不外借章。

words.enDefinition: the service point where librarians help you find sources

examples.en: The reference desk on level two helps you track down peer-reviewed sources.
examples.zh: 二楼的「参考咨询台」能帮你查找同行评审文献。

examples.en: Bring your assignment prompt to the reference desk and they'll suggest databases.
examples.zh: 带着作业要求去「参考咨询台」，馆员会推荐该用哪些数据库。

words.enDefinition: a letter written by a professor supporting your application

examples.en: Ask for each reference letter at least three weeks in advance.
examples.zh: 每封「推荐信」都要至少提前三周去请。

examples.en: A strong reference letter mentions specific projects from your seminars.
examples.zh: 一封有力的「推荐信」会提到你研讨课上的具体项目。

words.enDefinition: the code an office gives you to track your request

examples.en: Quote the reference number in every follow-up email you send.
examples.zh: 你发的每封后续邮件都要写上「受理编号」。

examples.en: The reference number appears on the receipt right after submission.
examples.zh: 提交后，收据上会立刻显示「受理编号」。

words.enDefinition: the message asking a professor to write a reference

examples.en: Send your reference request with your CV and draft statement.
examples.zh: 发「推荐信请求」时附上简历和陈述草稿。

examples.en: A polite reference request gives professors time to write well.
examples.zh: 礼貌的「推荐信请求」能给教授留出写好推荐信的时间。

collocations: follow up on a reference request

words.enDefinition: an official recommendation sending a student to another service

examples.en: The nurse gave me a referral to a physiotherapist off campus.
examples.zh: 护士给我开了「转介单」，推荐我去校外的物理治疗师那里。

examples.en: Ask the front desk for a referral if you need long-term counseling.
examples.zh: 如果你需要长期咨询，请向前台索要「转介」。

words.enDefinition: reload a webpage to get the newest version of it

examples.en: Refresh the page right at noon or the sign-up slots fill instantly.
examples.zh: 中午整点要马上「刷新页面」，不然名额瞬间被抢光。

examples.en: If the poll doesn't appear, refresh the page and wait a few seconds.
examples.zh: 如果投票没弹出来，就「刷新页面」再等几秒。

collocations: refresh the page and try again

words.enDefinition: light food and drinks provided at club events

examples.en: The club budget covers refreshments for every general meeting we hold.
examples.zh: 社团预算为每次全体大会都提供「茶点」。

examples.en: Refreshments will be served in the clubroom after the guest panel.
examples.zh: 嘉宾座谈结束后，「茶点」将在社团活动室供应。

words.enDefinition: to prove that a statement or argument is wrong

examples.en: One archival email refuted the claim the whole seminar had accepted.
examples.zh: 一封档案邮件就「驳倒」了全研讨课都接受的论断。

examples.en: You cannot refute a study by disliking it; show where the data breaks.
examples.zh: 你不喜欢一项研究并不能「驳倒」它，得指出数据究竟哪里有问题。

collocations: refute the argument point by point

words.enDefinition: a gathering where chapters from nearby schools meet and compete

examples.en: At the regional conference, our delegation presented the campus food recovery project.
examples.zh: 在「地区会议」上，我们代表团介绍了校园食物回收项目。

examples.en: The regional conference mixes workshops, awards, and networking dinners for delegates.
examples.zh: 「地区会议」为代表们安排了工作坊、颁奖和社交晚宴。

words.enDefinition: officially sign up for your courses before the term starts

examples.en: Freshmen register for classes right after they meet their advisors.
examples.zh: 大一新生见完导师后就「注册选课」。

examples.en: I couldn't register for classes until I cleared the library hold.
examples.zh: 解除图书馆的欠书冻结后，我才能「注册选课」。

words.enDefinition: office managing enrollment, records, and registration

examples.en: Email the registrar about the grading error before Friday's deadline.
examples.zh: 周五截止日前，把评分错误的问题邮件发给「注册办公室」。

examples.en: The registrar extended enrollment for students affected by the system outage.
examples.zh: 系统故障期间，「注册办公室」为受影响的学生延长了选课时间。

words.enDefinition: officially canceling all your courses before a term

examples.en: A registration cancellation before classes start avoids late penalties entirely.
examples.zh: 开课前提交「取消注册」可以避免逾期罚款。

examples.en: Her registration cancellation freed two seats in the morning lecture.
examples.zh: 她的「取消注册」让上午的大课空出了两个名额。

words.enDefinition: block on your account that stops registration

examples.en: A registration hold appeared because I never returned my lab key.
examples.zh: 因为一直没还实验室钥匙，我的账户被「注册冻结」了。

examples.en: Clear every registration hold before your enrollment appointment time arrives.
examples.zh: 选课预约时段到来之前，务必解除所有「注册冻结」。

words.enDefinition: official window when students may sign up for courses

examples.en: The registration period for spring courses starts in early November.
examples.zh: 春季课程的「选课期」十一月初开始。

examples.en: Don't panic if you miss the first registration period; there's a second round.
examples.zh: 错过第一轮「选课期」也别慌，还有第二轮呢。

words.enDefinition: personal code required before you can register

examples.en: Your advisor gives you a registration PIN after your meeting.
examples.zh: 面谈结束后，导师会给你「注册密码」。

examples.en: I lost my registration PIN and had to visit the registrar's office.
examples.zh: 我弄丢了「注册密码」，只好跑一趟注册办公室。

words.enDefinition: website where students manage course enrollment

examples.en: The registration portal crashed again during the busiest enrollment hour.
examples.zh: 选课最繁忙的时段，「选课系统」又崩了。

examples.en: Bookmark the registration portal on your phone before your appointment.
examples.zh: 选课时段到来前，把「选课系统」收藏到手机里。

words.enDefinition: a request for an exam to be marked again

examples.en: Submit a regrade request if you believe the rubric was misapplied.
examples.zh: 如果你认为评分标准用错了，可以提交「重新判分申请」。

examples.en: The regrade request window closes one week after grades are posted.
examples.zh: 「重新判分申请」的窗口在成绩发布一周后关闭。

words.enDefinition: a form that lets officers get paid back for purchases

examples.en: Attach every receipt to the reimbursement form or the treasurer will return it.
examples.zh: 所有收据都要附在「报销单」上，否则财务会退回。

examples.en: Submit the reimbursement form within two weeks or the claim expires.
examples.zh: 「报销单」要在两周内提交，过期就报不了了。

words.enDefinition: officially restoring a student after dismissal, suspension, or a hold

examples.en: His reinstatement was approved after one semester of documented progress.
examples.zh: 经过一学期有据可查的进步，他的「恢复学籍」申请获批。

examples.en: The reinstatement letter listed the GPA required to stay enrolled.
examples.zh: 「恢复学籍」通知里列出了维持学籍所需的绩点。

words.enDefinition: come back into a meeting after your connection drops

examples.en: My screen froze, so I left and rejoined the meeting within a minute.
examples.zh: 画面卡住之后，我退出并在一分钟内「重新加入会议」。

examples.en: If the audio cuts out, rejoin the meeting before restarting your laptop.
examples.zh: 如果音频断了，先「重新加入会议」，别急着重启电脑。

collocations: rejoin the meeting with new audio

words.enDefinition: a signed form permitting the office to share your information

examples.en: Sign the release form so your parents can discuss your account.
examples.zh: 签了「信息公开授权表」，父母才能查询你的账户。

examples.en: Without a release form, staff cannot even confirm you are enrolled.
examples.zh: 没有「信息公开授权表」，工作人员连你是否在读都不能确认。

words.enDefinition: the course credits you still need before graduating

examples.en: The degree audit shows I only have nine remaining credits.
examples.zh: 学位审核显示我只剩九个「剩余学分」了。

examples.en: She plans to spread her remaining credits across two final terms.
examples.zh: 她打算把「剩余学分」分摊到最后两个学期修完。

words.enDefinition: studying from home or elsewhere through live or recorded classes

examples.en: Remote learning during my first year meant lectures at odd hours.
examples.zh: 大一的「远程学习」意味着上课时间乱七八糟。

examples.en: Some professors keep a remote learning option for students who travel.
examples.zh: 有些教授会为要出差的学生保留「远程学习」选项。

words.enDefinition: online exam supervision through webcam software

examples.en: Remote proctoring flags suspicious eye movements during the online exam.
examples.zh: 「远程监考」会标记在线考试中可疑的视线移动。

examples.en: Test the remote proctoring software a day early to fix browser issues.
examples.zh: 提前一天测试「远程监考」软件，免得浏览器出岔子。

words.enDefinition: extend the borrowing time for a book you keep

examples.en: You can renew a book twice unless another patron has placed a hold.
examples.zh: 只要没人预约，每本书你可以「续借」两次。

examples.en: Renew a book from the app instead of hauling everything back to campus.
examples.zh: 直接在App上「续借」，不用把书大老远搬回学校。

collocations: renew a book before the due date

words.enDefinition: pay dues again to stay in a club another term

examples.en: Don't forget to renew membership before October 1 or you'll be removed from the roster.
examples.zh: 记得在10月1日前「续会籍」，否则你会被移出成员名册。

examples.en: It only takes two minutes online to renew membership for the spring term.
examples.zh: 在网上「续会籍」只要两分钟，春季学期也照旧。

words.enDefinition: extend loan periods through the library website or app

examples.en: Renew online the night before exams instead of carrying the books back.
examples.zh: 考试前一晚「在线续借」就行，不用把书背回去。

examples.en: I forgot to renew online, so the system emailed me an overdue warning.
examples.zh: 我忘了「在线续借」，系统就发来了逾期提醒。

words.enDefinition: pay for a personal storage locker for a fixed period

examples.en: Rent a locker at the gym desk for the whole semester.
examples.zh: 在体育馆前台「租储物柜」，可以租一整个学期。

examples.en: You can rent a locker in the science building for lab coats.
examples.zh: 你可以在科学楼「租储物柜」来放实验服。

collocations: rent a locker for the semester
rent a locker at the gym
rent a locker near your classes

words.enDefinition: take a course again to improve the grade

examples.en: You must repeat a course if you failed a required one.
examples.zh: 必修课挂科了就必须「重修」这门课。

examples.en: Ask your advisor whether it's better to repeat a course or take an elective.
examples.zh: 问问导师是「重修」这门课好，还是改选别的课好。

collocations: repeat a course for a better grade

words.enDefinition: a course taken again to improve an earlier grade

examples.en: Only the higher grade of a repeated course enters the GPA calculation.
examples.zh: 「重修课程」只把更高的那次成绩计入绩点计算。

examples.en: My transcript marks the repeated course with an R flag.
examples.zh: 我的成绩单给「重修课程」标了R记号。

collocations: a repeated course on the transcript

words.enDefinition: to say the same thing again in different words

examples.en: Let me rephrase that, because I garbled the distinction between validity and soundness.
examples.zh: 让我「换个说法」，刚才我把有效性和可靠性的区别说乱了。

examples.en: If the question confuses people, the TA usually rephrases it with a concrete example.
examples.zh: 如果问题让大家困惑，助教通常会「换个说法」并配上具体例子。

words.enDefinition: the charge covering the cost of a lost or ruined item

examples.en: The replacement fee for a hardcover runs about forty dollars plus processing.
examples.zh: 精装书的「赔偿费」大约四十美元，另加手续费。

examples.en: Pay the replacement fee within a month and they refund it if the book turns up.
examples.zh: 一个月内交了「赔偿费」，之后若找到书还能退款。

words.enDefinition: notify the office that something of yours went missing

examples.en: Report a lost item online and the office will email you if it turns up.
examples.zh: 在网上「申报失物」，一旦有人捡到，办公室会邮件通知你。

examples.en: Report a lost item right away and include any serial numbers.
examples.zh: 丢失物品后要立刻「申报失物」，并附上序列号。

collocations: report a lost item to security
the form to report a lost item

words.enDefinition: to return to the class and share your group's results

examples.en: Each breakout room has five minutes to report back with one sentence.
examples.zh: 每个分组讨论室有五分钟「汇报」，只用一句话概括。

examples.en: When we reported back, the moderator wrote our three ideas on the shared screen.
examples.zh: 我们「汇报结果」时，主持人把我们组的三个想法写上了共享屏幕。

words.enDefinition: to formally ask for your exam to be marked again

examples.en: You can request a regrade within one week of the score release.
examples.zh: 出分后一周内可以「申请重新判分」。

examples.en: I requested a regrade because the rubric line about diagrams was skipped.
examples.zh: 我「申请了重判」，因为评分标准里有关图示的那条被漏看了。

collocations: request a regrade within a week
request a regrade through the form
request a regrade for one question

words.enDefinition: course you must complete for your degree

examples.en: Calculus is a required course for every engineering freshman here.
examples.zh: 微积分是这里所有工科大一新生的「必修课」。

examples.en: Check the catalog so no required course slips through your plan.
examples.zh: 查好课程目录，别让任何「必修课」漏出你的计划。

words.enDefinition: move a booked meeting to a different time

examples.en: You can reschedule your appointment if it clashes with your exam.
examples.zh: 如果和考试冲突，你可以「改约时间」。

examples.en: Reschedule an appointment at least a day ahead to avoid a no-show mark.
examples.zh: 「改约时间」至少要提前一天，以免被记爽约。

words.enDefinition: officially cancel an acceptance, usually over failed conditions

examples.en: The university can rescind an offer if final grades collapse.
examples.zh: 期末成绩大跌的话，学校可能「撤回录取」。

examples.en: The school may rescind the offer once falsified grades are confirmed.
examples.zh: 一旦成绩造假被证实，学校可能「撤回录取」。

words.enDefinition: a student paid to help a professor with research

examples.en: As a research assistant, I clean datasets and run surveys for Professor Diaz.
examples.zh: 作为「研究助理」，我为迪亚兹教授清洗数据、发放问卷。

examples.en: Research assistants usually work ten hours a week for tuition support.
examples.zh: 「研究助理」通常每周工作十小时换取学费减免。

words.enDefinition: a full-time staff researcher on a research project

examples.en: The lab's research associate manages the instruments and the datasets.
examples.zh: 实验室的「副研究员」管理仪器和数据集。

examples.en: Research associates at our lab usually hold one-year renewable contracts.
examples.zh: 我们实验室的「副研究员」一般签一年一续的合同。

words.enDefinition: a one-on-one appointment to plan a search strategy for a project

examples.en: Book a thirty-minute research consultation before you start the literature review.
examples.zh: 开始写文献综述前，先约一次30分钟的「研究咨询」。

examples.en: The research consultation showed me how to narrow my topic with Boolean operators.
examples.zh: 「研究咨询」教我用布尔运算符收窄选题。

words.enDefinition: a researcher on a fixed-term contract, often after a PhD

examples.en: Dr. Chen is a research fellow funded by a three-year grant.
examples.zh: 陈博士是由三年期经费资助的「研究员」。

examples.en: Research fellows share the big office with the postdocs down the hall.
examples.zh: 「研究员」与走廊尽头的博士后们合用大办公室。

words.enDefinition: funding awarded to professors for a research project

examples.en: Professor Haddad's new research grant pays for two student assistants.
examples.zh: 哈达德教授的新「科研经费」够雇两名学生助理。

examples.en: Undergraduate research jobs are often funded by a professor's research grant.
examples.zh: 本科生的科研岗位常常由教授的「科研经费」支付。

words.enDefinition: a professor's team of students and researchers

examples.en: Professor Okafor invited me to join her research group next term.
examples.zh: 奥卡福教授邀请我下学期加入她的「课题组」。

examples.en: The research group meets every Friday to discuss new papers.
examples.zh: 「课题组」每周五开会研讨新论文。

words.enDefinition: an online page listing the best databases and sources for one subject

examples.en: The library's research guide for economics lists the key databases by topic.
examples.zh: 图书馆的经济学「研究指南」按主题列出了核心数据库。

examples.en: Start every assignment from the research guide instead of Googling blindly.
examples.zh: 写作业先从「研究指南」入手，别盲目谷歌。

words.enDefinition: the shelving where held items wait under requesters' names

examples.en: Look for your last name on the reserve shelf behind the circulation desk.
examples.zh: 在借还台后面的「预约取书架」上找你的姓氏。

examples.en: Items on the reserve shelf are sorted alphabetically by the requester's surname.
examples.zh: 「预约取书架」上的书按预约人姓氏字母排序。

words.enDefinition: Holding some places in a class for students who meet specified enrollment criteria.

examples.en: The registrar explained that reserved seating keeps some places available for students in the program.
examples.zh: 教务处解释，「预留选课名额」是为该项目的学生保留部分课位。

examples.en: Check the notes on reserved seating before you add the lab to your schedule.
examples.zh: 把实验课加入课表之前，先看「预留选课名额」的说明。

words.enDefinition: create a new password after forgetting or losing the old one

examples.en: I got locked out of the portal and had to reset my password before class.
examples.zh: 我登不进系统，上课前只好「重置密码」。

examples.en: Reset your password through your school email if the portal rejects it.
examples.zh: 如果门户系统不认你的密码，就用学校邮箱去「重置密码」。

words.enDefinition: the final credits that must be earned at your university

examples.en: Transfer students must meet the residency requirement of thirty final credits.
examples.zh: 转学生必须满足最后三十学分在本校修读的「本校修读要求」。

examples.en: The advisor explained the residency requirement to our exchange group.
examples.zh: 导师向我们交换生小组解释了「本校修读要求」。

words.enDefinition: another chance to take an exam you failed

examples.en: An August resit gives failing students one last chance to pass the module.
examples.zh: 八月的「补考」给不及格的学生最后一次通过这门课的机会。

examples.en: If you fail the resit too, you may have to repeat the year.
examples.zh: 如果「补考」还没过，你可能就得重修一年。

words.enDefinition: to finish outstanding work so a temporary grade becomes final

examples.en: You have until March to resolve an incomplete before it lapses to an F.
examples.zh: 你要在三月前「补完未完成成绩」，否则会自动记F。

examples.en: She resolved the incomplete by submitting the missed lab reports in January.
examples.zh: 她一月份补交了缺的实验报告，「了结了缓评」。

collocations: resolve an incomplete by the deadline
resolve an incomplete with the professor

words.enDefinition: an event where every student office hosts an information table

examples.en: The resource fair gathers every student office in one big hall.
examples.zh: 「资源展会」把所有学生服务机构都聚在一个大厅里。

examples.en: I collected tutoring and shuttle schedules at the resource fair.
examples.zh: 我在「资源展会」上拿到了辅导班和班车的时刻表。

words.enDefinition: course limited to certain majors or class years

examples.en: That studio is a restricted course open only to design majors.
examples.zh: 那门工作室课是「限制选课」，只对设计专业开放。

examples.en: Restricted courses open to everyone once juniors finish registering first.
examples.zh: 大三学生优先注册结束后，「限制选课」向所有人开放。

words.enDefinition: the official day exam results are released

examples.en: On results day, the portal crashes every year at nine sharp.
examples.zh: 每年「放榜日」九点整，教务系统都会被挤爆。

examples.en: She barely slept the night before results day, refreshing the portal constantly.
examples.zh: 「放榜日」前夜她几乎没睡，一直刷新教务页面。

words.enDefinition: a second attempt at an exam you chose to redo

examples.en: She signed up for a retake of the standardized test in March.
examples.zh: 她报名三月「重考」那项标准化考试。

examples.en: Universities limit how many times you can retake an exam.
examples.zh: 大学对「重考」次数设有上限。

words.enDefinition: come back to classes when an approved leave ends
acceptedEnVariants: return from a leave of absence

examples.en: Notify the registrar two months before you return from leave.
examples.zh: 「休学返校」前两个月要通知注册办。

examples.en: Students who return from leave keep their original catalog year.
examples.zh: 「休学返校」的学生保留原入学年份的培养方案。

collocations: return from leave in the fall

words.enDefinition: a student coming back after a break or approved leave

examples.en: Returning students can register earlier because their records are already active.
examples.zh: 「返校学生」的档案已经激活，可以更早注册。

examples.en: The readmission guide walks returning students through each required step.
examples.zh: 重新入学指南逐步引导「返校学生」完成各项手续。

words.enDefinition: to reread responses before handing the paper in

examples.en: Save ten minutes to review your answers before the invigilator calls time.
examples.zh: 留出十分钟「检查答案」，再等监考员宣布收卷。

examples.en: Review your answers at least once, since transferred digits are the most common slip.
examples.zh: 至少「检查答案」一遍，誊写错数字是最常见的失误。

collocations: time left to review your answers

words.enDefinition: condensed notes made for final review

examples.en: Condense each lecture into a single page of revision notes.
examples.zh: 把每节课浓缩成一页「复习笔记」。

examples.en: We swapped revision notes to cover the lectures each of us missed.
examples.zh: 我们互换「复习笔记」，补上彼此缺掉的那几节课。

words.enDefinition: a plan dividing revision time across subjects

examples.en: Print a revision timetable and pin it above your desk.
examples.zh: 打印一张「复习计划表」，贴在书桌上方。

examples.en: My revision timetable gives the hardest course the first hour every morning.
examples.zh: 我的「复习计划表」把每天第一个小时留给最难的那门课。

words.enDefinition: a week reserved for studying before exams

examples.en: Revision week starts Monday, and tutors run drop-in review sessions.
examples.zh: 「复习周」周一开始，导师会开设随到随问的答疑。

examples.en: I mapped out every day of revision week so no course gets neglected.
examples.zh: 我把「复习周」的每一天都排好了计划，绝不偏废任何一门课。

collocations: make the most of revision week

words.enDefinition: watch a recorded lecture again to catch missed details

examples.en: I always rewatch the lecture the night before a midterm.
examples.zh: 期中考前一晚，我一定会「回看课程」。

examples.en: Rewatch the lecture where the professor solves the exact problem type on the quiz.
examples.zh: 考前把教授讲同类型题的那节课「回看」一遍。

collocations: rewatch the lecture before the exam

words.enDefinition: travel between campus locations on the free university bus

examples.en: I ride the shuttle to the north campus for my lab twice a week.
examples.zh: 我每周两次「乘坐班车」去北校区上实验课。

examples.en: Students ride the shuttle free with a valid student ID.
examples.zh: 出示有效学生证，就能免费「乘坐班车」。

words.enDefinition: booking a campus room for meetings or club events

examples.en: Room reservations for the clubroom open two weeks in advance on the portal.
examples.zh: 「活动室预订」在系统上提前两周开放。

examples.en: Our room reservation got bumped because a department needed the space.
examples.zh: 我们的「活动室预订」被顶掉了，因为某院系要用那个场地。

words.enDefinition: an informal discussion where everyone sits together as equals

examples.en: The department roundtable lets graduate students question senior professors about research ethics directly.
examples.zh: 系里的「圆桌讨论」让研究生能直接向资深教授提问科研伦理问题。

examples.en: At the careers roundtable, recent graduates shared how they landed their first interviews.
examples.zh: 在求职「圆桌讨论」上，刚毕业的学长学姐分享了拿到第一轮面试的经验。

words.enDefinition: to officially try to become a club officer

examples.en: Sophomores can run for office if they've been active members for a year.
examples.zh: 大二学生只要当过一年正式会员，就可以「竞选职位」。

examples.en: She decided to run for office after leading the fundraiser committee.
examples.zh: 带完筹款小组后，她决定「竞选职位」。

words.enDefinition: to take someone's idea and develop it further yourself

examples.en: When the TA says run with an idea, she means develop it, not just repeat it.
examples.zh: 助教说「顺着想法展开」时，意思是深入发展它，而不是简单重复。

examples.en: The group ran with my half-formed idea and turned it into the final presentation.
examples.zh: 小组「顺着」我那个半成型的想法一路发展，做成了期末展示。

collocations: run with an idea from class
run with it for a while

words.enDefinition: a paid semester or year off for professors to research

examples.en: Professor Ito is on sabbatical this fall, so email her TA instead.
examples.zh: 伊藤教授本学期「学术休假」，有事请邮件联系她的助教。

examples.en: Sabbaticals let professors step away from teaching and finish their books.
examples.zh: 「学术休假」让教授暂离讲台，专心写书。

words.enDefinition: a staff walk-along service for students traveling at night

examples.en: Call campus security for a safety escort if you leave the library late.
examples.zh: 晚上离开图书馆太晚时，可以叫校园保安提供「安全护送」。

examples.en: The safety escort service walks students to dorms until 2 a.m.
examples.zh: 「安全护送服务」凌晨两点前都会陪学生走回宿舍。

words.enDefinition: a staff member responsible for workplace safety rules

examples.en: The lab's safety officer runs the annual goggles check every fall.
examples.zh: 实验室的「安全员」每年秋天检查护目镜。

examples.en: Ask the safety officer before storing anything in the fume hood.
examples.zh: 往通风橱里放东西前，先问过「安全员」。

collocations: report hazards to the safety officer

words.enDefinition: the opening greeting line of a letter or email

examples.en: The salutation sets the tone for your entire email to a professor.
examples.zh: 「称呼语」决定了给教授整封邮件的语气。
