examples.en: Choose a formal salutation when emailing a professor for the first time.
examples.zh: 第一次给教授写邮件，要选正式的「称呼语」。

words.enDefinition: to rescue a failing course grade before the term ends

examples.en: There is still time to salvage your grade if you ace both remaining labs.
examples.zh: 只要剩下两次实验都拿A，还来得及「挽救成绩」。

examples.en: Extra credit offered at the end helped me salvage my grade in chemistry.
examples.zh: 期末推出的加分项帮我「挽救了化学成绩」。

words.enDefinition: a booking made for later on the same day

examples.en: Call at 8 a.m. if you want a same-day appointment.
examples.zh: 想约「当日预约」的话，早上八点就打电话。

examples.en: Same-day appointments at the health center go quickly in flu season.
examples.zh: 流感季校医院的「当日预约」很快就约满了。

words.enDefinition: the measurable progress toward a degree that financial aid requires

examples.en: Financial aid continues only while you maintain satisfactory academic progress.
examples.zh: 只有保持「学业进展达标」，助学金才会继续发放。

examples.en: Dropping below satisfactory academic progress puts your aid package on hold.
examples.zh: 一旦低于「学业进度达标」线，你的资助套餐就会被暂停。

words.enDefinition: store an unfinished post or message before you submit it

examples.en: Save a draft of your discussion post so the site can't eat it.
examples.zh: 讨论帖先「保存草稿」，免得网站把内容吞掉。

examples.en: I always save a draft before submitting anything on the LMS.
examples.zh: 在系统上交东西之前，我都会先「保存草稿」。

collocations: save a draft of your post

words.enDefinition: a raw score adjusted onto a uniform scale

examples.en: The scaled score smooths out small differences between exam versions.
examples.zh: 「折算分」会抹平各试卷版本之间的细微难度差异。

examples.en: A raw score of forty-two became a scaled score of one hundred and twenty.
examples.zh: 四十二分的原始分折算后是一百二十分的「折算分」。

words.enDefinition: a copier feature that emails scanned pages as PDF attachments

examples.en: Use scan-to-email on the copier to save chapters without paying for prints.
examples.zh: 用复印机的「扫描到邮箱」功能，把章节存下来还不用花打印费。

examples.en: Scan-to-email failed until I typed my full campus address without typos.
examples.zh: 「扫描到邮箱」一直失败，最后发现是校园邮箱地址打错了。

words.enDefinition: a machine-read bubble sheet used in US exams

examples.en: Use a number two pencil on the scantron form, never a pen.
examples.zh: 「机读答题卡」一定要用2B铅笔填涂，千万别用钢笔。

examples.en: He filled in the wrong student number on his scantron form.
examples.zh: 他在「机读答题卡」上涂错了学号。

words.enDefinition: book a fixed meeting slot with an office or advisor

examples.en: Schedule an appointment online because walk-ins wait longest at noon.
examples.zh: 尽量在线「预约办理」，中午现场取号等得最久。

examples.en: Schedule an appointment with the registrar before the deadline rush.
examples.zh: 赶在截止日高峰之前向注册办「预约办理」。

words.enDefinition: online tool that generates possible timetables

examples.en: The schedule builder automatically blocks out any sections that overlap.
examples.zh: 「排课工具」会自动剔除有冲突的课段。

examples.en: Save two versions in the schedule builder before your enrollment window opens.
examples.zh: 「选课窗口」开放前，先在排课工具里存好两套方案。

words.enDefinition: the registrar's searchable listing of every section and time

examples.en: The schedule of classes updates nightly as seats fill and open.
examples.zh: 随着名额变动，「课程安排表」每晚都会更新。

examples.en: Filter the schedule of classes by campus before choosing sections.
examples.zh: 选课前，先按校区筛选「课程安排表」。

words.enDefinition: planned downtime when an online system is temporarily unavailable

examples.en: The portal was down all night for scheduled maintenance before enrollment.
examples.zh: 选课前夜，门户系统整晚都在「系统维护」。

examples.en: The LMS warned us about scheduled maintenance this Sunday from two to four.
examples.zh: 系统提示本周日两点到四点进行「系统维护」。

words.enDefinition: the GPA from science courses, tracked for medical school applications

examples.en: Medical schools weigh your science GPA more than your overall one.
examples.zh: 医学院看「理科绩点」比看总绩点更重。

examples.en: Retaking gen chem lifted my science GPA from 3.0 to 3.4.
examples.zh: 重修普通化学把我的「理科绩点」从3.0提到了3.4。

words.enDefinition: a calculator with advanced functions allowed in exams

examples.en: Only a scientific calculator without graphing functions is allowed in this exam.
examples.zh: 这场考试只允许使用不带绘图功能的「科学计算器」。

examples.en: Bring spare batteries for your scientific calculator on exam day.
examples.zh: 考试当天记得给「科学计算器」带上备用电池。

words.enDefinition: the official document listing standardized test results

examples.en: Order an extra score report for each university on your list.
examples.zh: 给你申请名单上的每所大学都订一份额外的「成绩报告」。

examples.en: The official score report breaks down your performance by section.
examples.zh: 官方「成绩报告」会分部分列出你的表现。

words.enDefinition: loose paper for rough working during an exam

examples.en: Do your calculations on the scratch paper, not in the question booklet.
examples.zh: 计算过程写在「草稿纸」上，别写在试卷册里。

examples.en: The proctor collected everyone's scratch paper along with the finished exams.
examples.zh: 收卷时，监考人员把大家的「草稿纸」一并收走了。

words.enDefinition: a video that captures exactly what happened on a screen

examples.en: I made a screen recording to show the TA exactly where the portal failed.
examples.zh: 我录了段「屏幕录制」，让助教看清门户到底哪一步出错。

examples.en: The professor posted a screen recording walking through the homework setup.
examples.zh: 教授上传了一段「屏幕录制」，演示怎么配置作业环境。

words.enDefinition: broadcasting what's on your display to the rest of the call

examples.en: Screen sharing stopped working right when my part of the presentation started.
examples.zh: 轮到我讲的时候，「屏幕共享」偏偏坏了。

examples.en: Turn on screen sharing sound if your slides have video clips.
examples.zh: 幻灯片里有视频的话，记得开「屏幕共享」的声音。

words.enDefinition: a low-stakes practice game between members of the same club

examples.en: Saturday scrimmages let new players test skills before the season starts.
examples.zh: 周六的「练习赛」让新人在赛季开始前检验技术。

examples.en: We ran a scrimmage against the second team to try new formations.
examples.zh: 我们和二队打了一场「练习赛」，试验新阵型。

words.enDefinition: a transcript inside an unopened envelope stamped by the registrar

examples.en: Keep the sealed transcript unopened or universities will reject it.
examples.zh: 「密封成绩单」不要拆封，否则学校会拒收。

examples.en: Bring one sealed transcript to the scholarship interview on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五的奖学金面试要带一份「密封成绩单」。

words.enDefinition: a panel that interviews candidates for a faculty job

examples.en: The search committee invited three candidates to give job talks.
examples.zh: 「招聘委员会」邀请了三位候选人来做求职讲座。

examples.en: Grad students can attend the open sessions with the search committee.
examples.zh: 研究生可以参加与「招聘委员会」的公开见面环节。

words.enDefinition: how many free seats remain, often shown live in an app

examples.en: Check seat availability in the app before making the trip across campus.
examples.zh: 过来之前先在App上查一下「座位余量」。

examples.en: Seat availability dropped to five free desks by noon during reading week.
examples.zh: 读书周中午时，「座位余量」只剩下五个空位。

words.enDefinition: claiming seats with belongings while leaving them empty for hours

examples.en: Seat hogging with empty backpacks got called out in the library newsletter.
examples.zh: 用空书包「占座」的行为被图书馆通讯点名了。

examples.en: Staff now clear seat hogging after thirty minutes of unattended desks.
examples.zh: 现在「占座」超过三十分钟，馆员就会清桌。

words.enDefinition: the assigned seat printed for your exam

examples.en: Your seat number is printed at the top of the admission ticket.
examples.zh: 你的「座位号」印在准考证的顶端。

examples.en: Find your seat number on the list posted outside the exam hall.
examples.zh: 「座位号」可以在考场外张贴的名单上查到。

words.enDefinition: an extra screen connected to your laptop for more workspace

examples.en: I put the lecture on my second monitor and my notes on the laptop.
examples.zh: 我把讲课画面放到「外接显示器」上，笔记本屏幕用来记笔记。

examples.en: A second monitor makes split-screen note-taking during lectures way easier.
examples.zh: 有「外接显示器」，边听课边记笔记轻松多了。

collocations: drag the slides to the second monitor

words.enDefinition: one scheduled group meeting of a course

examples.en: Section 002 of the lecture meets Tuesdays and Thursdays at ten.
examples.zh: 这门大课的「002课段」在周二和周四上午十点上课。

examples.en: Pick a section whose discussion times don't clash with labs.
examples.zh: 选一个讨论时间不与实验课冲突的「课段」。

words.enDefinition: digits identifying which meeting group you join

examples.en: Registration asks for the CRN, not just the section number.
examples.zh: 注册时要输入课程号，不能只填「课段编号」。

examples.en: The section number tells you which instructor and room to expect.
examples.zh: 「课段编号」告诉你对应的授课老师和教室。

words.enDefinition: a staffed post where visitors sign in

examples.en: Sign in at the security desk before entering the research wing.
examples.zh: 进研究区前，先在「安保台」登记。

examples.en: Leave your visitor pass at the security desk when you leave.
examples.zh: 离开时，把访客证交回「安保台」。

collocations: sign in at the security desk
check in at the security desk

words.enDefinition: a person hired to watch and guard a building

examples.en: The security guard checks student IDs at the library entrance.
examples.zh: 「保安」在图书馆入口查验学生证。

examples.en: Show your ID card to the security guard after midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜后进楼要向「保安」出示证件。

collocations: show your ID to the guard

words.enDefinition: to fully agree with someone about something

examples.en: My lab partner and I never see eye to eye on how to frame the introduction.
examples.zh: 我和实验搭档在引言怎么写上从来「看法不一致」。

examples.en: Once she explained her dataset, we finally saw eye to eye on the method.
examples.zh: 等她讲清数据集，我们终于在这一方法上「意见一致」。

collocations: see eye to eye on policy
see eye to eye with someone

words.enDefinition: a professor's request to talk privately after a lecture

examples.en: If your quiz score worries you, see me after class.
examples.zh: 小测成绩让你担心的话，「课后来找我」。

examples.en: See me after class and we'll sort out your enrollment error.
examples.zh: 「课后来找我」，咱们一起把选课错误改掉。

collocations: asked to see me after class
see me after class on Friday

words.enDefinition: a campus walk you complete alone using a printed map

examples.en: Grab a map from the booth and do the self-guided tour.
examples.zh: 在展台拿一张地图，自己完成「自助参观」。

examples.en: The self-guided tour takes about forty minutes at a relaxed pace.
examples.zh: 「自助参观」放慢脚步走大约四十分钟。

words.enDefinition: a course unit you complete on your own schedule online

examples.en: Each self-paced module has a checkpoint quiz at the end.
examples.zh: 每个「自定进度模块」结尾都有一道检查测验。

examples.en: Finish the self-paced module on lab safety before your first session.
examples.zh: 第一次实验课前要先完成实验安全的「自定进度模块」。

words.enDefinition: the GPA you type into an application before transcripts arrive

examples.en: Enter your self-reported GPA carefully, because it must match the transcript later.
examples.zh: 填报「自报绩点」要仔细，之后必须和成绩单对得上。

examples.en: My self-reported GPA was 3.42, rounded from the official transcript number.
examples.zh: 我的「自报绩点」是3.42，由成绩单上的官方数字四舍五入而来。

words.enDefinition: the GPA earned within a single term on its own

examples.en: My semester GPA was 3.8, though my cumulative is still 3.3.
examples.zh: 我这学期「学期绩点」3.8，不过累计的还是3.3。

examples.en: One 2.4 semester GPA barely dented the cumulative I had built up.
examples.zh: 一个2.4的「学期绩点」几乎没撼动我攒起来的累计绩点。

words.enDefinition: a long loan that lasts the entire term without renewals

examples.en: Grad students get semester loans on most books in their own subject area.
examples.zh: 研究生对本专业大部分图书享有「学期借阅」。

examples.en: The semester loan covers the whole spring term, including reading week and break.
examples.zh: 「学期借阅」覆盖整个春季学期，包括读书周和假期。

words.enDefinition: a small discussion class where students present and debate readings

examples.en: In our Friday seminar, each student presents one chapter and then leads the debate.
examples.zh: 周五的「研讨课」上，每位学生讲一章内容，然后主持讨论。

examples.en: My seminar has only eight students, so hiding silently in the back row is impossible.
examples.zh: 我的「研讨课」只有八个学生，想安静地躲在后排根本不可能。

words.enDefinition: tap a quick emoji like a thumbs-up that floats on screen

examples.en: Just send a reaction instead of unmuting when you agree with an answer.
examples.zh: 同意别人观点时发个「表情反馈」就行，不用开麦。

examples.en: Everyone sent a reaction when the professor announced the quiz was canceled.
examples.zh: 教授宣布测验取消时，所有人都发了「表情反馈」。

words.enDefinition: long-serving professors with the highest ranks

examples.en: Senior faculty teach the advanced seminars and supervise most theses.
examples.zh: 高阶研讨课和大多数论文都由「资深教员」负责。

examples.en: Senior faculty members vote on the department's new course proposals.
examples.zh: 新课程提案由「资深教员」投票表决。

words.enDefinition: an experienced teaching-focused rank below professor

examples.en: Senior lecturers here carry most of the first-year teaching load.
examples.zh: 这里大一的授课大多落在「高级讲师」身上。

examples.en: Our senior lecturer also runs the department's weekly writing clinic.
examples.zh: 我们系的「高级讲师」还主持每周写作辅导。

words.enDefinition: a long research paper written during the final year

examples.en: Writing a senior thesis takes two semesters of independent research.
examples.zh: 写「毕业论文」需要两个学期的独立研究。

examples.en: Her senior thesis on urban birds won the department prize.
examples.zh: 她关于城市鸟类的「毕业论文」获得了系里的大奖。

collocations: a senior thesis on urban ecology

words.enDefinition: a week of celebration events for graduating seniors

examples.en: Senior week includes a boat cruise, barbecues, and the yearbook signing.
examples.zh: 「毕业生周」包括游船、烧烤和纪念册签名活动。

examples.en: Buy senior week passes early because events sell out fast.
examples.zh: 「毕业生周」的通行证要早点买，活动很快售罄。

words.enDefinition: a trained animal allowed everywhere to assist a disabled student

examples.en: Service animals are allowed inside classrooms and the dining hall.
examples.zh: 「服务犬」可以带进教室和食堂。

examples.en: Register your service animal with the disability services office before move-in.
examples.zh: 入住宿舍前，先在残障学生服务处登记你的「服务犬」。

words.enDefinition: a staffed window for submitting forms and picking up items

examples.en: Take your form to the service counter on the second floor.
examples.zh: 把表格拿到二楼的「服务柜台」。

examples.en: The service counter closes at four, so come before your afternoon class.
examples.zh: 「服务柜台」四点关门，要赶在下午上课前过去。

words.enDefinition: a record where volunteers log their community service hours

examples.en: Volunteers enter every shift into the service log for verification at graduation.
examples.zh: 志愿者要把每个班次录入「服务时长记录表」，毕业核验时要用。

examples.en: The coordinator audits the service log monthly to catch missing signatures.
examples.zh: 负责人每月核查一次「服务时长记录表」，以防漏签。

words.enDefinition: an organized activity where members help the local community

examples.en: This month's service project is repainting the community center's reading room.
examples.zh: 这个月的「志愿服务项目」是粉刷社区中心的阅览室。

examples.en: Each semester ends with a service project the whole club joins.
examples.zh: 每学期都以一个人人参与的「服务项目」收尾。

words.enDefinition: automatic logout after a page sits inactive for too long

examples.en: A session timeout kicked me out mid-quiz, but my answers were saved.
examples.zh: 测验做到一半「会话超时」把我踢了出去，好在答案都保存了。

examples.en: I saved the essay draft before the session timeout could close the page.
examples.zh: 我在「会话超时」关掉页面前保存了论文草稿。

words.enDefinition: to score highest and become the benchmark for class scaling
acceptedEnVariants: set the curve on the exam

examples.en: Kevin set the curve on the orgo midterm with a 98.
examples.zh: 凯文有机化学期中考了98分，「定下了曲线基准」。

examples.en: Nobody has set the curve in this weeder class for three semesters.
examples.zh: 这门筛选课已经三个学期没人「定下曲线基准」了。

collocations: set the curve on the midterm
the student who set the curve

words.enDefinition: the volunteers who arrange chairs, tables, and gear before an event

examples.en: The setup crew arrives ninety minutes before doors to arrange chairs and banners.
examples.zh: 「布场小组」在开门前九十分钟到场，摆好桌椅和横幅。

examples.en: Volunteers can choose between the setup crew and the cleanup team.
examples.zh: 志愿者可以在「布场小组」和收尾小组之间选一班。

words.enDefinition: sit at someone else's large table when free seats run out

examples.en: Mind if I share a table? Every single desk upstairs is full.
examples.zh: 我能「拼个桌」吗？楼上所有位子都满了。

examples.en: Strangers quietly share a table during finals without ever talking.
examples.zh: 期末时陌生人安静地「拼桌」，彼此一句话也不说。

words.enDefinition: show your computer display to everyone else in the meeting

examples.en: Share your screen when you present so we can follow your slides.
examples.zh: 展示时请「共享屏幕」，方便大家跟着看幻灯片。

examples.en: The TA shared her screen and walked us through the citation format.
examples.zh: 助教「共享屏幕」，带我们过了一遍引用格式。

collocations: share your screen during the presentation

words.enDefinition: the floor and section where a specific item is shelved

examples.en: The catalog lists the shelf location as Level 3, QA range, aisle twelve.
examples.zh: 目录显示这本书的「馆藏架位」在三楼QA区第12排。

examples.en: Copy the shelf location into your phone notes before climbing the stairs.
examples.zh: 爬楼梯前，先把「架位信息」记到手机备忘里。

words.enDefinition: brief written replies of a few sentences

examples.en: Section B has six short answer questions worth five points each.
examples.zh: B部分有六道「简答题」，每题五分。

examples.en: For short answer questions, give the definition plus one clear example.
examples.zh: 答「简答题」时，给出定义再加一个清晰的例子。

words.enDefinition: quiet someone with a sharp sh sound, as librarians famously do

examples.en: We got shushed within a minute of laughing on the silent floor.
examples.zh: 在静音楼层刚笑出声，一分钟内就被人「嘘」了。

examples.en: The librarian shushed two freshmen for calling across the reading room.
examples.zh: 图书馆员对在阅览室里喊话的两个新生发出了「嘘」声。

words.enDefinition: the fixed path a campus bus follows between stops

examples.en: The shuttle route covers the dorms, the gym, and the main quad.
examples.zh: 这条「班车路线」覆盖宿舍、体育馆和主广场。

examples.en: They added a weekend shuttle route to the shopping district.
examples.zh: 学校新增了一条开往商业区的周末「班车路线」。

words.enDefinition: the timetable listing departure times for every campus bus

examples.en: The shuttle schedule always changes during summer and winter breaks.
examples.zh: 暑假和寒假期间，「班车时刻表」会有调整。

examples.en: Screenshot the shuttle schedule because not every stop posts departure times.
examples.zh: 截图存下「班车时刻表」，因为不是每个站都张贴班次。

words.enDefinition: a free bus loop connecting dorms, campuses, and stations

examples.en: The free shuttle service runs every ten minutes between campuses.
examples.zh: 免费「班车服务」每十分钟往返校区一趟。

examples.en: The shuttle service adds extra late-night routes during exam weeks.
examples.zh: 考试周期间，「班车服务」会增开深夜班次。

words.enDefinition: a marked bus stop where campus shuttles pick up passengers

examples.en: The nearest shuttle stop to the dorm is by the north gate.
examples.zh: 离宿舍最近的「班车站」在北门旁边。

examples.en: Check the app for live departure times at each shuttle stop.
examples.zh: 在应用上查看每个「班车站」的实时发车时间。

words.enDefinition: a live map showing where each campus bus currently is

examples.en: The shuttle tracker shows the next bus arriving in four minutes.
examples.zh: 「班车实时追踪」显示下一班车四分钟后到站。

examples.en: Check the shuttle tracker before you walk to the stop in the rain.
examples.zh: 下雨天走去车站前，先看一下「班车实时追踪」。

words.enDefinition: a private chat between two people during a larger discussion

examples.en: The moderator paused and waited until every side conversation had died down completely.
examples.zh: 主持人停下不语，直到每场「开小会」都彻底安静下来。

examples.en: A side conversation about weekend plans kept pulling our attention away from the panel.
examples.zh: 旁边有人「开小会」聊周末计划，一直分散着我们听座谈的注意力。

words.enDefinition: a list where visitors write their names

examples.en: Write your name on the sign-in sheet at the department office.
examples.zh: 到系办在「签到表」上写下名字。

examples.en: Attendance at the review session is tracked with a sign-in sheet.
examples.zh: 复习课用「签到表」记录出勤。

collocations: sign-in sheet at the front desk

words.enDefinition: a whole floor where no talking or calls are allowed at all

examples.en: Floor five is a silent floor, so take phone calls downstairs in the lobby.
examples.zh: 五楼是「静音楼层」，要打电话请下楼去大厅。

examples.en: I revise on the silent floor because even whispers get you stares there.
examples.zh: 我在「静音楼层」复习，那里连耳语都会招来白眼。

words.enDefinition: a formal sign-off word for letters and emails

examples.en: End formal requests to the dean with Sincerely and your full name.
examples.zh: 给院长的正式申请以「Sincerely」加全名结尾。

examples.en: Sincerely sounds much more formal than Cheers in academic emails.
examples.zh: 学术邮件里，「Sincerely」比Cheers更正式。

words.enDefinition: to attend and attempt a formal exam

examples.en: You will sit the exam in the main hall with around three hundred others.
examples.zh: 你将在主考场「应考」，同场大约还有三百人。

examples.en: Students who sit the exam in August receive their results in September.
examples.zh: 八月「应考」的学生九月拿到成绩。

words.enDefinition: to avoid saying which side you support in a debate

examples.en: Sitting on the fence protects you in some classrooms but looks evasive here.
examples.zh: 在某些课堂里「不表态」是自我保护，在这里却显得回避。

examples.en: The professor called on me precisely because I was sitting on the fence again.
examples.zh: 教授偏偏点我，正因为我又一次「骑墙不表态」。

collocations: sit on the fence during debates
accused of sitting on the fence

words.enDefinition: to read fast for main points, skipping the details

examples.en: Skimming the case before class is risky when the professor cold-calls on details.
examples.zh: 教授会就细节随机点名，所以课前只「略读」案例风险很大。

examples.en: If you are short on time, skim the introduction and the conclusion first.
examples.zh: 时间不够的话，先「略读」引言和结论部分。

words.enDefinition: the officer who plans mixers, formals, and fun events

examples.en: The social chair booked a rooftop venue for the spring formal.
examples.zh: 「文娱负责人」为春季舞会订到了一个屋顶场地。

examples.en: As social chair, he plans game nights and one big mixer each term.
examples.zh: 作为「文娱负责人」，他每学期策划游戏之夜和一场大型联谊。

words.enDefinition: a British term for a student club around a shared interest

examples.en: The Economics Society hosts a weekly talk and ends every term with a formal.
examples.zh: 经济学「社团」每周举办讲座，学期末还会办正装舞会。

examples.en: Joining two or three societies is the fastest way to make friends here.
examples.zh: 在这里加入两三个「社团」是交到朋友最快的方式。

words.enDefinition: teaching by probing questions until students can defend their reasoning

examples.en: Law professors use the Socratic method, questioning one student until the argument holds up.
examples.zh: 法学教授采用「苏格拉底问答法」，连续追问一个学生直到论证站得住脚。

examples.en: The Socratic method scared me at first, but it taught me to reason out loud.
examples.zh: 「苏格拉底问答法」起初让我害怕，但它教会我边说边推理。

words.enDefinition: a comfortably earned B grade, respectable but not spectacular

examples.en: A solid B in thermodynamics will not stop me from graduating with honors.
examples.zh: 热力学拿个「稳稳的B」不会妨碍我以荣誉毕业。

examples.en: I walked out of the final expecting a solid B, not an A minus.
examples.zh: 考完期末我本以为能稳拿个「B」，没想到会是A减。

words.enDefinition: a female social organization with chapters at many universities

examples.en: Sorority recruitment happens in the fall and involves rounds of interviews.
examples.zh: 「姐妹会」纳新在秋季进行，要经过好几轮面试。

examples.en: Her sorority pairs older members with freshmen as study buddies.
examples.zh: 她所在的「姐妹会」安排老成员与大一新生结对学习。

words.enDefinition: a charity kitchen serving free meals to people in need

examples.en: Our club serves lunch at the neighborhood soup kitchen every first Sunday.
examples.zh: 我们社团每月第一个周日都在社区「救济厨房」帮忙打饭。

examples.en: Volunteering at a soup kitchen counts double hours during exam weeks.
examples.zh: 考试周在「救济厨房」做志愿可以记双倍时长。

collocations: serve meals at the soup kitchen

words.enDefinition: to say something at the wrong moment or overstepping

examples.en: I worried I had spoken out of turn by challenging the guest speaker's data.
examples.zh: 我质疑了外请讲者的数据，担心自己「说话不合时宜」。

examples.en: The professor laughed it off and said nobody speaks out of turn in her class.
examples.zh: 教授一笑置之，说在她的课上不存在「说话失当」这回事。

collocations: speak out of turn in class
afraid of speaking out of turn

words.enDefinition: to say honestly what you think, even if unpopular

examples.en: Seminars reward students who speak their mind politely, not those who stay safe.
examples.zh: 研讨课奖励的是「有礼有节说出真实想法」的学生，而不是明哲保身的人。

examples.en: It took a whole term before I felt free to speak my mind about the theory.
examples.zh: 过了整整一学期，我才敢对这套理论「畅所欲言」。

collocations: encourage students to speak their minds

words.enDefinition: a meeting layout that fills the screen with whoever is talking

examples.en: I use speaker view during lectures so the professor's slides stay big.
examples.zh: 听课时我用「演讲者视图」，画面更大更清楚。

examples.en: Speaker view jumps between faces whenever someone coughs into their mic.
examples.zh: 谁对着麦克风咳嗽一声，「演讲者视图」就切到谁。

words.enDefinition: a protected area holding rare, old, or valuable materials

examples.en: Special collections on the basement level stores the university archives from 1892.
examples.zh: 地下层的「特藏部」保存着1892年起的校史档案。

examples.en: You need gloves and registration to handle manuscripts in special collections.
examples.zh: 在「特藏部」翻阅手稿需要登记并戴手套。

words.enDefinition: adjusted assessment after illness affects your exam performance

examples.en: Apply for special consideration if food poisoning struck on exam day.
examples.zh: 考试当天食物中毒的话，可以申请「特殊情况照顾」。

examples.en: Special consideration cannot change your answers, but it may add marks or allow a resit.
examples.zh: 「特殊情况照顾」改不了你的答案，但可能加分或安排补考。

words.enDefinition: one-time course on a current or niche subject

examples.en: This semester's special topics course covers AI ethics and society.
examples.zh: 本学期的「专题课程」讲 AI 伦理与社会。

examples.en: Special topics courses change every term, so grab them while offered.
examples.zh: 「专题课程」每学期都不同，开设时要抓紧选。

words.enDefinition: an error in how a word is spelled

examples.en: Minor spelling mistakes rarely cost points here unless they change the meaning.
examples.zh: 在这里，小的「拼写错误」一般不扣分，除非改变了词义。

examples.en: The examiner circled every spelling mistake on my essay in red pen.
examples.zh: 考官用红笔圈出了我文章里的每一处「拼写错误」。

words.enDefinition: binding a report with a plastic coil so it lies flat

examples.en: Add spiral binding to your lab report for three dollars at the print desk.
examples.zh: 在打印台花三美元给实验报告加个「螺旋装订」。

examples.en: Spiral binding keeps the pages flat, which makes grading easier.
examples.zh: 「螺旋装订」能让书页摊平，老师批改更方便。

words.enDefinition: divide presentation slides among group members so everyone prepares a part

examples.en: We split the slides three ways and rehearsed over Zoom on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我们把幻灯片「分成三份」，周六在Zoom上排练。

examples.en: Split the slides early so nobody makes two the night before.
examples.zh: 早点「分工做幻灯片」，免得有人拖到前一晚赶两张。

collocations: split the slides among four people

words.enDefinition: the person chosen to present a group's conclusions

examples.en: Each breakout room picks a spokesperson to summarize its answer to everyone.
examples.zh: 每个分组讨论室推选一名「发言代表」，向全班总结答案。

examples.en: Nobody wanted to be spokesperson, so we drew lots and I lost.
examples.zh: 没人想当「发言代表」，我们抽签，结果抽中了我。

words.enDefinition: the one-week March holiday in the middle of spring term

examples.en: Offices run limited hours during spring break, so submit forms early.
examples.zh: 「春假」期间办公时间缩短，表格要尽早交。

examples.en: She spent spring break at the library finishing her lab report.
examples.zh: 「春假」她泡在图书馆赶实验报告。

words.enDefinition: a dress-up dance party a club throws near year's end

examples.en: Tickets for the spring formal sell out within a week every April.
examples.zh: 每年四月，「春季舞会」的门票一周内就售罄。

examples.en: The spring formal included a photo corner and a small awards ceremony.
examples.zh: 「春季舞会」还设了拍照角和小型颁奖环节。

words.enDefinition: the shelved areas where most of the collection is stored

examples.en: The stacks on level four get warm and quiet by mid-afternoon.
examples.zh: 四楼「书库」到了下午会又暖和又安静。

examples.en: Wander the stacks near your subject and you'll always discover something useful.
examples.zh: 在本专业的「书库」里逛逛，总能发现有用的书。

words.enDefinition: a searchable list of university employees and contacts

examples.en: Find your professor's email address in the campus staff directory.
examples.zh: 在校园「教职工名录」里查教授的邮箱。

examples.en: The staff directory lists every professor's office and phone extension.
examples.zh: 「教职工名录」列出了每位教授的办公室和分机。

words.enDefinition: a person employed by the university in a non-teaching job

examples.en: A staff member at the front desk can print your enrollment letter.
examples.zh: 前台的「工作人员」能帮你打印在读证明。

examples.en: Staff members wear lanyards so you can tell them apart from students.
examples.zh: 「工作人员」都挂着工牌，一眼就能和学生区分。

collocations: staff member at the front desk

words.enDefinition: the students who handle sets, lights, and sound for shows

examples.en: Join the stage crew if you'd rather build sets than perform on them.
examples.zh: 如果你更想搭布景而不是登台，就来加入「舞台工作组」。

examples.en: The stage crew arrives three hours early to test lights and microphones.
examples.zh: 「舞台组」提前三小时到场调试灯光和麦克风。

words.enDefinition: a uniform exam scored the same way for everyone

examples.en: Many international students take a standardized test like the TOEFL before applying.
examples.zh: 许多留学生在申请前要考托福这类「标准化考试」。

examples.en: Your standardized test scores arrive at universities together with your application.
examples.zh: 你的「标准化考试」成绩会随申请材料一起寄给大学。

words.enDefinition: to found a new registered student organization on campus

examples.en: To start a club, you need five members, a constitution, and a faculty advisor.
examples.zh: 「创建社团」需要五名成员、一份章程和一位指导老师。

examples.en: She decided to start a club for board game design after transfer week.
examples.zh: 转学周过后，她决定和朋友「创建社团」，专注桌游设计。

words.enDefinition: open a new topic for others to reply to on a forum

examples.en: Start a thread instead of burying your question under someone else's.
examples.zh: 有疑问就「发起新帖」，别埋在别人的帖子下面。

examples.en: She started a thread to find partners for the group presentation.
examples.zh: 她「发了个新帖」找小组展示的搭档。

collocations: start a thread in the forum

words.enDefinition: an essay explaining your goals for graduate study

examples.en: Draft your statement of purpose early and revise it with a tutor.
examples.zh: 尽早起草「目的陈述」，并请辅导老师修改。

examples.en: The statement of purpose should connect your coursework to future research.
examples.zh: 「目的陈述」要把你的课程学习与未来研究联系起来。

words.enDefinition: keep your microphone switched off when you're not speaking

examples.en: Stay muted during the guest lecture and type questions in the chat.
examples.zh: 嘉宾讲课时请「保持静音」，问题打在聊天区。

examples.en: I stay muted by default because my keyboard is incredibly loud.
examples.zh: 我默认「保持静音」，因为键盘声实在太响了。

words.enDefinition: leave your desk briefly during a class or meeting

examples.en: Step away during the break because nobody expects you to sit for two hours.
examples.zh: 休息时可以「暂时离开」，没人要求你连坐两小时。

examples.en: I stepped away for one minute and missed the attendance poll.
examples.zh: 我就「离开」了一分钟，结果错过了签到投票。

words.enDefinition: a small stepladder kept in the aisles for reaching top shelves

examples.en: Grab the step stool to reach the oversized atlases on the top shelf.
examples.zh: 拿「取书梯凳」去够书架顶上的大开本地图册。

examples.en: Every aisle in the stacks has a step stool bolted near the end panel.
examples.zh: 书库每排书架末端都固定着一架「取书梯凳」。

words.enDefinition: end the broadcast of your screen to the meeting

examples.en: Remember to stop sharing before you open your grades tab.
examples.zh: 打开成绩页面之前，记得先「停止共享」。

examples.en: He forgot to stop sharing, so the whole class watched him browse job listings.
examples.zh: 他忘了「停止共享」，全班都看到他在浏览招聘信息。

words.enDefinition: all A grades in every course for a term or year

examples.en: She pulled off straight A's while working twenty hours a week.
examples.zh: 她每周打工二十小时还做到了「全A」。

examples.en: Two semesters of straight A's lifted my cumulative GPA back above 3.7.
examples.zh: 两个学期的「全A」把我的累计绩点重新拉回3.7以上。

words.enDefinition: an exaggerated version of an argument, easy to attack

examples.en: Calling the theory useless is a straw man; the paper never claimed that much.
examples.zh: 说这套理论一无是处是「稻草人谬误」，原论文可没夸下这么大的海口。

examples.en: The TA showed us how a straw man hides the real disagreement between the two authors.
examples.zh: 助教向我们演示了「稻草人论证」如何掩盖两位作者真正的分歧。

words.enDefinition: a per-student fee that funds clubs and campus events

examples.en: Part of every student activity fee goes back to registered clubs like ours.
examples.zh: 每份「学生活动费」中都有一部分会拨给像我们这样的注册社团。

examples.en: The activity fee committee decides how the student activity fee is split each year.
examples.zh: 活动费委员会决定每年「学生活动费」如何分配。

words.enDefinition: a service supporting students in disputes with university offices

examples.en: Student advocacy helped me when my scholarship was suddenly cancelled.
examples.zh: 奖学金突然被取消时，「学生权益服务」帮了我大忙。

examples.en: The student advocacy office explains your rights in plain language.
examples.zh: 「学生权益服务处」会用平实的语言解释你的权利。

words.enDefinition: a trained staff member who speaks up for students in disputes

examples.en: A student advocate sat with me during the meeting with housing.
examples.zh: 和住宿部门开会时，一位「学生权益顾问」陪在我身边。

examples.en: The student advocate can review your complaint letter before you send it.
examples.zh: 投诉信寄出前，「学生权益顾问」可以帮你把关。

words.enDefinition: the university office responsible for student life outside classes

examples.en: Housing questions go to student affairs, not to your academic department.
examples.zh: 住宿方面的问题要找「学生事务」部门，而不是你的院系。

examples.en: She works in student affairs and helps organize campus events.
examples.zh: 她在「学生事务」部门工作，帮忙组织校园活动。

words.enDefinition: a campus branch of a national professional or honor society

examples.en: Our student chapter of the engineering society sends delegates to the national conference.
examples.zh: 我们工程学会的「学生分会」派代表参加全国大会。

examples.en: Starting a student chapter gives you access to the society's journals and mentors.
examples.zh: 建立「学生分会」就能使用学会的期刊和导师资源。

words.enDefinition: a smaller elected council handling campus student affairs and events

examples.en: The student council organizes the winter ball and the club awards night.
examples.zh: 「学生会」负责组织冬季舞会和社团颁奖之夜。

examples.en: Student council meetings are open, so any student can raise a concern.
examples.zh: 「学生会」会议对所有人开放，任何学生都能提出关切。

words.enDefinition: the number of students per faculty member at a school

examples.en: A low student-faculty ratio means smaller classes and easier access to professors.
examples.zh: 「师生比」低意味着班级更小，也更容易约到教授。

examples.en: The engineering school advertises a student-faculty ratio of ten to one.
examples.zh: 工学院宣传自己的「师生比」为十比一。

collocations: student-faculty ratio of ten to one

words.enDefinition: the elected body representing students to the university administration

examples.en: Student government allocates the activity fee budget among registered clubs.
examples.zh: 「学生自治会」负责在注册社团间分配活动费预算。

examples.en: She ran for student government to improve funding for small clubs.
examples.zh: 她竞选「学生自治会」，想为小社团争取更多经费。

words.enDefinition: the official guide to university rules, offices, and procedures

examples.en: The student handbook lists every deadline and each office contact.
examples.zh: 「学生手册」列出了所有截止日期和各部门联系方式。

examples.en: Search the student handbook before emailing a question to the registrar.
examples.zh: 给注册办提问之前，先查查「学生手册」。

words.enDefinition: the photo card that proves you are a student on campus

examples.en: Replace a lost student ID card at the campus services desk for a small fee.
examples.zh: 「学生证」丢了可以去校园服务台补办，要交一点手续费。

examples.en: Your student ID card doubles as your library card and meal card.
examples.zh: 「学生证」同时也是你的图书卡和饭卡。

collocations: replace a lost student ID card

words.enDefinition: the unique number that identifies you in university systems

examples.en: Quote your student ID number in every email you send to the registrar.
examples.zh: 给注册办发的每封邮件都要写上你的「学号」。

examples.en: The clerk asked for my student ID number before pulling up my file.
examples.zh: 柜员先要了我的「学号」，才调出我的档案。

words.enDefinition: the official files a university keeps about each student

examples.en: The registrar can update your name in student records after you submit the form.
examples.zh: 提交表格后，注册办可以把你的名字更新到「学籍档案」里。

examples.en: Student records are confidential, so staff will not share them without your consent.
examples.zh: 「学籍档案」是保密的，未经你同意，工作人员不会外传。

words.enDefinition: an elected student who votes in the campus senate

examples.en: Student senators debated a new funding formula for three meetings straight.
examples.zh: 「学生参议员」们连续三次会议都在辩论新的经费分配方案。

examples.en: Each college of the university elects two student senators annually.
examples.zh: 学校每个学院每年选出两名「学生参议员」。

words.enDefinition: a building housing many student support offices under one roof

examples.en: Everything from counseling to tutoring is booked through the student services center.
examples.zh: 从心理咨询到学业辅导，都要通过「学生服务中心」预约。

examples.en: New students should visit the student services center during orientation week.
examples.zh: 新生应该在迎新周去一趟「学生服务中心」。

collocations: located in the student services center

words.enDefinition: your current standing at the university, such as active or withdrawn

examples.en: A leave of absence changes your student status to inactive for that term.
examples.zh: 休学后，你该学期的「学籍状态」会变为不活跃。

examples.en: Employers often call the university to verify a graduate's student status and degree.
examples.zh: 雇主常会打电话给学校，核实毕业生的「学籍状态」和学位。

words.enDefinition: the main student building for clubs, events, and services

examples.en: The student union is open until midnight, so club meetings run late.
examples.zh: 「学生会馆」开放到午夜，所以社团活动经常开到很晚。

examples.en: You can buy discounted movie tickets at the student union front counter.
examples.zh: 你可以在「学生会馆」前台买到打折的电影票。

collocations: hang out in the student union

words.enDefinition: a planned short rest that keeps long study sessions sustainable

examples.en: The union hosts a study break with free hot chocolate at eight.
examples.zh: 八点学生会馆举办「学习间歇」活动，提供免费热巧克力。

examples.en: Take a study break every ninety minutes to stay focused.
examples.zh: 每九十分钟安排一次「学习间歇」，能帮你保持专注。

words.enDefinition: a fellow member paired with you for revision and support

examples.en: New members get a study buddy before the first midterm each fall.
examples.zh: 每年秋天第一次期中考前，新成员都会配到一名「学习搭档」。

examples.en: My study buddy and I review lecture slides together every Sunday.
examples.zh: 我和「学习搭档」每周日一起过一遍讲义幻灯片。

collocations: pair up with a study buddy

words.enDefinition: a small individual desk with walls for distraction-free solo study

examples.en: Grad students can request a locked study carrel for the whole semester.
examples.zh: 研究生可以申请一学期的带锁「自习隔位」。

examples.en: I plug in at a study carrel because the walls block every distraction.
examples.zh: 我喜欢在「自习隔位」学习，挡板能挡住一切干扰。

words.enDefinition: a summary listing what a course exam will cover

examples.en: The professor posted a study guide listing every topic on the final.
examples.zh: 教授上传了一份「复习指南」，列出了期末考的所有考点。

examples.en: Our class built a shared study guide so nobody missed a key concept.
examples.zh: 全班合写了一份共享「复习指南」，谁都不会漏掉重点概念。

collocations: a study guide for the final

words.enDefinition: a casual space with couches where quiet talking and snacks are okay

examples.en: The fourth-floor study lounge lets you talk quietly and grab coffee.
examples.zh: 四楼「自习休息区」可以轻声聊天、喝咖啡。

examples.en: We held our group meeting in the study lounge instead of a booked room.
examples.zh: 我们小组会就放在「自习休息区」开，不用订研讨室。

words.enDefinition: reserving a group room through the library's online system

examples.en: Study room booking opens seven days in advance on the library website.
examples.zh: 「研讨室预订」在图书馆官网上提前七天开放。

examples.en: My study room booking vanished because I forgot to confirm within an hour.
examples.zh: 我一小时内没确认，那次「研讨室预订」就被系统取消了。

words.enDefinition: a planned block of time spent studying, alone or with others

examples.en: We booked a pod for a three-hour study session tonight.
examples.zh: 我们今晚订了研讨舱，来一场三小时的「自习」。

examples.en: A quiet study session before eight is worth losing an hour of sleep.
examples.zh: 八点前安静地「自习」一场，少睡一小时也值。

words.enDefinition: a short class teaching effective reading, memory, and revision techniques

examples.en: The study skills workshop covers active recall and spaced repetition.
examples.zh: 「学习技巧工作坊」会讲主动回忆和间隔重复这些方法。

examples.en: I attended a study skills workshop right before midterms started.
examples.zh: 期中考开始前，我参加了一次「学习技巧工作坊」。

collocations: sign up for the study skills workshop

words.enDefinition: your usual personal place to sit and work on campus

examples.en: The window seats on level six are my favorite study spot.
examples.zh: 六楼靠窗的位置是我最喜欢的「自习地点」。

examples.en: Everyone guards their study spot during finals, so arrive before the crowd.
examples.zh: 期末人人守着自己的「自习宝座」，你得赶在人流前到。

words.enDefinition: a librarian specializing in one department's research materials

examples.en: Email the subject librarian for chemistry if the databases overwhelm you.
examples.zh: 如果数据库用得晕头转向，就写信给化学「学科馆员」。

examples.en: Our subject librarian saved my thesis by digging up a 1970s survey report.
examples.zh: 「学科馆员」帮我挖出一份70年代的调查报告，救了我的论文。

words.enDefinition: send a formal report about a service problem through official channels

examples.en: Submit a complaint through the online form and keep the reference number.
examples.zh: 通过在线表格「提交投诉」，并保存好查询编号。

examples.en: You can submit a complaint anonymously, but staff cannot reply to you.
examples.zh: 可以匿名「提交投诉」，但工作人员就没法回复你了。

collocations: submit a complaint within ten days

words.enDefinition: a staff advisor helping students plan studies and campus life

examples.en: My success coach helped me balance a part-time job with coursework.
examples.zh: 「成功教练」帮我平衡兼职和课业。

examples.en: Book a success coach session through the student services portal.
examples.zh: 通过学生服务门户，预约一次「成功教练」面谈。

words.enDefinition: a box or online form collecting ideas from students

examples.en: Drop your ideas in the suggestion box outside the union office.
examples.zh: 把想法投进学生会办公室外的「意见箱」。

examples.en: The suggestion box led to a new evening shuttle route.
examples.zh: 「意见箱」里的一条建议，促成了新增的夜间班车路线。

collocations: post a note in the suggestion box

words.enDefinition: the highest Latin honor for near-perfect academic records

examples.en: Only a handful of graduates receive summa cum laude each year.
examples.zh: 每年只有极少数毕业生能获得「最优等毕业荣誉」。

examples.en: She finished first in her class and earned summa cum laude honors.
examples.zh: 她以全班第一的成绩获得了「最优等毕业荣誉」。

words.enDefinition: a final evaluation that determines the course grade

examples.en: The final project is the course's only real summative assessment.
examples.zh: 期末项目是这门课唯一真正的「终结性评估」。

examples.en: Unlike quizzes, summative assessments cannot be retaken just for practice.
examples.zh: 和小测不同，「终结性评估」不能为了练手而重考。

words.enDefinition: the long holiday between the spring and fall semesters

examples.en: On-campus jobs post their openings for summer break in April.
examples.zh: 校内岗位四月就会发布「暑假」招聘。

examples.en: Use summer break to retake the course you failed in spring.
examples.zh: 「暑假」可以重修春季挂掉的课程。

words.enDefinition: finishing requirements at the end of the summer term

examples.en: After one failed course, he chose summer graduation instead of spring.
examples.zh: 一门课挂掉后，他选择了「夏季毕业」而不是春季毕业。

examples.en: Summer graduation lets students walk at the following spring commencement ceremony.
examples.zh: 选择「夏季毕业」的学生可以参加来年春季的学位授予典礼。

words.enDefinition: short summer term for catching up on credits

examples.en: Taking statistics during summer session leaves my fall schedule lighter.
examples.zh: 「夏季学期」先修统计，秋季课表就轻松些。

examples.en: Summer session classes are condensed, so expect assignments due almost daily.
examples.zh: 「夏季学期」课程很紧凑，几乎每天都要交作业。

words.enDefinition: to oversee a student's research or a team's work

examples.en: Professor Weiss supervises six thesis students during this academic year.
examples.zh: 韦斯教授本学年「指导」六名写论文的学生。

examples.en: During experiments, each lab supervisor also supervises the undergraduate students.
examples.zh: 实验期间，「实验室主管」还要监督本科生操作。

words.enDefinition: a regular one-on-one meeting with your thesis supervisor

examples.en: Bring a short written agenda to each of your supervision meetings.
examples.zh: 每次「导师面谈」都带一份简短书面提纲。

examples.en: My supervision meetings have moved from Tuesday mornings to Thursdays.
examples.zh: 我的「导师面谈」从周二上午改到了周四。

words.enDefinition: peer-led group study sessions attached to difficult courses

examples.en: Supplemental instruction sessions for organic chemistry run twice a week.
examples.zh: 有机化学的「同伴导修课」每周上两次。

examples.en: Students who attend supplemental instruction regularly tend to score higher.
examples.zh: 坚持上「同伴导修课」的学生，成绩往往更高。

words.enDefinition: employees who keep offices running, like assistants and clerks

examples.en: Support staff handle the photocopying, room scheduling, and form signatures.
examples.zh: 复印、订教室、表格签字都由「行政支持人员」办理。

examples.en: Thank the support staff during finals week; they are swamped.
examples.zh: 期末周也请感谢「行政支持人员」，他们忙得不可开交。

words.enDefinition: extra papers, like letters or records, attached to an application

examples.en: Attach supporting documents such as bank letters or medical notes.
examples.zh: 请附上银行证明或医疗记录等「佐证材料」。

examples.en: Your appeal is stronger with supporting documents from the professor.
examples.zh: 有教授出具的「佐证材料」，申诉会更有力。

words.enDefinition: drop one course while adding another in one step

examples.en: You can swap a course in one step without losing your other seats.
examples.zh: 「换课」一步到位，不会丢掉其他课的名额。

examples.en: I decided to swap a course so my job shifts wouldn't clash with labs.
examples.zh: 我决定「换课」，这样上班时间就不会和实验课冲突了。

words.enDefinition: building entry granted by tapping your student card at doors

examples.en: Swipe access to the lab is activated after your safety training.
examples.zh: 完成安全培训后，实验室的「刷卡通行」才会开通。

examples.en: My swipe access stopped working, so I asked the desk to reset it.
examples.zh: 我的「刷卡通行」失灵了，就请服务台帮我重置。

words.enDefinition: to change a course's grading scheme to pass or fail

examples.en: You can switch to pass/fail until the midpoint of the semester.
examples.zh: 学期过半之前你都可以「改为合格制」。

examples.en: I switched to pass/fail in philosophy after the second midterm disaster.
examples.zh: 第二次期中考砸之后，我把哲学课「换成合格制」了。

collocations: switch to pass/fail before the deadline
switch to pass/fail for one elective

words.enDefinition: a live online class where everyone attends at the same time

examples.en: The synchronous session is recorded for anyone in a different time zone.
examples.zh: 「同步课堂」会录像，方便不同时区的同学回看。

examples.en: Attendance counts only during the synchronous session, not the recordings.
examples.zh: 只有参加「同步课堂」才算出勤，看录像不算。

words.enDefinition: to write down a message for someone who is out

examples.en: The professor is teaching right now, but I can take a message.
examples.zh: 教授正在上课，我可以帮你「留言转达」。

examples.en: He asked the receptionist to take a message for Professor Diaz.
examples.zh: 他请接待员替他给迪亚兹教授「留个口信」。

words.enDefinition: pull a paper ticket to hold your place in line

examples.en: Take a number at the entrance and wait to be called.
examples.zh: 在入口处「取号」，然后等叫号。

examples.en: You need to take a number even for quick questions.
examples.zh: 就算是简单问题，也要先「取号」。

collocations: take a number from the dispenser

words.enDefinition: stop taking classes for one term without formally withdrawing

examples.en: Many students take a semester off to work and save money.
examples.zh: 很多学生「休一学期」去打工攒钱。

examples.en: If you take a semester off, confirm how it affects your full-time status.
examples.zh: 如果决定「休一学期」，要确认它对全日制身份的影响。

collocations: plan to take a semester off
take a semester off from classes

words.enDefinition: to state clearly which side or position you support

examples.en: The rubric rewards students who take a stance early and defend it with evidence.
examples.zh: 评分标准青睐早早「亮明立场」并用证据捍卫的学生。

examples.en: I used to sit on the fence, but the TA pushed me to take a stance.
examples.zh: 我从前不表态，助教推着我必须「选定立场」。

collocations: take a stance on the issue

words.enDefinition: to attempt an official test or exam

examples.en: You can take the exam in December or wait and take it in May.
examples.zh: 你可以十二月「参加考试」，也可以等到五月再考。

examples.en: International students take the exam on campus with their passports as identification.
examples.zh: 留学生「参加考试」时用护照核验身份。

words.enDefinition: to arrange extra time to finish a course's remaining work

examples.en: I asked to take an incomplete after mononucleosis wrecked my exam schedule.
examples.zh: 单核细胞增多症打乱了我的考试安排，我申请了「未完成成绩」。

examples.en: Professors usually approve taking an incomplete only with documented emergencies.
examples.zh: 教授通常只对有证明的紧急情况批准「办理未完成成绩」。

collocations: take an incomplete in a course

words.enDefinition: an exam completed alone over several days off campus

examples.en: Our professor gave us a forty-eight-hour take-home exam over the weekend.
examples.zh: 教授给我们布置了一个周末进行、限时四十八小时的「带回家完成的考试」。

examples.en: Even for a take-home exam, working with classmates breaks the honor code.
examples.zh: 即使是「带回家完成的考试」，与同学合作也违反荣誉准则。

words.enDefinition: to disagree strongly and say so openly

examples.en: I take issue with the sampling method, not with the authors' overall goal.
examples.zh: 我对抽样方法「持异议」，并非针对作者的总体目标。

examples.en: She took issue with the way the TA framed the migration question.
examples.zh: 她对助教提出移民问题的方式「表示异议」。

words.enDefinition: an event where students perform singing, dancing, or comedy acts

examples.en: The international society's talent show is the highlight of culture week.
examples.zh: 国际学生社团的「才艺表演会」是文化周的高光环节。

examples.en: Sign up for a three-minute slot at the talent show by Friday.
examples.zh: 想上「才艺表演会」，周五前报名三分钟的节目档。

words.enDefinition: to keep speaking while another person is still talking

examples.en: The two presenters kept talking over each other until the moderator stepped in.
examples.zh: 两位展示者一直「盖过对方的说话声」，直到主持人出面才停。

examples.en: Talking over quieter classmates is the fastest way to lose goodwill in a seminar.
examples.zh: 在研讨课上「盖过安静同学的声头」，是败光好感的最快方式。

words.enDefinition: a prepared idea you plan to raise in discussion

examples.en: I keep three talking points on an index card in case my nerves hit.
examples.zh: 我在索引卡上备好三条「发言要点」，以防临场紧张。

examples.en: Her talking points covered the paper's method, sample, and one missing variable.
examples.zh: 她的「论点要点」覆盖了论文的方法、样本和一个遗漏变量。

words.enDefinition: to damage your grade average severely in one term

examples.en: Overloading eighteen credits can tank your GPA if you also work nights.
examples.zh: 如果晚上还打工，修满18个学分可能「拖垮绩点」。

examples.en: One failed lab course won't tank your GPA if you retake it promptly.
examples.zh: 实验课挂一科，只要及时重修，就不会「拖垮绩点」。

collocations: tank your GPA in one semester
worried it would tank your GPA

words.enDefinition: the grade average you aim to reach by a deadline

examples.en: Set a target GPA of 3.5 for the year and plan courses backward from it.
examples.zh: 把全年「目标绩点」定为3.5，再倒推排课。

examples.en: My target GPA for graduation is 3.6, so this term I need a 3.7.
examples.zh: 我的毕业「目标绩点」是3.6，所以这学期得拿3.7。

words.enDefinition: the hanging cord ornament attached to a graduation cap

examples.en: The tassel hangs on the right side until degrees are awarded.
examples.zh: 学位授予之前，「流苏」一直垂在帽子右侧。

examples.en: Many graduates keep their tassel as a souvenir after the ceremony.
examples.zh: 很多毕业生典礼后把「流苏」留作纪念。

words.enDefinition: a prize recognizing excellent university teaching

examples.en: Professor Duval has won the university's top teaching award twice.
examples.zh: 杜瓦尔教授两度获得校级「教学奖」。

examples.en: Students nominate their professors for the teaching award every April.
examples.zh: 每年四月，学生都可以提名「教学奖」人选。

collocations: nominate a professor for a teaching award

words.enDefinition: a grad student or new PhD hired to teach a course

examples.en: Each section of the big lecture has a teaching fellow leading discussions.
examples.zh: 大课的每个小班都有一名「教学研究员」带讨论。

examples.en: Teaching fellows grade for the professor and hold weekly help sessions.
examples.zh: 「教学研究员」帮教授批改并主持每周答疑。

words.enDefinition: the number of courses a professor teaches each term

examples.en: Her teaching load is two courses plus one graduate seminar.
examples.zh: 她的「授课工作量」是两门课加一门研究生研讨课。

examples.en: Professors with heavy teaching loads hold fewer weekly office hours.
examples.zh: 「授课任务」重的教授，每周答疑时间也更少。

collocations: a teaching load of two courses

words.enDefinition: the way a professor runs classes and explains ideas

examples.en: Her teaching style mixes short lectures with group problem-solving tasks.
examples.zh: 她的「教学风格」是短讲加小组解题。

examples.en: Ask older students about a professor's teaching style before enrolling.
examples.zh: 选课前先向学长打听教授的「教学风格」。

words.enDefinition: a game or exercise that helps members trust and cooperate

examples.en: Each retreat opens with team-building activities so new and old members mix quickly.
examples.zh: 每次休整营都以「团建活动」开场，让新老成员迅速熟络。

examples.en: The escape room team-building activity revealed who the natural planners were.
examples.zh: 密室逃脱这种「团建活动」最能看出谁天生擅长统筹。

words.enDefinition: the player who leads and organizes a sports team

examples.en: The team captain schedules scrimmages and reminds everyone about practice times.
examples.zh: 「队长」负责约练习赛，并提醒大家训练时间。

examples.en: Our team captain votes on rule changes at the intramural league meeting.
examples.zh: 我们的「队长」在校内联赛会议上参与修改规则的投票。

words.enDefinition: a shared meal a sports team holds before big games

examples.en: The team dinner before the championship is a pasta night at our captain's place.
examples.zh: 锦标赛前的「队内聚餐」是队长家的意面之夜。

examples.en: Coach cancelled practice so we could make the team dinner on time.
examples.zh: 教练取消了训练，好让我们准时赶上「队内聚餐」。

words.enDefinition: to separate tangled ideas or causes to see each clearly

examples.en: The seminar teased apart three different meanings of 'freedom' in the text.
examples.zh: 研讨课把文本中“自由”的三层含义逐一「梳理辨析」。

examples.en: Tease apart the two claims before deciding whether they actually conflict.
examples.zh: 先「拆解辨析」这两个论断，再判断它们是否真的冲突。

words.enDefinition: a quick test of camera, sound, and internet before an online session

examples.en: Do a tech check with your group the night before the presentation.
examples.zh: 展示前一晚，和小组一起做一次「设备检查」。

examples.en: The professor holds a five-minute tech check before every online exam.
examples.zh: 每次线上考试前，教授都会安排五分钟「设备检查」。

collocations: a quick tech check before class
do a tech check with the group

words.enDefinition: a permanent-track job leading to a tenure review

examples.en: She accepted a tenure-track position right after finishing her postdoc.
examples.zh: 博士后一结束，她就接受了「终身教职轨道」的岗位。

examples.en: Tenure-track faculty usually teach fewer courses than adjunct instructors do.
examples.zh: 「终身教职轨道」的教师课时通常比兼职讲师少。

words.enDefinition: a professor with a permanent contract that is hard to end

examples.en: A tenured professor cannot be fired just for unpopular research views.
examples.zh: 「终身教授」不会因研究观点不受欢迎而被解雇。

examples.en: Tenured professors sometimes teach the odd elective nobody else wants.
examples.zh: 有些冷门选修课只有「终身教授」愿意教。

words.enDefinition: the official start and end dates of each term

examples.en: You should always check the term dates before booking flights home.
examples.zh: 订回国机票前，一定要查「学期起止日期」。

examples.en: The term dates page lists every deadline for the year.
examples.zh: 「学期起止日期」页面列出了全年所有截止日。

collocations: term dates for the academic year

words.enDefinition: the fixed period an elected officer serves a club

examples.en: The term of office runs from May until the following April.
examples.zh: 「任期」从五月持续到次年四月。

examples.en: Each officer serves a one-year term of office before stepping down.
examples.zh: 每位干事担任一届「任期」后就会卸任。

words.enDefinition: Check whether a proposed reading is supported by the text or other evidence.

examples.en: We used the closing paragraph to test an interpretation that came up in the seminar.
examples.zh: 我们用最后一段来「检验一种解读」，这个解读是在研讨课上提出的。

examples.en: To test an interpretation, try explaining how it accounts for the change in the narrator's tone.
examples.zh: 要「检验一种解读」，可以试着解释它如何说明叙述者语气的改变。

collocations: test an interpretation against the evidence
test an interpretation of the passage
use a quotation to test an interpretation

words.enDefinition: exam nerves strong enough to hurt performance

examples.en: Deep breathing before the paper helps many students manage test anxiety.
examples.zh: 发卷前的深呼吸能帮很多学生缓解「考试焦虑」。

examples.en: Her test anxiety eased noticeably after several timed practice exams.
examples.zh: 做了几次限时模拟测试后，她的「考试焦虑」明显减轻了。

words.enDefinition: an approved site where standardized exams are run

examples.en: Book a test center seat early, because weekend slots fill fast.
examples.zh: 尽早预订「考点」考位，周末的名额很快就满了。

examples.en: Arrive at the test center an hour early with your identification.
examples.zh: 提前一小时带好证件到「考点」。

words.enDefinition: a planned method for attacking exam questions

examples.en: A simple test-taking strategy is answering the easy questions first.
examples.zh: 一个简单的「应试策略」是先做容易的题。

examples.en: The learning center runs workshops on test-taking strategies before finals.
examples.zh: 学习中心在期末前开设「应试策略」工作坊。

words.enDefinition: to try something small first to gauge reactions

examples.en: Test the waters with one short comment before launching into a full argument.
examples.zh: 在抛出完整论证之前，先用一句简短发言「试探一下」。

examples.en: She tested the waters by asking a question instead of giving her whole opinion.
examples.zh: 她没有直接亮出完整观点，而是先提了个问题「试探反应」。

collocations: test the waters with a question
test the waters in a new class

words.enDefinition: the office that supervises exams for students with accommodations

examples.en: Students with approved accommodations take their exams at the testing center.
examples.zh: 有便利安排的学生在「考试服务中心」参加考试。

examples.en: Reserve a seat at the testing center for each scheduled exam.
examples.zh: 每场排定的考试都要在「考试服务中心」预订座位。

collocations: take an exam at the testing center

words.enDefinition: a polite closing after someone helps you

examples.en: Thank you for your time, Professor — I'll revise the draft tonight.
examples.zh: 「感谢您抽时间」，教授，我今晚就改好草稿。

examples.en: She closed her email with thank you for your time and consideration.
examples.zh: 她在邮件结尾写上「感谢您抽时间」，并请教授斟酌。

collocations: thank you for your time and consideration
thank the professor for the meeting

words.enDefinition: a short written message thanking someone

examples.en: Send a thank-you note after a professor writes your recommendation.
examples.zh: 教授写完推荐信后，记得送一张「致谢便条」。

examples.en: A handwritten thank-you note stands out more than an email.
examples.zh: 手写的「致谢便条」比邮件更显心意。

collocations: a thank-you note to the professor

words.enDefinition: used to add a contrasting point after acknowledging something

examples.en: The method is elegant; that said, the sample is too small to generalize.
examples.zh: 这个方法很漂亮；「话虽如此」，样本太小，难以推广。

examples.en: I admire the theory. That said, applying it to our campus data seems forced.
examples.zh: 我欣赏这套理论，「尽管如此」，把它套在校内数据上仍显生硬。

collocations: that said, the evidence is thin

words.enDefinition: a calm, certified dog brought to campus to comfort students

examples.en: Therapy dogs visit the library on the last day of finals.
examples.zh: 期末最后一天，图书馆会有「治疗犬」互动活动。

examples.en: Petting a therapy dog for ten minutes lowered my stress before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前撸了十分钟「治疗犬」，我的压力小多了。

words.enDefinition: the professor who supervises your thesis from start to finish

examples.en: My thesis advisor meets with me every other Thursday afternoon.
examples.zh: 「论文导师」每隔一周的周四下午与我见面。

examples.en: Choose a thesis advisor whose research matches your topic closely.
examples.zh: 选择研究方向与你课题高度契合的「论文导师」。

words.enDefinition: the final date for submitting your completed thesis

examples.en: The thesis deadline for spring graduation this year is April tenth.
examples.zh: 今年春季毕业的「论文截止日期」是四月十日。

examples.en: She requested an extension two days before the thesis deadline.
examples.zh: 她在「论文截止日期」前两天申请了延期。

words.enDefinition: the oral examination where a committee questions your thesis

examples.en: Her thesis defense is scheduled for the first Friday of May.
examples.zh: 她的「论文答辩」安排在五月第一个周五。

examples.en: During the thesis defense, the committee asked about her sampling method.
examples.zh: 「论文答辩」中，委员会追问了她的抽样方法。

words.enDefinition: a delay on public release of a thesis, often for patents

examples.en: A one-year thesis embargo protects the team's pending patent application.
examples.zh: 一年的「论文保密期」可以保护团队待批的专利申请。

examples.en: She placed her thesis embargo so journals could publish first.
examples.zh: 她设置了「论文保密期」，好让期刊先行发表。

words.enDefinition: the research plan approved before thesis work begins

examples.en: The committee approved her thesis proposal with two minor revisions.
examples.zh: 委员会批准了她的「论文开题报告」，只需两处小修改。

examples.en: A strong thesis proposal defines the question, methods, and timeline.
examples.zh: 一份好的「论文开题报告」要界定问题、方法和时间表。

words.enDefinition: handing in the finished thesis by the official deadline

examples.en: Online thesis submission opens two weeks before the spring deadline.
examples.zh: 在线「论文提交」在春季截止日期前两周开放。

examples.en: Late thesis submission requires a petition to the graduate school.
examples.zh: 逾期「论文提交」需要向研究生院提交申请。

words.enDefinition: to suggest something casually to see if the group likes it

examples.en: Someone threw out an idea about debating the ethics code, and it stuck.
examples.zh: 有人「随口抛出一个想法」，要辩论伦理守则，结果被采纳了。

examples.en: Feel free to throw out an idea even if it sounds half-finished.
examples.zh: 哪怕想法听着半生不熟，也尽管「抛出来」。

collocations: throw out an idea for discussion

words.enDefinition: the amount of practice or meeting time a club expects

examples.en: Ask about the time commitment before joining, since some teams train daily.
examples.zh: 加入前先问清「时间投入」，有些队伍每天都要训练。

examples.en: The club lists a five-hour weekly time commitment in its recruitment flyer.
examples.zh: 社团在招新传单上写明了每周五小时的「时间投入」。

words.enDefinition: overlap between two courses you want to take

examples.en: The portal rejected my add because of a time conflict with statistics.
examples.zh: 因为和统计课「时间冲突」，系统拒绝了我的加选。

examples.en: Ask about an exception if the time conflict is only fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 如果「时间冲突」只有十五分钟，可以申请豁免。

words.enDefinition: a short class on planning weekly schedules and deadlines

examples.en: The time management workshop shows you how to plan a weekly schedule.
examples.zh: 「时间管理工作坊」教你怎样安排每周的日程。

examples.en: Sign up for the time management workshop through the services portal.
examples.zh: 通过服务门户报名「时间管理工作坊」。

collocations: register for the time management workshop

words.enDefinition: assigned registration start time issued by some universities

examples.en: My time ticket says I can register Thursday at nine sharp.
examples.zh: 我的「选课时间票」显示周四九点整可以开始选课。

examples.en: Students with more credits get an earlier time ticket for registration.
examples.zh: 学分多的学生能拿到更早的「选课时间票」。

words.enDefinition: an exam run against a strict countdown

examples.en: The timed exam closes automatically once the countdown hits zero.
examples.zh: 倒计时一归零，「限时考试」就会自动关闭。

examples.en: Practice under a timed exam setting before the real online test.
examples.zh: 正式在线测试前，先按「限时考试」模式练一遍。

words.enDefinition: used before defending someone or something against criticism

examples.en: To be fair, the study never claimed its sample represented the whole country.
examples.zh: 「说句公道话」，这项研究从未声称样本能代表全国。

examples.en: To be fair, the first-year presenter handled our toughest question better than expected.
examples.zh: 「平心而论」，这位大一展示者应对最刁钻问题的表现超出预期。

collocations: to be fair to the author

words.enDefinition: all points available across a course's assignments

examples.en: There are 1,000 total points in this class, and the final is 300.
examples.zh: 这门课「总点数」是1000，期末占300。

examples.en: I added my scores and divided by the total points to get 84 percent.
examples.zh: 我把得分加起来除以「总点数」，得到84%。

words.enDefinition: an instructor known for awarding lower grades than expected

examples.en: Professor Nguyen is a tough grader, so an A in her seminar means something.
examples.zh: Nguyen教授「给分很严」，所以她研讨课的A含金量很高。

examples.en: Check Rate My Professors to see who is a tough grader before enrolling.
examples.zh: 选课前上评师网站看看哪位是「给分严格的老师」。

words.enDefinition: a student who leads campus visits and answers questions

examples.en: Our tour guide was a junior who knew every building's history.
examples.zh: 我们的「参观向导」是大三学生，知道每栋楼的历史。

examples.en: The tour guide kept the group together near the busy crosswalk.
examples.zh: 在繁忙的路口，「参观向导」把队伍重新聚拢起来。

words.enDefinition: a block preventing transcript release until issues are resolved

examples.en: There is a transcript hold on my account from an unpaid fee.
examples.zh: 因为一笔未缴费用，我的账户被设了「成绩单冻结」。

examples.en: The registrar lifted the transcript hold once the fine was settled.
examples.zh: 罚款结清后，注册处解除了「成绩单冻结」。

collocations: a transcript hold for unpaid fees

words.enDefinition: an official note printed on transcripts about discipline or awards

examples.en: A suspension can leave a transcript notation that employers may see.
examples.zh: 停学处分可能在成绩单上留下雇主能看到的「备注」。

examples.en: Dean's list semesters show up as a positive transcript notation.
examples.zh: 登上优秀生名单的学期会在成绩单上留下正面「备注」。

words.enDefinition: the ordering process for copies of your academic record

examples.en: Submit a transcript request online and allow three business days.
examples.zh: 在线提交「成绩单申请」，并预留三个工作日。

examples.en: Her transcript request was delayed because of an old library fine.
examples.zh: 一笔旧的图书馆罚款耽误了她的「成绩单申请」。

words.enDefinition: a copying mistake made when grades or credits were recorded

examples.en: A transcription error turned my B into a D on the official record.
examples.zh: 官方记录上的一次「誊录错误」把我的B错登成了D。

examples.en: Report the transcription error to the registrar with your graded exam attached.
examples.zh: 附上批改后的试卷，向教务处报告这处「录入错误」。

collocations: a transcription error on the transcript

words.enDefinition: credits accepted from another college or exam scores

examples.en: My AP scores gave me transfer credit for two intro courses.
examples.zh: 我的 AP 成绩换到了两门入门课的「转学分」。

examples.en: Transfer credits count toward your degree but not your GPA.
examples.zh: 「转学分」计入学位，但不计入绩点。

words.enDefinition: the GPA carried in from a school you attended earlier

examples.en: My transfer GPA from community college reset when I entered the university.
examples.zh: 进入本校后，社区学院的「转入绩点」就清零重算了。

examples.en: Some scholarships combine your transfer GPA with your current institutional GPA.
examples.zh: 有些奖学金会把「转学前绩点」和本校绩点合并计算。

words.enDefinition: a student moving to this university from another college

examples.en: As a transfer student, I had to submit transcripts from two colleges.
examples.zh: 作为「转学生」，我提交了两所学校的成绩单。

examples.en: Transfer students often lose a few credits when they move.
examples.zh: 「转学生」转校时常常损失一些学分。

words.enDefinition: a reduced public transport fare offered to students

examples.en: Show your student card to get the transit discount on buses.
examples.zh: 坐公交时出示学生证，就能享受「交通优惠」。

examples.en: The transit discount applies to monthly passes, not single tickets.
examples.zh: 「交通优惠」只适用于月票，不包括单程票。

words.enDefinition: a prepaid card letting students ride city public transport

examples.en: Your student transit pass covers city buses and the light rail.
examples.zh: 学生「公交通行卡」可以坐市内公交和轻轨。

examples.en: Pick up your transit pass at the services center with your ID.
examples.zh: 带上证件，到服务中心领取「公交通行卡」。

words.enDefinition: use a browser tool to display a page in another language

examples.en: I translate the page to double-check deadlines written in complicated English.
examples.zh: 我会「翻译网页」，核对写得复杂的截止时间。

examples.en: Right-click and translate the page if the instructions feel unclear.
examples.zh: 如果说明看不太懂，就右键「翻译网页」。

words.enDefinition: a question designed to mislead careless readers

examples.en: The last item was a trick question with two nearly identical options.
examples.zh: 最后一题是道「陷阱题」，两个选项几乎一模一样。

examples.en: Read every word twice, because trick questions love absolute words like always.
examples.zh: 每个词都要读两遍，「陷阱题」最爱用 always 这类绝对词。

words.enDefinition: a cup awarded to the winner of a club competition

examples.en: The intramural trophy sits in the clubroom window for everyone to see.
examples.zh: 校内联赛「奖杯」摆在社团活动室窗边，人人可见。

examples.en: We engraved last season's trophy with every member's name after the final.
examples.zh: 决赛后我们把每位成员的名字都刻在了上个赛季的「奖杯」上。

words.enDefinition: a statement you mark as true or false

examples.en: Ten true-false questions open the quiz, so read each statement carefully.
examples.zh: 测验开头是十道「判断题」，每句都要仔细读。

examples.en: Watch for words like always and never in true-false questions.
examples.zh: 做「判断题」时，要警惕 always 和 never 这类绝对词。

words.enDefinition: a test session used to pick players for a team

examples.en: Soccer tryouts run all week, and cuts happen after Friday's scrimmage.
examples.zh: 足球「选拔」持续一周，周五练习赛后就公布名单。

examples.en: He spent the whole summer training for basketball tryouts in November.
examples.zh: 为了十一月的篮球「选拔」，他练了一整个夏天。

words.enDefinition: hand something you found to staff so the owner can collect

examples.en: Please turn in a found item at the front desk of any campus building.
examples.zh: 捡到别人的东西，请到任何一栋楼的前台「上交拾获物品」。

examples.en: Turn in a found item quickly so staff can contact the owner.
examples.zh: 捡到东西要尽快「上交拾获物品」，工作人员好联系失主。

collocations: turn in a found item immediately
turn in a found item at the desk
encourage students to turn in found items

words.enDefinition: switch on the text track while watching a video or call

examples.en: Turn on captions if the guest speaker's accent is hard to follow.
examples.zh: 嘉宾口音难懂的话，就「打开字幕」。

examples.en: Remember to turn on captions before you start the recorded lecture.
examples.zh: 看回放之前记得先「打开字幕」。

collocations: turn on captions for the video

words.enDefinition: switch on your webcam so others can see you

examples.en: Turn on your camera during presentations because it's basic politeness here.
examples.zh: 做展示时要「打开摄像头」，这是基本礼貌。

examples.en: The professor asks us to turn on our cameras when we ask questions.
examples.zh: 教授要求提问的时候「打开摄像头」。

collocations: turn on your camera for attendance
ask students to turn on their cameras
turn on your camera when speaking

words.enDefinition: move the cap tassel from one side to the other

examples.en: Graduates turn the tassel from right to left after receiving degrees.
examples.zh: 毕业生领学位后把「流苏」从右拨到左。

examples.en: The dean asked everyone to turn the tassel together at the end.
examples.zh: 院长请大家最后一起「拨流苏」。

collocations: turn the tassel to the left
ask graduates to turn the tassel

words.enDefinition: a booked session with a tutor for one course

examples.en: I booked a tutoring appointment for Wednesday to go over my chemistry notes.
examples.zh: 我的「辅导预约」约在周三，一起过一遍化学笔记。

examples.en: Cancel your tutoring appointment if you cannot make it, or you lose priority.
examples.zh: 去不了就取消「辅导预约」，否则会失去优先排课资格。

words.enDefinition: a club activity pairing volunteers with students who need academic help

examples.en: The tutoring program pairs education majors with middle schoolers needing math help.
examples.zh: 「辅导项目」把教育专业的志愿者与需要数学辅导的中学生配对。

examples.en: Volunteers in the tutoring program commit to one hour every Wednesday.
examples.zh: 「辅导项目」的志愿者每周三要投入一小时。

words.enDefinition: your opinion offered modestly, as if it hardly matters

examples.en: Just my two cents, but the paper's conclusion overstates what the data shows.
examples.zh: 「一点浅见」，这篇论文的结论夸大了数据能支撑的范围。

examples.en: Can I offer my two cents on the debate question before we vote?
examples.zh: 表决之前，我能就这道辩题「说两点自己的浅见」吗？

words.enDefinition: a login needing your password plus a code from your phone

examples.en: The portal added two-factor authentication, so keep your phone nearby at login.
examples.zh: 门户系统加了「两步验证」，登录时手机要放在身边。

examples.en: Two-factor authentication texts me a code every time I open the LMS.
examples.zh: 每次打开学习管理系统，「两步验证」都会给我发验证码。

words.enDefinition: a reserve item that must return to the desk within two hours

examples.en: Most textbooks on course reserves are two-hour reserves that cannot leave the building.
examples.zh: 课程预留教材大多是「两小时短借」，不能带出馆。

examples.en: It's a two-hour reserve, so scan the chapters you need before returning it.
examples.zh: 这是「两小时短借」，还之前抓紧把需要的章节拍下来。

words.enDefinition: bags and laptops left alone on seats, often removed by staff

examples.en: Unattended belongings get removed after thirty minutes when the floor is full.
examples.zh: 满座时，「无人看管的物品」三十分钟后就会被清走。

examples.en: A sign warns that unattended belongings may be moved to the front desk.
examples.zh: 标示上写着：「无人看管的物品」可能被移到前台保管。

words.enDefinition: notes or devices not permitted in an exam room

examples.en: Having unauthorized materials on your desk, even a phone, triggers an incident report.
examples.zh: 桌面上出现「违禁材料」，哪怕是手机，都会被记录上报。

examples.en: The invigilator confiscated the unauthorized materials and noted the incident.
examples.zh: 监考员没收了「违禁材料」，并记录了这次违规。

collocations: unauthorized materials in the exam room

words.enDefinition: lost property nobody has collected after a set period

examples.en: Unclaimed items are donated to a local charity after sixty days.
examples.zh: 「无人认领的物品」六十天后会捐给当地慈善机构。

examples.en: The lost and found shelf is crowded with unclaimed items before breaks.
examples.zh: 假期前，失物招领架上堆满了「无人认领的物品」。

words.enDefinition: a student status before committing to a field

examples.en: Entering as an undeclared major gives you time to explore subjects.
examples.zh: 以「未定专业」入学让你有时间探索各个学科。

examples.en: About one in five freshmen starts college with an undeclared major.
examples.zh: 大约五分之一的新生入学时是「未定专业」。

words.enDefinition: the staff member handling undergraduate course issues

examples.en: The undergraduate coordinator resolved my registration hold early this morning.
examples.zh: 「本科生事务协调员」一早帮我解除了选课冻结。

examples.en: The undergraduate coordinators know all the exception policies by heart.
examples.zh: 「本科生事务协调员」对各种例外政策了如指掌。

words.enDefinition: a first university degree taken before graduate study

examples.en: International students often need an undergraduate degree before applying to master's programs.
examples.zh: 国际学生通常要先取得「本科学位」才能申请硕士项目。

examples.en: He finished his undergraduate degree in three years by taking summer courses.
examples.zh: 他通过修暑期课程，三年就拿完了「本科学位」。

words.enDefinition: to score below your usual level on an assessment

examples.en: I underperformed on the physics final and finished with a B minus.
examples.zh: 我物理期末「发挥失常」，最后拿了B减。

examples.en: Students who underperform once often rebound strongly on the next assessment.
examples.zh: 一次「发挥失常」的学生常在下次考核强势反弹。

collocations: underperform relative to the class average

words.enDefinition: the offices and officials that run the university day to day

examples.en: The university administration announced new fee deadline rules for spring.
examples.zh: 「校方行政部门」公布了春季缴费截止日期的新规定。

examples.en: Emails from university administration always end with an office contact.
examples.zh: 「校方行政部门」的邮件总会在末尾附上部门联系方式。

words.enDefinition: the official school email account the university assigns you

examples.en: The registrar only replies to messages sent from your university email address.
examples.zh: 注册办只回复从你的「校园邮箱地址」发去的邮件。

examples.en: Check your university email address daily because official notices go there first.
examples.zh: 每天查看你的「校园邮箱地址」，官方通知都先发到那里。

words.enDefinition: a day the whole university closes, apart from public holidays

examples.en: The counter is closed on every university holiday, so plan visits carefully.
examples.zh: 每个「学校假期」柜台都关门，办事要规划好。

examples.en: Deadlines never fall on a university holiday; they move to the next day.
examples.zh: 截止日期不会落在「学校假期」，会顺延到下一个工作日。

words.enDefinition: an official rule that applies across the whole university

examples.en: University policy requires all appeals in writing, not by phone.
examples.zh: 按「校规」，申诉必须书面提交，不能打电话。

examples.en: Parking fines are handled separately under a different university policy.
examples.zh: 停车罚款按另一项「校规」单独处理。

words.enDefinition: the top leader of a whole American university

examples.en: The university president opens commencement with a short welcome speech.
examples.zh: 「大学校长」会在毕业典礼上简短致辞。

examples.en: Students rarely meet the university president outside of big ceremonies.
examples.zh: 除了大型典礼，学生很少能见到这位「校长」。

collocations: welcome speech by the university president

words.enDefinition: to make an online course unit available to students

examples.en: The instructor will unlock a module each Monday, starting with the course overview.
examples.zh: 讲师从课程概览开始，每周一「解锁一个模块」。

examples.en: Our course uses quiz results to unlock a module once we complete its prerequisites.
examples.zh: 我们的课以测验成绩为依据，修完前置内容后就会「解锁一个模块」。

collocations: unlock a module on a set date
unlock a module after a quiz
unlock a module for enrolled students

words.enDefinition: a grade printout you can generate yourself from the portal

examples.en: Print an unofficial transcript for the scholarship interview this afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午的奖学金面试要用的「非官方成绩单」，自己在系统里打印就行。

examples.en: The advisor reviewed my unofficial transcript before approving my extra courses.
examples.zh: 导师在批准我加选课程前，查看了我的「非官方成绩单」。

words.enDefinition: a plain GPA where every course counts the same

examples.en: My unweighted GPA is 3.0, but weighted it climbs to 3.4.
examples.zh: 我的「非加权绩点」是3.0，加权后升到3.4。

examples.en: Some scholarships ask for the unweighted GPA exactly as printed on the transcript.
examples.zh: 有些奖学金要求填报成绩单上原样的「非加权绩点」。

words.enDefinition: confirm that the original ruling stands after review

examples.en: The committee will uphold a decision if the original process was fair.
examples.zh: 如果原流程公正，委员会通常会「维持原决定」。

examples.en: If they uphold the decision, your last option is the ombudsperson.
examples.zh: 如果委员会「维持原决定」，你最后的途径是找申诉专员。

words.enDefinition: send your finished work to the course site for grading

examples.en: Upload an assignment early because the site slows down right before deadlines.
examples.zh: 作业要早点「上传」，截止前网站会特别卡。

examples.en: I uploaded the assignment from the library an hour before it was due.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆「上传了作业」，赶在截止前一小时。

collocations: upload an assignment as a PDF
upload the assignment before the deadline

words.enDefinition: advanced course usually taken by juniors and seniors

examples.en: Most upper-level courses require special instructor permission for sophomore students.
examples.zh: 大多数「高年级课程」要求大二学生先取得教师许可。

examples.en: Save some upper-level courses for senior year when you know your focus.
examples.zh: 留几门「高年级课程」到大四，那时你更清楚方向。

words.enDefinition: the British degree class just below a first, called a 2:1

examples.en: Most graduate programs in the UK ask for upper second-class honours.
examples.zh: 英国大多数研究生项目要求申请者持有「二等一学位」。

examples.en: She missed first-class honours but still graduated with upper second-class honours.
examples.zh: 她与一等学位失之交臂，但仍以「二等一学位」毕业。

words.enDefinition: the top student who gives the farewell speech

examples.en: The valedictorian closed the ceremony with a heartfelt farewell speech.
examples.zh: 「毕业生代表」以一段深情的告别演讲为典礼收尾。

examples.en: Being named valedictorian requires the highest GPA in the class.
examples.zh: 被评为「毕业生代表」需要全年级最高的绩点。

words.enDefinition: the official university team that competes against other schools

examples.en: Playing for a varsity team means year-round training and travel schedules.
examples.zh: 进「校队」意味着全年训练和出行日程。

examples.en: She balanced engineering coursework with varsity team commitments every fall.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，她都要在工程课业和「校队」任务之间找平衡。

words.enDefinition: the chief executive of a UK or Commonwealth university

examples.en: In Australia, the vice chancellor is the head of the university.
examples.zh: 在澳大利亚，「英联邦大学校长」是大学的最高负责人。

examples.en: The vice chancellor announced several new scholarships for international students.
examples.zh: 这位「英联邦大学校长」宣布为国际学生增设奖学金。

words.enDefinition: the officer who steps in when the president is away

examples.en: The vice president chaired the meeting while the president was at a conference.
examples.zh: 社长外出参会期间，例会由「副社长」代为主持。

examples.en: As vice president, she oversees recruitment and the new member mentoring program.
examples.zh: 作为「副社长」，她负责招新和新成员带教项目。
