words.enDefinition: technology for holding meetings with live video over the internet

examples.en: Every department here uses different video conferencing tools for seminars.
examples.zh: 这里每个系研讨会用的「视频会议」软件都不一样。

examples.en: Good lighting makes a bigger difference than an expensive video conferencing camera.
examples.zh: 灯光好坏比贵的「视频会议」摄像头影响更大。

words.enDefinition: a short recorded video submitted instead of a written reply

examples.en: Our intro assignment is a one-minute video response for the class to watch.
examples.zh: 自我介绍作业是一分钟的「视频回复」，全班都会看。

examples.en: The professor allows a video response instead of a written discussion post.
examples.zh: 教授允许用「视频回复」代替书面讨论帖。

words.enDefinition: the full written text of a recorded lecture or video

examples.en: Search the video transcript for 'midterm' to find the exam review section.
examples.zh: 在「视频文字稿」里搜midterm，直接跳到期末复习那段。

examples.en: Reading the video transcript is faster than rewatching a fifty-minute lecture.
examples.zh: 读「视频文字稿」比重看五十分钟的课快多了。

words.enDefinition: a fake image that hides the room behind you on camera

examples.en: I set a virtual background because my dorm wall is completely bare.
examples.zh: 我设了个「虚拟背景」，因为宿舍墙壁实在太空了。

examples.en: Her virtual background kept glitching every time she waved her hands.
examples.zh: 她一挥手，「虚拟背景」就不停地闪。

collocations: blur or use a virtual background

words.enDefinition: an online space where a class meets, talks, and shares work

examples.en: Our seminar meets in a virtual classroom with a shared whiteboard.
examples.zh: 我们研讨课在「虚拟教室」上，还带共享白板。

examples.en: The virtual classroom keeps a chat log you can read after class.
examples.zh: 「虚拟教室」会保留聊天记录，下课后可以回看。

words.enDefinition: a simulated experiment you complete online instead of in a lab

examples.en: The chemistry department swapped the titration for a virtual lab this week.
examples.zh: 化学系这周把滴定实验换成了「虚拟实验」。

examples.en: The virtual lab lets you retry the experiment without wasting reagents.
examples.zh: 「虚拟实验」可以反复重做，不浪费试剂。

words.enDefinition: office hours held over video call instead of in an office

examples.en: Virtual office hours fill up fast, so book a slot days ahead.
examples.zh: 「线上答疑」名额抢得很快，要提前几天预约。

examples.en: I asked my question during virtual office hours and shared my screen.
examples.zh: 我在「线上答疑」时提问，还共享了屏幕。

words.enDefinition: a professor temporarily teaching at another university

examples.en: A visiting professor from Oxford teaches our semantics course this term.
examples.zh: 本学期的语义学由牛津来的「客座教授」讲授。

examples.en: Visiting professors usually stay for only one or two semesters.
examples.zh: 「客座教授」通常只停留一到两个学期。

words.enDefinition: a researcher staying temporarily to do research at a university

examples.en: My supervisor is hosting a visiting scholar from Tsinghua this year.
examples.zh: 我的导师今年接待了一位清华来的「访问学者」。

examples.en: Visiting scholars can use the library just like regular faculty.
examples.zh: 「访问学者」可以像正式教师一样使用图书馆。

words.enDefinition: student enrolled temporarily from another institution

examples.en: As a visiting student, I could only register for open courses.
examples.zh: 作为「访问学生」，我只能选还有余位的课程。

examples.en: Visiting students usually apply through cross-registration to take courses here.
examples.zh: 「访问学生」通常通过跨校选课来这边上课。

words.enDefinition: the British oral examination defending a doctoral thesis

examples.en: Her viva lasted three hours with two external examiners present.
examples.zh: 她的「博士口试答辩」进行了三个小时，两位校外评审在场。

examples.en: He spent the summer preparing for his viva in chemistry.
examples.zh: 他整个夏天都在准备化学「博士口试答辩」。

words.enDefinition: a club whose members do community service projects together

examples.en: The volunteer club runs a weekend tutoring program at the public library.
examples.zh: 志愿者社团在市立图书馆运营周末「辅导项目」。

examples.en: Joining a volunteer club is an easy way to earn service hours.
examples.zh: 加入「志愿者社团」是攒服务时长的简单途径。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled block of time spent volunteering at an event

examples.en: I took the Saturday morning volunteer shift at the campus food pantry.
examples.zh: 我领了周六上午在校园食物分发站的「志愿班次」。

examples.en: Sign-up for volunteer shifts opens Monday, and popular slots fill within hours.
examples.zh: 「志愿班次」周一开放报名，热门时段几小时就满了。

collocations: sign up for a volunteer shift

words.enDefinition: the time spent waiting before you are served

examples.en: The wait time at the ID office is shortest on Friday mornings.
examples.zh: 周五早上补证办公室的「等候时间」最短。

examples.en: Check the website for current wait times before you walk over.
examples.zh: 过去之前，先上网查一下当前的「等候时间」。

words.enDefinition: to hold back until it is your proper moment to speak

examples.en: Learn to wait your turn instead of cutting across whoever is speaking.
examples.zh: 要学会「等轮到自己再发言」，别打断正在说话的人。

examples.en: I waited my turn all class, and then time ran out before I spoke.
examples.zh: 我整节课都「等着轮到自己」，结果下课铃响前没轮上。

collocations: wait your turn in the discussion

words.enDefinition: a space with seats for visitors who are waiting

examples.en: Please have a seat in the waiting area until the dean calls you.
examples.zh: 请在「等候区」稍坐，院长叫到再进去。

examples.en: The waiting area outside the professor's office has two chairs.
examples.zh: 教授办公室外的「等候区」摆着两把椅子。

words.enDefinition: queue for a full course when seats reopen

examples.en: Put yourself on the waitlist the moment a course shows full.
examples.zh: 课程一显示满员，就马上加入「候补名单」。

examples.en: I was seventh on the waitlist and still got in before Friday.
examples.zh: 我当时排在「候补名单」第七位，周五前还是选上了。

words.enDefinition: message telling you a waitlisted seat opened

examples.en: You have twenty-four hours to respond to a waitlist notification.
examples.zh: 收到「候补通知」后，你有二十四小时可以确认。

examples.en: Turn on email alerts so a waitlist notification never slips past.
examples.zh: 打开邮件提醒，就不会错过任何「候补通知」。

words.enDefinition: your spot in line for a full course

examples.en: My waitlist position improved to third after four students dropped.
examples.zh: 四位同学退课后，我的「候补位次」升到了第三。

examples.en: Check your waitlist position daily throughout the first week of class.
examples.zh: 开学第一周，每天都查看一下自己的「候补位次」。

words.enDefinition: officially cancel a charge as a one-time courtesy

examples.en: The supervisor agreed to waive a fine because the catalog showed wrong closing hours.
examples.zh: 由于目录里显示的闭馆时间有误，主管同意「免除罚款」。

examples.en: Ask nicely and they may waive a fine once per academic year.
examples.zh: 好好说明情况，每年一次他们可能会给你「免除罚款」。

collocations: waive a fine for a first offense

words.enDefinition: take part in the ceremony procession and stage walk

examples.en: International students can walk at commencement even before finishing their last credits.
examples.zh: 国际学生即使还没修完最后学分，也可以「毕业走台」。

examples.en: He will walk at commencement in May and finish his thesis in July.
examples.zh: 他会参加五月的典礼「毕业走台」，七月再完成论文。

collocations: be eligible to walk at commencement

words.enDefinition: a clinic service that treats patients without appointments

examples.en: The health center runs a walk-in clinic for minor illnesses.
examples.zh: 校医院设有处理小毛病的「免预约门诊」。

examples.en: I used the walk-in clinic when my sore throat got worse.
examples.zh: 嗓子疼加重的时候，我去看了「免预约门诊」。

words.enDefinition: a short first counseling chat without any prior booking

examples.en: No booking needed; the counseling center holds walk-in consultations every afternoon.
examples.zh: 无需预约，咨询中心每天下午都有「免预约咨询」。

examples.en: I tried a walk-in consultation first before committing to weekly sessions.
examples.zh: 我先试了一次「免预约咨询」，再决定要不要每周固定咨询。

words.enDefinition: a visit without an appointment, served when a slot frees up

examples.en: Walk-in visits are welcome on Tuesdays, but Wednesdays are appointment only.
examples.zh: 周二接受「无预约到访」，周三只办理预约。

examples.en: As a walk-in, I waited forty minutes behind booked students.
examples.zh: 作为「无预约到访」的人，我排在预约学生后面等了四十分钟。

words.enDefinition: fixed hours when staff see students without any booking

examples.en: The advisor's walk-in hours are Tuesdays and Thursdays from two to four.
examples.zh: 顾问的「免预约时段」是周二和周四下午两点到四点。

examples.en: During walk-in hours, no appointment is needed for quick questions.
examples.zh: 在「免预约时段」，问简单问题不需要预约。

words.enDefinition: to explain something step by step

examples.en: Could you walk me through the proof from yesterday's lecture?
examples.zh: 能「一步步讲解」一下昨天课上的证明吗？

examples.en: The registrar walked me through the transfer process on the phone.
examples.zh: 注册办在电话里「一步步指导」我办转学手续。

collocations: walk me through step by step

words.enDefinition: an official letter telling you that something must improve

examples.en: The warning letter arrived two weeks before the withdrawal deadline.
examples.zh: 「警告信」在退课截止日前两周寄到。

examples.en: Do not panic when a warning letter comes; read the listed steps first.
examples.zh: 收到「警告信」别慌，先看清信里列出的步骤。

words.enDefinition: a small slider that physically blocks your laptop camera

examples.en: I stuck a webcam cover on my laptop after reading about hackers.
examples.zh: 看到黑客盗号的新闻后，我在笔记本上贴了「摄像头遮挡片」。

examples.en: A webcam cover is cheap insurance against accidentally broadcasting your room.
examples.zh: 「摄像头遮挡片」很便宜，能防止不小心把房间直播出去。

collocations: a webcam cover over the lens

words.enDefinition: an online seminar with a speaker and a large remote audience

examples.en: The career center hosts a resume webinar every Thursday at noon.
examples.zh: 就业中心每周四中午办一场简历「网络研讨会」。

examples.en: Register for the webinar early because the Zoom room caps at three hundred.
examples.zh: 「网络研讨会」名额只有三百人，要趁早报名。

words.enDefinition: a deliberately hard course that filters out weaker majors

examples.en: Organic chemistry is the classic weed-out course for pre-med students.
examples.zh: 有机化学是预医学生公认的「筛选课」。

examples.en: Surviving the weed-out course felt better than the A itself.
examples.zh: 熬过那门「淘汰课」比拿到A本身还让人有成就感。

collocations: a weed-out course for the major

words.enDefinition: a regular gathering a club holds every week

examples.en: Our weekly meeting is Thursdays at seven in the student union lounge.
examples.zh: 我们的「每周例会」在周四晚七点，学生会休息室见。

examples.en: Attendance at the weekly meeting counts toward your service hour requirement.
examples.zh: 「每周例会」的出勤会计入你的服务时长要求。

words.enDefinition: a short weekly write-up reacting to the assigned reading

examples.en: A weekly reading response of three hundred words keeps everyone honest about the reading.
examples.zh: 每周三百词的「每周读书报告」让谁都不敢不读材料。

examples.en: My TA said my weekly reading response should argue a position, not just summarize.
examples.zh: 助教说我的「每周读书报告」应当论证立场，而不是单纯总结。

words.enDefinition: to add your opinion to a discussion already underway

examples.en: The professor usually waits ten minutes before weighing in with her own reading.
examples.zh: 教授通常先等十分钟，才「发表意见」说出自己的解读。

examples.en: Can I weigh in on the sampling question before we move to methodology?
examples.zh: 在进入方法论之前，我能就抽样问题「发表一下看法」吗？

words.enDefinition: an average where components count for different percentages

examples.en: Your course grade is a weighted average, with the final worth forty percent.
examples.zh: 你的单科成绩是「加权平均」，期末占四成。

examples.en: The weighted average of my quiz scores pulled the lab grade down.
examples.zh: 我小测分数的「加权平均」把实验成绩拉低了。

words.enDefinition: a GPA that gives courses different influence by credit hours

examples.en: Weighted GPA favors students who take more credit hours of hard courses.
examples.zh: 「加权绩点」更偏向选修高学分难课的学生。

examples.en: The registrar's office publishes how it computes your weighted GPA each term.
examples.zh: 教务处公布每学期「加权绩点」的计算方法。

words.enDefinition: a large sign greeting visitors at a club event

examples.en: The welcome sign at the fair listed our meeting times and QR code.
examples.zh: 招新会上的「迎宾指示牌」写着我们的活动时间和二维码。

examples.en: Volunteers repainted the welcome sign on the clubroom door this weekend.
examples.zh: 志愿者周末把社团活动室门上的「迎宾牌」重新画了一遍。

words.enDefinition: a simulated GPA showing outcomes if future grades change

examples.en: The advisor ran a what-if GPA to show how an A in orgo changes everything.
examples.zh: 导师跑了一个「模拟绩点」，展示有机化学拿A能改变什么。

examples.en: Use the what-if GPA tool before deciding to take the hard elective.
examples.zh: 决定选那门硬核选修前，先用「假设绩点」工具算一算。

words.enDefinition: lose your internet connection suddenly in the middle of something

examples.en: The dorm Wi-Fi cut out during the quiz, and support took an hour.
examples.zh: 做测验时宿舍「Wi-Fi断了」，报修等了一个小时。

examples.en: My Wi-Fi cut out right as the professor was explaining the curve.
examples.zh: 教授讲到评分曲线一半，我的「Wi-Fi断了」。

words.enDefinition: a desk beside a large window, prized for daylight and views

examples.en: I snagged a window seat overlooking the quad before eight this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上八点前我抢到了俯瞰草坪的「靠窗座位」。

examples.en: Window seats go first, so head straight upstairs when the doors open.
examples.zh: 「靠窗座位」最先被占，开门后要直接上楼。

words.enDefinition: a polite opener before disagreeing with someone senior

examples.en: With all due respect, Professor Hayes, the study contradicts the claim you just made.
examples.zh: 「恕我直言」，海斯教授，这项研究与您刚才的论断相矛盾。

examples.en: With all due respect to the panelist, her answer skipped the question entirely.
examples.zh: 「恕我冒昧」，这位嘉宾的回答完全绕开了问题本身。

collocations: with all due respect to the author
with all due respect, I disagree

words.enDefinition: last day to withdraw with a W instead of a grade

examples.en: The withdrawal deadline this term is the Friday of week nine.
examples.zh: 本学期的「退课截止日」是第九周的周五。

examples.en: After the withdrawal deadline, you'll receive a real letter grade.
examples.zh: 过了「退课截止日」，就会拿到正式的课程评分。

words.enDefinition: the official form used to drop a course or leave the term

examples.en: Pick up a withdrawal form at the department office before Friday.
examples.zh: 周五前去系办公室领取「退课申请表」。

examples.en: Both the instructor and advisor must sign your withdrawal form.
examples.zh: 「退课申请表」需要任课教师和导师共同签字。

words.enDefinition: a math question wrapped in a real-life story

examples.en: The exam had four word problems about interest rates and loan payments.
examples.zh: 考试里有四道关于利率和还贷的「应用题」。

examples.en: Underline the numbers first, because word problems hide the real question in the story.
examples.zh: 先把数字划出来，「应用题」会把真正的问题藏在情节里。

words.enDefinition: to solve a problem starting from the result

examples.en: For the discount problem, work backwards from the final price.
examples.zh: 做打折那道题时，从最终价格「倒推解题」。

examples.en: Working backwards helped her spot exactly where the equation went wrong.
examples.zh: 「倒推解题」帮她准确找到了方程出错的地方。

words.enDefinition: a request form for maintenance or repairs

examples.en: Submit a work order for the jammed door in the computer lab.
examples.zh: 机房门卡住了，提交一张「维修工单」。

examples.en: The work order status shows the repair is scheduled for Tuesday.
examples.zh: 「工单」状态显示维修定在周二。

words.enDefinition: to gather courage slowly before doing something frightening

examples.en: It took me three weeks to work up the nerve to disagree with the professor.
examples.zh: 我花了三周才「鼓起勇气」反驳教授。

examples.en: I finally worked up the nerve to read my response aloud in front of everyone.
examples.zh: 我终于「鼓起勇气」，在全班面前朗读了我的读书回应。

collocations: work up the nerve to speak
work up the nerve to ask

words.enDefinition: to manage a messy discussion and keep it productive

examples.en: The TA wrangled a discussion that kept sliding into complaints about the workload.
examples.zh: 讨论一再滑向对作业量的抱怨，助教费力地「驾驭着讨论」。

examples.en: Wrangling a discussion of twelve opinionated students is harder than it looks.
examples.zh: 「驾驭一场讨论」，让十二个主见十足的学生好好说话，比看上去难得多。

collocations: wrangle a discussion back on topic

words.enDefinition: an academic paper submitted as proof of research writing ability

examples.en: The program asks for a writing sample of fifteen pages.
examples.zh: 该项目要求提交十五页的「写作样本」。

examples.en: He submitted an edited seminar paper as his writing sample.
examples.zh: 他提交了一篇修改过的研讨课论文作为「写作样本」。

words.enDefinition: the official written outcome explaining what was approved or denied

examples.en: The written decision listed the reasons the petition was denied.
examples.zh: 「书面决定」列出了特批申请被拒的原因。

examples.en: Ask for a written decision so you can plan the next appeal step.
examples.zh: 索要「书面决定」，方便规划下一步申诉。

words.enDefinition: a formal ask put in writing instead of spoken

examples.en: Submit a written request if the phone queue keeps failing you.
examples.zh: 电话一直打不通，就提交「书面申请」。

examples.en: Keep a copy of every written request for your own files.
examples.zh: 每份「书面申请」都自己留一份底。

words.enDefinition: posting your reply under a different topic than you meant

examples.en: I posted my question in the wrong thread and nobody answered for days.
examples.zh: 我把问题「发错了帖」，好几天没人回复。

examples.en: The TA moved my comment because it was in the wrong thread.
examples.zh: 助教把我的评论移走了，因为我「发错了主题帖」。

words.enDefinition: said when someone's audio is choppy and hard to hear

examples.en: The professor said, 'You're breaking up,' and asked me to move closer to the router.
examples.zh: 教授说「你声音断断续续」，让我离路由器近一点。

examples.en: Everyone typed 'you're breaking up' in the chat until she reconnected.
examples.zh: 聊天区里刷满了「你声音断断续续」，直到她重新连上。

words.enDefinition: said to tell someone the class can't hear them speaking

examples.en: The TA finally typed 'You're on mute' in the chat after thirty silent seconds.
examples.zh: 整整三十秒没声音后，助教终于在聊天区打出「你静音了」。

examples.en: I froze when the professor said 'You're on mute' because I thought my mic had died.
examples.zh: 教授说「你静音了」时我愣住了，还以为麦克风坏了。

collocations: type you're on mute in the chat
tell the speaker they're on mute

words.enDefinition: a live class held over the Zoom video app

examples.en: My eight a.m. Zoom class lets us keep cameras off, honestly a blessing.
examples.zh: 早上八点的「Zoom网课」可以不开摄像头，简直是福音。

examples.en: I joined the Zoom class from the library because my roommate was blasting music.
examples.zh: 室友放歌太吵，我去图书馆上了「Zoom网课」。

words.enDefinition: tiredness from staring at video calls all day

examples.en: By Friday afternoon my Zoom fatigue is so bad I can't process anything.
examples.zh: 到了周五下午，「视频会议疲劳」严重到我什么都听不进去。

examples.en: Back-to-back synchronous sessions gave the whole class Zoom fatigue by Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 一连上了几节同步课，到周五下午全班都出现了「视频会议疲劳」。

words.enDefinition: the clickable web address that takes you into a Zoom meeting

examples.en: The professor posted the Zoom link five minutes after class was supposed to start.
examples.zh: 该上课了教授才把「Zoom链接」发出来，晚了五分钟。

examples.en: Save the Zoom link to your calendar so you don't dig through email.
examples.zh: 把「Zoom链接」存进日历，省得到邮件里翻找。

words.enDefinition: a holding area where people wait until the host lets them in

examples.en: I sat in the Zoom waiting room for ten minutes because the professor was late.
examples.zh: 教授迟到了，我在「Zoom等候室」干等了十分钟。

examples.en: The TA admits everyone from the Zoom waiting room once the slides are ready.
examples.zh: 幻灯片放好以后，助教再把大家从「Zoom等候室」放进来。

collocations: wait in the Zoom waiting room
admit students from the waiting room
